text.body:
oṃ
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ
śrīśivarahasyākhyaḥ mahetihāsaḥ māheśvarākhyaḥ prathamāṃśaḥ
ṣaḍdarśanapāraṃgatānāṃ janakapūr brahmaśrī. sahajānandopādhyāyābhidhānāṃ mahānubhāvānāṃ sevayāsamāsāditavidyena marūvūr. gaṇeśa śāstriṇā
sarvatantrasvatantrāṇāṃ sarvatomukhaparyantānekakratubhirārādhitaparameśvarāṇāṃ paṃcanadakṣetramalaṃkṛtavatāṃ brahmaśrī. bālakṛṣṇaśāstriṇāṃ śiṣyeṣvanyatamena
varahūr. sundareśvara śāstriṇāca
samyak pariśodhitaḥ
devakoṭṭābhidhanagaravāstavyasya me. aru. nā. rāmanātha śreṣṭhivaryasya dravyasahāyena cennapattananagarasthena bi. e. padayutena ka. sadāśiva śreṣṭhivaryeṇa vāṇīnilaya mudrākṣaraśālāyāṃ
mudrito vijayatetarām
1913
śrīśivarahasyaprathamāṃśasya viṣayānukramaṇikā

pṛ0 1) śrīgaṇeśāyanamaḥ
śrīgurubhyonamaḥ
śrīśivarahasyākhyaḥ mahetihāsaḥ
prathamāṃśaḥ
sūtamuni saṃvādaḥ
[idaṃ prathamataḥślokadvayamapi pustakeṣu kvacinnadṛśyate |] śuklāṃbaradharaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaśivarṇaṃ caturbhujam | prasannavadanaṃ dhyāyetsarvavighnopaśāntaye || śirasāśivabhaktānāṃ [idaṃ prathamataḥślokadvayamapi pustakeṣu kvacinnadṛśyate |] pādāṃbujarajaḥkaṇān | vandāmahe vayannityaṃ vāsanādhvāntabhāskarān || purā māheśvare satre pravṛtte munayastadā | yadṛcchayā''gataṃ sūtaṃ paippalādaṃ hi satriṇaḥ || vājaśravasa āhustaṃ samavetā maharṣayaḥ | kṛṣṇājinottarāsaṃgā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ || tripuṇḍravilasatphālā rudrākṣāṃgadakaṃkaṇāḥ | yajñeśvaraṃ mahārudraṃ pūjayanto'dhvareṇa te || liṃge'gnihotre sūrye ca rudrasūktajapādarāḥ | pañcākṣarāvṛttiparāḥ śivanāmaparāyaṇāḥ || pañcakośātigaṃ devaṃ pañcāsyaṃ parameśvaram | dhyāyantaḥ parayā bhaktyā taṃ papracchurakalmaṣāḥ || saṃpūjyārghyāsanairbhojyaiḥ praśrayapraśnabhāṣaṇaiḥ | anyonyaṃ kuśalapraśnaiḥ praśrayāvanatāstadā ||
pṛ0 2) teṣāṃ kulapatirvṛddhaḥ prāha taṃ maunibhārgavaḥ |
maunibhārgavaḥ –
paippalāda sanāthāssmaḥ tvadāgamanato vayam || 8 || māheśvaraṃ yatassatraṃ pravṛttaṃ pārameśvaram | tvaṃ bhakto'tīva rudrasya skandanandīśasannibhaḥ || jaigīṣavyo muniḥ pūrvamūrdhvaretā pahātapāḥ | śaṃkarājñāprabhāvena skandādyatprāptavān śubham || puṇyaṃ śivarahasyākhyamitihāsottamottamam | triṇetrāpāracaritaṃ dvādaśāṃśasamanvitam || upāsatā tvayāpūrvaṃ manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ | bhaktyā tvananyayā śaṃbhostvayi yatproktavānsvayaṃ || yasmindadau haraḥ prītyā saṃsthiteṣu muniṣvapi | dvādaśāṃśayutaṃ sākṣādrahasyaṃ śivasaṃbhavam || śivaratnamahākośaṃ taddevyā hṛdayaṃgamam | skandāyācaṣṭa sā devī prītyā tena pradarśitam || śaṃkarasyā''jñayā sūtaguraute śāṃbhavottame | jaigīṣavyāyatatprādāt skandasskanditatārakaḥ || iti śuśruma vṛttāntaṃ tanno [nobrūhitvaṃ ghṛṇānidhe itipāṭhāntaram ||] brūhi kṛpādhikāt | sugopyamapi tadbrūhi yato bhaktā vayaṃ śive || triṇetrasucaritrāṇāṃ pātrabhūtā munīśvarāḥ | māheśvareṇa satreṇa śuddhagātrā vayaṃ sadā || sutrāmamānye loke'pi vāñchā no pātabhītitaḥ | gātre kalatre putrevā mitrevāsnehavarjitāḥ || viraktāśca vadāsmabhyaṃ rahasyaṃ śāṃbhavaṃ mudā | tvaṃ [tvaṃnojñānapradaḥ iti pustakāntare ||] bho jñānapradassākṣādguruḥ śivasamo mataḥ || tvaṃ no mātā pitāsmākaṃ vada tatkaruṇābalāt | itthaṃ sa paippalādo hi sūtaḥpṛṣṭomunīśvaraiḥ || uvāca prāñjalirvākyaṃ teṣāṃ bhaktyā sutoṣitaḥ | ananyaśaṃbhubhaktyāca jānanpātrañcatānapi ||
sūtaḥ –
pātraṃ bhavantaḥ kṛpayā maheśituḥ satreṇa dānaistapasopasadbhiḥ | pavitragātrāvabhṛtena dīkṣayā vedāntasārārthavicāraniṣṭhāḥ || 22 || śṛṇudhvamādyaṃ prathamāṃśametadyathā gururme bhagavān prasādabhāk | maheśvarasyāpratimaprabhāvo bhāvo bhavotkṛṣṭahṛdojhjhitāśaḥ [anvitāśaḥ iti pustakeṣukvacit ||] || 23 || jaigīṣavyamunistatāpa tapasā rudraṃ japaṃstuṣṭadhīḥ kaṣṭānapyasamīkṣya saṃyatamanā [saṃvṛtamanāḥ itipāṭhaḥ ||] varṣāyutaṃ vāyubhuk |
pṛ0 3) śiṣṭaḥ śrīśipiviṣṭapādakamaladhyāno viśiṣṭā'ntaro brahmiṣṭho hi gariṣṭhamadbhutataraṃ prāpa prasādaṃ harāt || 24 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe sūtamunisaṃvāde prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
jaigīṣavyasurasaṃvāde dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ
sūtaḥ – śatamukhaśikhivedaśākhā [śatamukhaśikhibhedaveda iti bhedaśabdasāhitye sugamatayārtho jñāyate |] śatamukhanutaṣaṇmukhāptabaṃdhuṃ | nabhaśikhasukhadaṃ mahebhavaktraṃ khagagatipaṃkajajātasaṃstutam [jastutaṃbhaje] || 1 ||
utphullāmalanīlanīrajamahāsihmāsanādhyāsitā pārāvārajagadvibodhacaturā vāṇī manohāriṇī | bho śaṃbho śiva sāṃba śaṃkara mahādevetitānāmṛtā- svādāsvādanavallakīmukharitānaṃdollasā pātu naḥ || 2 || pāpāgādhamahāṃbudherjanijarākallolapāraṃparī- majjajjantukadaṃbakaṃ karuṇayā pāraṃ paraṃ yogataḥ | śaṃbhoḥ satkathayā [sundarasatkathāsurasayā] sudhāsurasayā sannaukayā kevalaṃ saṃtīrṇantu karoti jantunivahaṃ satkarṇadhāro guruḥ || 3 || kālāvacchedayuktān vidhiharamurabhicchakrasūryenduvāyūn sṛṣṭvā taiḥ krīḍatīśo jagadudaradarīmadhyapadmaikasaṃsthaḥ | nīrūpo viśvarūpaḥ pramathagaṇavarairviśvakartryā jananyā heraṃbaskandayukto gururamaravaraḥ pūrvikaḥ pātu nityam || 4 || pañcāsyavaktrakamale [pañcāsyavaktrakamale ityayaṃślokaḥ saṃpūrṇatayā pustake nadṛśyate ||] makaraṃdametat pañcatvanāśanakaraṃ śrutipañcakaṃhi |
pṛ0 4) [puṇyaṃ śaivarahasyasāramadhunā pepīyatāṃmuktaye ityayaṃ pādaḥ arthānvayasyasamīcīnatvāt śārdūlavikrīḍitachando yuktatvāt vedeṣu prathitañca pañcakatayā ityasya ślokasyāsaṃpūrṇatvāccānenaiva ślokena yutasyāditi niścīyate | parantu granthasya paramārṣeyatvāt pustakadṛṣṭapādakramaṃ vipariṇamayituṃ navayamīśāmahe |]puṇyaṃ śaivarahasyasāramadhunā pepīyatāṃ muktaye | pañcāsyadhyānapūtā [pañcāsya dhyānapūtāḥ ityayaṃ pādopi pādatrayamapekṣate ākare tu na dṛśyate] dvijavaratilakāḥ pañcapāpairvihīnāḥ || 5 || vedeṣu prathitañca pañcakatayā bhūteṣu pañcasvapi kośe pañcakatontimaikavasateḥ śaṃbhoḥ kṛpākāraṇaṃ | śrutvā janmajarādiduḥkhanivahaiḥ [janmaprāpyamahītale bahuvidhaṃ pāpānikṛtvāmuhuḥ kāmakrodha iti pustakāntare dṛśyate ||] pañcatvahīno bhavet || 6 || durmāyālasitena pāpamatibhāgāyātyaho saṃsmṛtim tyaktvā śaṃkaranāmabodhitakathāpīyūṣapānojhjhitaḥ | kāmakrodhajarāvipattimaraṇaiḥ sauriṃ [sauriṃ=antakamityarthaḥ anena tadadhiṣṭhita narakayātanā lakṣyate |] vrajedduḥkhitaḥ svasyāsyāntaravarttipāyasavaraṃ tyaktvā''khumūtraṃ pibet || 7 ||
munayaḥ – sa kathaṃ tapasā devaṃ prasādya parameśvaram | jaigīṣavyassarvagurustaporāśiḥ śivārcakaḥ || kaṃ kāmamalabhatsūta taṃ no vistarato vada | śrotumicchāsti mahatī caritre śāṃbhave hi naḥ || vadādyakaruṇāmūrte śūlino'malasatkathāḥ [śūlinovilasatkathāḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] | sa vājaśravasāṃ vākyājjaharṣa parameśvaram || dhyātvā svahṛtpadmakośe jagādāgādhabodhadām | kathāṃkaluṣacittānāṃ tamaḥkāluṣyamuktaye ||
sūtaḥ – vāyurdodhūyate yadyudayamuḍugaṇo baṃbhramīti drutaṃ khe vahnirjājvalyate yanna ca salilanidhirmādhavīṃ dodhavīti | bhūryadvadbobhavīti sthiracaradhṛtaye tacca tādṛkca sarvaṃ svāyattāśeṣasattāsthitiyamanaparaṃ śaṃbhulīlottha muktam || 12 || śṛṇudhvaṃ munayassarve satriṇaḥ pūtamānasāḥ | jaigīṣavyatapaścaryākāraṇaṃ tāraṇaṃ nṛṇām ||
pṛ0 5) sa tapo'tapadatyugraṃ śāṃbhavaṃ vratamāsthitaḥ | himavacchikhare pūrvaṃ saṃvatsaraśatāṣṭakam || agnirityādibhirmantrairvimṛjyāṃgāni bhasmanā | tripuṇḍraphālassatataṃ kaṇṭhakakṣorubāhuṣu || dhṛtarudrākṣakoṭīro rudrākṣakavacāvṛtaḥ | pañcākṣaraparo nityaṃ rudrāvartanatatparaḥ || 16 || grīṣmepañcāgninirataḥ kevalaṃ salilāśanaḥ | varṣāsvākāśanilayo hemaṃte jalamadhyagaḥ || phalaparṇāśano nityaṃ varṣaṃ pavanapāraṇaḥ | kaṭadhūmāśano varṣaṃ varṣaṃ laṃbadadhaśśirāḥ || evaṃ tapasyatastasya jaigīṣavyamahāmuneḥ | varṣāyutamagāttīvraṃ rudravinyastacetasaḥ || vareṇācchandayadbrahmā taṃ viṣṇuḥ pākaśāsanaḥ | tasya te cittajijñāsāṃ kartuṃdevāvyavasthitāḥ || tānanālokayanvipro naiva kiñcidatho'rthayat | gaṃbhīrasāgarākāramalakṣyaṃ śivavallabham || jitendriyaṃ jitāhāramūrdhvaretasamavyayam | śivaliṃgārcanavyagraṃ pañcākṣarajapādaram || rudrasūktārthavijñānapravaṇaṃ saṃyatendriyam | haṃsārūḍhaḥ padmasaṃsthaśśārṅgadhṛggaruḍāsanaḥ || airāvatasamārūḍhaḥ pākaśāstramarairvṛtaḥ | tasya cittaṃ suvijñātumāgatāste muniṃ tadā || brahmā viṣṇustathā śakrassurāsuramarudgaṇāḥ | dhyāyantaṃ parameśānaṃ jaigīṣavyaṃ tadā dvijāḥ || svaṃ svaṃ vāhanamāruhya svasvālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ | tasyacittaparīkṣārthaṃ [śaivendraṃ taṃ surendrāste dṛṣṭvāvismayamāgatā iti kvacitpustake'dhikatayādṛśyate ||] brahmāvākyamathābravīt ||
brahmovāca –
vatsottiṣṭha mahābhāga jaigīṣavya mahāvrata | adeyaṃ tava nāstyeva trilokyāṃ tvattapasyayā || tvatsamo na munirbrahmannūrdhvaretā mahātapāḥ | rudrāvarttanaśīlaśca rudravinyastamānasaḥ || dyubrahmopendralokeṣu viharasvājarāmaraḥ | bhuṅkṣvabhogānyathākāmaṃ devabhogyānanuttamān || śakrasthāne'psarobhistvaṃ nandane viharājaraḥ | pibasvāmṛtamutkṛṣṭaṃ devaiḥ peyamanuttamam || viṣṇuloke tathā bhogānvaiṣṇavānbhuṃkṣvakevalam | nānāvidhairmahāyajñaiḥ prāpyaṃśakrasado'khilaiḥ || gavāṃ dānaistathānnādipradānaiṣṣaḍrasānvitaiḥ | deśe kāle ca pātre ca gṛhavastrādidānataḥ || pānīyaśālānivahairgharmakāle munīśvara | mahāṣoḍaśadānaiśca śuddhadravyārjitena ca || maṇṭapāṭṭālakaraṇairviprāṇāṃ sthāpanārcanaiḥ | udyānārāmakaraṇaiśchāyāvṛkṣādiropaṇaiḥ || kanyādānaiśca vividhairvratakṛcchrādibhirdvija | prāpyā lokāmadīyāhidhanyairmānuṣyavartmabhiḥ || teṣūtsavena bhogāṃstvaṃbhuṅkṣvaviprayathāsukham | ayaṃ śakro'marādhīśo varaṃ dātuṃ tavāgataḥ ||
pṛ0 6) karīndro yasya vahane caturdantassupāṇḍaraḥ | yassarvayajñe viprendrairāhūtassomapāyibhiḥ || sarvāsuravisaṃharttā kuliśaṃ yasya cāyudham | ahaṃ sarvajagatsraṣṭā bhāratīpatiruttamaḥ || matputrāssṛṣṭikartāro na kaścinmatsamo dvija | pulastyaḥ pulaho'triśca kaśyapo manurevaca || aṃgirā nārado dakṣo vītihotro mahāmuniḥ | nava prajānāṃpatayo yebhyassṛṣṭirvinirgatā || caturvaktrastvahaṃ sākṣādvarāndātuṃ tavāgataḥ | tataḥ prāhāṃbujābhākṣastaṃ muniṃcātigarvitaḥ ||
viṣṇuruvāca – ahamevākhilādhāraśśaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ | mamaśārṅgaravaṃ śrutvā daityendrā mūrchitā bhṛśam || sihmakolākṛtirahaṃ bhūtvā devānatoṣayam | hiraṇyākṣañca kaśipuṃ murañca madhukaiṭabhau || raṇe mayā hatā daityā rāvaṇādyā mahābalāḥ | lakṣmīpati rahaṃ sākṣāt kṣīrābdhirnilayo mama || śeṣo'nantaphaṇāmaulirmamatalpaṃ mahāmune | prabhābhāsitadikkuñjaṃ kaustubhaṃ mama vakṣagam || cakraṃ śatadaśāraṃ me daityāsṛṅmasṛṇaṃ kare | yatpakṣāghātapavanairullolāssaptasāgarāḥ || kādraveyaphaṇāratnarājidhāro hi vāhanam | mannābhikaṃdasaṃbhūtassākṣāllokapitāmahaḥ || madīyayaśasā vyāptaṃ jagadetaccarācaram | matprasādena sarveṣāṃ sidhyantyakhilasiddhayaḥ || tādṛśaṃ svadṛśā paśya tvatpurasthitamāśumām | tvatkāmaṃ pūrayāmyāśu tacchīghraṃ varayasvame || tvadīyatapasāvidvan prasādasumukho'smyaham | tadā sa viṣṇuvacasā jaigīṣavyo mahāmuniḥ || dṛṣṭvā prāhāmaraśreṣṭhānniṣkāmāntarasundaraḥ | kāmāridhyānanirdhūtaniṣkāmahṛdayo muniḥ ||
jaigīṣavyaḥ – yatproktaṃ tattathā viṣṇo tvayā padmāsanena ca | śakrasyāsya śrutaṃ sarvamaiśvaryaṃ lokavismayam || na vismāpayituṃśakyaṃniṣkāmasyamamāntaraṃ | yathonmūlayituṃ śakyaḥ kiṃ merurvāyunāmunā || viṣṇo tvadvacasā ceto na vicālayate mama | kaivartakanyākānīnadvijadaityanṛpārbhakāḥ || tavāvatāramāhātmyavettāro na vayaṃ hare | harapādāṃbujadhyānanirdhūtatamaso vayam || 55 || śaivendreṣu na te dhārṣṭyaṃ vidyate hi gadādhara | prāptakāmāvayaṃviṣṇo nityānityavivekinaḥ || yaḥ kāmānanusaṃdadhāti manasā prāpnoti lokānamūn brahmopendraśatakratuprabhṛtināṃ vāsastatobhraśyati |
pṛ0 7) prāgjanmānubhavena yoniṣu ciraṃ bhrāntastato vidyayā viśveśasya kṛpāvaśācchatatanuprānte vimukto bhavet || 57 || kiṃ vā brahmendraviṣṇuprabhṛtisurapadaiḥ puṇyaleśaikalabhyaiḥ kiṃ raṃbhādikayonibhoganicayaissrakcandanādyutsavaiḥ | pātāntāvadhisundaraiḥ kimadhamaiḥ kiṃ kāmanāviplutaiḥ yuṣmadrodhanayā nacālyati mano niṣkāmajāḥ śrotriyāḥ || 58 || saṃsārāpārasārapracuritamanaso nityanityāśca bhogāḥ kāmyante kāmibhirye satatabahurasāḥ kātarāḥ pāmarāste | śrīman dhīman parārthin sakalasuragaṇāḥ śrīśaśāṃkāṃśamauleḥ śrīmatpādābjayugmapraṇihitamanaso nirbhayāścāmarāste || 59 || narakamukhasukhānāṃ vyarthakolāhalānāmasukhamukhamatīnāṃ yadyapi ghnanti tatvam | harapadaniratānāṃ viśvabhūtātmanānnaḥ karaṇaviṣayabhogā naiva lūyanti viṣṇo || 60 || brahmā śakro bhavāṃśca prakṛtiparavaśāḥ paśya sarveśvarasya śrīśa śrīśaṃkarasyāgatisagatigativyomakeśasya [āgatisagatigativyomakeśasya iti padavibhāgo jñeyaḥ | āgamyata ityāgatiḥ karmaṇiktin upāsya iti yāvat sagatīnāṃ jñānināṃ gatiḥ prāpyabhūtaparamakāṣṭhārupāsā kāṣṭhā sā parāgatirityādi śrutiśatapratipādita iti bodhyam |] śaṃbhoḥ | tasyāyaṃ dāsadāsastripurapuraharaśrīśivasyāsya karttuḥ pāturharttuḥ prakarttuḥ śṛṇuta sumanaso nityamanyanna jāne || 61 || paśupativaradānāttatvasaṃprāptabhūteḥ paśuvaravaradānātkiṃ mama prāptihetuḥ | paśupati caraṇābjadhyānasanmānasaṃ me nahi khalu bhavatṛṣṇāpāradūraṃ haredyaḥ ||| 62 || tryakṣāṃghripravaṇaprasannamanaso lakṣyasya kiṃ me surai- rlakṣībhūtabhavatpadeṣu nitarāṃ vāñchā na me jāyate | kiṃ taccākṣatavīkṣaṇāsthiraciraṃ viśvantu viśveśvarā- jjātaṃ tatra muhurmuhuḥ pravilayaṃ yātyeva yātaṃ bhavet || 63 ||
pṛ0 8) rajjau kalpitadantaśūkasadṛśaṃ devā nakiñcijjagat jātañcāpi janiṣyamāṇamapivā bhūtaṃ hi rajjau bhramaḥ | tadvatsarpadaśopamānamiti yā dhīrvai paraṃ muktaye sā dhīścāpi nirantaraṃ bhagavataśśaṃbhoḥ kṛpāyāḥ phalam || 64 || nakvāpi spṛhayanti śaṃkarakathāpīyūṣapānātparam liṃgāliṃganapūtabhasmaniṭilā rudrākṣamālādharāḥ | puṇyāsteśatarudramadhyavilasannāmnāṃ padārthādarāḥ bhāvā bhāvukadivyajanmatapasā bhūmaṇḍale pāvanāḥ || 65 || mārāpāraśarāgrakuṇṭhanamahāsāraikadhāropalāḥ sārāsāravicāradhīrahṛdayādhaureyadhuryāssadā | pārāvāravikārasaṃsṛtimahāduḥkhāṃbudhestārakāḥ viśvādhīśvarapūjakāstuniyataṃ pāpaughasaṃhārakāḥ || 66 ||
sūtaḥ – jaigīṣavya mukhābjanissṛtamahodārotkaṭaṃ te madhu pītvā cāmaranāyakā madhutṛṣāsvānaṃditasvāntarāḥ | ūcuḥ prāñjalayastadā dvijavaraṃ brahmā mahendro hariḥ jñātvā tasya viniścayaṃ śivasamāsaktaṃ manaścāpi te || 67 ||
devāḥ – prāpyeśānapadāṃbujotthasumanāmodāttasanmānasaḥ tvaṃ vai śāṃbhavapuṃgavastava hṛdaṃ jñātuṃ pravṛttāssurāḥ | niṣkāmo'si niraṃkuśo'si bhagavan proktaṃ hi tat kṣamyatām svātmārāmatayā tvayaiva sakalā bhogāssadaivojhjhitāḥ || 68 || evaṃ te vibudhāḥ praśasya ca muniṃ cāliṃgya liṃgārcakaṃ dhanyāssmeti vadanti sundaragirāpyānandadhārāvṛtāḥ | śaivoktāmṛtavākyananditamanassvāntā mudā te dvijāḥ svaṃ svaṃ vāhanamādhiruhya tarasā gantuṃ manaścakrire || 69 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe jaigīṣavyasurasaṃvādo nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ 2|
pṛ0 9) jaigīṣavyasurasaṃvāde tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ
jaigīṣavyaḥ – śṛṇudhvaṃ brahmaviṣṇvādyā yanmānasyamahaitukam | nityaṃ sarvajñatā tasya devadevasya śūlinaḥ || yo vedāntaikasaṃvedyo yaṃ dhyāyanti mumukṣavaḥ | yasya niśvāsapavanā vedāścatvāra eva hi || yo brahmaviṣṇurudrāṇāṃ janakaḥ parameśvaraḥ | sūryasya janitā vahneścandracakrānilātmanām || na tasya kāraṇaṃ śaṃbhossa sarvasyāpi kāraṇam | yassamārādhyate viprairbhinnabhinnakriyādibhiḥ || yastvagnīṣomajaṃ sarvaṃ jagatpāti sanātanaḥ | asaṃgassarvabhūteṣu nirvikāro vikāriṣu || yaṃ sūkṣmabudhyā paśyanti svahṛdā vītarāgiṇaḥ | yo dhyānena japairyajñaistapasānāśakena ca || sa vetti vedyānakṣāṇi manovācāmagocaraḥ | yasmādbhūtāni jāyante yena jīvanti tānyapi || yatra līnāni kalpyante sa ekaḥ parameśvaraḥ | yastvapāṇirniraṃghriścāpyacakṣuścāpyathāśravāḥ || so'ntike sa hi dūrasthassabāhyābhyantare'pi ca | sasatyaṃ jñānamānando guṇairhīnaśca nirguṇaḥ || svatantraśca supūrṇaśca tena pūrṇamidaṃ jagat | sa nityaścetanānāñca patīnāṃ patirīśvaraḥ || yastvekassṛjatīśānaścarācaramidaṃ jagat | yathorṇanābhistantūnvai sṛjate grasate'pi ca || yasya rūpāparijñānāddehamātmeti manyate | yasya rūpāparijñānānmana ātmeti manyate || yasya rūpāparijñānātkhānicātmeti manyate | yasya rūpāparijñānādbhūtānyātmeti manyate || yasya rūpāparijñānātsarvamātmeti manyate | yasyākāśaśśarīraṃ hi cākāśo naiva vettitam || yasya bhūmissvarūpaṃ hi taṃ bhūmirnaiva vetti hi | yo manaścakṣurādīnāṃ niyaṃtā parameśvaraḥ || yasya bhāsā jagadbhāti saśakrānalavāyavaḥ | bhītyābhānti ca vāntyeva cetanānāṃ sacetanaḥ || yasya māyāvilasitaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam | sa māyī parameśānastenāvāsyamidaṃ jagat || yo'śarīro hyaliṃgaśca yamibhiḥ paridṛśyate | yasya vijñānamātreṇa sarvaṃ vijñātameva hi || jñānamātmā tvahaṃ brahma jñānaṃ śāntiranuttamā | sa ekaḥ paramātmāhi nehanānāsti kiñcana || sa eko jñānavānīśa īśanībhissa īśate | eka eva mahānrudraḥ puruṣo viśvato mukhaḥ || 20 || ta mekaṃ jñānamātmānaṃ tyaktvānyattadidaṃ jagat | yajjñānāddhṛdayagraṃthichedanaṃ jāyate nṛṇām || yasyaikatvaṃ hi vijñāya śokaṃ tarati mānavaḥ | sa eva jyotiṣāṃ jyotissa eva tamasāṃtamaḥ || sa ekassarvabhūteṣu bahudhā bhāti māyayā | yo jāgratsvapnaturyābhirgūḍhotmā na prakāśate ||
pṛ0 10) yodṛśyassūkṣmayā budhyā tatprasādena kevalam | tapasā veditavyassa nānyathā karmakoṭibhiḥ || yo vedādau svaraḥ prokto vedānteṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ | ya īśāno'dhividyānāṃ pāradṛśvā sanātanaḥ || yo bhūtasaṃghe supte'pi jāgartīśo maheśvaraḥ | yasmātprāṇo mano jajñe sahi nātyeti kiñcana || yojyotirjyotiṣāṃ devo viśvātmā viśvato mukhaḥ | yo bhūmimatyatiṣṭhacca yasmādbrahmāṇi jajñire || yato brahmeśaviṣṇvindrāssaha devaiśca jajñire | yo brahma brahmaviccāpi cātra brahma samaśnute || eṣa brahmaiṣa viṣṇuśca eṣa devo virājate | eṣa bhūtapatirdeva eṣa seturvidhāraṇaḥ || ekameva mahādevamindramitrādibhissuraiḥ | nāmarūpaguṇaiścaiva māyayā manyate janaḥ || 30 || idaṃ jagatpurā sṛṣṭvā tasminprāviśadīśvaraḥ | vyākurvannāmarūpe tu vyavahārīva bhāsate || puruṣo yaḥ parassūkṣmo bhoktā bhojyañca yassadā | yokhiloviśvanetā ca yasmānnānyatparāyaṇam || aśarīro'vyayātmāyaścāśīrṇohyavināśakaḥ | yo māyayā śarīrasthastadvīryairnaivalipyate || bhogīva bhāsate devo hyannapānādibhogabhāk | yaśca sarvendriyātītassarveṣāmapi bhāsakaḥ || yo'vyaktovyaktatāmetya jagatpuṣṇāti līlayā | yo'vidyayāsaṃsarati vidyayāca pramucyate || yo'nādhāro'khilādhārassvemahimnipratiṣṭhitaḥ | yaṃ śṛṇvaṃtopi vedāntairmuhyanti yatayassurāḥ || yastvenaṃvṛṇute devāstasyaivātmāprakāśate | ya ātmāsarvabhūtastho jaḍānāṃ viduṣāmapi || yo jagajjanmamaraṇairaśīryo nahi śīryate | yohyāgatairduḥkhasaṅghaissukhairvā spṛśyate nahi || yasminjñāte'khilaṃ jñātaṃ nakiñcidavaśiṣyate | yamavijñāyaviśveśaṃduḥkhāntannādhigacchati || yo saṃgaḥ puruṣo nityassthāṇuvanniścalo guṇaḥ | yo na jīvaśśivaścāpi cānyopādhivivarjitaḥ || pañcakośātigohyātmā sadānandaghanassukham | eko'dvayastṛtīyaśca navaisabahudhāvibhuḥ || yontike sahidūrasthastenāvāsyamidaṃsurāḥ | sabhūmāparamānanda ārtametajjagatsurāḥ || tajjaṃ tallaṃca tadanaṃ jagadetatprakāśate | yastamaḥpārago nityaṃ manovācāmagocaraḥ || 43 || yasyaiva śaktirvividhā svabhāvājjñānadāsurāḥ | sa eṣa paramānandassadasatpakṣavarjitaḥ || liṃgahīnassadā'saṃgo yo vedāntaika gocaraḥ | dṛśyate tvagryayābudhyā sūkṣmayāsūkṣmadarśibhiḥ || muktayedehisaṃghānāṃ sulabhovyaktatāṃgataḥ | triṇetro nīlakaṇṭhaścacomādehārdhavigrahaḥ || 46 || krīḍate pramathādhīśo heraṃbaskandaputravān | sarvāvāso'pi bhagavānkailāsācalamāsthitaḥ || yasya liṃgārcanenaiva trailokyaśrīravāpyate | yasya prasādādviṣṇutvaṃ tvayā prāptaṃ sudarśanam ||
pṛ0 11) brahmaṇassṛṣṭisāmarthyamindrasyāpyarinigrahaḥ | devarājyaṃ bhogabhāgyaṃ sarvamaiśādanugrahāt || na tatra sūryo deveśo bhāti candro nacānalaḥ | bhītyābhānti ca sarve'pi so'ntarāpuruṣo haraḥ || hiraṇyabāhurīśāno hiraṇyapatirīśvaraḥ | karmadevāssarva eva brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || 51 || yasyājñāvartinassarve sarveṣāṃ kāraṇaṃ śivaḥ | brahmaṇaśca śiraśchinnaṃ devadevena līlayā || indrasyāsyabhujastaṃbho yenākāri dayālunā | yasya bhaktasya śāpena daśajanmāni te hare || saukaraṃ nārasihmanterūpaṃ saṃśikṣitaṃ harāt | sarvaṃ jānāmiteviṣṇo brahmanśakragatavyathāḥ || yūyaṃ hi paśavo'jñāna jṛṃbhitāḥ paśupassahi | gacchantvadya yathākāmaṃ mādṛkṣenāstidhṛṣṭatā || bhavaṃto devatāssarve tvahaṃśarvapadāśrayaḥ | ityuktvā dhyānamātiṣṭajjaigīṣavyo mahāmuniḥ || dhyānena tena mahatā cedamāha tadā dvijāḥ |
jaigīṣavyaḥ – yaccabrahma jagajjagacca yadṛte nāstīti vadyaṃ padaṃ tvevaṃ ye vidurīśvareśvaradhiyā te yāṃti śaṃbhoḥ padam | te lokānhi nayāṃti yāpitamahāduḥkhābhitaptāpadaḥ saukhyañcāpi samāpnuvaṃti bhagavaṃstvadbhaktisārādarāḥ || 57 || bāhubhyāntava dhanvane ca bhagavankurve namassvastaye bhītāstvaddhanuṣaḥ karāgraviśikhairhetyā śaravyāya ca | pāhīśa pravimucya jyāmathadhanuḥkoṭyośśarāntsaṃtyajan hetiṃ pātaya māṃ vilokaya dṛśā dūre niṣaṃgaṃ tyaja || 58 || śaivendrāśśivasaṃmatāssuravarāpāravyathābhītito no bibhyaṃti na cāpnuvaṃti ca hare yuṣmadvarān kiṃphalān | kiṃtvīśānapadāraviṃdabhajanānnānyanmanaściṃtyate kṣudreṣu prabhaviṣṇavo nahi vayaṃ yāta svadhāmantsurāḥ || 59 || hārā eva bhavaṃti bhāgyanivahaiśśrīcandracūḍārcakā- steṣāṃ tvatpadavāsanāpi sutarāṃ vāṇīśa śakrālayam |
pṛ0 12) kiṃ jāyeta girīndraśekharagato mattadvipāliṃ bhina- tsihmaḥ kiṃtṛṇamatti tadvadiha me tvatto varāṇāṃ spṛhā || 60 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe jaigīṣavyasurasaṃvādo nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
viṣṇuvākyaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ
devāūcuḥ –
tava bhāvamaho jñātumāgatā vayamadya vai | sa eva sarvakāmānāṃ pūrako'sti na saṃśayaḥ || kiṃ tavāsukaraṃ vidvaṃstriṣu lokeṣu vidyate | tvanmano dhyāyati sadā yataśśivapadāṃbujam || yeṣāṃ manasi viśveśapadāṃbujayugaṃ bhavet | teṣāṃ kiṃ bhuvanaiśvaryairvinaśvaratarairmune || 3 || yato maheśakṛpayā dṛḍhā bhaktirbhavecchive | yayā bhaktyā dvijavarāssurāsuranarā api || 4 || muktāśca mocayaṃtyanyāñchaivāḥ kāruṇikottamāḥ | bhaktirevavirūpākṣe sarveṣāṃ muktidāyinī || bhaktyāsaṃpūjitoliṃge hyaliṃgo'pi maheśvaraḥ | bilvapatraistatphalairvā bhasmanāvā mahacchriyam || prāpnoti mukti sāmrājyamapunarbhavadāyakam | bhasmābhiṣiktā ye bhāvāstripuṇṭrāṃkita mastakāḥ || rudrākṣamālākoṭīradhāriṇo mālikādharāḥ | pañcākṣarāvṛttiparā rudrādhyāyajapādarāḥ || śivaliṃgārcakāśśaivāśśivakṣetranivāsinaḥ | naivedyabhojinaśśaṃbhoryātrāpuṣpaphalārpakāḥ || ananyasvāṃtarā viprā manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ | śivadhyānena saṃtṛptāssadāśiva kathādarāḥ || gaṇayanti mahāśaivā nāsmānkarmasurānmune | tavedṛṅmānasaṃ vipra na kasyāpi munerapi || tvadbhāvo bhavasaṃsakto bhavanāśāya kevalam | yathā ratnanidhiṃ prāpya sa kiṃ gṛhṇāti loṣṭakam || yathā mattebhakuṃbhasthassakiṃ kharamapekṣate | yathaiva kalpakavanaṃ saṃprāpyārkamapekṣate || 13 || yathā maṇimayaṃ hāraṃ prāpya kiṃvā varāṭikām | tathāsmadīya bhogeṣu mūḍhorajyatikāmataḥ || tvaṃ kāmāripadadhyānānniṣkāmo'si mahāmune | triṇetrapādakamalamitraṃ tvanmānasaṃ mune || tvameva śaivadhuryeṣu mūrdhanyo dhanya evahi | tava saṃdarśanāpārasaṃhṛtākhilapātakāḥ || 16 || jagajjanmasisṛkṣāsu viśveśena niyojitāḥ | nalabhāmaiva viśrāṃtiṃ śrāṃtāssaṃsāravartinaḥ || sadā vaiṣayikā devā vayaṃ sarve mahāmune | tava vākpaṃkajodbhūtasādhusārāśritāṃtarāḥ || 18 ||
pṛ0 13) vayaṃ viśrāṃtimāpannāḥ prapannāḥ paramāṃ gatim | śaivendrāṃga mahāsaṃga nirmuktākhila hṛttamāḥ || uttamā vidhiviṣṇviṃdrā deveṣu tava darśanāt | kālakūṭamahājvālā nirdagdhāhni mahāmune || aśītayanmahādevaḥ pītvāhālāhalaṃviṣam | devānarakṣadbhagavānhatvā tripuramulvaṇam || kṛtvā māṃ bāṇamatyugraṃ dhṛtvāmeruṃ śarāsanam | maurvīñcakārāhipatiṃ sārathiṃ vidhimātanot || vedāhnayāṃstathācakre cakre sūryañca candrakam | dharāmaṇḍalametadvai sasaritsavanābdhikam || surāsurānbhaṭāṃścakre karṣaṇe vāyumaṇḍalam | kiṃ sa viśvādhiko devo viśvabhūteṣu gaṇyate || asmāsu paśubhūteṣu devaḥ paśupatiśśivaḥ | paśūnasmānnibadhnāti māyāpāśena śaṃkaraḥ || sa eva kṛpayā jantūnmocayatyeva sarvadā | yasya liṃgaṃ sadākālaṃ pūjayanti marudgaṇāḥ || matpūjyohi mahādevassarve vayamataṃdritāḥ | janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhairabhibhūtā mahāmune || 27 || purā mannetrapadmena saṃpūjyāptaṃsudarśanam | daityendradrāvakaṃ sākṣādviśveśasya kṛpābalāt || mṛkaṃḍutanayaṃ kālamṛtyoryo mocayacchivaḥ | śvetañca taṃ nṛpasutamarakṣatkālapāśataḥ || yasya liṃgasya sanmauliṃ mūlaṃ brahmāhamapyadhaḥ | adṛṣṭvā paramāṃ śāṃtiṃ prāptavaṃtau purā mune || upamanyuṃ munisutaṃ gāṇāpatyena yojayat | śilādatanayesākṣātsvasārūpyaṃ dadau haraḥ || bhṛṃgīśaṃ ca muniśreṣṭhaṃ kopanaṃ bhaktimattaram | nijabhaktagaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ caṇḍīśañcāpyakalpayat || daityendraputraṃ bāṇañca sahasrabhujamātanot | vīrabhadreṇa niṃdaṃtaṃ vidhiṃ śikṣayadīśvaraḥ || 33 || mamāvatārarūpāṇi matsyakūrmakiṭīhnariḥ | narasihmādirūpāṇi haṃtātyudvejakāni me || śārabhaṃ rūpamāsthāya purā ghorataraṃ śivaḥ | śivabhaktāstathānye'pi surāsuramunīśvarāḥ || prasādābhimukhenaiva prasādena niyojitāḥ | smarāṃdhakagajādyāśca śikṣitāśca pinākinā || indrasyāsya prasādena savajrastaṃbhito bhujaḥ | na tena sadṛśo devo yo vedāṃtaikagocaraḥ || anantamahimādhārastvaparicchinnavaibhavaḥ | yogīyate sadeśāno vede vedāntamauliṣu || yaṃ yajanti mahāsatre yo dhyeyo yogibhissadā | yaṃ dānaistapasā bhaktyā pūjayānaśanena ca || ṛṣayo devasaṃghāśca svasvakāmārthasiddhaye | viśvoviśvātigassākṣādviśveśo viśvabhāvanaḥ || na tasya kāryaṃ karaṇaṃ na kriyā vā maheśituḥ | parāsya śaktiścitraiva sarvākāreṇa bhāsate || tanmāyāmohitā eva vayaṃ sarve surāsurāḥ | janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhairabhibhūtāssma sarvaśaḥ || tasyaivājñāvaśādetajjagaccakraṃ pravartate | vahnirvahati kavyāni havyāni ca sureṣvapi || 43 ||
pṛ0 14) udeti savitā nityaṃ kimastaṃ yāti śāsanāt | somo'mṛtamayassākṣādudetyoṣadhināyakaḥ || nakṣatrāṇi bhramantyeva grahādhārā bhramanti hi | pravāti pavano maṃdaṃ meghā varṣanti śāsanāt || bhūmirvahati viśvaṃvai lokāssarve caturdaśa | śeṣo'pidhatte śirasi bhuvaṃ bhavapadāśrayaḥ || parvatāssarito vāpyassamudrāstasya śāsanāt | nodvelatāṃ prayāntyeva smaraśāsanaśāsanāt || pālayāmi śivādeśājjagatsāsuramānuṣam | vidhissṛjati bhūtāni rudro'nte saṃhariṣyati || indraḥ pālayate devāntsosurāntsaṃharatyapi | yamo'pi pāpināṃ śāstā yamaśāsanaśāsanāt || kubero dhanapo nityaṃ varuṇo yādamāṃpatiḥ | īśāno rudrasaṃghānāṃ yakṣāṇāṃ niṛtistathā || sarvaṃ sāsuramānuṣaṃ jagadidaṃ tasyeśasacchāsanā- dāste'tyaṃtadhiyābhiyāsuranaravrātāstuvante ṛcā | sāmnā rudraśatairmahopaniṣadāṃ sārārthavākyaiśśivaḥ kastādṛkṣavariṣṭha evahi mune devādhidevaśśivaḥ || 51 || sarve svīyavimānavāhanagaṇaiśśreṇībhireṇīdṛśā- manyonyaṃ punarīśapādamanasassaṃvarṇitanniścayam | ityuktvā prayayurmudā vidhiharī śakrastathānye surā natvā taṃ munipuṃgavaṃ suragaṇā yātāssvagehaṃ tadā || 52 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe viṣṇuvākyaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
jaigīṣavyaprasādakaraṇaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ
sūta uvāca– evaṃ tapasyatastasya kālobhūyānavartata | valmīkāvṛtagātrasya tṛṇavallīyutasya ca || tasyaiva tapasā lokāssantaptāśca surāsurāḥ | vismayaṃto muniṃ dṛṣṭvā munayassaṃśitavratāḥ || nārado vīṇayā lokānnāmnāgāyanmaheśituḥ | śrāvayantsatataṃ lokāndhūtapāpānathākarot || himavacchikharaṃ dṛṣṭvā jaigīṣavyamadṛśyata | valmīkasyāntaradṛśā paśyanvai nārado muniḥ || tapasātāpayallokāndhyāyanrudramananyadhīḥ | rudrādhyāyārthavijñānapravīṇamanasaṃ sadā ||
pṛ0 15) dṛṣṭvāsavismayopeto nāradastamabhāṣata | jaigīṣavya mahābhāga tapasā saṃśitavrata ||
nāradaḥ– tvattapasyā mahātīvrā tayā lokāśca tāpitāḥ | kimadya prārthyamastīha tava kāmasya sattama || tvādṛśā no muniśroṣṭhā dṛṣṭāvāpi śrutā mayā | ākaumārabrahmacarye tavaiva nirataṃ manaḥ || ūrdhvaretāstvamevāsi munisaṅgheṣu suvrata | tavādyadarśanādvipra dhanyo'smi nitarāṃ mune || tavendrabrahmalokeṣu vaiṣṇave prathitaṃ yaśaḥ | lokapālāmarāssarve munayotīva suvratāḥ || dṛṣṭvā niṣṭhāntavātyugrāṃ tathedṛktapasaḥ kriyāḥ | rudrāvarttanaśīlasya cogravinyastacetasaḥ || sa nāradasya vacasā jaigīṣavyo mahāmuniḥ | svāgatenābhinaṃdyainaṃ niṣīdetyabravīnmunim || upaviṣṭe nārade tu jaigīṣavyo'mitaprabhaḥ | uvāca taṃ devamuniṃ vīṇāsaktakaraṃ tadā ||
jaigīṣavyaḥ – lokāṃstvayā sañcaratā kiṃ dṛṣṭañcitramadbhutam | tanme vada mahābhāga kuśalassarvasaṃsadi || tvayā nāviditaṃ kiñcittriṣu lokeṣu vidyate | sa jaigīṣavyavacasā prāha tannārado muniḥ ||
nāradaḥ – viṣṇuloke prahmaṇaśca śakrasaṃsadi cāpyaham | gacchanpaśyāmi puṇyānāṃ [lokānāmiti pāṭhaḥ |] bhoktāro munayo nṛpāḥ || puṇyānte patamānāṃśca nānāyoniṣu sattama | bhramantaḥ karmaṇānena tejomātraśarīriṇaḥ || tiraskṛtāstvayā devā brahmaviṣṇuharīśvarāḥ | yeṣāṃ prasādatassarve svargānanta śriye mune || te'pi devāstvayā dhūtā niṣkāmenedamadbhutam | kāmāṃganāśapādābjadhyānaniṣkāmitaṃ manaḥ || tavedaṃ mānasaṃ dṛṣṭvā devāścāścaryamāgatāḥ | brahmā viṣṇustathā śakrassarve ca munayo vayam || eṣa gacchāmi kailāsaṃ nānāgaṇaniṣevitam | vijñaptuṃ te tapaścaryāṃ devadevāya śaṃbhave || ityuktvotthita evāsau nārado divyadarśanaḥ | jagāmalokānakhilānkailāsañca mahāmuniḥ || nānārudragaṇopetaṃ surakinnaraśobhitam | nandibhṛṅgimahākālagaṇanāyakakoṭibhiḥ || rudraiśca rudrakanyābhirapsarobhissamāvṛtam | heraṃbaskandanandīśa bāṇacaṇḍīśvarādibhiḥ || samāvṛtaṃ taruvarairnānāpuṣpaphalopagaiḥ | praphullapaṅkajotphullanīlotpalasarovaraiḥ || 25 ||
pṛ0 16) kailāsaśikharāpārasaudhapaṃktīśvarālayaiḥ | kanatkanakaratnaughamaulikuṃbhapatākakaiḥ || dodhūyamānairnitarāṃ rājadvṛṣagaṇaistadā | śukabarhiṇanādaiśca kokilālāpasundaraiḥ || murajānakaśaṅkhādimaḍḍumaddalavādanaiḥ | dundubhyāghātajārāvavināditaguhāmukhaiḥ || vīṇākvaṇanaśabdaiśca gandharvakṛtagāyanaiḥ | muralīsaralīlīlāvilāsāpsarasāṅgaṇaiḥ || pranṛtyatkinnarānīkaśiñjanmañjīra nisvanaiḥ | kailāsaśikharāpāramadrākṣīnnārado muniḥ || dvāristhitannandikeśamapaśyadvetrapāṇinam | jaṭāmakuṭaśobhāḍhyaṃ tripuṇṭrāṅkitamastakam || bhasmābhyaktaṃ rudragaṇaissamantātpariveṣṭitam | dadarśa nayanābjābhyāṃ tejorāśimivasthitam || tenābhipraśnakathanairnandito nārado muniḥ | uvāca dvāri devasyagāyanmadhuravīṇayā || nāmāni devadevasya pāvanāni mahāmuniḥ | naṃdikeśāgratassvairaṃ jagau rudrānumoditaḥ ||
nāradaḥ – śiva śiva bhava hara devaśāsana nagaśara pāhi dayākaṭākṣasāraiḥ | bhava bhavajanitāṃ rujaṃ harāśu pramathādhīśvara vīra dhīra pāhi || 35 || śiva śiva dahanābjamitrasomaprakaṭavilocana kṛttivāsa śaṃbho | tava śiva kṛpayā smarāṃdhakāre bhava bhavaśamanādbhayaṃ nacaiva || 36 || haragirisutayā sadopakaṇṭha prabalagarāśana nīlanīlakaṇṭha | hṛdibhavayamināṃ kilopakaṇṭha prathitamahoragabhogaśobhikaṇṭha || 37 || hara hara śamanaikabhītijātaṃ hara hara bhavajātaghoraduḥkham | hara hara pāpamapākuruṣva śaṃbho hara hara murajitsupūjitāṃghre || 38 || śaṃbho śaṅkara candraśekhara dayāsārāmarādhīśvara pāpāpārajalābdhiśoṣaṇamahābāḍavyavahne śiva | kāntārdhākṛtiśobhitāṃga kamalākāntākṣipūjyāṃghrika viśveśānavidhipracaṇḍaśirasālagnaprayāṇe hara || 39 || śūlaprotthitadakṣavakṣaharaṇa tryakṣāmarādhīśvara pāhīmañjanamarbhakaṃ tava vibho bhāvaikalabhya prabho |
pṛ0 17) gānaṃte śṛṇu nāradasya hi mukhādvīṇākvaṇanmañjulam bho bho devavara prasīda bhagavandṛṣṭiṃ kṛpāyāḥ kuru || 40 || gānānte nāradamukhādvīṇākvaṇanamañjulam | śrutvaivaṃ nandikeśādyā gaṇāśśaṃbhormahātmanaḥ || vyajijñipaṃste devāya śaṅkarāya mahātmane | praṇamya nandikeśo'pi pidhāyāsyaṃ kareṇa vai || uvāca devaṃ varadaṃ prasannāsyaṃ trilocanam ||
naṃdikeśvaraḥ– śaṃbho śaṅkara dhūrjaṭe triṇayanāpāravyathāṃ saṃhara pārāvāramahāprabhāva jagatāṃ vyāpārasārādara | tvannāmāmṛtadhārayā jagadidaṃ prāptastaveśāṃtikam saṃbhāvya pramathādhinātha padavīṃ draṣṭuṃ padābjaṃ tava || 43 || dvāre tiṣṭhati vāritassahi mayā kiñcājñayāśuprabho devājñāvasareṇa taṃ gamayituṃ divyaṃ muniṃ nāradam | tvatpādāṃbujalolamiṣṭamanasaṃ sarvairviśiṣṭāntaram bhaktijñānaviraktiśālisukhitaḥ pādau didṛkṣuḥ prabho || 44 || naṃdikeśavacaśśrutvā kaṭākṣāgreṇa śaṅkaraḥ | saṃjñāṃ cakre'khileśāno nāradāgamanaṃ prati || nārado'pi ca deveśaṃ natvā tuṣṭāva harṣitaḥ | śipiviṣṭaṃ mahādevamaṣṭākṛtimanoharaḥ ||
nāradaḥ– jaya jaya deva maheśa dhūrjaṭe jayajaya [atra bho ityanusandhāne ślokassamīcīnassyāt |] viśvavidhāna dakṣaśikṣa | jaya jaya viśrutavedagītakīrte jaya jaya bhaktajanārpitaika bhukte || 47 || jaya jaya bhagavaṃstapaḥkriyāṇāṃ phaladānonmukha pañcavaktra śaṃbho | tava śiva bhagavanpadābjayugmamabhipūjya svahṛdā tapaikarāśiḥ || 48 || munirāste himavannagordhvamaulau tava divyāmṛtadehalokanaikatarṣaḥ | itthaṃ nāradavākyena jātaharṣo maheśvaraḥ | jaigīṣavyaṃ yayau draṣṭuṃ nānāgaṇavarairvṛtaḥ || 49 || āruhya śākvaraṃ [śākvaram-vṛṣabhamityarthaḥ |] divyaṃ nānālaṅkārabhūṣitam | nānāgaṇamukhodgītavādyavṛndakṛtāravam ||
pṛ0 18) chatracāmarahastaiśca patākāvidhṛtairgaṇaiḥ | umayā skandaherambanandibhṛṅgigaṇāvṛtaḥ || 51 || kṣaṇena himavanmaulimājagāma maheśvaraḥ | munibhirgaṇamukhyaiśca mandasmitamanoharaḥ || udyacchaśāṅkadhavaladhāvalyāṅkasamaprabhaḥ | gaṅgātuṅgataraṅgaugha maulidyuti virājitaḥ || dṛṣṭvā taṃ munimekāgramānasaṃ sa maheśvaraḥ | dayākaṭākṣāmṛtasindhuvarṣairvalmīkabhūtammunimāvavarṣa | sa cotthito devavaraṃ praṇamya tuṣṭāva cāṣṭākṛtimaprameyam || 54 ||
jaigīṣavyaḥ– maheśvara mahoddhata prabalapāpatāpāpaha prapannajanarakṣaṇa kṣaṇaviśiṣṭaśiṣṭeṣṭada | vinītajanavatsala tripuramārasaṃśoṣaka prasīda dayayādhunā bhavadavāgnisaṃśoṣaka || kṣapāpatikalādhara kṣapitapāpatāpāpaha pracaṇḍagaralāśana tridaśamaulivandyāṅghrika | mahokṣavaravāhanādhvarasudakṣadakṣāpaha bhagākṣihara śaṅkara prasabhamāśu paśya prabho || 56 || harāmaravarottama prabalasaurigarvāpaha mṛkaṇḍutanayārcita prabalaśūladagdhāndhaka | phaṇīndramaṇikaṅkaṇojvalita sūryasomānalatrilocana dayārasaiḥ prathaya vedagītāśaya || triyambaka sadāśiva tridaśanāyakāśāvasa yamīndrahṛdayābjagoccalitamaḍḍunādapriya | sukṛttivasanāmalocchavasitabhogibhogapriya prasīda mayi deva bhormuraharābjanetrāṅghrika || ramāramaṇasāyaka prabalamerusaddhanvaka mahīvararathāṅgakavidhṛtasomapūṣātmaka | turaṅganigamāvyaya vidhisuyantarīkṣasva māṃ dayārasadṛśānayā madanakāyanāśādara || jaigīṣavyastutiṃ śrutvā santuṣṭaḥprāha śaṅkaraḥ | prāñjaliṃ vinayopetaṃ muniṃ vīkṣya smarārdanaḥ ||
īśvaraḥ– tvaṃdhūrjaṭipremaraso mumukṣurmokṣaikatānaśśrutiśekharāntaḥ | tvamūrdhvaretā mama suprasādabhāktvaṃ sārabhūto'si munīśvarāṇām || 60 || vigalitamadamānalobhamohaḥ praśamitavṛttirumeśatarṣacetāḥ | dhṛtabhasitavaro varākṣamālaśśrutimūrdhanyamanorvicāra śūraḥ || 61 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe jaigīṣavyaprasādakaraṇaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||
pṛ0 19) jaigīṣavyaḥ– tvameva devadeveśa pitā mātā sakhā prabhuḥ | tvameva sarvaṃ deveśa viśveśvara maheśvara || 1 || najāne girijājāne tvattohyanyaṃ sureśvara | tasmātprasīda bhagavan karuṇāsāgarādhunā || 2 || prapanno'smi padadvandvaṃ nirdvandvaṃ te maheśvara | bhrātarau skandaherambau sakhāyo gaṇapā mama || 3 || jagatāṃ jananī gaurī janitrī mama śaṅkarī | jagatpitā tvameveśa pitā mama maheśvara || 4 || nānyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇe deva tvatpādāmbujabhaktitaḥ | saiva dharmārthakāmādimokṣaheturmamamādhunā || 5 || yayā bhaktyā mahādeva muktāssarve surāsurāḥ | tvadbhakta eva jagatimukto'nyānmocayatyapi || 6 || tvadbhaktyaiva vidhirviśvaṃ sṛjatyeva maheśvara | tvatto vedānadhigatassatyalokādhipo'bhavat || 7 || viṣṇustava padadvandvaṃ netrābjena samarcayan | daityabṛndaikasaṃhatyai cakraṃ prāpa sudarśanam || 8 || tvadbhaktyaiva virūpākṣa vaikuṇṭhasyādhipo'bhavat | padmasadmāpatiścāpi jāto rudrastvadāśrayāt || 9 || datvā śūlavaraṃ tasmai rudrāyāmitatejase | rudrāṇāmādhipatye ca tvayā so'pyabhiṣecitaḥ || 10 || yasya śūlānalajvālādagdhamante carācaram | śakro'marendratāṃ prāptastvadbhaktyaiva harādhunā || śacīpatitvaṃ saṃprāpa nānāsvargaikabhogabhāk | dhanādhipatvandhanadastvadbhaktyaiva maheśvara || yamo'pi tvatpadārcāto lokapālo'bhavacchiva | varuṇoyādasānnāthassūryacandrānilānalāḥ || tvadbhaktyaiva virūpākṣa lebhire dikpatitvatām | samarcayanti tvalliṅgaṃbhaktyā sarve surāsurāḥ || sahasrabhujatāṃ prāpto bāṇo bhaktyā taveśvara | paulastyatanayaśśambho rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ || jigye surānnṛpavarāṃstvadbhaktyaiva maheśvara | ghaṭodbhavena tvadbhaktyā samudrāśculukīkṛtāḥ || dadhīcināpitvadbhaktyāviṣṇave rūpamadbhutam | darśitaṃ māyine śambho bhṛguṇāśāpitohariḥ || upamanyunācabālenalabdhaḥkṣīraikavāridhiḥ | tvadbhaktyākālapāśaiśca pāśito'pi mṛkaṇḍujaḥ || jigāya mṛtyuṃ tarasā śveto'pi nṛpanandanaḥ | śilāśanena tvadbhaktyā putraḥ prāptohyayonijaḥ || tvadbhaktyānandikeśo'pi gāṇāpatyamavāptavān | caṇḍīśvaro'pi pitaraṃhatavāṃstava bhaktitaḥ || maṅkaṇo'pi purāsiddhassiddhiṃ prāpatvadarcanāt | somo'pi muktavānrājayakṣmatastvatprasādataḥ || dakṣo'pi dīkṣito yajñe śikṣito'nugrahīkṛtaḥ | śatarcanādayo'pīśavyāghrapādādayastathā ||
pṛ0 20) dūrvāsādyā mahābhāgā dattātreyādayastathā | rāmo'pi bhārgavaśśambho nṛpāṇāṃ kulaghātakaḥ || tathaivānye nṛpatayassomasūryānvayodbhavāḥ | āditeyāśca ditijā gaṇā rudrā munīśvarāḥ || bhūtā bhavyā vartamānā bhaktāstvadbhaktibhāvitāḥ | tava bhaktyaiva sarveṣāṃ svargamokṣau hi śaṅkara || tvadbhaktimeva yāce'haṃ tvananyagatirīśvara | himādrau sthāpite liṅge jaigīṣavyeśvarābhidhe || kedārātpaścime bhāge tasminnityaṃ tvamāvasa || 27 ||
sūtaḥ– ityukto muninā tena mahādevo girīndrajām | surāṇāñca munīnāñca śṛṇvatāṃ prāhaśaṅkaraḥ ||
īśvaraḥ– kathāmākarṇayāparṇe karṇābhyarṇavilocane | tūrṇaṃ pūrṇapadaprāptyai bhavārṇavanivāsinām || kṛtaliṅgamahāsadma padmasadmāpi sadmagā | teṣāṃ nityaṃ bhavedeva yairvākāri śivālayaḥ || tapāṃsi tena taptāni jīrṇaparṇāśanānmune | teneṣṭāssakalā yāgāstenādhītaṃ śrutaṃ śive || kedārākhyaṃ tvatpiturmaulisaṃsthaṃ liṅgañcaitatsarvadā muktibījam | kedāre'smiṃstvatpituścārumaulau bhūmānandañcāṅkuraṃ taccamuktyāḥ || 32 || etalliṅgātpaścime cāmunā me nāmnā svenāpyarcitaṃ paśya liṅgam | pratiṣṭhite yena kenāpi liṅge tiṣṭhāmīśe sarvathaivātituṣṭaḥ || 33 || tasmiṃtsadaivāvahito bhavāmi bhavāni nityaṃ sukhado'tiharṣadaḥ | bhavāni muktyai prathite pradoṣe prakāśane pūjanabhāvane'pi || 34 || samānacitto'rcanakṛdvibhāti naro varo me sa varocitassyāt | yaḥ kaścidbhuvaneśvari tribhuvane cottuṅgaliṅgālayaṃ ramyaṃ dvārakavāṭatoraṇamahāprākārasadgopuram | vidyutpuñjasamaprabhāmalamahāhemaikakumbhollasa- tkṛtvā janmaśatārjitākhilamahāpāpairnaro mucyate || 35 || ramye śailavare sarittaṭavare grāme pure parvate tīrthe vāpi vane girīndravaraje gaṅgātaṭe nārmade | tīre vāpi vane girīndravaraje gaṅgātaṭe nārmade |
pṛ0 21) tīre vāpi maheścareścari mahākṣetreṣu liṅgaṃ dadha- tsarvatrāpi śucau śucissamahimā tasyātipāro divi || 36 || aḍhyovāpi daridraśekharanarobhaktiḥ paraṃ kāraṇa- ṅkṛtvā cāpi śivālayaṃ sukhayuto bhūmau vimuktastataḥ | mṛddāruprabhavaṃ śileṣṭakakṛtaṃ ramyaṃ sudhācchāditaṃ divyaṃ sanmaṇikalpitaṃ bhavaharaṃ sadyo vijāyeta me || 37 || kḷptaṃ cāruśivālayottamalasattuṅgaṃ hi liṅgammama prātiṣṭhāpya suvastracandanaghanāsāraiśca bilvārcakaḥ | kiṃ mattebhasuhemabhūmituragairgobhiśca ratnodbhavai- rdānairyāgavaraiścirārjitamahādharmaiśca kiṃ vā śive || 38 || yogairvā niyamairvratena tapasā tīrthāṭanenāpi kiṃ kanyānnādikadānato'pi hi varaṃ liṅgālayaṃ yaiḥ kṛtam | pātāntāvadhisundaraṃ kṛtamahādharmaikajālaṃ śive malliṅgālayakalpakasya sutarāṃ pātādbhayannāsti vai || 39 || yāvaccandrasutārakāgaṇamume yāvatsaricchailakā- stāvanme gaṇapottamo hi sa bhavetkailāsamaulau mama | khaṇḍaṃ vā sphuṭitaṃ tathā parakṛtaṃ jīrṇaṃ viśīrṇaṃ tathā tasyoddhāramume karoti sukṛtairyaśśraddhayā kevalam || 40 || kiṃ vakṣyāmi sadaiva tasya hṛdaye nityaṃ nivāso mama tasyānte vitarāmi muktimatulāṃ vakṣye rahasyantava | ko vā liṅgavaraṃ pradoṣasamaye yenārci bilvaiśśubhai- revañcāpi carācaraṃ tribhuvanābhyadhyakṣatāmāvahet || 41 || bhūmau putrakalatramitrasahito dhānyairdhanaissaṃyuta- ścānte cāpi vimuktimeti nitarāṃ liṅgārcanādeva me |
pṛ0 22) tailairvā vividhairghṛtaiḥ paśubhavairgavyena vā kevalaṃ codbodhyojvaladīpajālamagaje kṛtvaiva dīpāvalim || 42 || padme bhottamahaṃsatārakagaṇākārāvaliṃ madgṛhe ramyāmujvalavartikāmaghakulaṃ jvālīkṛtaṃ tena vai | dhūpairvā tvagarūdbhavairapi mahāsāmrāṇisadguggulū- bilvatvatkṛtayuktagandhasubhagāmodaiśśive kevalam || 43 || dagdhvā yāti padaṃ mama tvaghakulaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtārtho bhave- jjñānañcāpi samāpnuyātsuniśitaṃ vedāntavākyodbhavam | karpūrodbhavakhaṇḍaṣaṇḍajamahājvālālasaddīpakai- rujvālya pramathādhināthajamāliṅgetamoliṃ bhinat || 44 || pāpādreḥ kuliśaṃ bhavatyatha śive taddīpadāne mayi prāpnotyeva kulonnatiṃ varasutānprāpnoti śambhoḥ padam | gavyaiḥ kāpilajaistathetaragavāṃ sāraiḥ payobhirghṛtai- rdadhnā cāpyadhikaṃ phalena śataśaḥ kṣaudreṇa cākṣudratām || 45 || prāpnotīkṣurasena gandhasalilaiḥ puṣpottharatnodakai- ssvarṇotthairabhiṣicya liṅgamamalaṃ prāpnoti muktiṃ śive | puṇṭrekṣuprabhavaiśca sadrasavarairmocāphalānāṃ gaṇai- rnārelāṃburasālasārajarasairjaṃbīranīrairapi || 46 || utkocaiḥ panasodbhavairmama mahāliṅge'bhiṣicyādarā- tprātassaṅgavakālato'pyatitarāṃ sāyaṃ vimukto bhavet | bhakteṣu pravaro mamaiva sadane sadgotrajo'saunaro bhuktvā sarvasukhaṃ bhuvi priyatamo yātyeva devi priye || 47 || grīṣmartau mama liṃgasaṅgatamahāmaulau galantī jharī- dhārāsārasupāṭalāgarurasaiḥ puṣpāṃbubhiḥ pūritaiḥ |
pṛ0 23) dhārākalpanajena yatphalamume tatkena vā śakyate vaktuṃ janmaśatāyutārjitamahāpāpairvimukto bhavet || 48 || utphullaiḥ kamalaissitāsitavaraissanmallikamālatī- jājīkundasupāṭalairbakamahādhurtūradroṇārkakaiḥ | kalhāraiḥ kumudairjapādamanakairutphulladāḍimbakaiḥ punnāgārjunacampakairbakulakairmandāravālhātakaiḥ || 49 || nīlodyadvikacotpalaiḥ kuravakaissatkarṇikāraiśśivaṃ nandyāvartaśirīṣabilvakusumairaktāśvasāraiśśivaiḥ | jaṃbvāmraiśca palāśakaiśśamisumairdūrvāpamārgādibhi- rviṣṇukrāntakuśaiśca kāśajanitairabhyarcya mukto'mbiṃke || 50 || prāpnotīṣṭamahetukaṃ bhagavataśśambhoḥ kaṭākṣāṅkurai- rliṅge puṇyatame pradoṣasamaye puṇyeṣu kāleṣvapi | maudgalyo'tha śatarcanātribhṛgavo dhaumyāgrajo gautamo mārkaṇḍeyadadhīcigarga uśanā muñjo kariśśaunakaḥ || 51 || dūrvāsā jamadagnijoṅgiravarā dattātrijo vyāghrapā- jjābāliśca dadhīcimitrajanitaḥ kuṃbhodbhavaśśailaje | deveṣu prathito vidhiśca murabhicchakro'ryamāgnirmaru- tpāśī yakṣapatiryamo'tha niṛtiśceśānamukhyā gaṇāḥ || 52 || skandaścebhajavaktrako gaṇavaro nandīśabhṛṅgīśvarā- staṇḍuścaṇḍiriṭī subhadrakavaro vīro mahābhairavaḥ | śaivendrā bhasitatripuṇṭraniṭilā rudrākṣamālāṅgadā rudrāvartanalolaśīlamanaso liṅgārcakā me śive || 53 || anye'mī munayo grahāśramaratāśśrāntāḥ paraṃ saṃsṛte- rnānādaivatapūjanena kudhiyo jānanti no māṃ śive |
pṛ0 24) kānīnastvayamapyume vidhivaśātsaṃprāpya me kāśikāṃ matsānnidhyagatordhvabāhurasakṛdvyācaṣṭa daivaṃ harim || 54 || tasmānnārhati vaktumapyatitarāṃ śrotuṃ madīyaṃ rahaḥ puṇyaṃmuktirahasyametadanaghaṃ śiṣyeṣu pātreṣvaho | tvaṃ samyakpratipādayāśu bhasitoddhūleṣu matpremajā- pārāvāramahāṃbumagnamanasāṃ puṇyeṣu śaiveṣu ca || 55 || jaigīṣavyamunīndra dāpaya paraṃ śaivaṃ rahasyaṃ mama nākhyeyaṃ śivabhaktivarjitamunau puṇyantvidaṃ muktidam | datvā bhaktivihīnamānavavare pāpaṃ mahatprāpnuyā- tkiñcāpnoti vṛdhāśramaṃ suniśitaṃ pātre yathā me jalam || 56 || prājñā [etasminnekaḥ pādo na kasminnapi kośe dṛśyate |] jñānakalāptaye sumanaso vedāntaśikṣāratā- śśāntāśśāntatarendriyāśca janatāpārabhramāsaṃbhramāḥ | ye ye bhaktavarā mameśvari varaiḥ pālyāssadā te tvayā || 57 ||
sūtaḥ– devyā dṛṣṭvā mukhābjaṃ triṇayananayanānandasandohabīja- ñcotphullāmalakairavopamamukhaśśrīpārvatīnāyakaḥ | dṛṣṭvācāpi muniṃ viśiṣṭamanasaṃ śiṣṭātiśiṣṭantadā cāṣṭāṃgākhilayogajālanikaraiḥ pūtaikasanmānasaḥ || 58 ||
īśvaraḥ– pūto'yaṃ bhuvaneśvari trijagatāmīśo muniśśāṅkaraḥ putraste nikhilāgamaikarasiko bhūyāttvayā''lokitaḥ | saṃpratyeṣa tavānanābjavikasatsūryasya ṣaḍvaktrataḥ prāpnotu prasabhaṃ madīyamahasāṃ sāraṃ jagatpāvanam || 59 ||
pṛ0 25) skandasskanditatārakastava śive paryaṅkabhūtāṅkaka- śśuśrāvākhilamaṃgalaṃ tvayi mayā saṃproktametacchrubham | ṣaḍbhissvairvadanacyutāmṛtarasaiḥ puṣṇātu cainaṃ muniṃ śaivairadya rahasyasambhavakathādhārāsudhāśīkaraiḥ || 60 || jaigīṣavyamukhābjato munivarāśśṛṇvantu śaivaṃ raha- śśaivā eva bhavanti tacchatamahānandaikabodhāssadā | nānyeṣāmmatirasti śaṅkarakathāpīyūṣapānotsave bhaktyutthāmṛtapānapīnamanaso devi sphuṭaṃ kecana || 61 || vedāntārthavicārasārasugamaṃ śaivaṃ rahasyaṃ mayā devyai dattamatastayā balavatā snehena dattaṃ mune | skandāyāsuraśikṣakāya dada tāṃ gacchādhunā taṃ pratī- tyukto'sau girijāmanoharavacaśśrutvā munirniryayau || 62 || natvā śaṃbhupadaṃ jagāma rabhasā yukto munīndrairapi devaścāpi mudā yayau paśupatirdevyā surādyairvṛtaḥ | kailāsaṃ gaṇapotthavādyanikarairdevaisstavaissaṃstuto bhaktānāṃ puruṣārthasādhanaparassvānandakaissaṃyutaḥ || 63 || ilāmilanmauliratho mahātmā jaigīṣavipro'dhvararājamīśaṃ saṃpūjya natvābhijagāmaśaṃbhuṃ skandāya ca skandamudārthavedane || 64 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe jaigīṣavyāgamanannāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||
jaigīṣavyaskandasamāgamo nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ
sūta uvāca– ityuktvā prayayau devaḥ kailāsaṃ śaṅkarālayam | nandibhṛṃgigaṇaughena surāsuravarārcitaḥ || jagajjanitryā devyā ca mahāvṛṣabhavāhanaḥ | jaigīṣavyo munirnatvā mahādevapadāṃbujam ||
pṛ0 26) dhyāyannabhijagāmaiva skandaṃ krauñcavidāraṇam | upāyayau munivaraiśśaivendrairbhaktitatparaiḥ || mārkaṇḍeyo'thamaudgalyo jamadagnirbhṛgustathā | dūrvāsāścya vanogargo vītahavyo'nalāśanaḥ || gautamo'trirbharadvājo dālbhyohayaśirāmanuḥ | ucathyo'gnidhvajaścaiva dadhīcirmaunibhārgavaḥ || vyāsaḥ parāśaro'kuṇḍaḥ kaviraṃgiraso madhuḥ | upamanyurviśākhaśca tuhaṇḍaḥ kavaṣodhruvaḥ || jābālikāśyapau mitro nāradastuṃburustathā | parvato'thāṇimāṇḍavyo daṇḍovyāghrapadohanuḥ || vedagarbho vītihotraḥ kaṇvo medhātithirdhanuḥ | śaunakastāṇḍakaścaiva mitravindo'namitrakaḥ || hayagrīvaḥ pippalādo dattātreyovikatthanaḥ | agastyaścānilāśaśca śatarcā āśvalāyanaḥ || sanandassanakaścaiva kumāraśca sanātanaḥ | evamādyāśca munayaśśaivendrāśśivasammatāḥ || 10 || agnirityādibhirmantrairbhasmoddhūlanatatparāḥ | triyāyuṣaistripuṇṭrāṅkā rudrākṣāṃgadakaṅkaṇāḥ || pañcākṣarajapāsaktāḥ pañcāsyaddhyānatatparāḥ | atharvaśirasā devaṃ pūjayanti stuvanti ca || kecicchikhājapāsaktāḥ kecitkaivalyajāpakāḥ | praṇavābhyāsaniratāḥ kecijjābālajāpakāḥ || bṛhadrathantaraṃ vāmadevasāmādijāpakāḥ | saṃhitābhistathā sāmnāmṛcāñca yajuṣāntathā || rudrādhyāyajapāsaktāḥ pañcabrahmaparāyaṇāḥ | sarve liṃgārcanaparāstrikālammunisattamāḥ || pañcarudrajapāsaktāḥ pañcāsyaddhyānatatparāḥ | śiva naivedya bhoktāro niyamādbilvapūjakāḥ || vairāgyabhāgyaniratā nityānityārthakovidāḥ | vedavedārthatatvajñā dṛḍhaprajñāmanīṣiṇaḥ || tapasāṃ rāśayassarve sadārāśśivatatparāḥ | śivanāmajapāsaktāssarvadā śivacintakāḥ || agnihotraparāssarve yajñādyairdagdhakilviṣāḥ | śiṣyapraśiṣyasahitā āgatāste nabhodhvanā || skandāśramaṃ sarasvatyāstīre pāvanapāvanam | nānāskandagaṇopetaṃ devagandharvaśobhitam || nīlādriśikhare puṇye nānātaruvarāśritam | barhinṛttāravaiścaiva puṃskokilavināditam || śukaśārikasaṅghuṣṭaṃ kapotakṛtahuṅkṛtaiḥ | mṛdaṃgamurajodghoṣairvīṇātālalayānugaiḥ || 22 || pranṛtyatkinnarānīkamutphullakamalākaram | skandālayamapaśyaṃste nānāratnavirājitam || gopurāṭṭālavalabhīvapraprākāraśobhitam | suvarṇakhacitānekanavaratnavirājitam || 24 || paryaṃkāstaraṇairdivyaissihmanādavarairyutam | gandharvanītabakulairupetaṃ gītavādanaiḥ || 25 || sihmāsanasthaṃ varadaṃ ṣaḍvaktraṃ mukuṭojvalam | hemapītāṃvaradharaṃ calaccāmaravījitam ||
pṛ0 27) kanatkanakaratnaiśca citrakuṇḍalaśobhitam | mahārharatnamālādimuktāhārasukandharam || 27 || śaktihastaṃ mahāśaktestanūjamatisundaram | dadarśurmunayassarve skandaṃ krauñcavidāraṇam || praṇamya jaigīṣavyādyā munayasskandamavyayam | tena nirdiṣṭaviṣṭabdhaviṣṭarā munayassukham || nabhasspṛgāyāti samīragatyā bhasmāvadhūtākhilapāpasaṅghaḥ | śarannabhābhaḥ paripūrṇacandrabhāssamāluloke'dritanūbhavābham || 30 || jaigīṣavyamukhābjalokanamahānandāṃbudhermadhyaga- ssvasyaivāntikamāgataṃ purabhidā saṃpreṣitaṃ jñātavān | pātraṃ vīkṣya maheśamitrahṛdayagranthārthasaṃbodhane hṛṣṭaḥ puṣṭatanuḥ prakṛṣṭavacasāmudbodhabodhe munim || 31 || jaigīṣavyāṃgasaṃgasphuṭapulakatatiśśaivavaryaṃṣaḍāsyo netrairvyālokya tuṣṭo bhasitadhavalitasvāntagātro munīndram | menemenātanūjātmajavaravaraṇe dhāraṇe vītarāgam || 32 ||
skandaḥ– tvadāgamanasaṃbhramādbhramatatiḥ praṇaṣṭā mama śivena kathitaṃ purā śivarahasyadharmābhidham | samudramiva sindhubhiśśivakathāsudhāvāridhau samullasati manmanastadapi bodhahetustvayi || pacelimatapaḥphalairamitapuṇyasaṅghrārjitairbhavānapi samāgatastripuravairisaṃpreṣitaḥ | muniṣvapi viśeṣatastvayidayā maheśasya yā nako'pi bhuvaneṣu vā pramathanāthaliṃgārcakaḥ ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe jaigīṣavya skandasamāgamonāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||
skandadarśanannāma aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ
sūta uvāca–
upopaviviśurhṛṣṭāṣṣaḍānanavilokanāt | hṛṣṭāstataste śaivendrā aṣṭamūrtikṛpāspadāḥ ||
ūcuḥ prāñjalayassarve jaigīṣavya purogamāḥ |
pṛ0 28) munaya ūcuḥ– skanda tripurasaṃhartṛtanūbhava sukhāspada || 2 || krauñconmātha giriśreṣṭha śūrādīnāṃ vidāraṇa | śivajñānasudhāṃbodhe saśaktecākhilārthada || kumāra mārasaṅkāśa prapannajanavatsala | śivāṅkabhūtaparyaṅka sarvabhūtahṛdantara || 4 || vīrabāhumukhānekagaṇottamaniṣevita | śikhivāhāmarendrādisenāpālana he prabho || 5 || praṇavādimahāvākyasārāsāravicāraka | bhaktahṛtpadmasandehatamasstomanivāraka || 6 || jñānodayodyanmārtāṇḍa pracaṇḍataravikrama | tava pādāṃbujadvandvavilokanahatāśubhāḥ || 7 || jaigīṣavyasya tapasā dṛṣṭo'smābhirmaheśvaraḥ | tenājñaptā vayaṃ sarve jaigīṣavyapurassarāḥ || tvadvākpaṅkajaniṣyandamakarandamadhuvratāḥ | pātuṃ śivarahasyākhyamamṛtaṃ bhavanāśakam || 9 || prayātāḥ puṇyabhāreṇa tava sannidhimutkaṭāḥ | santaptānbhavadāvāgnimadhyasthānadhunāmunīn || sudhāśīkarayādṛṣṭyāśītayāśuprasīda naḥ | itthammunīnāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā skando harātmajaḥ || prasannacetāstānāha śāṃbhavānharanandanaḥ ||
skanda uvāca– jaigīṣavyamukhā yūyaṃ munayo bhāvasattamāḥ | bhavabhāvaikasaṃpannā bhaktāssarve maheśvare || bhavatāṃ darśanenaiva bhāvanānanditaṃ mama | manasaḥ padmamutphullaṃ muneśśrutvā tapaḥkriyām || prasādo'pi mahādevājjaigīṣavyasya sattama | śivājñayā samāyāto jaigīṣavyo mahāmuniḥ || bhavadbhiśśāṃbhavaissārdhaṃ mayā jñātaṃ hṛdaiva hi | pātrabhūtā bhavanto hi triṇetrapadapūjakāḥ || yadgopyamapi tadvakṣye rahasyaṃ śivahṛdgatam | śivāṅkasaṃsthena mayā śrutametatpurātanam || 16 || dvādaśāṃśasamāyuktaṃ devyai devena darśitam | puṇyaṃ pāpaharañcai tatsarvaśrutiśirogatam || 17 || bhavānyai ca bhavenaiva kathitaṃ bhavanāśanam | kathānakaṃ śrutiśiraḥ praṇavārthaṃ mahāghabhit || 18 || jaigīṣavyāgragā yūyaṃ śṛṇvantu paramārthataḥ | dharmakāmārthamokṣāṇāṃ sārabhūtamidaṃ śubham || 19 || śrutvedaṃ hi kathāratnaṃ śaṅkarasya parātmanaḥ | śrotumanyannaroceta yathānyāḥ prākṛtāḥ kathāḥ || 20 || sṛṣṭisthityantakathanairnṛpāṇāñcaritāśrayaiḥ | varṇāśramaikakathanaśramabhāraiḥ kathānakaiḥ || 21 || dharmābhāsakathābhiḥ kiṃ yathā śaṃbhoḥ kathārasam | kimandhakūpamadhyasthastamasā pariveṣṭitaḥ || 22 || anyānandhānpūrayeta tathaivānyakathā mune | purāṇeṣu prakathitaiḥ kintu carvitacarvaṇaiḥ || 23 ||
pṛ0 29) janmamṛtyuyutānāñca surāṇāṃ munipuṃgavāḥ | kathāḥ kathantārayanti janmamṛtyujarāyutān || śrīmanmṛtyuñjayasyaiva kathā mṛtyuvivarjitān | karoti jagatāṃ viprāśśaivāśśivarahasyagāḥ || sudhāsāgaramadhyasthaḥ kiṃ nu kūpodakaṃ pibet | kvaṇadvīṇādininadaṃ śrutvā kākaravaṃ yathā || yathā ratnākaraṃ prāpya kācakhaṇḍamapekṣate | yathā mattebhasadṛśaḥ kiṃmalāśanakṛtkiṭiḥ || 27 || yathā mṛgendrasadṛśovānaraḥ kiṃ dvijottamāḥ | tathā cānya kathāsaktāstyaktvā śiva kathārasam || yathā śivo mahādevassarvavedāntasaṃstutaḥ | tathā śivarahasyākhyamitihāsavarammune || 29 || śivakaṇṭhamaṇiścāyaṃ pāpamocakamocakaḥ | purā kailāsaśikhare devyai devena kīrtitam || 30 || prāha devaṃ virūpākṣamambikā parameśvarī || 31 ||
śrī devyuvāca– śaṃbho viśveśa bharga triṇayana purahankālakālāndhakāre pāpāre phālanetra smarahara garapa trāhi devāndvijāṃśca | kathaya tava rahasyaṃ yena muktā trilokī nigamaśirasi niṣṭhā kā gariṣṭhā vadādya || yadi tava karuṇābdhe śīkarāsārapātraṃ mama śrutivarapātraṃ tvaṃ kṛtārthī kuruṣva | tava caritamaśeṣaṃ lokaduḥkhāpanutyai purahara kuru karṇe māmakīne dayasva || 33 || sugopyamapi śaṅkara pramathanātha viśvādhika nidhehi mayi tatsthiraṃ ciramapi prarūḍhaṃ tvayi | tvadīyadayayā paraṃ prakaṭitāntaraṃgaṃ mama tvadīyacaraṇāṃbuje sakalabhaktibhāvairyutā || 34 || iti devyā vacaśśrutvā prāhakāmaprabhañjanaḥ | svāṅkasaṃsthāmmahādevīṃ tadaṅkasthena yatpurā || mayāśrāvi kathāsindhurahasyaṃ tadbruve'dhunā | bhavānāṃ bhavanāśāya bhavabhaktivivardhanam ||
īśvara uvāca– nādeyantava vidyate tribhuvane śailendraje kevala- ndehārdhe'dhikṛtāsi viśvajananī nirūparūpastvayā |
pṛ0 30) viśvaṃ pāsi tathātsi śaktirakhilā devi tvayā śaktimā- nukto'haṃ śrutibhirnirindriya iti tvatto'smi dehaṃ gataḥ || 37 || apāṇipādo'hamaluptaśaktiḥ paśyāmyacakṣuḥ praśṛṇomyakarṇaḥ | ahaṃ vijānāmi samastametatsahaiva santaṃ na vijānanti devāḥ || 38 || śīrṇeṣvaśīrṇo'hamajaḥ purātanaśśarīrahīno'smi sadāhyasaṃgaḥ | vedāśca vedāntavaco yato me nivṛttabhāvā manasā sadāṃbike || 39 || kathaṃ pāmarā vānarākāraceṣṭāssadākāmalobhādimātsaryayuktāḥ | varākāśśarāvādihastā raṭanti surāścāsurāścāsurā bhūsurāḥ kim || 40 || labhante tvamekākinī skandanandīśamukhyā madīyaprakṛṣṭaprabhāvaikatarṣāḥ | yato bhāvalabhyaikamūrtiṃ maheśaṃ sadāvedavedāntavācāṃ durāpam || 41 || vijānāsi devi tvamādyaṃ mamādyaṃ sadā śuddhabuddhaṃ cidānandarūpam | triṇetraṃ garādhīśakaṇṭhaṃ sahāṃbaṃ prapaśyanti yogīndramukhyā harājāḥ || 42 || ahaṃ lokamuktyarthamīśāni dehaṃ sṛjāmyadya kāmaṃ nigṛhṇāmi cānte | śive vyaktarūpaṃ surādyairdurāpaṃ najānīyuretatkathāṃ pāmarā mām || 43 || śṛṇu śravaṇabhūṣaṇaṃ nigamapārasāraṃ sphuṭaṃ sugopyamapi vartate hṛdi sugopyametattvayā | aśāṃbhavavaśe'rpito na bhavati prarūḍhastaruryathaiva marubhūmigaśśivarahasyametattathā || 44 || suśāṃbhavasarovaraprathitaraktaphullābjinīvikāsanadivākaraśśivajanaikatoṣapradaḥ | hṛdantaratamogaṇonmathitapāpameghānilo viśoṣayatu duṣpathaprabhavakāmapaṃkaṃ sadā || 45 || bhajantu sudhiyassadā śravaṇarāśisanmaṃgalaṃ na hīnajanamānasāśśravaṇametadeva sphuṭam | dhruvaṃ bhavati śailaje nigamasārabhūtaṃ madhu śivārcakajanapriyaṃ madhulihasta eva priye || 46 || prakṛṣṭarasabhāvukā bhavabhavābdhisaṃśoṣakāḥ ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe skandadarśanannāma aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||
pṛ0 31) skandaśivagaṇasaṃvādo nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ
sūta uvāca– evamabhyāgatāntsamyaksadasaspatiśāsanāt | skandāsyavimalodāranirgacchantyaśśivāśrayāḥ || 1 || kathāḥkāpathaduśrāvyā nārado'thasurānyayau | cakṣuśravākanyakāśca śravaṇārthaṃ divaspatīn || brahmendraviṣṇulokeśāṃstadudantakathā bhuvi | viṣṇave brahmaṇe caiva dikpālebhyo'mareśvare || taccākathayadīśebhyo jaigīṣavyaprasādajam | maheśvarasya śrutvā te devāssaṃbhramamānasāḥ || kathāśravaṇalolākṣā nāradena samāgatāḥ | vinatānandanārūḍho lakṣmīpatiratandritaḥ || 5 || dhavalābhranibhātyucca haṃsārūḍho vidhistadā | abhyagādbhāratīnātho nāgārūḍhassureśvaraḥ || svaṃ svaṃ vāhanamāruhya yayurdevāstadāmudā | tārakārisadaḥ prāptā nānābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 7 || praṇamya brahmaviṣṇvindrāḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭā jaguḥ ||
devā ūcuḥ– skandananditavandārubṛndavandyapadāṃbuja | śivabhāvāmarādhyakṣa śrutuṃ tava mukhācchubhāḥ || śaṃbhośśaṃbhuja sarvasvāḥ kathāśśivarahasyagāḥ | śrotuṃ pravṛttā munibhirjaigīṣavyena sādarāḥ || tasmātpravartaya śubhāḥ pāpatāpanivārakāḥ | tadā suramunīndrāṇāṃ vacasānandanirbharaḥ || jagāda saṃpraṇamyeśamaṃbāṃ vighnādribhedanam | dhyātvā svahṛtpadmagataṃ jaigīṣavyamudaikṣata || 11 || śaivendrānamarendrāṃśca protphullanalināsyakaḥ | uvāca prasabhaṃ sabhyāntsadasaspati pūjakān || bhasmatripuṇṭraniṭilānrudrākṣāṃgadakaṅkaṇān | śivapādāṃbujavyagracetasastānabhāṣata || 13 ||
skanda uvāca– tvameva bhavabhakto'si jaigīṣavya śṛṇuṣvame | sahaibhirmunibhissārdhaṃ devaiśśivarahasyakam || devyai devena kathitaṃ pāpatāpaviśoṣaṇam | evaṃ saṃvadatānteṣāṃ sindhūrāruṇagaṇḍabhṛt || 15 || vāraṇendramahāvaktro vighnapūganivārakaḥ | skandāśramantadā prāpa gaṇabṛndaniṣevitaḥ || vimānavaramāsthāya kailāsācalatastadā | nandibhṛṃgi mahākālabāṇacaṇḍīśvarādayaḥ || tuhuṇḍahuṇḍasānandamahānandāśca bhairavaḥ | tundaḥ kālāgnirudraśca ye cānye gaṇapottamāḥ || somanandiprabhṛtayo gaṇakoṭivarapradāḥ | samāgatā maheśena preṣitā gaṇanāyakāḥ || 19 ||
pṛ0 32) mastakāntajaṭodbhāsidhṛtabālenduśekharāḥ | tripuṇṭravilasatphālā rudrākṣāṃgadakaṃkaṇāḥ || mahāḍamarunādotthahuṃkārita diśā mukhāḥ | tāndṛṣṭvā sahasottasthau munibhiśca surāsuraiḥ || natvā dviradavakrantaṃ datvārghyāsanamutkaṭam | saṃpūjya modakāpūpadūrvāgandhākṣatādibhiḥ || tārakārirgaṇendrāṃstānparyaṣvajatā gāḍhahṛt | nandīśvarādīntsasnehaṃ pūjitāste mahārhaṇaiḥ || niṣedusskandamabhito munīndrāssurapā gaṇāḥ | paśyantaste prāñjalayaṣṣaḍānana varānanam || ūcuste nandikeśādyāsskandaṃ krauñcavidāraṇam || 25 ||
nandikeśvaraḥ– jaigīṣavyasya tapasā prasannena śivena ca | tvadvāgamṛtaniṣyandakathāśravaṇalālasān || asmāntsaṃpreṣayāmāsa tvadantikamumāpatiḥ | umāṃkasaṃsthena purā tvayā'śrāvi manoharam || śaivaṃ śivāyai kathitaṃ rahasyaṃ pāpabhedanam | dvādaśāṃśayutaṃ sākṣātpaśupāśavimuktidam || vedasmṛtipurāṇeṣu bhārateṣvāgameṣvapi | paśudharmāśca munibhiḥ proktāssaṃsāradāyakāḥ || patidharmaikakathanaṃ vimuktidamumāpatiḥ | vedavedāntasārotthakathāḥ pāpanikṛntanīḥ || kathayāmāsa taddevyai rahasyaṃ śrutisammitam | jābālopaniṣatsāraṃ sākṣāddharamukhoditam || tadantikapradeśe'pi naivāsmākamavasthitiḥ | saptaprākārabāhye vai gopurāgre vyavasthitāḥ || devyutsaṃgagatenādya tvayā tacchrutamuttamam | tadvadāsmabhyamadhunā gopyaṃ devena kīrtitam || aparṇāyai mudā tatra kailāse śaṃkarālaye | hārendrasyānuṣaṃgeṇa phaṇīndrāśca prasāditāḥ || surendrāśca munīndrāśca jaigīṣavya tapasyayā | tvayi premāspade śaṃbhośśaṃbhunā preṣitāvayam || jaigīṣavyaṃ puraskṛtya vadāsmākaṃ kṛpānidhe | nidhānabhūtaṃ sadratnaṃ śivadharmaikasādaram || itthannandīśavākyena candrodaya ivāṃbudhiḥ | praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe nagādhīśasutāsutaḥ || 37 || vacasāhlādayantsarvāngaṇendrānamareśvarān | munīśvarāngajendrāsyaṃ jaigīṣavyaṃ mahāmunim || uvāca cāgrajannatvā maheśañcāṃbikāmapi | gajānanantadāstauṣītstotreṇāthaṣaḍānanaḥ || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā gaṇendrasurabhūsuraiḥ ||
skanda uvāca– payodadhipayebhavadvikacapuṣkaraiḥ puṣkaraṃ madāndhakaraṭitvacovasanaputramindraprabham | tripuṇṭratilakojvalaṃ dviradavaktrakuṃbhojvalaṃ maheśajanimarcakaṃ praṇatavighnarājaṃ surāḥ ||
pṛ0 33) sindhūradūrvācitakuṃbhamauliṃ gaṇḍasthalīlaṃbitacāmaraugham | karṇāvataṃsīkṛtapadmakośaṃ namāmi vighnārtiharaṃ prasannam || 41 || karaṭajamadadhārāgandhasandohabandhadvijadalikulamālaṃ karṇasaṃvītatodyaiḥ | bhajata nigamasāraṃ nāgayajñopavītaṃ paśupativaraputraṃ vighnarājannato'smi || 42 || sṛṇiparaśukarābjaṃ naumi vijñānahetuṃ gaṇapatimagajāntaḥpremadhārārasāptam | phalakulaguḍamādyaṃ modakaughapriyaṃ tvāṃ paśupativaraputrannaumi nāgendravaktram || ākhuvāhamajaśaurisureśaissindhurendravadanaṃ munivandyam | vedabṛndanivahaisstutamādyaṃ gadyapadyavacasā praṇato'smi || 44 ||
sūta uvāca– gajāsyamitthaṃ saṃstutya ṣaḍāsyastundilāntaraḥ | prāhatānpramathādhīśāntsureśānbhūsurāṃstataḥ || 45 || jaigīṣavyammuniśreṣṭhaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ śiva sammitam | skando'grajasyānumateśśivayoḥ prāhatanmatam ||
skanda uvāca– īśānāṃbunidhessuśīkaragaṇā brahmendranārāyaṇā- ste śaktyādimarutpracāracalitāstatsūnujāssṛṣṭayaḥ | tatsūnuprabhavā nṛpādaya ime kintatkathābhiḥ phalaṃ saṃprāpnoti visṛṣṭayo'tra hi mahābhūtādibhistā mṛṣā || 47 || mithyābhūtajagatpracāravihito dharmo'tra varṇāśramā- pārāvāravicārasārahṛdayāsteṣāṃ śramaḥ kevalam | kintaccarvitacarvaṇena viduṣāṃ vidyodbhavo jāyate yaṃ dharmottamamāmananti tapasā saṃvedya ekaśśivaḥ || 48 || jaigīṣavyamukhāśca bhūsuragaṇā yūyaṃ gaṇāśśāṅkarā viṣṇubrahmasureśvarā munigaṇāśśrīmadgaṇeśāgrataḥ |
pṛ0 34) vakṣye tacchivayorapāracaritaṃ kailāsamatyādarā- daprāpyaṃ tvatidurdhiyāñca sudhiyāṃ śrīmanmaheśālayam || 49 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe skandaśivagaṇasaṃvādonāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||
jaigīṣavyaskandasaṃvāde daśamo'dhyāyaḥ
skanda uvāca– śivapādāravindaśrīryyāśriyaṃ śrīpatiṃ vidhim | indraṃ candraṃ surānanyānutpādayati sā śivā || ḍuṇḍiñca nandikeśañca tathā bhṛṅgiriṭiṃ munim | mārkaṇḍeyaṃ dadhīciñca dūrvāsaṃjāmadagnikam || jaya jaya maṃgalatarasundaratamamaṃgalāpate jaya jaya viśvavidhānasaṃsthitinidhanaśikṣaṇacaṇa bandhutara sundara varakṛttivasana munibṛndavinuta ninditamakhasaṃhṛte surananditagaṇa puramāraka bhavaśoṣaṇa garalāśana śamanabhayakaṃpitamunipotakaśaraṇa aruṇādhipa karuṇākara janatāraṇa taraṇisthita surakāraṇa māraśoṣaṇa triguṇanigamagaṇapoṣaṇacaraṇa śaraṇaṃ bhava śaraṇaṃ bhava śaraṇaṃ bhava dayayā || 3 ||
nigamāgamavacanātiga yamimānasagaganāntara vayunasthitisurakāraṇa māraśoṣaṇabhavanāśana varahāraka dahanāmalanayana mananātiga vṛṣavāhanagamana bhavanāśana vasitāśaka surabhūsuranikarāvana pitṛkānanavihṛte daharākṛtikuharātiga varabhūdharaśayana kharaśītajakarasaṃsthita murabhedanaśaradhāraṇa puranāśana nigamavrajaturagottama uragādhipakṛtaśiñjanivarakārmuka mṛgadhṛk kuliśāyudhamukhadaivatabhaṭarakṣaṇacatura śaraṇaṃ bhava śaraṇaṃ bhava śaraṇaṃ bhava dayayā || 4 ||
dahanānilatapanāmaravarabhūsurajalanāyakaśamanākṛtavinate kalitākhilacarajaṅgamajagatāmavana jananādika lalitottamacarita bharitānatavaratāta janatāpahṛte vinatātmajavāhanārcanajanitātuladayayā vikacāṃbujanibhalocanarathasaṃvahanaprada vidhimaulijaphalakāmalaśayabhūṣita bhagavan pavanānalavalamāraṇabalaśoṣaṇa tṛṇacālanamapi kṛte kṛṇute na hi nikhilāgamaśirasaṃstutacarita śaraṇaṃ bhava śaraṇaṃ bhava śaraṇaṃ bhava dayayā ||
pṛ0 35) varuṇālayamathanodbhavagaralotthitamahasā surakinnaraharavalāna harisrāyaka rabhasā kabalīkṛtagarasambhavanalināmalaśubhakandhara jaladopama bhagavan madhumāraṇanayanāmalanalinārcitapadapaṃkaja lulitāṃbudhiculukīkṛtaghaṭasambhavanutitoṣita yatimānasavarabhūṣaṇa phaṇikaṃkaṇa bhagavan duritāpaha calitāmalalalitendukalālavavimalīkṛtajagate śaraṇaṃ bhava śaraṇaṃ bhava śaraṇaṃ bhava dayayā || 6 ||
makhasanmukhahavanāśanamukhatarpitahavibhakṣaṇavibudhavrajanalinotthitamahimātiga paripūjanarahitātulamanyukṛte mananotthitagaṇagarjana paritarjana surabharjana vidhinandana kṛtaśikṣaṇa paripūritaduritāntaka gajamāraṇakaraṇa agajādhipa bhujagādhipaśayanārpitavidhimaulijakalitasraja valabhinmatabhagadaivatanayanāṃbujanāśakṛte śaraṇaṃ bhava śaraṇaṃ bhava śaraṇaṃ bhava dayayā || 7 ||
jaṭilālaka mṛganāyakamadapāṭanajanitāṃbarakaṭiśobhita vaṭasaṃsthita nigamāgamabhaṭagoṣaka suranāyakatruṭitākhilajagadudbhavaghaṭakarparahariśarakarṣa puradāhana bhagavan paṭutākṛtinikhilasthitikaṭukībhavajaladhe bhavadāgamajagadudgamajaladālayavahana tripurāntaka śamitāntaka śamitāndhaka śamitākhiladuḥkha vibho śaraṇaṃ bhava śaraṇaṃ bhava śaraṇaṃ bhava dayayā || 8 ||
pavanāśanamaṇikaṃkaṇa garalāśanamadhusūdanavalanāśanayamunānujabhavanāśana sikatāśanatanayāmalagaṇasattamaguṇabandhurahṛdayānana munisattamavinuta gaṇagarjitavadanāyitaśaśidhāmakakṛtanetraka uḍunāyakaśikharāmaravaranāyakakumudākarasamudāyajatatalocana dviradānanasutaharṣada taruṇendulalāmamasṛṇāruṇanakhajotpalakalikāyitasurajālakamakuṭītaṭaghaṭitāṃbujapāda śaraṇaṃ bhava śaraṇaṃ bhava śaraṇaṃ bhava dayayā || 9 ||
akhilāṇḍaga śukatuṇḍajaghaṭanotthitamadhurāyitasukhatandrijarasasārasapadanāma jamunigītavinoda kanakāṃbujajanitākhilagajakhaṇḍana yamakhaṇḍana śaśikhaṇḍanakalitāmalaśirase mṛdumaṇḍita urageśvarakṛtakuṇḍala vidhikhaṇḍana śikhaṇḍavaralocana baḍavānalakṛtajihvaka śikhivāhanakṛtabodhana śrutimaṇḍalaśirase puradaṇḍana nagakodaṇḍajahariśarakarṣaṇākhaṇḍalakarabhañjana munimaṇḍalakṛtarakṣaṇa khaṇḍaparaśo taṇḍunandigaṇabhṛṃgi-
pṛ0 36) caṇḍikṛtatālamaddalajaghuṅghumadhvanijamaḍḍughargharitaraṃganāṭyapara jahnujāvitatanīratīravilasacchivaliṃga śaraṇaṃ bhava śaraṇaṃ bhava śaraṇaṃ bhava dayayā || 10 ||
ityaṣṭapadyaissvāntasthaṃ tuṣṭāvāṣṭākṛtiṃ haram | skando natvātha jagatāṃ mātaraṃstotumārabhat || udārataragaṃbhīrapadyairhṛdyairmaheśvarīm | devavāmāṃkabhāgasthāṃ tārakārissvamātaram || 12 ||
skanda uvāca– naumi staumi jagatprasādaghaṭanāsaṃsthānasaṃpāditāṃ lokālokanatatparāṃ bhagavatīṃ māyāṃ maheśāśrayām | viṣṇubrahmamarudgaṇeśvaramahāsāmrājyadānakṣamā- mīśāṃkādhikṛtāṃ prasādamukharāṃ kāyena vācā sadā || 13 || indukundakarimattajabiṃbasphāradhāravijitākhilabṛndām | nīlameghanalināmalakāntiṃ kesarīndravarabhūdharakūrmām || 14 || vaktradantagamanādharakeśairlocanena jaghanena kucābhyām | pādapaṃkajarajaḥparibhūtā nāgayakṣasuramānavakanyāḥ || 15 || ambāmambhoruhākṣīṃ sakalasurakadambaikaśāliprapūrṇāṃ kāśīśeśānnapūrṇāṃ vidhihariharasatsaṃstutāṃ bhargakāntām | śāntāṃ śāntāntaraṃgāṃ bhajadaghapaṭalīvyālanāgāntakāntāṃ kāntāndevasya devīmagavaravarajānnaumi cinnityasaṃsthām || 16 || nalinajavanitāpadmasaṃsthākarasthaiḥ | vidhivahagarudābhaiścāmarairvījyamānāṃ śaśimukhanijabharturbhāryayā chatravatyā | sitanabhasaṭasihmaskandhasihmāsanasthāṃ gajamukhaśikhivāhapremajānandadṛṣṭim || raktabījaturagāridhūmrajācāmarārivaraśuṃbhaniśuṃbhān | caṇḍamuṇḍavarabhaṇḍajamuṇḍairājibhūmikamalairivadevī || 18 || kodaṇḍākṛṣṭadaṇḍoccalitavaraśarāsāradhārādibhiryā tastārāmaravīrasaṃstutapadā sā pātu naśśreyase || 19 ||
pṛ0 37) sūta uvāca– evaṃ saṃstuvatastasya skandasyāmalacetasaḥ | prādurāsīdvṛṣārūḍho bhagavāñchrīvṛṣadhvajaḥ || nīlakaṇṭhastriṇetraśca bhogībhogavibhūṣaṇaḥ | koṭiprabhākarodbhāsimayūkhāvalibhāsitaḥ || diśāmukhatamasstomamaulisomanivāritaḥ | calaccāmaravālotthavātaproccalitāṃbaraḥ || chatrachāyāvāritodyadbhānubhānamarīcimān | somassahomayābhyāgādgaṇasaṅghasamāvṛtaḥ || surāsurakaronmuktasumavarṣaughasantatiḥ | tadgandhabandhasaṃbandhamarudāmodamoditaḥ || 24 || vikacatkamalāmodamālayā śobhivigrahaḥ | vilasanmaṇimuktādimālāvalitakandharaḥ || phaṇāmaṇikṛtānekamāṇikyavarakaṅkaṇaḥ | jaṅgamādripratīkāśavṛṣārūḍho'bhyagācchivaḥ || munikinnaragandharvagānadhārāstutastutiḥ | dṛṣṭvādevantadottasthau skandassihmāsanāttadā || munīndraiśca gaṇendraiśca surendrairgaṇapena ca | jaigīṣavyena muninā praṇanāma maheśvaram || 28 || dṛṣṭvā namantantaṃ skandaṃ sagaṇaṃ samuniṃsurān | dviradāsyammunīndrañca jaigīṣavyaṃ kṛpāṃbudhiḥ || karuṇāparayā dṛṣṭyā cāluloke sahāṃbayā | putrau gāḍhaṃ pariṣvajya mūrdhnicāghrāya śaṃkaraḥ || uvāca sarvadevānāṃ sannidhau skandamīśvaraḥ ||
īśvaraḥ– vatsānayātavastutyāsantuṣṭo'smi sahāṃbayā | dhanyayāmānyayāskandatvammamātīvavallabhaḥ || tvayāmadvadanāṃ bhojādyacchrutaṃ sāramaiśvaram | śaivaṃ śivarahasyākhyaṃ varamokṣakathāśrayam || gaṇānāñca surāṇāñca munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām | jaigīṣavyaṃ puraskṛtya mama bhaktaṃ jitendriyam || māriṣṭaṃ māca te vighnaṃ mama bhūyātkathārase | yato vighnaharaste'dya sannidhau vartate'grajaḥ || 34 || ityuktvā ca mahādevīmālokya ca hasanharaḥ || 35 || nānāsthāvarajaṅgamādijanibhirbhrāntasya mānuṣyatā mānuṣye sati vipratā śrutigatā cācāratā tatparam | iṣṭāpūrtivaśakriyādiśataśo vṛtyā paraṃ śāṃbhavo liṃgāliṃganacetasā sa hi bhavenmuktastvaliṃgassukhī || 36 || śrutiśatavidhijālakarmamūlāstriguṇagatāgatisaukhyaduḥkhaśīlāḥ | manasijasukhamānasaṃgalīlāmananavicāravivarjanena bālāḥ || 37 ||
pṛ0 38) narakamukhamavāpya cendralokaṃ bhavabhuvanaṃ samavāpya martyalokam | punarapi jananena karmaśeṣairmatimapi ghoratarāṃ samāpnuvanti || 38 || kiṃ vedairakhilaiḥ purāṇanicayairanyonyanindāparaiḥ kiṃ vā bhāratayuddhakīrtanamume kiṃ kṣudradharmādibhiḥ | yatreśānakathāpracāravidhurānissārabhūtā kathā kāvyenāpi kimatra rāmakathayā duḥkhotkaṭāyāḥ phalam || 39 ||
sūtaḥ– kṛtāñjalipuṭā devī prāhaśaṃbhuṃ sanātanam | maheśaṃ jagadādhāramanādhāraṃ maheśvaram ||
devyuvāca– tvatkṛpāpātrabhūtānāṃ nāśubhaṃ vidyate hara | mattaśśuśrāva vedārthasāraṃ śaivarahasyakam || 41 || skando'yaṃ skanditārātirvinīto vītamatsaraḥ | rahasyaṃ yattvayā proktaṃ munīñchrāvayatu prabho || surabhūsurasaṅgheṣu gaṇendreṣu maheśvara | prasādaḥ kriyatāmadya śravaṇāya munirdhṛtaḥ || 43 || jaigīṣavyo'pi matimāṃstava bhaktastvananyadhīḥ | tadā devyā vacaśśrutvākarapaṃkajamuttamam || nidadhau skandaśirasi jaigīṣavyasya śaṃkaraḥ | śaṃkaraśrīkarasparśājjaigīṣavyakumārakau || nematuśśivapādābjaṃ protphullahṛdayānanau | skandaśśivapadābjantatkarābhyāṃ saṃspṛśañjagau || ayammehastamantreṇa svanetrakamalasravaiḥ | abhyaṣiñcanmudā bhaktyānānyatkiñcidamanyata || skandaṃ prāha mahādevo jaigīṣavye kṣaṇastadā ||
īśvara uvāca– śive kilaiṣatoṣakṛnmunīśvareṣu yatpriyo viśeṣataḥ kṛpājharībharīkulena lokitaḥ | kalākulena tarpito yathaiṇabālalāñchana- sstathaiṣa jaigiṣavyakaḥ kaṭākṣato bhavenmama || 48 || prasādya sarvānamarānmunīndrāngaṇeśvarānskandamunīnmaheśvaraḥ | jagāma gauryā jagatāṃ vidhātā saṃstūyamāno munidevasaṅghaiḥ || 49 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe jaigīṣavyaskandasaṃvāde daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||
pṛ0 39) skanda jaigīṣavyasaṃvāde dvādaśāṃśasaṃkhyākathanaṃ nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
sūta uvāca– śivadarśanajānandasandohānandanirbharaḥ | prāhaśūrāriritthantaṃ munimālokya śāṃkaram ||
skanda uvāca– jaigīṣavyaśṛṇuṣvādya rahasyākhyānamuttamam | śaive rahasye devena devyai kathikathānakam || tadvakṣyāmi samāsena śṛṇutvaṃ munibhissaha | gaṇeśvaraissureśaiśca tatrādau kathayāmyaham || namaskṛtvāprameyāya mahādevāya śambhave | devīṃ gajānanaṃ devaṃ śaivācāryānakalmaṣān || māheśāṃśaḥ prathamato nāmnāsau munisattama | jaigīṣavya prasādante maheśasya samāgamaḥ || gaṇānāndevasaṃṅghānāṃ munīnāñca samāgamaḥ | mayā prasādito devasstotravaryeṇa sattama || kailāsavarṇanañcaiva vicitraṃ śrīmaheśituḥ | devyā maheśasaṃvādaḥ kautukena nagottame || 7 || caritraṃ śivayostatra vicitraṃ bhūdharottame | kailāseśvarapūjā ca maheśena prakalpanam || 8 || dvāraprākāraracanā gaṇānāṃ sthānakalpanam | mama devyāśca viprendra gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥ || sahasraliṃgādhyāyañca kailāsasya tapaḥ kriyā | tatprasādanamīśena tanmaulauvasatistathā || kailāsasyābhiṣekaśca śaṃbhunā kalpitonagaiḥ | jijñāsā caivadevānāṃ devyāḥ prādurbhavātsurāḥ || jñānārthakathanañcaiva cātmaliṃgasya pūjanam | māheśe'sminmaheśena kathāḥproktāśśivena hi || diksaṃkhyayā muniśreṣṭha kathito'yaṃ sahasrataḥ | dvitīyoṃśo bhavo nāmnā tasminproktaṃ hareṇa hi || devyāścaiva tapaścaryā maṇidvīpāgamastathā | kalpavāṭīramyanīpavanadvīpopavarṇanam || 14 || cintāmaṇimahāsaudhavarṇanaṃ śrīpurasya ca | tasmātkailāsagamanaṃ kāmeśasya vapurdharaḥ || kāmeśayā ca devyāca tatra nityamavasthitiḥ | himācalāgamaścaiva devyāstatra gatirmune || dūrvāsaso mahimnaśca kathanaṃ tattapaḥkriyā | dvitīye bhavasaṃjñe'tra kathitaṃ śaṃkareṇa hi || 17 || sahasratritayenaiva [ślokasārdhena sāhasra tritayenaiva śaṃkaraḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] ślokasārdhena śaṃkaraḥ | harastritīyo devena kathitoṃśo munīśvarāḥ || tasminmuniprārthanayā vyāsena parikīrtanam | gāyatryāśca tapaścaryā devyāgamanamuttamam || gaṇānāṃ preṣaṇañcaiva tīrtheśamahimā tathā | śrīśailamahimā cāpi mānasārcanakalpanam || janakasya ca saṃvādo yājñavalkyena śaṃkara | padmāvatyā ratnanidhessaṃvādaḥ paramādbhutaḥ ||
pṛ0 40) tasyottarārdhe cāṃśasya pūjāratnanidhestathā | śivasya devadevasya mahādevasya śūlinaḥ || yamalokasya vṛttānto darśanaṃ śivayostathā | saṃvādo bhasmarudrākṣadhāraṇe mahimāpi ca || gaṃgāyā narmadāyāśca varaprāptyupavarṇanam | māheśvaravratañcaiva varṇanaṃ śrīmaheśituḥ || 24 || śaivārcanādikathanaṃ śivaḍuṇḍicaritrakam | trayastriṃśatsahasreṇa saṅkhyayā prokta eva hi || caturthaśśivasaṃjñohi cāṃśassākṣācchivoditaḥ | bṛhajjābāladharmādikathanaṃ daśakasya hi || bhasmarudrākṣamahimā śivaliṃgārcanasya ca | mahimā śivabhaktānāṃ śaivānāṃ bhojane'pi ca || śivakṣetranivāsasya kathanaṃ bilvapūjanāt | pūjāprabhāvakathanaṃ tasminnaṃśe prakīrtitam || catussahasratassaṅkhyā devadevoditā śubhā | bhargonāmnā pañcamāṃśaḥ kathito'traśivenahi || jyotirliṃgadvādaśānāṃ mahimā tatra kīrtitaḥ | vāmadevopadeśaśca śrutisiddhānta kīrtanam || gaṃgāsāgaramāhātmyaṃ prabhāse puṣkarasya ca | haridvāraprabhāvaśca bilvamūlārcanasya ca || sahasranāmakathanandevadevasya śūlinaḥ | mahimā devadevena kathito'sti viśeṣataḥ || 32 || śivāyai ṣaṭsahasro'tra kathito munisattama | śaṃkarāṃśastataṣṣaṣṭho diksaṅkhyā kramasaṅkhyayā || kathitaśśrīmaheśena tasminrudropavarṇanam | śivaliṃgārcanasyāpi bhasmarudrākṣadhāriṇām || mahimā śāṃbhavānāñca kathito vistareṇahi | nidāghṛbhusaṃvādaṣṣaṣṭhāṃśo jñānavistaraḥ || ugro nāmnā saptamo'tra kathitaśśaṃkareṇa hi | devasya devyā saṃvādo nāmasāhasrakīrtanam || avimuktapraśaṃsā ca śatarcanatapaḥkriyā | nāmnāmaṣṭottarākhyānaṃ mahimnamathavai hareḥ || 37 || puṣpadantamahimnākhyakathanaṃ tatra sattama | kāṭakoṭarajākhyānaṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ mahimā tathā || śrīśailasyāruṇādreśca tathā vṛddhācalasya ca | śrīmaddakṣiṇakailāsamāhātmyamapi vistarāt || puṇḍarīkapurasyāpi kāñcyāśśrīmahimādbhutaḥ | kuṃbhaghoṇa praśaṃsā ca tathā madhyārjunasya ca || caturdaśasahasreṇa kathito'traśivenahi | bhīmo'ṣṭamo mahāṃśo'trakathito vistareṇa hi || 41 || diṅnāgasaṅkhyayā caiva sahasreṇa munīśvara | pātālalokaliṃgānāṃ mahimākathanaṃ mune || 42 || śrīhāṭakeśamahimā śeṣasyātratapaḥkriyā | prasādaśca maheśena tasya bhūbhāradhāraṇe || 43 || sadāśivoṃśo navamastasmiñchaṃbhoḥ kathānakam | śivenoktaṃ mahādevyai nāmasāhasramuttamam || kalau śaivasamācārapramāṇena vimuktidam | mahāśāṃbhavadharmāṇāṃ kīrtanaṃ parikīrtitam || ṣaḍvaktrasaṅkhyayā me'dya sahasreṇaiva kīrtanam | īśvarāṃśo'tra daśamo daśadharmānukīrtanam ||
pṛ0 41) bilvārcanaṃ rudrajapaḥ pañcākṣaramahodayaḥ | śivaliṃgārcanasyāpi bhasmarudrākṣakīrtanam || śāṃbhavānāṃ śivakṣetre śaivabhaktārcanantathā | śivanāmnassmṛteścāpi daśame mahimātu yaḥ || tasminprakīrtito vipra śaṅkarasyākhyasaṅkhyayā [śaṃkarasya kramātmakaḥ iti pāṭhāntaram |] | ekādaśo mahādevaḥ proktoṃśaśśaṃbhunā tadā || mannetrakramasaṅkhyātaśśivapūjākramātmakaḥ | abhiṣecanikānāñca phalaṃ puṣpeṣu kīrtanam || bhaktīnāṃ daśakānāñca kīrtanaṃ pūjane tathā | munisaṅkhyā granthataśca īśo nāmnātra dvādaśaḥ || śivanāmnāṃ sahasrasya kīrtanaṃ tatra kīrtitam | prasādaśśaṃkarasyāpi mamaivānugrahātmakaḥ || śivaratnākarakathāmāhātmyaṃ munitoṣaṇam | etadadhyāyasāhasraiḥ kīrtitaṃ śrīśivena hi || devyai devena kathitaṃ rahasyaṃ śivasammatam | sadāśivasamo devo nāsti lokatrayeṣvapi || tathā śivarahasyena tulyamanyanna vidyate | śaivasāramahāratnakośo'yaṃ munisattama || 55 || puṇyo'yaṃ pāvanaścāyaṃ bhaktisārakathāśrayaḥ | saṃsārāyāsadharmāṇāṃ kathanena vivarjitam || varṇāśramavicārādikathāśramavivarjitaḥ | atyāśramoktadharmāṇāmākaro'yaṃ mahāmune || nānākathāsudhāśśaivāḥ paramānandanirbharāḥ | devyai devena kathitāśśatasāhasrato'dhikāḥ || bhaktaiśśrāvyo'yamatulaścetihāsavarottamaḥ | śaivasārakathāratnaṃ sarvasvo'yaṃ munīśvarāḥ || skande gajānane gauryāṃ yathāprītirmaheśituḥ | tathā śivarahasye'pi gopyaṃ gopyamidaṃ śubham || nadeyaṃ naiva vaktavyamādau tebhyastvayā mune | śapa matpadayorvipra nacenmūrdhādya te patet || vedāntasārasarvasvaṃ śivabhaktiprakāśakam | deyaṃ bhaktāya viprāya putrāyātyantarāgiṇe || vaktavyamanahaṃkāracittāyātmaguṇāya ca | śaivāya śaṃbhorutkarṣabhaktiyuktāya te mune || saṃvatsaroṣitāyatvaṃ bhaktāyānte nivāsine | triṇetracintāpātrāya nānyasmai satyamucyate ||
skandaḥ– jagāda jagatāṃ gurustrijagatāṃ janitrīṃ mudā jagattritayajantuhṛttrividhatāpaduḥkhāpaham | jaḍājaḍagatasthitipralayabhāvabhāvaṃ bhavaṃ viśoṣayadidammuhuśśivarahasyaratnāṃśumān || 65 ||
pṛ0 42) tadeva bhavatāṃ vade bhavadavāgnisaṃśoṣakaṃ vidhuntudamukhotthitaprakaṭasomadhāmaprabham | vikāsitadiśāmukhaprathitapāṇḍimānopamaṃ sudhāmapi budhāḥ paraṃ havanavaktrahavyāśanāḥ || 66 || vidhūya suralokagāḥ paripaṭhanti śaṃbhoḥ kathā- manāthajananātha te pramathanātha nātho'smyaham | girīndravarakanyakāhṛdayanātha pādāṃbujaṃ manorathapathātigaṃ prathaya bhaktibhāvaṃ tvayi || 67 || kṣamāratharathāṃgakassphuṭasupāṇibāṇāsano hiraṇyanagakārmukassakalaviśvanāthādhunā | sa eva sukhasaṃpadānnidhirapārapuṇyāspada- ssa eva sukṛtī sadā yajati vedamadhyeti ca || 68 || sa dānanicayārjitaprabhavadharmasārādhika- ssa uttamasasāgarāvasana urvarādānakṛt | kṣaṇārddhamadhikādaraśśivarahasyadharmaśravā- ssa eva gaṇanāyakaśśivapadābjayugmārcakaḥ || 69 || surāsuracarācaraprabhavanāśarakṣākramai- rnavāyutaraṇāṃkaṇaprabhavayuddhaduḥkhodbhavaiḥ | śramaikarasadhūrgatairvividhavarṇadharmāśramaiḥ kathābhiriha naśvaraṃ na bhavati śrutīśekharam || 70 || tuṣādrirabhikhaṇḍanaiḥ kimiha labhyate taṇḍula- stathā śivakathāṃ vinā na hi śamāya jantormanaḥ | śaivānandarahasyasāgaramahādvīpopamā dvādaśā- ste cāṃśāḥ khalu śaṃkareṇa vihitā nāmāni teṣāṃ vade || 71 ||
pṛ0 43) māheśaḥ prathamastato'pi hi bhavo hāraścaturthaśśivobharga- śśaṃkara ugro bhīmasadāśiveśvaramahādeveśasaṃjñā kramāt | granthaiḥ padyamahāghamaulibhidurairvedāntasārātigai- śśabdaissundaravāgvilāsamadhurairadhyāyabṛndaiśśivaḥ || 72 || sāhasraiśca śataissahasrakiraṇākāraistathā śaṃkaro diglokāmarabrahmavedṛtubhirdiṅnāgatassaṅkhyayā [diglokāmarabṛndavedṛtubhiriti pāṭhāntaram |] | madvaktrāmalanīlanīrajasamaṃ netrakramaṃ śaṃkara- syāsyākṣikramaśomunikramamayo devyai śivenākathi || 73 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe skandajaigīṣavyasaṃvāde dvādaśāṃśasaṃkhyākathanaṃ nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||
kailāsavarṇanannāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
sūta uvāca– jaigīṣavyāya yatproktaṃ skandenāmitatejasā | kailāsāpārasaudhānāṃ gopurāṇāṃ nagasya ca || pramāṇaṃ liṃgasaṅghānāmālayānāñca nirmitiḥ | śivena nirmitaṃ sākṣānmanasaivātulaprabham ||
skanda uvāca– jaigīṣavya śṛṇuṣvādya kailāsasthānamuttamam | śṛṇuṣva śailaṃ śikharaiśśaṃbhorāvāsamuttamam || sarvagasyāpi devasya mahādevasya śūlinaḥ | mahākailāsamityuktaṃ śivatatvārthavedibhiḥ || 4 || īśānagaṇamukhyasya kailāsaṃ dakṣiṇāśramam | ayaṃ mune'marendrāṇāṃ nivāso merurunnataḥ || praviṣṭaṣṣoḍaśādhastāddvātriṃśanmūrdhni viśrutaḥ | vṛṣasstambhamayo bhāti mahākailāsasannidhau || kailāsādapi pūrvasyāṃ pañcāśacca sahasrakaiḥ | yojanaiḥ prāksthito merurnānāsuragaṇāśrayaḥ || jvalajjvalanasaṃkāśaḥ kanakottamaparvataḥ | sahasrayojanotsedhaṃ viddhi meruṃ surālayam || 8 || ṣaṭṣaṣṭiḥ kathito yoginnūrdhvāyāmaikamūlataḥ | lakṣayojanamānena kailāso dharaṇīdharaḥ || 9 || kulācalāssaptaśataṃ prākāraparighāstathā | prākārasyāntarālasya saptadvīpāssasāgarāḥ ||
pṛ0 44) saptābdhayassudhāṃbhodhikallolāmalavījitaḥ | koṭiyojanamānena kailāso bhūdharo mahān || rājato rājate'tyantaṃ pañcāśallakṣamānataḥ | saptapātālamūlāntassaptalokānta ucchrayaḥ || mahārājatabhūbhāgaścandrakoṭisamaprabhaḥ | nāgnirnavidhurnosūryastattejassadṛśo bhuvi || 13 || caturdaśa mahālokānucchrāyaśśikharaissvayam | madhye sudhāsāgarasya phenamaṇḍopamassthitaḥ || na haro na harirdhātā mahendrādyāśca devatāḥ | na suparṇoragā yakṣā na gandharvā ditessutāḥ || na vīkṣituṃ śaknuvanti kiṃ punargantumañjasā | tatprabhābhihatālokā harājahariṇo dvija || tattejasā pratihatāssūryendupavanānalāḥ | sudhāsāgarakallolaiḥ kailāsasparśavāyavaḥ || 17 || punanti lokānakhilānviṣṇubrahmaharāmarān | surāsurāṇāṃ gamanaṃ na tatra manasāpi hi || na vedavacanaiśśakyo mahākailāsaparvataḥ | talleśaleśamahimāṃ kaśśakto vaktumapyaṇu || 19 || sahasravadanaśśeṣassahasrākṣo'pi nekṣate | kiṃ punarmānavāḥ kṣudrā varākāste surāsurāḥ || śataṃ kulācalāmukhyāḥ prākārāivasaṃsthitāḥ | mahadbhirucchritaiśśṛṅgaiḥ kecidgopuravatsthitāḥ || tadantarāntarāleṣu parighākṛtayo'bdhayaḥ | tato'pi saptaprākāraṃ śaṃbhorantargṛhaṃ param || prākārabhūtāste śailāstāñchṛṇuṣva dvijottama | kumudaḥ pāriyātraśca mainākaḥ pūrvadiggatāḥ || dardaro malayo vindhyaḥ paścime yogipuṃgava | udayāstācalau muñja uttarasyāṃ diśisthitāḥ || nīlo dakṣiṇakailāso himavāndakṣiṇe sthitaḥ | vigāhyāvahitāssarve cābdhibhissarvato diśam || dvīpābdhayaste parighāssaptasaptaiva parvatāḥ | tadantarāntarāleṣu viharanti divaukasaḥ || 26 || gandharvāpsarasassiddhānāgayakṣāssuparṇakāḥ | kinnarāḥ puruṣāḥ puṇyā vidyādhara sa cāraṇāḥ || munayo gaṇasaṅghāśca nānābhūmaikabhūmayaḥ | tato'pi viṣṇubrahmādyā īśānā rudramūrtayaḥ || viharanti payoṃbhodhiprākāravaramāśritāḥ | svādūdakābdhitīre ca tato'pi pramathādhipāḥ || tato'pi ratnaprākāro daśasāhasrayojanaḥ | tadratnakāntidhārābhirmaṇḍitaṃ bhuvanatrayam || mattakokilanetrābhastatrāste ratnaparvataḥ | śatayojanakocchrāyaḥ padmarāganagottamaḥ || 31 || mayūkhamālāvitatatanmayūkhatiraskṛtaḥ | candrakāntamaṇiprodyatprākāro'sti tadantarā || pañcāśataṃ sahasrañca yojanāyāmato dvija | somācchaśatapīyūṣaniryaddhārāsamanvitaḥ || tatkāntisāradhārābhī rañjitāstatra bhūmayaḥ | himasāramahātāra dhārāvyāpinagottamaḥ || daśasāhasramānena tatrāste hīrako hyagaḥ | indranīlāmalamaṇiprākāro'sti tadantare ||
pṛ0 45) pañcāśatso'pi mānena nīlanīlotpaladyutiḥ | tannailyagarbhasaundaryadhārādhīraikabhūmayaḥ || tatrāsti parvatavaraścendranīlaśiloccayaḥ | nīlanīradasaṃśliṣṭavidyullekhānvitachaviḥ || daśasāhasravistāraḥ pariṇāhe'pi tādṛśaḥ | harinmaṇīndrapravaraprākāro'sti tadantarā || tanmaṇīndraprabhābhāsiharitā eva bhūmayaḥ | pravālaparvatastatra viṃśatsāhasramunnataḥ || 39 || biṃbāmalalasatkāntikānto bhūdharanāyakaḥ | tadantare'pi prākāro gomedamaṇikalpitaḥ || triṃśatsāhasramānena madhupiṃgalasundaraḥ | tatroccaḥ parvato vipra kuruviṃdamaṇiprabhaḥ || 41 || pakṣasaṃkhyāsahasreṇa śikharaiścāpi tādṛśaḥ | tasyāntare'pi prākāraḥ puṣparāgaśilāñcitaḥ || catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇāṃ yojanonnatamānataḥ | tasyāmalachavigaṇaissadṛśāstatra bhūmayaḥ || tatrāpi bhūdharaśreṣṭho muktāmaṇiśataiścitaḥ | unmattākhubhujottuṃgalocanāmalasachaviḥ || tadantarā tviṣākāraviṃśatsāhasramānataḥ | tatviṣā cābhitassarvapītībhūtadigantaraḥ || vaiḍūryānekasūtrācchadhārārasavijṛṃbhitāḥ | bhūmayastatra śobhante vismayānāṃ smayapradaḥ || tatrāsti parvatavaro navaratnayutachaviḥ | kvacinmarakatasvacchalaharīharitākṛtiḥ || 47 || kvacidvidrumasaṃkāśassandhyāghananibhaḥ kvacit | kvaciddhīrakajātyacchaphalamūlasamacchaviḥ || kvacidvaiḍūryasūtrotthabhābhāsitadigantaraḥ | unmattakokilākṣābhakuruviṃdanibhaḥ kvacit || puṣparāgasarāgodyadrāgarakto'ruṇaḥ kvacit | tṛṇagrāhimahānīlanīlimnā ca nabhopamaḥ || kvacidgomedakāpāramadhudhārāsamachaviḥ | muktākāntitiraskāriślakṣṇanairmalyabhāyutaḥ || svacchācchasphaṭikopāṃta biṃvitākhiladiktaṭaḥ | nānārāgamayūkhaughaścendracāpanibhaḥ kvacit || tatrāsti maṇṭapavaraṃ nānācitravicitritam | padmarāgamaṇistambhastambhapīṭhamanoharam || sihmaśārdūlaśarabhagajahaṃsaśukākṛtiḥ | vyāliśuṇḍānalinyādicitracitrita vismayam || ekaikaratnasaṃkḷptanīlochrāyaikabhāsuram | paṃktiśasstambhasāhasrairnavaratnapariṣkṛtaiḥ || 55 || āpādapīṭhajaślakṣṇagopānasisubhittikam | svacchādarśatalaprāyabhūmibhāgaikarañjitam || tatra stambhaprabhājyotsnāprabhākaraśataprabham | na sūryacandrau bhāsete vahninakṣatravidyutaḥ || tiraskṛtāḥ prabhāstatra na rātrirna divākvacit | evaṃ lakṣastambhayuktāmaṇṭapāstatrakalpitāḥ || paryantagopurottuṃgaratnasaudhāyutairvṛtaḥ | sahasralakṣaphalakaisstambhakuṃbhairyuto mune || 59 || gopurāṇāṃ pramāṇantu manasāpi na śakyate | nānārudrāvatārādimaṇikalpitavigrahaḥ ||
pṛ0 46) mūrtayo devadevasya devyā vāhanasaṃyutāḥ | skandaheraṃbanandīnāṃ saptalokāntamucchritāḥ || gopurāṇāṃtalairdivyairvistārāyāmalakṣakam | liṃgodbhavastataḥ pārśvevṛṣavāhastataḥ param || sindhuratvakparīvītaḥ kvacitsāṃbassaputrakaḥ | skandaheraṃbasahitaḥ kvacidgaṇagaṇairvṛtaḥ || umārdhavigrahaścāpi nṛttāṭopayutaḥ kvacit | vāmāṃgadakṣiṇāṃgodyajjanārdanavidhiḥ kvacit ||
