devīpariṇayākāraḥ kvacidbhikṣāṭanākṛtiḥ | śūlāsaktakaraścāpi mṛgapāṇiḥ purādihā || andhakāsurasaṃhāro dakṣiṇāmūrtirūpadhṛk | munīnāṃ jñānadassiddhicinmudrāparicihnitaḥ || tatpūruṣavāmadevādyā īśānāghorasaṃjñakāḥ | bālendumukuṭāssarve kapardavaraśobhitāḥ || ratnābharaṇabhūṣāḍhyā mūrtayaśśaṃkarasya hi | dikpālapālikābhiśca tattadrāgamaṇiprabhāḥ || kalpitāḥ parameśena śivalīlāvicitritāḥ | paryantasphaṭikābhāśca vṛṣā nīlavilocanāḥ || mahāśṛṃgaikamakuṭaghaṇṭāmaṇivibhūṣaṇāḥ | gopurordhvagatāssarve mahāhīrakaśṛṃgakāḥ || 70 || prākārarājadvṛṣabhā mahārhamaṇikalpitāḥ | talānāṃ koṭibhiścāpi gopurāṇāṃ prakalpanaiḥ || gopurāgramahāratnakalaśaistyaktatārakaiḥ | dodhūyamānoccalitasamīraṇapatākakāḥ || 72 || tatra garbhagṛhaṃ śaṃbhornavaratnānvitojvalam | tatrāsti maṇipīṭhodyaccandrasphaṭikasambhavam || mahāliṃgaṃmahākāraṃ ratnanāgaphaṇānvitam | mahāratnavane jātaphullamālāvibhūṣitam || 74 || suvarṇakhacitānekabilvacampakapūjitam | śambhunā ca mahādevyā lokānugrahakāmyayā || samarcitaṃ trikāleṣu pradoṣeṣu viśeṣataḥ | tatrastharatnaniryātakāntibhirdīpitantadā || 76 || tatrātodyāni kurvanti gaṇāśśambhormahātmanaḥ | kāhalīmurajāpāramaḍḍuḍiṇḍimajarjharāḥ || śaṃkhamaddalabheryaśca nissāṇāḥ paṭahānakāḥ | gomukhāssvastipātālāveṇuvīṇāvināditāḥ || rudrakanyāsahasrāṇi nāṭyaṃ kurvanti tatra hi | hāvabhāvamanojñāni peśalālāpavanti ca || yauvanonmadadhārāṇi raṇitāṅghrijanūpuraiḥ | kvaṇadratnajaṭāṭaṃkakapolāmalasacchavi || 80 || dhūpāmodaikabahalagandhagandhāyitā diśaḥ | nandiprotsāritagaṇāstatrāste śaṃkaroṃ'bayā || pūjitantaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ paśyanratnaissupūjitam | rudrakanyākarābjotthanakhakvaṇanaghaṭṭitam || tantrīmukhotthagandharvagānaṃ śṛṇvantsadāṃbayā || śiva śiva śiva śaṃbho candramaule'malātman hara hara gurubhāraṃ śāṃbhavān modayasva | vitara paramamuktiṃ saṃsṛtirmā kadācidbhavatu bhavabhavābdhestārakaṃ tvāṃ prapannaḥ || 83 ||
pṛ0 47) evaṃ śaṃkaranāmasārasudhayā plāvyan gaṇāñchaṃkaraḥ paśyeśi prasabhaṃ śivāvadanajāṃbhojabhramatṣaṭpadāḥ || 84 ||
īśvaraḥ– kailāseśvaraliṃgametadamalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ sakṛtpūjitaṃ māmapyāśu sudhārdrasārahṛdayaṃ kartuṃ pravṛttaṃ śive | ityaṃbāvadanannirīkṣya bhagavānprovāca sākṣācchiva- stalliṃgālayadarśanañca sukaraṃ puṇyairagaṇyairapi || 85 || no paśyanti surāsurāḥ pramathapā viṣṇurvidhirneśvaraḥ paśyatyeva maheśvaro girijayā svaṃliṃgamatyādarāt | bhogībhogaphaṇāmaṇipravilasalliṃgaikamaulīlasa- ccandrāsārakarapracārajanitānaṃgaprabhāvojjhitam || 86 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsavarṇanannāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||
kailāseśvarapradoṣapūjāvarṇanannāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ
śrī sūta uvāca– kailāseśvaraliṃgasya mahādevassanātanaḥ | varivasyāṃ [varivasyā pūjetyarthaḥ |] svayaṃ cakre sarvapūjyo'pi śāṅkaraḥ || 1 ||
ṛṣayaḥ– sa kathaṃ sarvapūjyo'pi bhagavānagajāpatiḥ | kailāseśvaraliṃgasya pūjanaṃ kṛtavānvada || 2 ||
sūta uvāca– evameva purā pṛṣṭo jaigīṣavyena śaṃkaraḥ | tamāha vinayānamraṃ devasenāpatiḥ purā || 3 ||
skandaḥ– sādhu pṛṣṭantvayā vipra tatte vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam | devadevasya caritaṃ śṛṇvatāmaghanāśanam || 4 || sa sarvagopyo dharmātmā sarvākāratayā sthitaḥ | liṃgārcanaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ vimuktidamiti dvijāḥ ||
pṛ0 48) svayaṃ karoti bhagavānaṃbikāpatirīśvaraḥ | bhuktidaṃ muktidañceti sarveṣāṃ bodhanāya hi || 6 || saṃsārasāgaremagnāntsamuddhartuṃ maheśvaraḥ | kāryaṃ surāsuraiścaivaṃ viṣṇubrahmamarudgaṇaiḥ || 7 || devairmunīndrairgaṇapairdvijaiścaivātha śāṃkaraiḥ | pūjaiva paramaṃ śreya iti darśayituṃ śivaḥ || 8 || svayaṃ devyā mahādevaḥ pūjāṃ liṃge karoti hi | talliṃgapūjanaṃ devyā śivenākāri tacchṛṇu || prātassaṃgavamadhyāhnapradoṣeṣu munīśvarāḥ | nandikeśādigaṇapai rudrāṇībhissadāśivaḥ || pūjāprakalpanaṃ śaṃbhośśaṃbhunā varivasyayā | kailāseśvaraliṃgasya pūjanantacchṛṇuṣva me || saptasāgarapātrottharasadhārādibhiśśivaḥ | gaṇānītaiśca saṃbhārairmanasā kalpanakṣamaiḥ || 12 || pūjayā bhogamokṣau ca sarveṣāñca pradarśitum | karotyapacitiṃ śaṃbhuḥ kailāseśvarapūjanam ||
jaigīṣavyaḥ– tatpūjana prakāraṃ me kathaya śravaṇoddhataḥ | ebhirmunivarairdevairgaṇendraiśca viśeṣataḥ || 14 ||
skanda uvāca– śṛṇu tvaṃ devadevena kailāseśvarapūjanam | yathākṛtaṃ maheśena śṛṇutvaṃ muktidāyakam || 15 || śravaṇenāpi bhaktānāṃ sarveṣāṃ muktidāyakam | śṛṇuṣvaikamanā vipra tvamebhirbhūsuraissuraiḥ || gaṇaughairnandikeśādyairaṃbikāpatipūjanam | devyai devena kathitaṃ pṛcchaṃtyai śaṃkarassvayam || tadvakṣyāmi samāsena śṛṇu tvaṃ pāpanāśanam || snātvā kailāsagaṃgātaṭamaṇikalite maṇṭape śaṃbhurīśo devyā nandīśamukhyairgaṇavarasahito bhasmanoddhūlya gātram | sthitvā liṃgālaye sve maṇigaṇakhacite svāsane sanniviṣṭa- śśiṣṭassarveṣṭadātā samasamasamado hyarcati prājñavaryaḥ || 18 || kṛtvā phālatale tripuṇṭraracanāṃ bālendumaulissvayaṃ rudrākṣāmalahārakaṇṭhavalayaḥ pañcāsyapañcākṣaraḥ | kiñcitkiñcidudañcadañcaladṛgambhojāvalīmālikāṃ vāraṃvāramihārpayatyagajayā jīvajjayārthī śivaḥ || 19 || tatreśānavarasya pañcavaradāsyāsyāsyapañcānane- śānasyeśvaraliṃgamadbhutatamaṃ tatpañcavaktreśvaram |
pṛ0 49) tadvaktrāmalato jharībhararasaiḥ pañcāpagā nissṛtāḥ kailāsācalanimnagātaṭamahāliṃgaikasaudhālayāḥ || 20 || prācyāṃ ratnācchagaṃgā śivataragabhavā devagaṃgākilāste paścātkailāsagaṃgā tadaparabhuvigā ratnasopānayuktā | tatrāvācyāṃ ca śuddhā kamalagaṇagaṇaissaṃyutātyugragaṃgā tanmadhye brahmagaṃgā sphaṭikanibhajalā pañcatāḥ pañcatāntāḥ || 21 || etā yā maṇiliṃgapañcamukhatassannissṛtā maṇṭapā- tpuṇyāḥ puṇyataraṃgaśītalajalāḥ kūlaṃkaṣākhyāḥ parāḥ | divyāpāraśivālayasthitamahāliṃgaikasaṅghākulā- stīreṣu prathitorumaṇṭapamaṇīkḷptaissudhābdhiṃgamāḥ || 22 || nānābilvavanairapāratarujaiḥ phullaprasūnākulaiḥ pakṣīṇāṃ ca ravaiśca tīravakulai raktācchadehallakaiḥ | kokānāñca kulaissukacchapamahāmīnairbakānāṃ kulai- sstokaiḥ potakacakravākakuraraiḥ puṇyaiśca satsārasaiḥ || 23 || tattīrāmalamaṇṭape maṇimahākḷpte susihmāsane devyā nandigaṇeśvarairharavaraḥ paśyantsarinnirjharīḥ | liṅgaṃ pañcamukheśvaraṃ madhurimānetrāñcalaiśśaṅkara- stadvaktrāmalapaṅkajodbhavanadīḥ puṇyāstadāheśvaraḥ || 24 ||
īśvaraḥ– prāleyācalamindukundadhavalaṃ gokṣīraphenaprabhaṃ bhasmābhyaṃgamanaṃgadehadahanajvālāvalīlocanam | viṣṇubrahmamarudgaṇārcitapadaṃ ṛgvedanādodayaṃ vande'haṃ sakalaṃ kalaṃkarahitaṃ sthāṇormukhaṃ paścimam || 25 || gauraṃ kuṃkumapaṃkilaṃ sutilakaṃ vyāpāṇḍugaṇḍasthalaṃ bhrūvikṣepakaṭākṣavīkṣaṇalasatsaṃsrastakarṇotpalam |
pṛ0 50) snigdhaṃ biṃbaphalādharaṃ prahasitaṃ nīlālakālaṃkṛtaṃ vande yājuṣavedanādajanakaṃ vaktraṃ harasyottaram || 26 || bālārkāgnitaṭitpradīptakanakapraspardhitejoruṇaṃ gambhīradhvanisāmavedajanakaṃ tāmrādharaṃ sundaram | ardhendudyutilolapiṅgalajaṭābhāraprabaddhoragaṃ vande siddhasurāsurendranamitaṃ pūrvaṃ mukhaṃ śūlinaḥ || 27 || kālābhrabhramarāñjanadyutinibhaṃ vyāvṛttapiṅgekṣaṇaṃ karṇodbhāsitabhogimastakamaṇiprodbhinnadaṃṣṭrāṅkuram | sarpaprotakapālaśuktiśakalaṃ vyākīrṇamāśekharaṃ vande dakṣiṇamīśvarasya vadanaṃ cādharvanādodayam || 28 || vyaktāvyaktanirūpitañca paramaṃ śuddhāṃśasatvādhikaṃ tasmāduttaratatvamakṣaramidaṃ dhyeyaṃ sadā yogibhiḥ | oṅkārādisamastamantrajanakaṃ sūkṣmātisūkṣmaṃ paraṃ dhyāyetpañcamamīśvarasya vadanaṃ khavyāpi tejomayam || 29 || etāni pañcavadanāni maheśvarasya ye kīrtayanti manujāssatataṃ prabhāte | gacchanti te śivapadaṃ rucirairvimānaiḥ krīḍanti śaṃkaragaṇaissatataṃ śivāgre || 30 || ityuktvā niragāttato surasarittīrāttadāndolitai- rhāraistairbhujageśvaraprakalitai ratnācchasatpādukaḥ | kailāseśvaradhāma sundaramahānandaikasārāspadaṃ dṛṣṭvā liṅgavaraṃ pradoṣasamaye saṃpūjya pūjābharaiḥ || 31 || śrīviśveśvara [ayamardhaḥ adhikatayā vartate |] ugra ugratanujārātipriyaśśaṃkara- śśrīkaṇṭhaḥ kaluṣādripakṣadalanasvārāḍasaṃgaśśivaḥ | prāhotphullasuraktapaṃkajalasadvaktro bhavānīṃ haraḥ paśyeti prasabhaṃ madīyamahimārambhaikapūjābharam || 32 ||
pṛ0 51) īśvaraḥ– kuṃbhairaṃbhodharācchacchavijitadhavalaiḥ pūritaiḥ kṣīravārddhau parvodyacchaśisannibhaissphaṭikajaiḥ koṭyāvadhīsaṅkhyayā | tatkṣīrottamamaṇḍasārasubhagaissiñcāmi liṅge mama kailāseśvaranāmake janijarārogāpahe śaṅkari || 33 || ānītaṃ mama tatpayoṃbudhibhavaṃ vīrairgaṇendreśśive sadvṛttāmaladhārayā janimume tuṣṭaḥ pradoṣeṣvaham | kaṣṭāni prasabhaṃ hārāmi sukṛtāṃ rāśindiśāmi kṣaṇā- tsiñcanliṅgasupūjakāya girije tasmādahaṃ pūjaye || 34 || daddhyambhonidhisambhavairnibiḍitaṃ tatkhaṇḍamaṇḍaṃ dadhi prodyaḍḍiṇḍimamaṇḍalābhamagaje datvā svaliṅgottame | godohaprathite pradoṣasamaye sandāritāghaughake kāryaṃ pūjanametadeva samaye sarvaissurairapyaham || 35 || talliṅgaṃ paripūjayāmi vasudhādhṛgdhuryamaulau niśa- ñcottuṅgāmalaratnakumbhavilasatprājyājyadhārādibhiḥ | svājyāmbhodhisamāhṛtairmama gaṇaissaṅkhyātigaṃ taddhṛtaṃ- tatrājyāmalagandhasārasubhagā gandhīkṛtāstādiśaḥ || 36 || siñcāmi prabhasaṃ sugoghṛtaghanaiḥ kailāsaliṅgaṃ mama madhvaṃbhodhisamāhṛtairmaṇighaṭairmādhvīkasāraṃ madhu | garbhodyanmaṇisārakāntisubhagairgomedakācchaprabhai- ssiñcāmyadrivarātmaje sumadhurādhāreyagarbhaṃ madhu || 37 || dhārākāramadīyaliṅgaśirasi harṣeṇa paśyāṃbike śailoddāmaśikhānibhāśśikharitāduttuṅgasāropamāḥ | prāleyācalamaulisārasubhagāścāpāṇḍurāśśarkarā datvā tanmama liṅgamaulivilasaccandrāṃśudhārā samam || 38 ||
pṛ0 52) harṣāplāvihṛdantaraḥ pratidinaṃ hṛṣyāmi paśyādrije kulyāstatra manoramādritanaye nārelanīlodbhavāḥ | tābhissaṃbhṛtasadghaṭādivitatairlakṣaiḥ pravāhākulā talliṃgāsekanīraiḥ pravahati madhujā devagaṃgeti nāmnā || 39 || sarve viṣṇupitāmahendravaruṇāścānandabhaktyā vṛtā- stīrthaṃ tīrthaparaṃparaikaphaladaṃ jñātvānubhūyāpi te | sevante satataṃ nitāntamagaje jetuṃ punassaṃsṛtiṃ- tuṃgāghaughataraṃgabhaṃgasubhagāstasyāntarāste surāḥ || 40 || saptachadācchaphalaśailavaro'drikanye kḷpto mayā sugurupītataraśca meroḥ | tajjaistvagārarahitaiśśaśikhaṇḍamauliliṃgārcanasya phalameva janurbhavāni || 41 || uttuṃgasālasurasālarasālasārairniṣṭaptahemajharisodaragarbhajātaiḥ | talliṃgasecanamume sughaṭaiḥ karomi puṃsāmapi pramathanāthapadaṃ dadāti || 42 || devi strīkucasannikāśalikucāpāraprabhāgandhaja- sphārāsāramahārasādikalaśaissaṃsecayāmyaṃbike | kailāsācalaliṅgamaulivilasalliṃgaikasadbhūṣaṇaṃ liṃgantvetadapāragandhalulitairnīraiśca gandhodakaiḥ || 43 || ikṣusāgaramahormibhirīśe liṃgamauliriyameva viśiṣṭā | siktaye ghaṭasahasrasudhārā kāritā girisute kamanīyā || 44 || kośaiḥ kānanasaṃbhavairmadhujharīsārātisārassphuṭaṃ niryatpītatarātikāntinivahairgandhīkṛtāśāmukhaiḥ | tatkośāmalarāśibhirgirisute sañchannamaiśaṃ śiraḥ paśyāmi prathitekṣaṇaḥ prakaṭite puṇye pradoṣe mama || 45 || kastūrīghanasārakuṅkumamahāpāṭīrasārairghaṭai- ścandrāsāravilolitāṃbughaṭitaissatpāṭalāmoditaiḥ |
pṛ0 53) śrāntā me gaṇapuṃgavāśca nitarāṃ puṇye pradoṣe mama svādūdāmalanīladhāritaghaṭodvāhe paraṃ śailaje || 46 || śaṅkhānāñca sahasrakairmaṇicitairgośṛṃgadhārādibhiḥ kṣīrājyādimadhupravāhajaladhipluṣṭaiśca tailairapi | tadgandhottamapiṣṭalepanagataśrīcikkaṇāgharṣaṇai- śśrīpatrairmṛdusārasūkṣmatṛṇakairutpañcagavyairapi || 47 || sauvarṇottamakumbhasambhavamahādhārāsahasraiśśatai- rarghyai ratnasuvarṇakalpitakuśāgrāṃbūdbhavaistajjalaiḥ | aṣṭāṅgārghyakakalpitaissumadhurairgarbhāṃbukumbhaiśśive saṃsicyākhilamindukundajamahāpāṭīrasatpāṭalāḥ || 48 || modotthāṃbudasannibhaiśca kalaśaistauryatrikodbhāvanai- rdhūpaiścāpi mahāmadhūtthamadhuparkāsārapārairapi | pradoṣasamaye mayā śaradudīcarākāśaśi prakāśacayasauhradairviralakuḍmalairandhasām || 49 || madīyarajatācalaprakaṭaśaṅkibhārāśibhi- ssudhākarakalālasallalitaliṅgamaulyarpitaiḥ | vedāścatvāra ete prathitatamayaśasstomadhārānurāgā- ssvādūdāmalanīrasecanavidhau śākhāśikhābhiḥ kramāt || 50 || rudrāṇāṃ stavanena māmapi śive santoṣayantassthitā mūrtāste vihitāgrapaṅkajakarā viśvāsabhūtā mama || 51 || ghanarasamṛganābhisāradhārāmṛgamadapaṭalīpaṭīracandragandhaiḥ | parivītaṃ bhujageśasannivītaṃ prabhayā koṭiśaśāṅkasūryatulyam || 52 || gotrādhirājatanaye vinayena paśya saṃpaśyadātmagatisaukhyadamekabhāsvat | ghumughumitasugandhagandhitāśāmukhamukharaiḥ parilipya liṅgametat || 53 || parihṛṣṭo nitarāṃ bhavāmi gauri tridaśālabhyasugandhayakṣakardamaiḥ |
pṛ0 54) maṇijālātataratnakūlacitraiḥ paridhāyāmalasvarṇasaddukūlaiḥ || 54 || śivaliṅgaṃ mama śailarājakanye paripaśyāmi sugandhigandhavastraiḥ | brahmāṇḍagolakamume prabhayā na tulyaṃ malliṅgagolakavarottamaratnadhārā || 55 || sāvadhūtaśaśimaulikalālalāmantadratnamaulyakalane na vidhirna viṣṇuḥ | yakṣādhipo'pyagasute'dya vikuṇṭhitākṣaḥ ke'nye kṣamā vada samānahṛdā nirīkṣya || yaddarśanena samaduḥkhavirāmaṇaṃ syādyadratnavaryanicayairmukuṭātiśobham | pūritākhilajanājanikāmaṃ vāmadevamiha paśya sukāmam || 57 || phaṇāmaṇi sahasrakairvidhṛtavaktramuktāphalaiḥ prabhātatasabhāvalī maṇigaṇāttakāntyā yutam | tripuṇṭraniṭilollasattilakitācchasaddhīrakaṃ prapaśya girikanyake vimalamauliliṅgaṃ mama || 58 || sahasramukhasatphaṇipravaramaulimāṇikyasa- ddyutīvijitakāntito mama svabhogasaṃveṣṭitaiḥ | phaṇāchavikṛtāṃbarachavijitādyasacchatrakaṃ śive śirasi me sadā dadhati liṃgamaulau mama || 59 || viśveśvarākhyavaraliṃgasamānamānamānandasaukhyadamidaṃ mama supriyeyat | hantuṃ samagrajanapātakarāśimeva sarvārtharāśidamidaṃ paripūjayāmi || 60 || nānāmaṇidyutisarāvalibhūṣitantanmalliṃgameva kamalācchadṛśā prapaśya | puṇye pradoṣasamaye muditastvayā'haṃ talliṃgamadhyabhavane mahimāsthito'ham || vikasitasitapadmaratnakaṃjamālānavanīlotpalajaissahasramālikābhiḥ | madhubandhuragandhadivyagandhaissitamandārajaraktamālikābhiḥ || 62 || dināntasamayollasanmadhuragandhajātīsarai- rvasantakalikāsphuranmadhuragandhamallīsaraiḥ | vikuṇṭhitamidaṃ mama prakaṭasomadhāmaprabhā- samutthamagakanyake vimaladroṇamālāyutam || 63 ||
pṛ0 55) kadaṃbavananīpajasphuradapāramālābharai- rvilolavarapīṭhagaṃ prakaṭamauliliṃgaṃ śive | prapaśya nayanāṃcalairvikacamañjarīkaprabhaiḥ pradoṣasamaye'mbike nayanajanmanastatphalam || 64 || tadbilvaratnakamalairamalairbhavāni punnāganāganavacaṃpakadūrvayāpi | nīlotpalairdamanakaiḥ karavīrajātidroṇārkakāśajavakaiḥ kanakaissamarcya || 65 || satpuṇḍarīkavakulairdhavakarṇikāramālūrakundakusumairatiharṣato'ham | rājīvāmalamallikāsumasarasphārotthagandhāndhakai- rlolaṃbairvikasatsumotthamadhupaiḥ paśyāṃbike pūjitam | etalliṃgavaraṃ pradoṣasamaye bilvīdalottaṃsakaṃ dhuttūreṇa hi śobhate'dya nitarāṃ maulisthacandrādhikam || 66 || agarutarujātadhūpadhūmairbahulāmodavikāsidiksamūhaiḥ | marudākulalaṃbitorudhārāvikasatsvargapathāḥ pracārajālaiḥ || 67 || suvarṇamaṇibhājane śiśunabhodyadambhojinī- priyāṃśucayasaṃkramiprakaṭadākṣyaratnāṃśubhiḥ | manorathapathātigairmama suliṃgamālāyitai- ssupāṇḍaraśaśiprabhairhimatuṣārakundaprabhaiḥ || 68 || sucandravarakhaṇḍakairviracitorudīpāvalī- sugoghṛtasuvartikojvalasudīpajālairapi | gṛhāṅkaṇatamastatipravidadāradṛtyādarai- rakhaṇḍataramaṇḍanaiḥ prathitapadmahaṃsopamaiḥ || 69 || sutārakagaṇāvalīlalitamuktajālaprabhai- rvilokaya girīndraje mama sumaulibhāsaṃkaraiḥ | nānābhakṣyamahādrigandhasurasāścāmoditāstādiśa- ssusvādvannajarāśibhiśca ghṛtajaissūpapravāhaiśśive || 70 ||
pṛ0 56) śākaiśśailanibhairmadhupramathitaiḥ kṣīrādidadhyodanaiḥ prāleyācalasannibhaissuguḍakairnaiveditaiśśaṅkari | nārikelalikucaissukapitthairmātuliṃgakadalīsurasālaiḥ || 71 || kharjūrairbadarīsugandhajarasairdāḍiṃbanāraṃgakaiḥ kaṃkolāmalakaissurādanaphalai rājādanairjātikaiḥ | naivedyekṣujakāṇḍakairgirivarājjāte mude me bhave- ttāṃbūlaiḥ khadirairlavaṃgamukharairjātīphalailāyutaiḥ || 72 || muktācūrṇasupūrṇapūgamadhuraiḥ karpūrasaṃvāsitai- rutphullāmalanāgavallijadalaiḥ prodyadgirīndraprabhaiḥ | naivedyaṃ parikalpayāmi girije tasminpradoṣe hyahaṃ vīṇānikvaṇamaṃjumaṃjulasudhādhārāsamairgāyanaiḥ || 73 || mannāmāmṛtamīśvareśvari mudā rudrāṇibhiḥ kalpitaṃ śambho śaṃkara dhūrjaṭe triṇayana kālāndhakāre hara | pāhīśa pramathādhinātha mahimanliṃgākṛte pāhino ratnaiḥ kalpitamaddaladhvaniyutaiśśaṃkhotthanādaiśśive || 74 || prodyatkāhalanisvanairmadhuritaṃ tanmaḍḍuḍiṇḍīravaiḥ || 75 || dundubhyāghātanādairmama gaṇavaragāsyoruniśvāsarāgai- rveṇūrandhraniṣevaṇāṅgulibhavaistālaiśca sajjhallaraiḥ | tuṣṭo'haṃ prathite pradoṣasamaye talliṃgasekādaro nānyatkiñcidavediṣaṃ trijagatāṃ vyāpāramapyadrije || 76 || raṃge tuṃgataraṃgabhaṃgacapalairnṛtyairmahāmaddalai- rvīṇāveṇuninādasāmyalayato nṛtyanti liṃgāgrataḥ | rudrāṇīgaṇakoṭayo'tra subhage mañjīraśiñjasvanai- śśambho śaṃkara sāṃba pāhi śiva nastūrṇaṃ prasādaṅkuru || 77 ||
pṛ0 57) ityevaṃ subhagā vilāsamadhurā hāvaiśca bhāvairapi cotkrāntāvṛtaratnakāntivilasatpūrṇendusāmyānanā | kumbhodyatkarikumbhasannibhakucāḥ kāñcījhaṇannisvanā- stālotthāhatipādapadmajaravaiḥ kurvanti vidyuddhvanim || 78 || gaṇeśakarabhāsvatā vividhalokasāmrājyadhu- gviviktakṛtalāñchanaiśśaśisuvṛttamuktātataiḥ | mahoḍugaṇamauktikaprakaṭatārapaṃktītatai- rgirīndratanaye dhṛtānyamitachatrakoṭyo gaṇaiḥ || 79 || paraṭāramaṇotthakāmitāṅgotthitapakṣāhananābhacāmaraughaiḥ | gaṇabṛndairakhilaiśca sevyamānaṃ mama liṅgālayadhūnanaiśśive'dya || 80 || pravālamayadaṇḍinā malayaśailabhūmāruta- supotataravāyunā nagavarāripāṇījuṣā | jayena camarīmṛgapracalavālagucchātmanā sukhī jitamume tadā mama suliṃgamatyādarāt || 81 || dhṛtaiḥ pramadapāṇibhirvanakalāpipucchoccayaiḥ kṛtairvyajanakoṭibhirharitacandrakoṭyaṃśubhiḥ | madīyamaṇimaṇṭapaṃ harimaṇībhirākalpita- mivādya girije tadā prathitabhābhirādīpitam || 82 || pramathaprakarordhvahastasaṃsthairmaṇivaryairvividhaissarāgralambaiḥ | vilasannavaratnagucchasacchairdhuvadīśānavarāgragāḥ patākāḥ || 83 || liṃgaprakramaṇairahaṃ sa iti talliṃgapraṇāmādara- ssvātmānaṃ paricintayāmi girije'pyānandadhārāvṛtaḥ | pratyutthākhilalokajālamakhilaṃ matto na bhinnaṃ kvaci- tkiñciccāpi śive mamaiva manasassaṅkalpajālaṃ jagat || 84 ||
pṛ0 58) mayyevāgasute layaṃ prayāti nikhilañcaiko'dvayo'haṃ sadā nāneti prasabhaṃ vadanti nigamā vācāṃ manodūragam | anyānanda samammadīyamamalaṃ [anyānandamume iti pāṭhaḥ |] jānanti yo yogino no vedā yatayassurāsuragaṇā viṣpādayo'pyabjajāḥ || 85 || jñānaṃ jñeyamidaṃ jagadgatamume jñātā na kiñcitsthiti- rbhūmāhaṃ sukhadhāmako hi mahatāṃ hrasvo na cāṇussthiraḥ | svātmānandamume mamālpakamidaṃ liṃge'pyaliṃgo'smyahaṃ cākāśādividūragasthitilayotpattiṣvasaṃgo'smyaham || 86 || ityevaṃ paramārthatastribhuvane tiṣṭhāmi viśvātigo gopyammaddhṛdayaṃ girīndratanaye tubhyammayā darśitam | ityuktvā parameśvarastrijagatāṃ nātho'pi viśvākṛti- rdṛṣṭvā liṃgamapārabilvakusumaissaṃpūjitaṃ mastake || 87 || dṛṣṭvā tāmagajāṃ nanartaparamānandaprasādaikabhūḥ kailāsācalamaulimaṇṭapavare talliṃgasānnidhyake | aṇḍakhaṇḍanamahāghanaghoṣaścaṇḍatāṇḍavalaladvidhimuṇḍaḥ | kuṇḍalīśakṛtakuṇḍalagaṇḍastaṇḍumaḍḍuninadotthalayāṃghriḥ || 88 || nandibhṛṃgikṛtaḍiṇḍimanādairmaṇḍito hi śivayā sa hi raṃgaḥ | ḍuṇḍirājakṛtaśaṅkhaninādaistuṇḍaṣaṭkakṛtatūryaninādaiḥ || 89 || jaṭācchaṭavigharṣitāḥ paripatanti tārāgaṇā vamanti rudhirammukhairbhuvananāganāgā nagāḥ | jagannaṭanasaṃbhramādbhavati helayāndolitaṃ harīndravidhayassurā munijanāssakampāṃgakāḥ || 90 || aṣṭāvaktrasugītasāmamurajoccaṇḍapracaṇḍollasa- ḍḍiṇḍīmadhvanimaḍḍumaddalamahāsāmāṣṭadaṃṣṭrāravaiḥ |
pṛ0 59) bhrājatpadmajamuṇḍaṣaṇḍajamahāmālālasadvakṣasaṃ līlācālitahastakaṃkaṇamahānāgordhvamaulīlasat || 91 || ratnāplāvitakāntiraṃjitadṛśaṃ nṛtyantamaikṣacchivā codyadbhānumarīcisannibhajaṭāsāmrājyapaṭṭāyitā | lolannīlasuratnapaṃkajalasadgaṃgātaraṃgotthitā pārāvārasudhāghanotthanaṭanāṭopā phaṇīmaṃjulam || 92 || ānamrākhilalokajālamumayā sadratnaraṃgāntare nṛtyantaṃ dadṛśussarudragaṇapāḥ kailāsamaulisthitam | jhalaṃjhalitakaṃkaṇaṃ padavalatkvaṇannūpuraṃ kiṇīkiṇitasadhvaniṃ sphaṭikaratnasanmekhalam || 93 || ghuṇaṃghuṇakṛtāravaṃ padagaratnamañjīrakaṃ caṭaccaṭaravotthitaprapadapadmaghoṣaṃ śivam || 94 || tauryatrikotthitamahāravajātaghoṣalokatrayodgatasurāsurakinnareḍyam | mandasmitākhilavimohanaveṣabhūṣaṃ rājacchaśāṃkamahasā dhavalīkṛtāśam || 95 || taṃ nīlalohitamumā jagadādihetuṃ nṛtyantamiṣṭadamupaiti ca tuṣṭacakram [vaktramiti pāṭhāntaram |] | aṣṭākṛtiṃ nikhilakaṣṭaharaṃ pradoṣe'paśyacchivā sakaruṇārasasāradṛṣṭyā || 96 || tāṃ vīkṣyāgasutāṃ smayanniva mahādevassakailāsabhū- kailāseśvarapūjayā sarasayā kaṣṭāni sañjahrivān | lokānāṃ gaṇapātmanāmatha umāṃ prāha prasannānanaḥ paśyāmbeti vadantsadāśivatarormugdhenducūḍaśśivaḥ || 97 ||
īśvara uvāca– kailāseśvaraliṃgametadamalaṃ muktipradaṃ śāśvata- ñcāpātālanimagnamūlamasakṛtsampūjitaṃ tanmayā |
pṛ0 60) tasyordhvāmalamaulirapyagasute jānanti naivāgamā devādyairmunibhistvayāpi ca mayā ko vāsti tatpūjakaḥ || 98 || pūjāpūjakapūjyaśabdarahitaṃ tatkevalo'haṃ śiva- stalliṃgaṃ [tathāpi talliṃgavaraṃ sadāśivañcakāstimacchailavare sadāṃbike | iti pustakāntare pāṭho vartate | tathā cet pūjāpūjaka pūjyaśabda rahitantatkevalo'haṃ śive iti pādo'saṃpūrṇo bhavet |] varadaṃ sadāśivamayaṃ macchailarāje śive | taddarśanārthaṃ munayassurāsurāstapyanti cādyāpi jagatyaviplavāḥ [harājaviṣṇavaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] || 99 ||
devyuvāca– tvayāpi na jñāyata ityaho me sāścaryamuktaṃ hi tvayā sadāśiva | tavāpi tatkiṃ kṛtaliṃgapūjayā rahasyametanmama tadvada prabho || 100 || ityuktaṃ girijāmanoharavacaśśrutvā prahasyāmbikāṃ lokaṃ sraṣṭumathātti pāti sutarāntatpālakaśśaṅkaraḥ | vācā candanaśītayā sukhakaraśśītāṃśudhārī śivaḥ prāhotphullamanoharābjavadano devīṃ tadā bhūtapaḥ || 101 ||
īśvara uvāca– nakarmaṇā naiva samādhibhirjapaistapasyayā vā vividhaiśca yajñaiḥ | vrataiśca dānairniyamairmameśvari prāpnoti kimmatpadapūjanaṃ vinā || 102 || tasmādahaṃ liṃgavaraṃ sadā mudā sampūjayāmīṣṭadameva lokān | saṃśikṣituṃ kāryamidaṃ vimuktyai sarvārthadañceti matammude mama || 103 || dhyāyāmi tadvedaśiro'dhigamyamoṅkāragamyaṃ paramārthatatvam | satyaṃ śivaṃ jñānasukhaṃ subodhannirdvandvamadvaitamanantarūpam || 104 || ekaṃ sthiraṃ śāśvatamavyayaṃ tatprāksṛṣṭito viśvamidanna yatra | saṃvīkṣitaṃ tatpunarudbabhūva tadeva jāye hṛdi bhāvayāmi || 105 || yasmātparannāparamasti kiñcidyasmādgarīyo [yasmādaṇīyaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] na hi kiñcidasti |
pṛ0 61) yenaiva pūrṇaṃ paridṛśyamānaṃ viśvantadevādya vibhāvayāmi || 106 || ityuktvā girijāṃ mahāśivataro ddhyāyanbhavassthāṇuva- nnirvyāpārataraṃgasāgara ivāpyakṣubdhagātraśśivaḥ | devī cāpi mumoda harṣabharitānandāṃgakāste gaṇā- ścetthaṃ tasya supūjanaṃ munivarāssatyaṃ [śrutvā mahāmuktimapyante prāpya tevanātraviṣayaḥ ityadhikatayā kvacitkośe dṛśyate |] vadāmi sphuṭam || 107 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāseśvarapradoṣapūjāvarṇanannāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 ||
kailāsaprākāravarṇanannāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ
munidevagaṇā ūcuḥ– kumāramārasaṅkāśa māramārāṃgasambhava | umāramaṇapādābjadhyānamārita pātaka || 1 || amarārimahāśūra tārakāsurasaṃhṛte | tvattaśśrutamaśeṣeṇa kailāseśvarapūjanam || 2 || bhavadvaktrotthitaśivakathānanditamānasāḥ | nirdhūtapātakā jātā dhanyāḥ pāvanapāvanāḥ || punaśśivakathāsindhutaraṃgodyatamānasān | kuruṣva tripurārātivaraputrātulaprabha || 4 ||
sūta uvāca– itthaṃ devaiśca munibhirgaṇendraiḥ prārthitastadā | kumāraḥ prāha tāndhanyāñjaigīṣavyaṃ purassthitam || pariṇatahimadhāmakāntavaktro vikacasutāmaralocano nagāriḥ | navacaṃpakakuḍmalābhanāsaḥ kuruvindābharado babhāṇa vipram || 6 ||
skanda uvāca– parṇādā munayassarve cāparṇāpativaibhavam | tūrṇamabhyarṇagāssarve samākarṇayatādhunā || 7 || suparṇavāhanādyāśca yūyaṃ karṇarasāyanam | arṇavāntarnivasateścaritaṃ varṇayāmyaham || 8 || mahākailāsabhūbhāge paṃcakoṭipramāṇake | śailaprākāramaddhye tu gaṇānāṃ vasatiḥ kṛtā || 9 || navalakṣapramāṇena pūrvadvārādigopuram | nīlaśailajasāreṇa nānārudragaṇānvitam || 10 || paṭṭikāpiṇḍikādyaiśca devakoṭyā suśobhitam | mahadbhirucchritaiśśṛṃgairullikhantamivāmbaram ||
pṛ0 62) daśasāhasraphalakairgavākṣitamivasthitam | vṛṣabhaiśca śilārājadbhadrarūpaiḥ parīvṛtam || 12 || nandīśvarālayaṃ tatra hemaraupyavirājitam | nānāsaudhatalopeta vanavāṭīvirājitam || sahasrastambhasaṃyuktaṃ patākojvalakumbhakam | kakṣyāgavākṣavitataṃ siṃhāsanavarānvitam || tatrasthanandikeśānaṃ svarṇavetralasatkaram | navaratnaprabhābhāsvatkirīṭakasuśobhitam || somadhāmasamānāsyaṃ rājadbālenduśekharam | caturbhujamudārāṃgaṃ tripuṇṭrojvalaphālakam || bhasmābhyaktaṃjaṭāśobhimastakaṃraktakuṇḍalam | muktāntaritarudrākṣamālāśatavirājitam || suyaśāpatimāśāsya dhyānapūtahṛdantaram | gaṇendraiśca munīndraiśca surendrairnnāradādibhiḥ || gandharvāpsarasāṃ saṅghai rudrairnnāgaiśca siddhakaiḥ | upāsitaṃ mahātmānamindreṇa maruto yathā || sevitaṃ nandikeśānaṃ pramathaiḥ parivāritam | tatrālayaṃ maheśasya navaratnavicitritam || hemaprākārasampannaṃ nānāvṛṣabhaśobhitam | garbhāgāraṃ tatra śambhossphaṭikopalanirmitam || nandīśvarābhidhaṃ liṃgaṃ tatrāstyekaṃ manoharam | darśanātsparśanāccāpi pāpasaṅghanivarhaṇam || dhūpairdīpopahārādyairbhakṣyairbhojyaiśca nityaśaḥ | kamalāmalamālābhirnīlotpalasahasrakaiḥ || bilvacampakapunnāgabakadhurtūrapāṭalaiḥ | sahasrabilvapatraiśca pañcāmṛtaniṣecanaiḥ || 24 || sāmrāṇyagarudhūpaiśca dīpaiḥ karpūrakhaṇḍajaiḥ | pūjayantaṃ maheśānaṃ nandikeśaṃ śilādajam || stotraisstuvantamīśānaṃ trikālaṃ sāvadhānataḥ | tatstutiṃ kathayāmyadya tanmune śṛṇu sādaram ||
nandikeśvara uvāca– indukhaṇḍalalitāmalamaule kundakāntisadṛśottamadeha | indirāramaṇalocanapūjya manmanogahanapaṃkajavāsa || 27 ||
skanda uvāca– itthaṃ stuvantantalliṅgaṃ prākprākārasya saudhagaḥ | saṃsthitassuyaśānātho gaṇakoṭiparīvṛtaḥ || niṣadho hemakūṭaśca prākprākārasya parvatāḥ | pañcalakṣapramāṇena tatraivāgneyagopuram || 29 || rudrāvatāracaritairvṛṣabhaiśśikharairvṛtam | tatrālayaṃ maheśasya gaṇendrasya mahātmanaḥ || 30 || liṃgākāraṃ tatra śambhussukeśeśvarasaṃjñakaḥ | pūjito gaṇapendreṇa gaṇalakṣaparīvṛtaḥ || 31 || sukeśena stutaṃ liṃgaṃ sukeśeśvarasaṃjñitam | pūjitañca trilokeṣu bilvapatraissubhaistathā ||
pṛ0 63) sukeśaḥ– pañcakośagaganātiga śambho vyomakeśa guṇasārasahaṃsa | kāśikāpuranivāsa meheśa pāhi śaṃkara sukeśamaheśa || 33 || nīlaśca mandaraścaiva prākāre dakṣiṇe nagāḥ | tatrāpi gopuraṃ śambhornānārudragaṇāvṛtam || daśalakṣapramāṇena cocchritaṃ gaganātigam | ullikhantaṃ devamārgaṃ sahasratalasaṃyutam || rudrāvatārakrīḍābhirvṛṣastaṃbhaiśca śobhitam | caṇḍīśvarālayaṃ tatra taptahemavibhūṣitam || 36 || sahasrastaṃbhasaṃyuktaṃ muktāvitatatoraṇam | nīlasanmaṇikḷptañca kakṣyāśatavirājitam || sopānai [saudhāpāralasacchṛṃgairupetanavabhūṣitaṃ iti pāṭhāntaram |] ratnasañchannairupetaṃ vanabhūṣitam | tatra sihmāsanāsīnaṃ vidyutpiṃgajaṭādharam || parvaśarvarināthārdhadharaṃ bhasmavibhūṣitam | tripuṇṭravilasatphālaṃ rudrākṣābharaṇānvitam || mahārhavasanopetaṃ nānāratnapariṣkṛtam | nimīlitākṣaṃ dhyāyantaṃ divyaṃ śambhoḥ padāṃbujam || kiṃ pūruṣaissiddhasādhyairmunibṛndairyamena ca | gaṇendraissevitapadaṃ rudrasaṅghairniṣevitam || 41 || tatreśvarasya sadanaṃ madanāntakarasya ca | prākāragopuropetaṃ navaratnaprakalpitam || 42 || caṇḍikeśeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃcaṇḍapāpapraṇāśanam | talliṃgajyotiṣā sarve dyoditāssūryasomakāḥ || talliṃgaṃ pūjayatyeṣa caṇḍikeśastrikālataḥ | bilvairmandārakusumairmallikākaravīrakaiḥ || karṇikārairapāmārgairmālatībhiśca śaṅkaram | dhūpadīpopahārādyairnartanaiḥ karatālakaiḥ || 45 || stotraisstauti mahādevaṃ prāñjaliścaṇḍikeśvaraḥ || 46 ||
caṇḍikeśvaraḥ– caṇḍīśa khaṇḍaparaśo śaśikhaṇḍacūḍa brahmāṇḍamauliga dharādharakārmukeśa | vidhyutthamuṇḍavaramālaka kuṇḍalīśa coccaṇḍatāṇḍava maheśvara śūladaṇḍa || 47 ||
śrī skanda uvāca– itthaṃ vidhāya stutimādareṇa caṇḍīśvarastrijagatāṃ patimindumaulim | natvā maheśvarapadāmburuhaṃ sadaiva dhyāyantsadaiva hṛdayābjasukhaṃ vidhatte || 48 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsaprākāravarṇanannāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||
pṛ0 64) śailaprākāravarṇanannāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ
skanda uvāca– naiṛte gopuraṃ śambhoḥ pañcalakṣapramāṇakam | rudrāṇāñcaritaiścaiva śobhitaṃ śikharairapi || 1 || bāṇastatra mahādevamupāste gaṇalakṣakaiḥ | navaratnasarobhūṣo mahāprāsādamadhyagaḥ || 2 || tadālayaṃ ratnakḷptaṃ sahasrastambhamaṇḍitam | tatra bāṇeśvarāgāraṃ tena liṃgaṃ samarttitam || 3 || maṇṭapairgopurairyuktaṃ trikālaṃ vilvapallavaiḥ ||
bāṇa uvāca– vāṇeśa śambho haribāṇapāṇe tvaṃ pāhi gaṃgādhara candracūḍa | viśveśa bharga madanāntaka kālakāla māmadya śaṃkara vibho gaṇanāthapūjyā || 4 || bhadrāṇi me saṃvidhatsvādya śambho dīkṣādidakṣādhvaradhvaṃsakāva | maheśāna pañcānanenduprakṛṣṭaikadhāma prabho saṃprasīda prasīda prasīda || 5 ||
skanda uvāca– itthaṃ stauti gaṇendro'sau bāṇo bāṇeśvaraṃ śivam | naiṛte gopure tatra prāsādavaramadhyagaḥ || astādriḥ pāriyātraśca paścātprākārasannagāḥ | tatraiva gopuraṃ śambhordaśalakṣaikayojanam || paṭṭikādevagoṣṭhaiśca stambhaiḥ kumbhaiśca koṇajaiḥ | rudrāvatārākrīḍābhī racitaṃ vṛṣabhairvṛtam || talānāñca sahasreṇa nirmitañcitravedikam | suvarṇaratnakalaśaiḥ kailāsādatisundaram || 9 || tatrāsti saudhapravaraṃ sahasrastambhamaṇḍitam | maṇimāṇikyakhacitaṃ divyasihmāsanairvṛtam || dhūpadīpādibahulaṃ bhakṣyabhojyasamanvitam | tatra bhṛṃgī mahātejā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahaḥ || tripuṇṭravilasatphālo maṇimāṇikyakaṃkaṇaḥ | candrārdhaśekharābaddharājatpiṃgajaṭādhara| || sihmāsanastho varado gandharvairgaṇapairvṛtaḥ | varuṇādisudikpālairgaruḍairapsarogaṇaiḥ || 13 || sevito ratnasaudhastho daśalakṣagaṇairvṛtaḥ | vāsukiśśaṅkhapālaśca kambalāśvatarau tathā || śeṣaśca takṣakaścaiva daityanāthā nṛpāstathā | upāsate bhṛṃgiriṭiśśivadhyānahatāśubhaḥ || tatrāsti garbhabhavanaṃ prākāravaragopuram | bhṛṃgīśvarākhyaṃ talliṃgaṃ saṃpūjya stauti bhaktitaḥ || pañcāmṛtaiḥ phalarasaiḥ pañcagavyodakairapi | candanaiḥ puṣpamālābhirbilvamandāracampakaiḥ || dhūpairdīpaistathāpuṣpairnaivedyairmukhavāsajaiḥ || 18 ||
pṛ0 65) bhṛṃgī uvāca– bhṛṃgīśa me manasijastavapādapadmabhṛṃgo bhavatvanudinaṃ sarasānumodaḥ | prāpnotu bhaktimakhilāṃ tava pādapadme māyā tu yātu duritaṃ caritantaveśa || śrīśaṃkarāmayahareśvara viśvamūrte viśvādhikeśa karasaṃgikuraṃgavāla [karaṭaṃkakuraṃgabāla iti pāṭhaḥ |] | mandārakundanavacampakabilvamālādivyottamāṃgadabhujaṃga sureśa pāhi || 20 ||
skanda uvāca– itthaṃ stauti sadākālaṃ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram | gaṇānāṃ śatalakṣaiśca svasamānaiḥ parīvṛtaḥ || vāyavye gopuraṃ śambhoḥ pañcalakṣapramāṇataḥ | rudrāvatārakrīḍābhiranvitammaṇivedikaiḥ || ratnakumbhaśatākīrṇaṃ vāyudhūtapatākam | vṛṣabhālaṃkṛtaṃ divyaṃ tatra saudhaṃ mahātmanaḥ || 23 || sahasrastambhasaṃyuktaṃ hemāsanasamāśritam | riṭirāste śivadhyānavidhūtākhilahṛttamaḥ || bhasmābhyaktastripuṇṭrāṃko ratnākalpavibhūṣitaḥ | somārdhaśekharodbhāsimukuṭo vāyusevitaḥ || dvilakṣagaṇapaiścaiva rudrabṛndairniṣevitaḥ | tatra garbhagṛhaṃ śambho riṭīśākhyamaheśituḥ || 26 || prākāragopuropetaṃ dhūpairdīpairmanoharaiḥ | jātīmallikamandārabilvairabhyarcya śaṃkaram || 27 || kṛtāñjalipuṭasstautiriṭīśaṃbhaktibhāvitaḥ | samudyatpulako devaṃ trikālaṃ liṃgasaṃsthitam ||
riṭiruvāca– viśveśa viśva madanāntaka viśvamūrte gaurīvarāmarabhujaṃgaphaṇābhirāma | gaṃgādharāntakaripo pramathādhinātha pāhīśa māmakadhiyādya lalāmasoma || 29 ||
skanda uvāca– itthaṃstautiriṭirbhaktyāriṭīśaṃmuditāntaraḥ | tatottare ca prākāre saṃsthitāśca kulācalāḥ || dundubhirmandaro nāmnā parvato raivatastataḥ | tatrāpi gopuraṃ śambhordaśalakṣordhvagaṃ sthitam || sahasratalasaṃyuktaṃ paṭṭikāvedikānvitam | ratnaśṛṃgāgravilasaddhūyamānapatākakam || 32 || rudrāvatārakrīḍābhiranvitaṃ vṛṣabhairapi | tatrāsti saudhapravaraṃ māṇikyatalakuṭṭimam || sahasrakanakastambhairnirmitaṃ vanarājitam | hemasihmāsanairyuktaṃ dhūpagandhānumoditam || maṇiprabhābhāsitañca tiraskṛtanabhoṅkaṇam [tamoguṇamiti pāṭhāntaram |] | kālāgnirudrastatrāste yakṣeśaiśca niṣevitaḥ ||
pṛ0 66) bhasmarudrākṣavītāṅgo muktāmāṇikyabhūṣaṇaḥ | mukuṭodyatsudhādhāmakhaṇḍojvalitavaktrakaḥ || tripuṇṭrarekhāvitataphālabhāgamanoharaḥ | triśūlapāṇirvarado hemasiṃhāsanasthitaḥ || kubereṇa ca devaiśca pañcalakṣagaṇairapi | hetipāśamahāśūladharaistairahimanyubhiḥ || 38 || tatrāgāraṃ maheśasya kālarudreśvarasya ca | prākāragopurayutaṃ dhūpadīpaśatāvṛtam || 39 || naivedyaiścandanaiścaiva bilvamandārapaṅkajaiḥ | sampūjya parayā bhaktyā stauti devaṃ pinākinam ||
kālāgnirudra uvāca– triyambaka sadāśiva tripuramārakālāntaka [kālāndhakādyapārasuraśatruhanhariśarādribāṇāsana iti pāṭhāntaram |] triśūlavarapāśasaṃyutakarādrivāṇāsana | prasādajanitānana prakaṭacaṇḍadhāmāgama sudhāṃśukaśikhaṇḍaka surasanātha māṃ pālaya || 41 || iti stauti prahṛṣṭātmā kālarudro maheśvaram | tasya prākāra koṇe cāpyaiśānyāṃ diśi saṃsthitaḥ || vīrabhadrassadaivāste gaṇalakṣaiḥ parīvṛtaḥ | taduttaraṃ hi kailāsaṃ tatra gopuramuttamam || pañcalakṣapramāṇena vedikāpaṭṭikānvitam | suvarṇaratnakhacitaṃ kalaśaiśśobhitaṃ mune || rudrāvatāravṛṣabhaiśśobhitaṃ tanmanoharam | tatra saudhavare kḷpte sahasrastambhamaṇṭape || 44 || hemaratnacite divyahemasiṃhāsanasthitaḥ | īśānena ca rudraiśca gaṇalakṣasamanvitaḥ || bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṃgastripuṇṭraparicihnitaḥ | rājadratnāṅgadairyukto maṇirudrākṣahārakaḥ || mukuṭodyatsudhādhāmakhaṇḍārdhajaṭilālakaḥ | sadāśivārcakavaraśśūlahastohi bhairavaḥ || tatraikaṃ bhavanaṃ śambhorvīrabhadreśvarasya ca | navaratnāṃkitaṃ divyaṃ prākāravaragopuram || 48 || dhūpāmoditadikcakraṃ maṇidyutivirājitam | talliṃgaṃ pūjayatyeva bilvamandāracampakaiḥ || dīpopahāradhūpaiśca candanenākṣatādibhiḥ | stauti hṛṣṭastrikālaṃ sa talliṃgaṃ pārameśvaram ||
vīrabhadra uvāca– kṣayadvīra dakṣādhvaradhvaṃsakāśāvaseśāna cāśāvihīneti tuṣṭaḥ | tvamevāsi bhadraṃ tvamevāsya bhadraṃ satāñcāsatāmāśu māṃ mokṣayādya || 51 || itthaṃ stauti sadāśambhuṃ vīrabhadro gaṇāgraṇīḥ | śailāvaraṇametadvai śambhośśivagaṇāśrayam ||
pṛ0 67) daśalakṣapramāṇena parighākṛtivistaram | gopurārbudakopetaṃ [gopurāṭṭālakopetamiti pāṭhāntaram |] ramyamaṇṭapamaṇḍitam || sahasraniyutastambhaiḥ kumbhaiścāpi samanvitam | ramyaliṅgālayottuṅgarājadvṛṣabhaśekharaiḥ || dhagaddhagitadikcakraṃ śailāvaraṇamīśituḥ | vyāyāmāyatadīrghañcāpyetadvo'bhihitaṃ mayā || evamābhyantarāḥ kḷptāḥ prākāravaragopurāḥ | sahasrapramathādhīśaissaptasāgaramadhyagaiḥ || śailadvīpasaridbhiśca nirmitaṃ vipinairapi | dhyātvā dhyeyamidaṃ vipragaṇo bhavati śāṃkaraḥ ||
skanda uvāca– naiva prākāramadhye haravidhiharayo no gaṇā nāpi vāto no candro na ca sūryaraśminicayonāgnitrayaṃ no surāḥ | ekastatra maheśvaro viharati svairaṃ sahāmbo mudā tadvedairapi vaktumeva na bhavetkāvā kathānyasya hi || 58 || śaraśaradhirathāṃgaṃ yantṛyānaṃ vahā vai dhanuvaramatha tajyā vairivargaṃ rathīca | harividhiśrutayaḥ kṣmā puṣpavantau tathābdhirnagavara uragendrastraipuraṃ śrīmaheśaḥ || niśvāsaśrutireka eva bhagavānāste sahāmbo bhava- stasyāpāravicitrasargabahulāssvābhāvikāśśaktayaḥ | tasyānandaghanasya bhaktiparamā bhāvā gaṇāste dvijā brahmendrādimarutpadeṣu vihitāssaktā maheśārcane || 60 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe śailaprākāravarṇanannāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 ||
pañcabrahmaprākāravarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ
jaigīṣavya uvāca– śikhivāha namaste'stu nagapautra mahāprabho | sundarānanasandoha dvādaśotpalalocana || nākanāyaka mainākamātulānalasambhava | śokamūkasudaityājigataprāṇāpahāraka || 2 || tārakakrauñcamathana punarvistarato vada | nahi tṛpyāmi te vaktrakathārasajharībharaiḥ || 3 ||
pṛ0 68) punaḥ kiyantaḥ prākārā gopurāṭṭālasundarāḥ | kailāsasya maheśasyāvasateratulasya ca ||
sūta uvāca– itthaṃ nanditamandāro jaigīṣavyena coditaḥ | surān gaṇānmunīṃścaiva protphullānanapaṅkajaḥ || uvāca pramatheśānannatvā devīṃ svamātaram || 6 ||
skanda uvāca– śṛṇudhvaṃ brahmavicchreṣṭhā [brahmaviṣṇvādyā iti pāṭhāntaram |] munayaśca gaṇottamāḥ [tapodhanāḥ iti pāṭhāntaram |] | jaigīṣavya mahāprājña śṛṇudhvamamalāḥ kathāḥ || śambhorvicitravibhavāśśrotrapātrāmalāḥ kathāḥ | kṣīrodadhimahākhātaprākāro'stitadantaraḥ || udbhūtacandrakiraṇaistaraṃgaiścaiva bhāsuraḥ | rajatocchrāyaśṛṃgāgro mahāvṛṣabhalāñchitaḥ || nānāgopuraratnaughaprabhābhāsitadiṅmukhaḥ | sphaṭikaiḥ kṛtadeveśavarasundaravigrahaiḥ || śobhito gopurāṇāṃca samūhaiḥ pariśobhitaḥ | tatpūrvadeśe devasya tatpūrvasya manoharam || gopuraṃ saudhasubhagaṃ stambhavidrumaputrikam | maṇikḷptācchavalabhīniryatpārāvatīgaṇam || tatra siṃhāsanavaraṃ navaratnavicitritam | tatra sthitaṃ gaṇairdevaiśśūlatejolasatkaraiḥ || kapardadhṛtacandrārkairbhasitāmalalocanaiḥ | tripuṇṭravilasatphālairvilasatphālalocanaiḥ || ratnāntaritarudrākṣamālālalitakandharaiḥ | nīradodyatprabhābhāsvannīrajopamakandharaiḥ || vātāśanakṛtocchvāsacaladdhāramanoharaiḥ | mahāḍamarunādena bhīṣitākhiladiktaṭaiḥ || phaṇāmaṇikṛtāpāranūpurāṃgadakaṃkaṇaiḥ | raṇanmañjīravalayaissiṃhasaṃhanairgaṇaiḥ || 17 || puṇḍarīkājinabhavatkṛṣṇarekhākaṭītaṭaiḥ | mahebhacarmavasanairbālātapasamaprabhaiḥ || 18 || gaṇendrairvāraṇendrābhaiḥ kariśuṇḍorubāhubhiḥ | ahimanyubhirutkṛṣṭaiḥ koṭibhirgaṇapairvṛtaḥ || pṛṣatkakaranistṛṃśabāṇāsanadharairvaraiḥ | pūrvato bhātitatpūrṣaścendukundasamaprabhaḥ || 20 || jaṭāmukuṭasaṃśobhirājarājakalādharaḥ | bhasmābhyaktastripuṇṭrāṃkaścaturbāhurudāradhīḥ || triṇetro nīlakaṇṭhaśca bālasūryāyutaprabhaḥ | tatpūruṣaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ saṃpūjya varivasyayā || samarcayati viprendra bilvapatraiśśivārcakaḥ | stuvate sāvadhānena talliṅgaṃ ratnadhāmagam ||
pṛ0 69) tatpuruṣaḥ– svacchachatrābhirāmaṃ chavijitarajataṃ chandasāṅgītatuṣṭam svacchandāyāṃ niricchodadhinijamahigocchannamacchācchadeham | chadmebhārichadācchachadamajamajaraṃ piñchatāpiñchaguccha- chāyāsachāyavāmāṅgamamadadhiṣaṇe sadvipacchedaneccham || 24 || āśīviṣāṅgada sadaiva maheśa kāśīvāsīkṛtānandavana prasīda | saṃsāravārāśitare purāre kīnāśanāśa bhayamāśu vināśayādya || 25 ||
skandaḥ– itthaṃ stauti sadākālaṃ puruṣaḥ [tatpūruṣaḥ parameśvaramiti pāṭhāntaram |] puruṣeśvaram | tatrāste gaṇapādhīśaḥ prācīntāṃpālayandiśam || kṣārodadhiparīvṛtaḥ kālāyasavinirmitaḥ | prākāro rājate vipra dakṣiṇe gopurairvṛtaḥ || lavaṇāmbhodhikallolaghargharānilaghoṣitaḥ | tatra nānā mahābhogaphaṇāratnālayo mahān || saudhāntarasthapīṭhasthobhrukuṭī kuṭilānanaḥ | uccaṇḍatarakodaṇḍakhaṇḍitārātimaṇḍalaḥ || jaṭāmaṇḍalagodbhāsisudhāmaṇḍalaśekharaḥ | vidyullateva ghanavaddaṃṣṭrāśobhitavaktrakaḥ || 30 || nīlāmalatanūbhāsvadbhāsitālepasundaraḥ | sajaloddāmaghanagagarbhāntarasuvidyutā || 31 || sadṛśāmalapuṇṭrāṃkastilakākalpabhūṣitaḥ | dhanurhetidharastādṛggaṇapairabhito vṛtaḥ || 32 || prasannakarasaṃkāśadordaṇḍavaracaṇḍakaiḥ | brahmāṇḍasphoṭanārāvaiḥ kodaṇḍavaramaṇḍitaiḥ || 33 || aghoro ghoravadanaḥ pātitāndakṣiṇāndiśam | caṇḍājñānatamoccaṇḍakhaṇḍane maṇḍitālakaḥ || aghoreśaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ saṃpūjya stauti bhaktitaḥ ||
aghoraḥ– sajjannirjararājarājamakuṭīnīrājanabhrājipa- drājīvaṃ jagadārtibhañjanaratañjetāramājau purām | āsāmrājyamihaiva jīvitanaye sāyujyamevejyayā dātāraṃ bhaja dhūrjaṭiṃ svahṛdaya me jahnukanyābhujaṃgam || 35 || anikaṭagamakapaṭagirāmahikaṭakaṃ naṭanalampaṭaṃ khapaṭam |
pṛ0 70) aghapaṭalapāṭanapaṭuṃ hāṭaka godhāridhāriṇaṃ vande || 36 ||
skandaḥ– pratīcyāmapitatrāsti prākāraḥ puṣparāgajaḥ | puṣparāgamaṇijyotirvibhāsitadigantaraḥ || tanmaṇīndrakṛtānekarudrakrīḍādivigrahaiḥ | vṛṣabhaistādṛśaireva gopurāgraprakalpitaiḥ || 38 || gopurairbhūdharākārai rājatkalaśasundaraiḥ | tatrāsti bhavanaṃ puṇyaṃ nānāmaṇivirājitam || vedikāpaṭṭikopetaṃ sihmāsanabarairvṛtam | sadyojātaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ kṣārasāravibhūṣitam || pūrvajātaniśānāthabhāsurāṃgamanoharam | rājatpiṃgāmalajaṭākṛtāpīḍaniśākaram || 41 || uḍunāyakasaṃśobhiphālānalavilocanam | pracaṇḍataramārtāṇḍamaṇḍalottamabhūṣitam || 42 || nīlendīvarasaṅkāśagrīvāvalayasundaram | puṣparāgakṛtānekamālākalitakandharam || 43 || vaiyāghracarmavilasatkaṭiratnasukāñcikam | ahimanyuvarāneka tādṛśairgaṇapairyutam || 44 || pāśāṃkuśābhayakaraṃ pāśinā parisevitam | dadhimaṇḍamahāṃbhodhimadhyasaudhavarāśrayam || gaṇaiścāpi mahoddaṇḍaḍimbhārāvavibhīṣaṇaiḥ | sevitaṃ pāśibhistatra paścimāṃ pātitāndiśam || sadyojāteśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ stauti bhaksyā prapūjayan || 47 ||
sadyojātaḥ– pāṭīradrumakīṭaketanajaṭākoṭīrabhāgeraṭa- tspāṭoccaistaṭinīsyadārbhaṭataṭajjūṭīkṛtāhichaṭa | ghoṭākṛtrimagokaṭītaṭapaṭībhūtebhacarmāmbara kṣoṇīruṇṇikaṭāṭakhāṭaviṭapinmaccittataṭyāmaṭa || 48 || vataṃsitasudhākaraṃ varaguṇaugharatnākaraṃ sphuranniṭilalocanajvalanadagdhamīnadhvajam | kulācalakumārikākucataṭīpaṭīrāṃkitaṃ bhajāmi bhajatāṃ sadābhayadamīśvaraṃ śaṃkaram || 49 ||
skandaḥ– iti stauti sadā liṃgaṃ sadyojāto maheśvaram | taduttare'pi prākāro gomedhamaṇikalpitaḥ || ghṛtodenāvṛtastatra tatkallolotthavāyubhiḥ | parīvīto gopuraiśca tanmaṇīndrakṛtaiśśubhaiḥ ||
pṛ0 71) vararudrāvatārodyadvigrahairvṛṣabhairyutam | śobhitaṃ tatprabhābhiśca tatrāsthānaṃ ca tasya hi || saudhairapāraśikharairbahustambhavirājitaiḥ | tatra saṃsthaṃ mahābāhuṃ vāmadevaṃ trilocanam || sihmāsane sukhāsīnaṃ bhasmoddhūlanapāṇḍaram | harinmaṇinibhākāraṃ vidyunnibhajaṭādharam || tripuṇḍrāṅkitasatphālaṃ khaṅgakheṭadharaṃ śubham | prasannāsyannīlakaṇṭhaṃ rājadindukalādharam || haritairgaṇapaiścaiva vāyubhiḥ parisevitam | udyanmaratakīgarbhasundarairvāyuvegitaiḥ || 56 || tripuṇṭracandrārdhadharairjaṭāmaṇḍalamastakaiḥ | bāṇabāṇāsanadharairhallakābhūṣabhūṣitaiḥ || 57 || vallakīmurajottuṅgamṛdaṅgavaravādakaiḥ | sevitaṃ parito vīraiśśūlāmalalasatkaraiḥ || 58 || vāmadevaṃ sāmajātājinabaddhakaṭītaṭam | kaṇṭhe bhujaṅgasaṃyuktaṃ mṛgendrāmalalocanam || kubereṇottarāṃ pāti diśaṃ yakṣeśvarāvṛtām | vāmadeveśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ sampūjyāstuvadīśvaram ||
vāmadevaḥ– tiṣṭhante stutipāṭhane tava vibho niṣṭhyūtaniṣṭhīvava- cchāṭhyaṃ niṣṭhuratāṃ vidhūya manasā brahmaikaniṣṭhāḥ kati | vaikuṇṭhārcita ratnapīṭhanilaya śrīkaṇṭha kaṇṭhollasa- nnīla jyeṣṭha kaniṣṭha kuṣṭhahanana śreṣṭhāntarātiṣṭha me || 61 || surakuvalayasomaṃ vāmadevākhyasāmastutamakhilaguṇānāṃ sīmadhāmānamīśam | jagadavanavināśaṃ śāmbhavodyatsukāmaṃ nijanayanakaṭākṣairdagdhakāmaṃ bhaje'ham ||
skandaḥ– evaṃ stauti mahādevaṃ vāmadevaḥ prasannadhīḥ | tadantarā girermūrdhni saṃstho hīrakasaudhakaḥ || rudrāvatāraprabhavairvigrahairvṛṣabhairapi | uragendramahāhāro maddhyandinaraviprabhaḥ || 64 || śarvarīśānamakuṭībhūtibhūṣitavigrahaḥ | gajendracarmavasano hīramālākṛtāṅgakaḥ || 65 || antarikṣai rudragaṇaiḥ pāti vyoma manoharam | niṣaṅgibhiḥ kavacibhiśchurikāhetidhāribhiḥ || vyomakeśaprasādena ceśānaścośitā satām | īśāneśaṃ mahāliṅgaṃ sampūjya stauti bhaktitaḥ ||
īśānaḥ– rathantararavapriyaṃ ratharathāṅgapāṇīśaraṃ manorathapathātigaṃ surathanāthasatkaṅkaṇam |
pṛ0 72) bhagīrathapathānugāvihitajahnukanyājaṭaṃ bhajāmi surago rathapriyamapārapāpāpaham || 68 || caṣake nijavājiheṣitaiścaraṇe vāyusubhojiśiñjitaiḥ | kaṭisīmni subhūribṛhmitairmukharaṃ daivatamāvirastu citte || 69 || aśvīkṛtasvīkṛtavedarāśināṅgīkṛtāṃgīkṛtaśambarāriḥ | astrīkṛtastrīkṛtadānavārirdevassadā me hṛdaye cakāstu || 70 ||
skandaḥ– evaṃ stauti sadākālamīśāno gaṇapāvṛtaḥ | āntarāḥ parighāścaiva prākāravaragopuram || mahākailāsabhavane maṇikalpitamuttamam | ratnaprākārametaddhipañcabrahmaprakalpitam || 72 || maheśena tadā vipra śravaṇādaghanāśanam || 73 || vicitraṃ śivanirmāṇaṃ vicitraṃ śivaceṣṭitam | vicitrā śivamāyā sā mahāmāyasya śūlinaḥ || yasyāṃśaleśalavaleśaśatāṃśaleśaleśairjagajjananakarmagatipraṇāśam | kurvanti vāmabhujabhūrmadhukaiṭabhārirdakṣāṃganetrajananau bhavatāṃ harājau || 75 || kvacitkalpe sraṣṭā haravidhimukundāḥ pratibhuvaḥ kvacidbrahmā viṣṇuḥ kvacidapi ca rudro'pi karaṇam | jagatsaṃsthānāśaprakṛtijaguṇaiḥ naiva karaṇā bhajantaścānyonyaṃ janakajananāśśambhukṛpayā || 76 || manovācāṃ cakṣurviṣayamapi notasya caritaṃ śivasyaitā līlāḥ prathitavitatā jāgatagatāḥ | svatantro'yaṃ śambhurguṇagaṇavihīno'pi saguṇa- ssvayā śaktyā citraṃ vidadhati girīśo'dya jagati || 77 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe pañcabrahmaprākāravarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||
pṛ0 73) kailāsaprāsādavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– tadantare'pi prākāraścandrakāntaśilāmayaḥ | kaladhautamahāsānuśikharoparisaṃsthitaḥ || pañcalakṣapramāṇena cāyāmenocchrayeṇaca | pariṇāhe'pi viprendra parivartojvalaprabhaḥ || kanakāmalakumbhāgro ratnabhrājanmaṇiprabhaḥ | sudhābdhijalakallolavilasatpādapīṭhakaḥ || caturdikṣu mahādvāragopurottamaśekharaḥ | somadhāmāyutodbhāsi cākacakyajitāntaraḥ || jagaccakramahābimbabimbitāntarasundaraḥ | tatkāntikāntadhārābhirdiśo'pi dhavalīkṛtāḥ || udyatsudhāṃśukiraṇanisṛṣṭotsṛṣṭanīrakaḥ | sudhātaraṅganṛtyordhvahāsaphenopamo'malaḥ || 6 || kailāsācalasarvasvasārabhūto'yamuttamaḥ | dhavalimnā tu ye loke pādapāssanti varṇane || teṣāmapyatidhāvalyānupamassa dvijottama | tatprākāramahāmaulau sphaṭikopalanirmitāḥ || vṛṣabhā nīlanayanāḥ pucche śṛṅge vibhūṣitāḥ | kuruvindollasajjihvāḥ kakudābhogabhāsurāḥ || 9 || karṇāgralambitātyuccasphuraccāmarapaṃktayaḥ | kecidānandabharitāḥ paśyantyanyo'nyamīkṣaṇaiḥ || kecitsurabhipāścātyabhāgabhogaikasambhramāḥ | vivṛtodyaddhīrakāntidantāvalivibhūṣitāḥ || kecidātāmranetrāntāssuraghaṭṭamahopalāḥ | pravālamaṇikḷptena lambinā vṛṣaṇena ca || nandanti ghanasannāhadhvanibhirjitadiṅmukhāḥ | evaṃ tatra mahāsaudhaprākāravarasaṃsthitāḥ || kalpakānāṃ vanaṃ tatra chadapuṣpaphalāvṛtam | nānāpalāśakalikākusumaiḥ phullaśekharam || ratnālavālakalitaṃ rājadrāmaṇyavedikam | tatra tatsumagandhodyadbandhurāmalamārutam || ghrāṇatarpaṇamatyantaṃ śītāsāravisāriṇam | vasantapramukhānekaiṛtubhiḥ parivāritam || kāmādhikapradaṃ tatra tatkalpakakulaṃ mahat | mandārapārijātaiśca santānaiścandanairvṛtam || nayanānandajananaṃ tāpatrayanivārakam | tatkailāsamahāpārasārabhūtaṃ manoharam || 18 || harinmaṇinibhaṃ svacchachatrachāyāsamaprabham | tatsumaprabhavāmodaghumughghumitamārutam || viṣṇubrahmāmarendrādyā munayaśca gaṇāssurāḥ | tṛptāntarāḥ pramuditā necchantyevahi nandanam || tatsukhāṃśaśatāṃśāṃśaśatakaṃ tatra nāsti hi | ityanyonyaṃ saṃvadanti kathaṃ tatprāpyate vanam || kevalaṃ śrīmaheśasya prasādena vinā dvija | nāsmākaṃ prasarastatra ceti vismāyitāntarāḥ ||
pṛ0 74) tatrotphullamahāratnasopānāvalibhāsurāḥ | svacchācchasphaṭikākārapānīyottamasaṃvṛtāḥ || suvarṇamṛdulālolamṛṇālochritakuṇḍalaiḥ | ratnakalhārakañjaiśca kumudaiścaiva śobhitāḥ || utphullaratnakamalasahasradalasaṃvṛtāḥ | harinmaṇīndravitataharicchadavarairyutāḥ || 25 || tatpatravilasannīlavelamuktāphalopamāḥ | tatpaṅkajarajaḥ puñjarañjitā mandamārutāḥ || tadbṛndamadhurāmodavisarpitadigantarāḥ | nīranīrajavalyo'pi vitatāstatra śāṅkara || indranīlakṛtānekakalikoddāmakesaraiḥ | vellitākīlitāpāranīlendīvarabhāsurāḥ || vikacatkumudāsārakesaracchadasaṃvṛtāḥ | kāsārasārasaralacalanācalapatrakāḥ || 29 || udyatsupuṇḍarīkācchatucchīkṛtasudhāvaliḥ | santyatranīrajadalasvacchaśāradavatsthitaḥ || tasyānte ratnavilasatpadmarāgamaṇidyutiḥ | prāsādaśśṛṅgasāhasraiḥ paritassarasastadā || vicitrāpārasadratnastambhapaṃktivirājitaḥ | tadvidrumalatājālastambhavidrumaputrikaḥ || gopānasīgatāpāragavākṣojvalakumbhakaḥ | rājatsuratnakalaśaprabhākīlitadiṅmukhaḥ || udyadbhānusahasrābhaḥ kiñjalkākṛtibhāsuraḥ | kvacitsihmāsanaṃ tatra navaratnavicitritam || kvacinmañcā ratnapādā mūlake vidrumānvitāḥ | sphaṭikopalasaṅkḷptatalādivitatāśśubhāḥ || harinmaṇitalāścāpi kuruvindatalāmalāḥ | indranīlamaṇikḷptamahāpīṭhamanoharāḥ || muktāvitānakalitā maṇilambitaśṛṅkhalāḥ | mañcā manojñā rucirāssopadhānopaśobhitāḥ || 37 || puṣparāgakagomedavaiḍūryatalakāntibhiḥ | bhānti tatra mahāpīṭhā vidyududyatprabhāyutāḥ || kvacinnimnabhramāstatra patanti prasabhaṃ gaṇāḥ | unnateṣu pradeśeṣu nimnabhrāntikarāssadā || sthale jalabhramaścāpi jale tatra sthalabhramaḥ | nānāratnapatatpatraśukaśārikarāvitaḥ || ratnapañjaramadhyasthaśukaśārikapaṃktibhiḥ | krīḍāmayūrairvalabhīlambipiñchaikabhāsuraḥ || tatra pakṣigaṇāssarve śiva śaṅkara pāhi naḥ | dhūpadhūmamahāgandhabandhurāmalamārutaḥ || maṇiprabhābhissatataṃ somasūryau tiraskṛtau | sarasīmadhyasaṃkḷptasaudhodyadvarakumbhakaḥ || maṇistambhakṛtāsārabhābhāsitadigantaraḥ | suvarṇāmbarasaṃkḷptavitatāmalamauktikaiḥ || jālikāpālikāpāravitānāvalibhāsuraḥ | tanmadhyahīrakottuṅgasihmāsanavarāśritaḥ || tatradevyā mahādevo vihāraśayanāsanaiḥ | saraḥprāntorukalaśadhārāsārordhvaśīkaraiḥ ||
pṛ0 75) yannīratīragandhodyaddhārāsāraughaśīkaraiḥ | kadācittatra madhyastho devyā vyajanahastayā || sevitaśśrīmaheśānaḥ kvacitpīṭhasthitaśśivaḥ | tatra nānāvidhāḥ krīḍā devyā cakre maheśvaraḥ || 48 || vicitrāṇāṃ caritrāṇāṃ triṇetrapriyakāmyayā | devyā pramudito devastatra saudhavareṣu ca || kāścittatra vadāmyadya śṛṇu bhūsura śāmbhava | vipine sarasastīre prāsādāgreṣu gopure || vijahāra mahādevo bhavānyā śaṃkarastadā | śailamālokayaddevo devyā devī sakhīgaṇaiḥ || adarśayadvicitrāṇi tasminkailāsaparvate || 52 || sālatālakṛtamālatamālairāmalakyavakulārjunapāṭalaiḥ | phānasairlikucabāhlikanīpairdāḍimaiśca surasālarasālaiḥ || 53 || jambūnimbakadambajaiḥ phalabharaistakkolahintālakai- raṃkolaissaralairaśokatilakaistindūkamālūrakaiḥ | punnāgairnaganāgasarjarasikaiḥ cāmpeyamādhūkakaiḥ plakṣāśvatthakapitthatintriṇibhavairbhūnimbajālairdhavaiḥ || 54 || vaṭakuṭajakuraṇṭaiḥ karṇikārāśvamāraiḥ kharabadarapalāśairloddhrasaccandanaiśca | kuravakaśukatuṇḍaiśśiṃśupāceṅgudībhirlikucavikacabhaṇḍaiḥ ketakaissinduvāraiḥ || 55 || kedārakovidāraiśca devadārukapitthakaiḥ | tagarāgarukṛṣṇābhraistuṃganīpakakamrakaiḥ || 56 || mandāradvayapārijātavakajairarkaiśca saptachadaiḥ pūgīnāralakharjuraiśca kuṭajairnāraṃgajātidrumaiḥ | plakṣodumbarakandalairmunibhavai rājādanairbarbarai- śśalmalyairvaraśigrukairmadhubhavaissanmātuliṃgairapi || 57 || bhūtāvāsaharītakītrikaṭukaiśśamyudbhavaiḥ kindaraiḥ prācīnāmalakaiḥ karañjakakubhairgandhāttajambūphalaiḥ | bandhūkaiściribilvajaiśca taragaiḥ kṛṣṇāgarūtthairdrumai- rmāliṃgaiśca śirīṣakaiḥ kusumitairanyaiśca śākhāśataiḥ || 58 ||
pṛ0 76) mallīmālatijātikāsurabhitaissāyantanonnidritai- ścandrāsāravikāsitairatisitaissaccandrikāvallibhiḥ | vallīnānnivahaiḥ kadambajarajassandohagandhānilai- rutphullaistilakaistamālajasumaiḥ phullairlasatkesaraiḥ || 59 || kundairindukaraprasāritamukhairālolasaptachadaiḥ kausumbhairaruṇaprabhāsumadhuraiḥ prodbhūtasatkesaraiḥ | drākṣāgucchasuvallikāsitasitāḥ puṇṭrekṣusārākarāḥ pūgadruṃgabalīkṛtāṃgamadhurāssannāgavallīlatāḥ || 60 || mandārasundarataruprakaraiḥ praphullairutphulladāḍimasumairbakakarṇikāraiḥ | pītāyamānasuṣamāyutacampakaistairutphullapāṭalakadambajarājavṛkṣaiḥ || 61 || satkiṃśukaiśśukamukhairvaraśalmalībhiḥ punnāganāganavanīpasumaiḥ praphullaiḥ | bhārātibhāraśikharaiḥ kaladhautaśailaḥ paśyāmbike'dya sumanoharavṛkṣasaṅghaiḥ || 62 || vallīvikāsitatanuḥ prasabhaṃ bhavāni prodyatsudhāṃśucayakoṭinibho vibhāti || utphullāmalapuṇḍarīkakumudairnīlotpalaissundarai- rāraktāmbujakañjanībhirabhitassadratnasopānakaiḥ | tatprāntāmalabilvamūlajamahāliṅgākṛtiśśaṅkara- stuṣyatyeva sarassurudragaṇapairdevyāgirīndre'dhikam || 63 || taddhyānadhārāmṛtapānapīnāssvātmaikatānā iva cakravākāḥ | sarassu kallolacalāktapakṣā haṃsā vakāssārasapaṃktayaśca || 64 || nārdrīkṛtāṅgāḥ khalu sañcaranti bhāvā bhavābdhāviva me prabhāvāt || 65 || kapivarakulamādyaccālanālokanādyaiḥ phalapatanajavarṣaiḥ puṣpareṇuprakīrṇaiḥ | śikhariśikharasārā bhūmayaśśośubhante karikaṭamadadhārāprasravaiḥ paṅkilāśca || 66 || śukabakapikakākakokadhūkairnibhṛtavināditacakravākapākaiḥ | gahanavipinaśākhimastasaṃsthāmadhurārāvavinādicakravākaiḥ || 67 || girivaraśikharāgre nṛttasāṭopabarhā harikulakṛtaghopairbṛhmitairvāraṇānām |
pṛ0 77) giriśirasi ninādaissārasānāṃ śukānāṃ pikaravakalakaṇṭhairnāditastadgṛhāntaḥ || mahiṣacamarakuñjadantaśṛṅgaiḥ kharakhuraghaṭṭanaśailasānunimnaḥ | sumanajagatavāyubandhurānumodadrumarajasaṃkṛtidroṇilambikṣaudraḥ || 69 || phalakulasumabhārairdīrghitānamraśākhāvrajadalikulamālānīlanīlābjatulyāḥ | madhurarasasupeśīlambahastāgraśākhā haragirivarabhāgā bhānti sauvarṇavṛkṣāḥ || 70 || kaladhautanagapraśastamustāpulakāmreḍitakolajālametat | sitadaṃṣṭrotthitaghoṇaghargharorurāvaṃ paśyamudāgirīndrajāte || 71 || harikharanakharairvidāritodyatkarikumbhodyataraktayuktamuktā- maṇijālāvṛtabhūmibhāgametat | dvipakulamidamatyudāraghoṣaṃ hariṇo dhāvati sihmanādabhītaḥ || 72 || valmīkordhvaphaṇaṃphaṇīśvarakulaṃ vātotthadikcakraka- ñcārtatrastavilocanaṃ hariravairbhītyā prasūtaṃ śiśum | tyaktvā dhāvati paśya paśya girije proḍḍīnameṇīkulam || 73 || kailāsācalaratnasaudhagamahāsihmāsanāddhyāsito devyutphullamukhāravindavigalanmādhvīkasāraṃ madhu | pītvā locanaṣaṭpadairvadati tāṃ paśyeti liṅgānyume bilvīkomalapallavairanudinaṃkailāsaśṛṅge'rcitam || 74 || paśyāmbike madanamattamayūrapiñchaissañchāditāni camarīgaṇapucchabhāraiḥ | saṃvījitāni karivistṛtakarṇatālaissiktāni tadvanagavāṃ payasaiva nityam || 75 || saṅgharṣaṇānmṛgakarīndrasudehabhārairbilvachadaiḥ patanataḥ paripūjitāni || 76 ||
skandaḥ– gaurīyallakabhallaśaurirurago'sacchiñjinī te nago- līlākārmukatāndadhāti bhagavānbhillākṛte te'dhunā | vedāsteturagā vidhirniyatikṛdviśveśa viśvādhika tvallīlādhigamena sarvajagatāṃ nāśaprabhāvasthitiḥ || 77 ||
pṛ0 78) vīkṣāśikṣitamanmathatripuraka dakṣādidīkṣāpaha tryakṣākṣādividūra bhikṣitamahāmaunīndravijñānada | īkṣā bhojanapakṣapāta dayayā kakṣādhivāsāvamām || 78 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsaprāsādavarṇanannāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||
kailāsamaulivarṇanaṃ nāma aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– hīrākāramahāsaudhe gharmatapto hi śaṃkaraḥ | devyā sarastaṭe ratnasihmāsanavare sthitaḥ || sucandracandanadrāvavilepitamahāṅgakaḥ | mahāgarumahādhūmavidhūpitaśikhastadā || 2 || ratnapātrasthitāpāramahāmodānnabhojanaḥ | tato'pi kalpakaphalaṃ devyā bhuktaṃ maheśvaraḥ || suratnakhacitānekaratnapātrasthitānphalān | dṛṣṭvā tuṣyati deveśaḥ kadācidamṛtāśanaḥ || ratnādarśavilokācchapratibimbaikadarśanaḥ | devyā lalāṭaphalake tilakaṃ ratnanirmitam || kalpayatyatihṛṣṭātmā sadānandaghanaśśivaḥ | pāṭīracandrakastūrīliptaṃ malayapaṃkajam || devīṃ vilepya saṃhṛṣṭassvāṅgamīśo'tiharṣataḥ | devyā dhammillamallīnāṃ ghrāṇānandakutūhalaḥ || kalpakāmodabahulapuṣpasragbhiśca bhūṣaṇaiḥ | tyaktvā kapardaṃ makuṭaṃ ratnakalpitamuttamam || dhārayatyatisaṃhṛṣṭaścandradvandvaṃ maheśvaraḥ | hārakeyūravalayairbhūṣāṃ svāṃkalayatyumām || 9 || kākodaramahāratnaṃ tyaktvā ratnaprabhādhikam | navaratnamahāhārāvalīlambitamauktikaiḥ || svakaṇṭhaṃ kīlayatyeva devyāḥ kaṇṭhe'pi śaṃkaraḥ | śitikaṇṭho virūpākṣo devyā krīḍati tatra hi || 11 || evaṃ viharatostatra brahmakalpaśataṅgatam | bhūtaṃ bhāvi bhavattatra kālakalpaṃ dvijottamāḥ || kālātītasya devasya sadā mṛtyuñjayasya ca | tasya kṣaṇārdhaṃ tāḥ krīḍāḥ kena vaktuṃ hi pāryate || 13 || dhārāsāragṛheṣu śaṅkhamurajoddhṛṣṭeṣu tuṣṭaśśiva- ścandrośīrasugandhabandhurajalaissatpāṭalāmoditaiḥ |
pṛ0 79) lālāṭotthahutāśasūryakiraṇaissantaptagātro'mbayā līlālālitaratnakīrakarayādhyāste ca sihmāsane || 14 || hīrāgāranibaddharatnajamahāḍolāsanāḍolanai- ratnaśvetajakāntibṛndanivahaistatsphītavātotthitaiḥ | sūkṣmairambarakāntibhirvikasitaissacchailasānuprabhai- rambāmīkṣati lokayeti sasudhākallolavārānnidhiḥ || 15 ||
īśvaraḥ– maṇidvīpanīpānprapaśyāmbike tvaṃ tavāpāramodapradā sā ca bhūmiḥ | sudhāsindhukallolaśītātivāto mahānandakandaṃ vidhatte maheśi || 16 || harinmaṇinibhe'drije tava śarīrakāntyādhikaṃ samastakaladhautajo'pyagavaro'yamapyunnataḥ | vibhāti haritaprabhassamṛgapakṣivallīdrumaḥ prapaśya mukure'mbike tava sarūpabhāgyādhikaḥ || 17 || manmaulisthitacandrakāntinikaraiḥ kāntyā svayā śailarāṭ svāmyāpāraśikhābhinṛttaśikhibhiḥ puṃskokilānāṃ ravaiḥ | sāraṃgai rurukairbakaiścamaribhiḥ prodbhūtapucchaissadā khaḍgānāṃ nivahairlulāyajakulaiḥ proḍḍīnadeṇīkulaiḥ || 18 || haritamaṇitṛṇāgraṃ sañcarantaścaranti kanakamayamṛgāste muktabindūcitāṅgāḥ | rajatanibhakapotā ratnapādāḥ kaṇāśāssvakagalaraṇitaiste svapriyāpṛṣṭhalagnāḥ || 19 || haṃsānāṃca kulaṃ svavaktrajamahāmuktāphalaiḥ pakṣati- vyādhūnāttadigantakāntibahulāste svacchadehāmalāḥ | krīḍanti prasabhaṃ prabhūtapayasi protphullaraktābjinī- madhyasthā iva cakravākajakulaṃ maunaṃ vidhatte śive || 20 || sukhayati mṛduvāto'pyatra bhītyā mamādya mṛgamadasumasaṃsthairgandhamādyatparāgaiḥ ||
pṛ0 80) kastūrīmṛgakā api drutataraṃ dhāvanti gandhāśayā- ssvasyāṅgasthitamapyume nahi tarāṃ jānanti mūḍhā iva | deheṣu sthitamapyume munisurā jānanti no māṃ yathā tadvatte'pi mṛgā vimūḍhamatayaḥ kailāsaśaile mama || 22 || mṛdutaraketakadhūlīpālīpiñjaritaśailavarasānuḥ | konususvanna bhajetāpyatrasthā diviṣado hasaṃtyeva || 23 || harinmaṇinibhāśśukā vadanaratnagomedakā- ssuratnamaṇikalpitāḥ kanakahīranīlaprabhāḥ | vadanti nagamauligāśśiva śiva prabho pāhinaḥ prakṛṣṭadayayā dṛśā pramathanātha kaṣṭaṃ hara || 24 || suśārikasukokilā hara hareśa viśveśvarā- pyanāthajanavatsala purahara prapaśyādyanaḥ | iti dhvanikṛtassadā śikhariśīrṣajahnūdgatā- ssuratnamaṇisannibhāstaralakāntaraktākṣakāḥ || 25 || paśyādrije kisalayaṃ surasālajātaṃ puṃskokilāpalapanena tudanti bhuktau | kīrānane paripatantyalayaḥ prakāmaṃ jambūphalabhramajitaśśuka eṣa mūḍhaḥ || 26 || palāśakalikābhramanmadhuparāgasaukhyādasau yathāviṣayiṇo'mbike sukṛtatarṣaduḥkhākulāḥ || 27 || vṛkṣālambitaśṛṅkhalāsucalite vaiḍūryamañce śiva- stadvatpuṣpakakāntirāgavilasanmañcasthitā sāmbikā | ḍolāḍolanakairvane viharatassvairaṃ śivau sundarau devībhiḥ kalitaissucāmaragaṇaissevyau ca vṛttau tadā || 28 || śrīcandanaprabhavasāraviliptagātrau cikrīḍaturnagasumoddhṛtavāyugandhaiḥ | nakhamukhavighaṭitadāḍimīphalodyanmaṇinibhabījavaraṃ dadāti devī || 29 || svakarāmbujasaṃsthakīravaktracchadanaṃ vīkṣya maheśitussahāsam |
pṛ0 81) kīro'pi śaṃkaramukhābjamavekṣya devīṃ natvā girā samabhiyācata bālavācā || 30 || dehīśa śaṃkara vibho śaśikhaṇḍacūḍa mādyadrasālakadalīphalasārabhaṃgam | ājñāpayeti tava nāma vadāmi śambho viśveśa cāttumiti tasya girā sahāsaḥ || indranīlamaṇikalpitasaudhe mañcasaṃsrutaśaśidyutikānte | talpake'dhiśayitasya purāreḥ pādapaṃkajayugaṃ svakarābjaiḥ || 32 || raṅgamaṇḍalagatā muhurambā vīṇayā vadati śaṃkaranāma || ratnotthāmalasaudhabhūmiṣu puro devasya devyāḥ puro rudrāṇyo navayauvanāvṛtakucāḥ krīḍanti hallīsakaiḥ | mallīgucchakacānatānanakarāḥ prodyajjhaṇannūpurāḥ kailāsācalamauligāssumadhuraṃ gāyanti nṛtyanti ca || 33 || viśveśa viśvādhika dīnabandho pāhīśa śambhodayayārdradṛṣṭyā | pāhi prasīda madamattamarālarājamātaṃgajaitragamane jagatāṃ janitri || 34 || āsaptalokāvadhi śailamaulau svaśekharāpāratviṣā tiraskṛtau | tatrastha eva praṇamanti devāstau candrasūryau gativarjitau bhayāt || 35 || maheśvarāpāradayāvidhānaṃ sudhābdhikallolitapādapīṭham | samullikhantaṃ śikharairapārairlokāstvaho taṃ kaladhautaśailam || 36 || śośubhyeta sadaiva tatra nadivā rātrirmaheśāśrayā- nnogandharvamarudgaṇā munigaṇā no brahmaviṣṇū surāḥ || 37 || no vāti vāyuḥ prasabhaṃ hi tatra tigmāṃśuśītāṃśurubhau hi vibhyataḥ | agnirnadṛṣṭassvaśikhāvalīḍhaṃ kakṣeṣu tatkīcakaveṇusaṅghe || 38 || eko rudra iti śrutistaditaro nāstyeva tatrāgame devyā dattakarassadaiva paśupastatraiva sañcāryasau | paśyanliṅgakadambakaṃ girivaraṃ phulladrumāṇāṃ gaṇaṃ tatrāpārasugopurāṅkaṇagatassvairaṃ sadā śaṅkaraḥ || 39 ||
pṛ0 82) tatprākāravaraikarakṣaṇacaṇāssantyeva koṭyo gaṇā rudrāṇyaśca caranti tasya savidhaṃ nānye gaṇā vā surāḥ | vāto'pi na pracalati dyumaṇeḥ karā vā somasya sundarakarāḥ prabhavanti naiva || 40 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsamaulivarṇanannāma aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 ||
kailāsavarṇanannāma ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– tadantarāsti prākāro vaiḍūryamaṇikalpitaḥ | rājallalāmavṛṣabhairvaiḍūryamaṇikalpitaiḥ || 1 || tatsūtrasaṃkramākrāntikāñcitākhilaparvataḥ | niṣṭaptarajatodbhāsvattatkāntyā pītavatsthitaḥ || 2 || tatra puṣpavanandivyannānāratnagaṇānvitam | nīlagomedahīraiśca puṣparāgaiḥ pravālakaiḥ || 3 || kuruvindairmarakatairmuktābhirabhiśobhitaiḥ | nīlotpalāmalajalaṃ kāsāramabhitassthitam || 4 || pravālaisstavakaiścaiva kalikotphullapuṣpakaiḥ | tattadratnaiśca saṃkḷptairindracāpanibhaprabhaiḥ || 5 || vitatācchamaṇibhrājacchāṇollīḍhakaraprabhaiḥ | dyobhūmisarvalokeṣu tādṛśaṃ na vanaṃ kvacit || 6 || saundaryasārasarvasvaṃ ramyaṃ mañjulamārutam | suvarṇacampakotphulladhūlikodyatsamīraṇam || 7 || tadvātasparśanenāpi brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | kṛtakṛtyā bhavantyeva tadā dhanyatarāssurāḥ || 8 || harinmaṇinibhākāraiḥ kekyālambitatatsumaiḥ | praphullatatsumāmodadhūlīkelisugandhidhṛk || 9 || pāṭalāmodabahalamindīvaragaṇāvṛtam | bhramatsāraṅgasaṃlūnanavaśāḍvalasundaram || 10 || śaṣpāvṛteva bhūrbhāti mahāmarakatopalaiḥ | svacchandacamarīpucchavījanodgītaṣaṭpadaiḥ || 11 || karṇikāraissvarṇavarṇairnabho bhāti hiraṇmayam | śubhrābhracayasaṃkāśakāśamandārasaṃyutam || 12 || raktācchamaṇimandāraphullakorakakaiśśubhaiḥ | tadgandhabandhurāmodaśītabandhuramārutam || 13 || tamālasālajoddāmaghargharārāvabhīṣaṇam | āragvathasumālotthaphullamañjariśobhitam || 14 || śukatuṇḍaprabhāsvacchapalāśairgucchasundaraiḥ | phullapunnāgajaiścaiva sumaistatkorakairapi || 15 || nabho vikīrṇatārābhaṃ bhāti muktā ivādhikam | devadārusumaiḥ phullaiḥ kadambālambigucchakaiḥ || 16 ||
pṛ0 83) śephāligucchairātāmraiḥ kubjāmranibiḍachadaiḥ | kuravāmodavakulamañjarībhirmanoharam || 17 || udyadindukarasvacchagucchairallakasallakaiḥ | bhallabhallātakoddāmapāribhadrodbhavaissumaiḥ || 18 || tamālapippalīgucchasumāmoditamārutam | ugragandhāyitadiśāsamūhairmadhukodbhavaiḥ || 19 || patatsumaiśca bhūrbhāti tārā iva nabhaścyutāḥ | puṇyakṣayādivottuṅgā yathā sukṛtino'phalāḥ || 20 || phanasoddāmamūlastha phalabhārāvanāmitam | suvarṇakantukrākāravilasallikucairapi || 21 || saurabhāmodapakvodyacchalāṭukulakairapi | uttuṅgamātuliṃgaiśca sthūlanimnoruśākhakaiḥ || 22 || rasagarbharasālaiśca kamrakāmrajajaiḥ phalaiḥ | mahānīlamaṇiprakhyairjambukārañjakairvṛtam || 23 || ānamradāḍimotphullasumaissphuṭitatatphalaiḥ | aṃkolakaiśśirīṣaiścāpyarjunabhrājigucchakaiḥ || 24 || pakvabilvaphalāmodatatsumodbuddhagandhitam | patatkapitthanivahaistathaivāmalakādibhiḥ || 25 || nāraṅgarañjitottuṃgaśākhiśākhābhiranvitam | vādāmākrūrakharjūratatphalānamraśākhakam || 26 || jātīphalarasāsvādamādyatkapikulākulam | ramyatālīvanodbhūtagandhānanditamārutam || 27 || haridratnanibhātyacchasupītakadalīdalaiḥ | ramyasaptachadopetaṃ nārīlaphalagucchakaiḥ || 28 || sitāsitaphalānamra mārutoddhūtamaulibhiḥ | udyaddyumaṇigarbhābhapūgīphalabharairdrumaiḥ || 29 || stabakānatisamphullarājatkuṭajapaṃktibhiḥ | kuṭajairvaṭajaiścaiva kūṭāgāramiva sthitam || 30 || vibhrājaddhavalātyaccha bālārkasumakesaram | nīpānokahajātyuccairaśokaiśśokanāśakaiḥ || 31 || prabhātabuddhasadbodhidrumachadaravāṇḍajaiḥ | vakulairdhavakelaiśca kesarāmodasundaraiḥ || 32 || takkolāṃkolakaiśśubhraissugandhabadarīdhavaiḥ | sugandhabaddhajambūkasugandhāmodimārutam || 33 || kandarpavarṣmasaṃkāśakāśmīradrumakesaraiḥ | tagarāmodabahalaṃ kṛṣṇāgarunagairyutam || 34 || lodhravadhrajabheruṇḍakāṇḍatāṇḍavagucchakam | vaṭantapasyantamiva saṭājālāñcitaṃ sthitam || 35 || khadirairbadaraiścaiva prabālā iva tatphalaiḥ | kovidāramahāśākhāvidāritanabhoghaṭam || 36 || bhallāliṃgitasanmallīsumabandhuramārutam | veṇusaṅgharṣaṇaravavīṇānādopamaṃ vane || 37 || sallakīsallayairyuktaṃ mallīvallīkṛtāṃgakam | hṛllīsallāsyaṃkurvadbhiśśākhābhiḥ phullabhallakam || 38 || gandhagandhitadidivacakraṃ vakrāṃgaṃ śākhisundaram | vaikaṃkataṃ vikarṣantaṃnabhomaṇḍalagān grahān || 39 || uḍupoḍugaṇākāraphulladgalitatatsumam | nalvamātramahāśākhaṃ tadratnavipinaṃ mahat || 40 || candanairnayanānandisumagandhisumārutam | āndolitamahāśākhalambitādhomukhasrajam || 41 ||
pṛ0 84) gucchaguñjadalivrātaṃ rasadāndolisundaram | navavāṭīparivṛtaṃ ratnakāntijharībharam || 42 || tatrāccharatnasphaṭikarājajjalataraṃgakam | vanasaurabhaśītācchaśīkarāsāramārutam || 43 || gandhagandhitapadmottharajaḥpaṭalasundaram | nīlanālīkasubhagaṃ sarastatra virājate || 44 || ratnasopānasambaddhaṃ caladāraktahallakam | tanmadhyasaudhaśṛṃgāgrakalaśojvaladīptimat || 45 || vidrumāmalabimbodyatkanakāntataraṃgakam | sahasrastambhavitataṃ pīṭhagopānasīyutam || 46 || rājatpravālavṛṣabhaṃ dodhūyitapatākakam | tatrojvalanmahāratnavedikāsamalaṃkṛtam || 47 || indukāntitiraskārihīradhārāsamāvṛte | sihmāsanavare devyā sahāste vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 48 || jighraṃstadvanasaṃphullasumagandhaṃ manoharam | marālakulasañcāraṃ sārasānāṃ ravaṃ haraḥ || 49 || devyāḥ paśyanmukhāmbhojaṃ kālaṃ nayati śaṃkaraḥ | tatraiva rudrakoṭyo'pi śūlāmalalasatkarāḥ || 50 || prākāraṃ parirakṣanti bahistatrāntare tu na | tatprākāraṃ tadvanañca nalinīntāñca sundarām || 51 || te rudrā devadevasya candracūḍasya śāsanāt || 52 ||
īśvaraḥ– girīndraśikharasrutairharitapītanīlāruṇai- ssravajjharibharībharairnikhilarītinirvāsitaiḥ | sravatkaraṭikumbhavatpaṭumadaprabho'yaṃ giri- stamālatilakairdhavaistilakito girirgairikaiḥ || 53 | nagendravaracāraṇaiḥ pratikṛtaiśca sadvāraṇai- rmaheṃgudamanoharajvalitatejavallīgaṇaiḥ | vibhāti mama śailarāḍgirivarāṃgakanye bhaja || 54 || tadbilvamūlaparikalpitaratnavedimadhyasya ratnakamalāmalakarṇikāyām | dṛṣṭvā girīndratanayāñcitabāhurīśaścandropalākalitaliṃgavareṣu devyā || 55 || samarcayati dūrvayā harimaṇiprabhābhātika- prakṛṣṭatarakāntayā dyumaṇibālakāntiprabhau | navāruṇasu bilvajaiśchadavarairmuhuśśaṃkaraḥ phalaiśca rasagarbhitairvimalajambunāraṃgakaiḥ || 56 ||
pṛ0 85) sudāḍimavarodbhavairvidalitaprabhābhāsuraiḥ kapitthakadalīphalai rasarasālapakvaiḥ phalaiḥ | nivedya girijākare dadhati raktakañjādhike || 57 || śaraṇyo deveśaḥ prathitamahimā vedaśikharai- natānāmudbodhe prakaṭavaruṇo vāraṇaśirāḥ | pracaṇḍoccaṇḍāṇḍasphuṭanavidhijoddaṇḍakuharo haroccaṇḍākhaṇḍapramadamuditastāṇḍavavaraḥ || 58 || mukundabrahmendrairamaratilakaissevitapado gaṇaiścaṇḍīśādyaissuravaratuhaṇḍādigaṇapaiḥ || 59 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsāvarṇanannāma ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 ||
pṛ0 85) śivagaurīsaṃvāde kṣetravarṇanannāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– tatrāntare'pi prākāro lakṣayojanavistaraḥ | hīrasāramahādhārātiraskṛtaśaśidyutiḥ || 1 || kailāsācalakāntyā ca taddhīraprabhayāpi ca | sudhāmbudhimahāvīcībimbitendukarairapi || 2 || maheśamukuṭoddāmacandrāsphārakalādibhiḥ | bhābhāsitadiśāstomastatprākārāgraśṛṃgakaiḥ || 3 || candrasūryagrahāstārāvidyuto'pyanalo dvijāḥ | tiraskṛtāstatprabhābhistadgopuravarāgragāḥ || 4 || mahīhīrakasaṃkḷptā nīlanetrā viṣāṇinaḥ | tadagragopuraṃ śubhraṃ pañcalakṣapramāṇakam || 5 || āsaptapātālatalādutthitaṃ hīrakalpitam | kapotavyālipālībhirdevasaṅghavirājitam || 6 || rudrāvatārakrīḍābhiḥ kalaśairvṛṣabhairapi | tasminnūrddhvatale devyā divyasihmāsanāśrayaḥ || 7 || kailāsaśailavaragopurahīrasaudhe divyairanekamaṇikalpitaviṣṭarasthaḥ | devyaivadatpaśupatissumahaccakālaṃ devādilokamakhilaṃ kathayatyumāyai || 8 ||
īśvaraḥ– kailāsaśailaśikharasthitadivyaliṃgasaṅkhyā harīndravidhibhistvahināyakena |
pṛ0 86) gaṇyanteva divi tārakapāṃsujālaṃ dhārāpi varṣajanitāśśṛṇu śailakanye || 9 || liṃgānāṃ kulametadeva girije mandāramālārcitaṃ vilvīkomalapallavairabhinavairdūrvāṅkuraiśśaṃkari | kāle puṇyatame pradoṣasamaye vītāghasaṅghe śive kāryaṃ sarvasurāsurairapimayā ratnaprabhādīpitam || 10 || kailāsācalalaliṅgamaṇḍalamidaṃ bhāsvajjaṭāmaṇḍalaṃ gaṃgātuṃgataraṃgaśaṃkitamahākākodarākalpakam | mandāradrumapuṣpasañcayamahābilvādimallīsumai- ratnāgārasukumbhamadhyavilasanmadhye sthitaṃ paśya vai || 11 || bilvānāṃ mūlabhāge vilasati maṇibhiścandanaiśśītaśītaiḥ karpūraiśca sugandhite harigaṇairāmodajighrāsubhiḥ | nityaṃ veṣṭitamaulibhāgamamalaistacchītavātāśanai- ssevyo'haṃ karuṇāpayonidhirume loke svaliṃgoccayam || 12 || svīyairmauliśaśāṃkadīdhiticayairgāṃgairivāmbhobharaiḥ kūjatkokilasadvijairiva mahārudrādisanmantritaiḥ | sarvāṃgeṣvabhiṣiktamaiśvaramahāliṃgañcatatpatrakai- rvātaireva vilūnavṛttapatitaissaṃpūjitaṃ paśya me || 13 || eṣāmagrabhuvi pracaṇḍajarayā proccaṇḍapiñchotthitai- rvātaireva śikhaṇḍimaṇḍalamidaṃ proccaṇḍasattāṇḍavam | kekālāpamanoharañca vipine sannartakīnāṃ daśāṃ prāpyaivodgāyatīva prathitabahurasaṃ puṇyasaṅghaiḥ kiledam || 14 || asminvilvavane navāruṇadalākrāntoruśākhānvite pracchāye camarīgaṇāḥ patanatobhītyaiva mūlaṃ gatāḥ | tatratyeṣu patatpatatranicayotsaṃgākulatpatrakaiḥ puchaiścāmarapaṃktivacchakalitairvījanti liṃgānyume || 15 ||
pṛ0 87) santuṣṭā bhava śailanandini śive nātaḥ paraṃ vidyate malliṃgārcanamevasādhanaparaṃ muktipradaṃ śāśvatam | kiṃ yajñairakhilavratādicaraṇaiḥ kiṃ dānasaṅghairjapai- retatkiṃ vitanoti muktiriti yā sādhīrhi duḥkhātmanām || 16 || udyadbāladivākarendusadṛśaiḥ kailāsaśṛṃgāgragai- rmāṇikyāmalahīrakaiśca kalitaissaudhāgraśṛṃgaiśśive | tattallokanivāsibhissuragaṇaissañjātavismāpakai- rnānāsūryaśaśāṃkasambhavamahākāntyādhikaṃ śobhate || 17 || kailāsācalasānupādaśikhare satyādhike merugā lokālokina eva tatra vihitā dikpālasaṅghāśśive | brahmāviṣṇumaheśvarāmaravarāssaptarṣayo'mīgrahā- ścauttānātmaja eṣa bhānti nitarāṃ tārāgaṇā rāśayaḥ || 18 || te meruṃ parito bhramanti girije paśyādhunā santataṃ tattadgopuramadhyabhāgavilasattauryatrikāṇāṃ svanaiḥ | tattatkālaśivārcaneṣu kalitairbherījaśaṅkhāravaiḥ kailāso'pyayamīśvareśvari mahāsannādanādāntaraḥ || 19 || meghānāṃ śatakairapi pramudito ghoṣaikabhūṣāmukhaḥ || vasudhādharakandarāntarasthā radakhaṇḍadviradāḥ kiśorasihmāḥ | svakakādharakesarairnagendraiḥ parinindanti vidīptamityume'dya || 20 || raviratha turagotthahreṣaghoṣaṃ pariśṛṇvanti ime hayārisaṅghāḥ | vinatānanakarṇaśṛṃganetrāstaṭidutthākhilaghasmaraikarāvāḥ || 21 || kharakhuraparighaṭṭanotthadhūlyājaladanibhaṃ ravimambike'dyapaśya | ravirapi svatanūjamukhyavāhairgirisaṃsthairabhijātalajjayeva || 22 || prasabhaṃ meghagaṇaṃ viśīrya hastairvijito'smīti diśaṃ prayāti yāmīm | madālayo'yaṃ kaladhautaśailastadagrato bhāti suvarṇaśailaḥ || 23 ||
pṛ0 88) tadūrdhvamaulisthitalokajālaṃ vilokayādho vihitannagasya me || 24 || brahmāpyeṣa sṛjatyajasramakhilaṃ lokaṃ hariḥ pātyayaṃ rudrassaṃharate'niśaṃ suravarairdikpālasaṅghaiśśive | satyasthovidhireṣa viṣṇubhavanaṃ vaikuṇṭhamālokayā- pīśānasya purīyamadrivaraje cendrasya caiṣā purī || 25 || eṣā saṃyaminī purī suvihitā kṣīrodadheḥ pārato gaṃgaiṣā saritāṃ varā trijagatāṃ pāpāpahā me purī | liṃgālaṅkṛtakoṭikārbudanibhā vārāṇasījyā śive viśveśākhyamaheśaliṃgavaragaṃ devyannapūrṇyā tvayā || 26 || surāsurā yatra vasanti muktaye vasantyaniṣṭaṃ parihāya matsaram | yato na muktaṃ hi mayāvimuktaṃ vadanti vedā api tatprabhāvam || 27 || gaṃgādvāramidaṃ pitustava mahāmaulau ca kedārakaṃ caiṣā sā batapāṭalīnagaragāyasyāssutā mānasāḥ | gaṃgāsūryatanūjayośca vihitassaṃgo'tra muktyai nṛṇāṃ snātānāṃñca sadā saritpativareṇāliṃgitā jāhnavī || 28 || gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgamo'tra girije someśvaro'yaṃ sadā sevyānāṃ saphalaṃ karoti ca manassantāpapāpāpaham || 29 || eṣaprayāgassakalāpagāśrayo gaṃgāpi yatrāmbujamitrajāyutā | tatrāplutānāṃ divi devi vāso visarjitāṃgā yadi teṣu muktiḥ || 30 || sā brahmaṇo vediranantapuṇyadā gayā pitṝṇāṃ pramude bhavāni | paśyādya tatraiva padaṃ madīyaṃ suradvijānāntu tathaiva vaiṣṇavam || 31 || tannaimiṣaṃ puṇyatamaṃ maharṣibhissamākulāṃ tāṃ badarīṃ vilokaya | sacitrakūṭassurasaṅghasamvṛtassaptaiva puryo'tra vimuktihetavaḥ || 32 || etadvādaśaliṃgasaṅghamagaje tattatpurīṣu sthitaṃ coṅkāro ghusṛṇeśvaro'yamagaje śrīkāmanātho'mbike |
pṛ0 89) asau mahākālavaro maheśo nāgeśvaro veṇuvanaikasaṃśrayaḥ || 33 || eṣā śarmadanarmadātrakalitā liṃgaikasaṅghāvṛtā śoṇo'yaṃ saritāṃ patiṃ pravahate liṃgaikasaṅghāśrayaḥ | puṇyā bāhunadī supuṣkaramidaṃ puṇyaṃ prabhāsaṃ tvidaṃ malliṃgāmalapātakaṃ girivarājjāte'maraṃ kaṇṭakam || 34 || śrīrudro'marakoṭireṣa vihitaḥ piṇḍārakaṃ matpriya- ñcaitatkṣetravaraṃ kuruprabhavajaṃ vindhyo hyayaṃ śailaje | eṣa śrīśailamaulirbhavajanitamahāpāpasaṅghaikahantā- caiṣātryambakaśailajā [bhagavati janatā iti pāṭhāntaram |] suvihitā godāvarī nimnagā || 35 || kṛṣṇā cāpi saridvarābdhiniratā liṃgāvṛtā puṇyadā || 36 || tatprāntasaṃstho ghaṭajo munīśo mayā purā preṣita eva vindhyahṛt | paścādathāmbhonidhitīrasaṃgataṃ gokarṇametanmama liṃgamambike || 37 || arundhadeṣo'maramārgamambike prajātaroṣaḥ kanakācalena | vindhyo'pyayaṃ śailavarastvadāśrayātpuṇyaṃ pratiṣṭhānapuraṃ supuṇyadam || 38 || kolāsureṇātra samīhitā purī tapasyatā tasya vadhāttvayā jitā | eṣo'ruṇādriḥ prathitaprabhāvo vṛddhādrirapyeva mameṣṭavāsaḥ || 39 || goparvataścātra vibhāti śailaḥ kāñcī jagatkāñcitaliṃgasaṃyutā | tvadāśrayātkāntatamā ca saiva tvadarcanārthaṃ hariṇā ca sevitā || 40 || śeṣācalastveṣa sutāśrayo mama taduttare bhāti maheśi paśya | kailāsa eṣo'bhimato hi dakṣiṇassahyācalo hyeṣa yato marudvṛdhā || 41 || sahyāpagātīragaliṃgamaṇḍalaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ kila śailakanye | kaverakanyātaṭaliṃgasaṅghaṃ śrīkaṇṭharatnādrikamātṛbhūtam || 42 || tajjambuliṃgañca haristato'pi pañcāpageśākhyamaho bhavāni | kumbheśvaraṃ liṃgamidaṃ manojñaṃ tadarjunañcāpi mayūraliṃgam || 43 ||
pṛ0 90) śveteśvaraṃ tatprathitaṃ vimuktidaṃ taduttare yadvirajaṃ viśokam | hṛtpuṇḍarīkaṃ vimalaṃ mamāśrayaṃ yatraiva me nartanamambike tvayā || 44 || sadaiva dṛṣṭaṃ prathite kṣārāmbudhestīragataṃ supuṇyadam | vedākhyasatkānanamabjasaṃjñaṃ liṃgāvṛtaṃ tatkamalālayākhyam || 45 || śrīsundaraṃ viṣṇupurañca devi tato'pi tadvīpagagandhamādane | nagottame liṃgavaraṃ mamāmbike || 46 || hariḥ purā bhārgavajena śapto bhāryāviyukto'pyahanatsarāvaṇam | tenaiva tatpūjitamambike'dya paśyādhunā setuvaraṃ supuṇyam || 47 || tatpaścime puṇyatamaṃ mamāmbike hālāsyasaṃjñaṃ varaveṇusaṃjñam | tatraiva tāmrācalasaṃgato'bdhistattīrasaṃsthānyapi devi paśya || 48 || liṃgāni tuṃgāni manoharāṇi mahendraśailo malayaśca śailaḥ | etāni te kṣetravarāṇi devi dṛṣṭāni ca śrotravaraiśśrutāni || 49 || pāpādrimaulerbhidurāṇi paśya kṣetrekṣaṇenāpi vimuktapāpāḥ || 50 || kṣetrāṇāñca patissadaiva kathito vedeṣu paśyādarā- dārātsarvajagadgato'pi viduṣāṃ duṣṭātmanāṃ śaijale | kaṣṭānyapyasamīkṣya yo'tra vihitaḥ kṣetreṣu vā sādara- stasmai tāṃ vitarāmi muktimagaje rudrākṣabhasmādare || 51 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe śivagaurīsaṃvāde kṣetravarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 ||
śivagaurīsaṃvāde prāṇigatinirūpaṇe ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
devyuvāca–
ke gacchanti mahādeva hye te devagaṇāśśiva | bhitvaiva maṇḍalaṃ bhānoḥ ka ete puruṣottamāḥ || somadhāma praviṣṭāḥ ke nivṛttāśca tataḥ punaḥ | dhūmalekhānibhāste ke kāstriyastā varānanāḥ || ke te gacchanti muditā vimānairarkasannibhaiḥ | tāḍyamānāḥ kaśāghātairmudgarairāyasairnarāḥ ||
pṛ0 91) striyo bālāśca puruṣairvikṛtāṃgaiḥ prahāriṇaḥ | pāśabaddhā vikarṣadbhiryānti ke dakṣiṇāṃ diśam || tadvadādya mahādeva jagaccakrapravartaka | sṛṣṭisthityantakāryāṇāṃ pravartaka nivartaka || 5 ||
skandaḥ– itthaṃ devyā tadā pṛṣṭo mahādevo maheśvaraḥ | jagāda girijāṃ tatra tasminkailāsasaudhake || sampaśyandevayānāni pitṛyānāni śaṅkaraḥ || 7 ||
īśvaraḥ– paśyonnidrasuraktapaṃkajalasadvaktre sunīlotpala- bhrājatphullavilocane hi yatayaścodyadravermaṇḍalam | bhitvā yānti samullasatsarasijaprodbhūtalokaṃ śive vedāntārthavicārasārahṛdayāśśrutvā gurorvaktrataḥ || 8 || tatvaṃśabdamasītyapīhaca mahāvākyārthatātparyata- śśabdabrahmaparāśca ye yadivarā gacchanti te brahmaṇā | muktā naiva nivartakā hi girije tanbrahmalokādume ye vai tvantimakālaśabdata iti mantreṇa karmandinaḥ || 9 || te vai sūryagatiṃ gatā api śive tenāturāḥ kṣīṇato vidyutpuñjasamāḥ patanti ca tato brāhmaṇyamāsādya te | kṛtvā cāśramamantimaṃ punarume vedāntaniṣṭhā guro- rvaktrābjacyutavākyato dvijāvarā nālīkajātāsano lokaṃprāpya vimuktaye ca satataṃ te cāpyupāsantyapi || 10 || ete cāgamasaṃgatāśca hi sadā yajvānamityāhutiṃ vaitāneṣu hutāhutībhiradhunā nītāśca te pūjitāḥ | vidyutpuñjasamaprabhābhirabhito hyehīti ca prārthitā- ścandrāsārakaraissadaiva nitarāṃ yāntyeva taddhāmataḥ || 11 || nityāgnihotravidhipūrṇamasādidarśacāndrāyaṇaiśca paśubhissucaturmasejyaiḥ | sautrāmaṇībhiratha ceṣṭisamūhajātaissomaistathaiva kaṭhakāgnicito dvijāgryāḥ ||
pṛ0 92) ekāhāhīnasatrairyajati ca satataṃ cāgnicetā dvijoyo yajvā cāruṇaketuto'pi nagaje yātyeva candrāṃśu tat || 13 || kiṃpākayajñagatibhissmṛtijātadharmaiḥ pāko bhavatyatitarāṃ sukṛtaiśca pākaiḥ | kiṃpākasevitajalena kimatra sāraḥ kiṃpāka eva phalato bhavatīti manye || ye rājasūyanarasarvagavāśvamedhairmedhādhipañca sakalādhipamādriyānāḥ | ye saptahotṛvidhiyājanato bhavāni sūryātivāhikagatiṃ sukṛtaiḥ prayānti || iṣṭāpūrtaṃ dharmityeva yo vai matpādābjadhyānapūjāvihīnaḥ | abhraṃ dhūmo rātrimāsārdhamāsairyāntyevānte dhāma somasya gauri || 16 || tapaśśraddhāyogairvividhabhavavarṇāśramaratā- stato naiṣkarmyeṇa prathitaguruvedāntaniratāḥ | tathaivāhnomāsāḥ puruṣamathavāmānavamume gatiṃ yāntassaurīṃ mama vividhapūjaiva hi narāḥ || 17 || candrādabhraṃ dhūmajālañca vāyuṃ vidyudvarṣaṃ coṣadhīnāṃ gaṇeṣu | jātāścānnaṃ pūruṣo yo'dyate yadreto bhūtvā straiṇagarbhe patanti || 18 || ye vai pāpāśśvātha caṇḍālasarpā bhūdārāṇāṃ yānti yonau tiraścām | ye vai puṇyā viprabāhūrujātāśśūdrāḥ puṇyāpuṇyagarbheṣu devi || 19 || iṣṭāpūrtavimohitā bahutarā anyārcanadhyānino nānyacchreya itīva mānasarasā bālāḥ punarmanyate | plavāścaite adṛḍhāssarvadharmā yajñāścaite tartumambe bhavābdhim || 20 || dīkṣābhistapasā vrataiśca niyamaiḥ kṛchraiśca dānaistathā yogairvā śrutipāṭhanaiśca paṭhanairiṣṭaiśca pūrtaiśśive | vedāntārthavicārananditamahākarmaṃdivaryaśśive varṇī cāpi gṛhī vanī ca satataṃ tatproktadharmādaraḥ || 21 || yatprāpnoti phalaṃ ca lokamakhilaṃ bhūyastato'pyuttamaṃ kailāsaṃ samavāpya matpadamahādhyāyena samprāpyate || 22 ||
pṛ0 93) makhamukhasukhasomajātadhārāṃ śikhiśikhavitatāṃ tathājyadhārām | lakhalakhitamukhāstathendralekhākhagapativāhayutākhuvāhayuktāḥ || 23 || śikhivāhāgrasarā vimānayuktāḥ paripītvā haribhirvimānavaryaiḥ | abhiyāntyadya vilokayāmbanākaṃ paripaśyāmalapaṅkajāsyanetre || 24 || surasaṅghairmuditaprapītasomā viharanti svagaṇaiśca nandanotthaiḥ | sumajālaiśca sucandanārdragātrā viharanti sma vimānavaryasaṃsthāḥ || 25 || ete yajvana eva kevalamume karmaikaniṣṭhāśśive santyaktānyavidhipradānitamahādānaikaniṣṭhāḥ pare | te vai candramasraṃ prayānti nagaje dhūmādimārgeṇa vai yātāyātadakarmajātamakhilaṃ [pātheyātmaka iti pāṭhāntaram |] bhuktvā patantyaṃtataḥ || 26 || rambhārambhopamorudvayagatasubhage bhekapṛṣṭhābhake te kumbhodyatkumbhikumbhopamaghanajaghanenāvṛtā nandaneṣu | tambimbopamasundarādhararasaṃ pītvātipīnāṅgakā- stadvakṣojavihārasārahṛdayāḥ paśyāmbike yajvanaḥ || 27 || etadyauvatamaṇḍalaṃ kacabharāsaṃsasaktasatketakaṃ bhartrāliṅganapānapīnamanasaṃ divyāṅgarāgāṃśukam | nānāratnavikāsitākhiladiśāṃ stomaprabhābhāsuraṃ yānairyāti sadā mudā pitṛvane bhartrāgnidagdhaṃ hi tat || 28 || gacchanti paśya muditāssuracāmaraughai- ssaṃvījitāssurasaśakrasado vimānaiḥ | gobhūmivastrānnasuvarṇakupyaraupyapradā dhānyamahīsuratnadāḥ || 29 || viprāgrahāravanaropaṇavāpikābhiḥ pānthān kharograkiraṇaiśśramabhārakhinnān | khinnānanāṅgān sukhaśītavātaiḥ kanyānnapānādisupādasevanaiḥ || 30 || viśrāmayanti kṣaṇamambike ye śālāsu te yānti śive'dya paśya || 31 ||
pṛ0 94) ete vīrabhaṭāssuśastranivahairbāṇairabhidyoditai- rdhārāsāraśareṣu ye sumukhataḥ prāṇāṃstyajanti priyān | te'mī maṇḍalamāśu saprabhamume tejomaṇerantarā yāntyevādbhutavikramārjitayaśassphītākhilāśātaṭāḥ || 32 || hīrākārasutārakākṛtisukhaṃ bhuktvendralokaṃ gatā bhraśyanti kramaśo'mareśvari punarnīre taṭe coṣadhau | paśyaitāntsudati prakṛṣṭavibhavopānte punargarbhagā- nevaṃ śīghrataraṃ taranti sukṛtairiṣṭaiśca pūrtairapi || 33 || yamabhaṭakṛtapāśabaddhahastā musalavidāritaraktagandhamastāḥ | sarabhasamupayānti cārtarāvairyamabhavanaṃ paripaśya pāpijālam || 34 || te vai kālamukhe dayārasahate santaptabhrāṣṭrasthitāḥ kumbhīpākamukhe śive kṛmiyutāpāre malānāṃ hrade | kṣārāpārasukardame vraṇakiṇairgātraistu sanmakṣibhiḥ kākairvṛścikadantaśūkanivahaiḥ khidyanti paśyāmbike || 35 || ete nārakiṇassadodararatā dāraiḥ parairmaithunā nānāpātakasaṃyutā gurujane śaive ca sandūṣakāḥ | stenāḥ pānthaharāḥ parānnaniratā durdyūtaduṣṭālayāḥ pāṣaṇḍā bhujayormahāyasavaraistaptaiśca cakrairyutāḥ || 36 || yeṣāṃ phālatalaṃ tripuṇṭrarahitaṃ ye rudrajāpyojjhitā ye liṅgārcanasādhanādivimukhā ye śambhunāmnojjhitāḥ | ye rudrākṣavidhāraṇe ca vimukhāḥ pañcākṣareṇojjhitā ye matkṣetranivāsahīnamanaso bhakteṣu sandūṣakāḥ || 37 || māṃ viśvādhikamīśvaraṃ trijagatāmādhārabhūtaṃ śivaṃ viṣṇubrahmamarudgaṇaissamamume paśyanti tānpaśya vai | ye vai pradoṣaparipūjanato vihīnā ye vā narā mama niveditabhuktivarjyāḥ ||
pṛ0 95) te'mīkālabhayaṃ prayānti narake duḥkhākulāḥ pātakā- kalpenāpi vimuktireva satataṃ nāstīti manye śive | śivālayavibhaṅgakāśśivavanādipuṣpāharā- śśivadruhajanārcakā mayi sadā vinindāratāḥ || 39 || teva yamamandirāntaranivāsalālābhujo bhavanti kṛmivaktrakā narakacitravaicitrake | ye rudrākṣavibhūṣaṇāssitalasadbhasmatripuṇṭrākṣakā mannaivedyasudhāśanāśśivamahādeveti nāmādarāḥ || 40 || malliṅgārcanatatparāśca satataṃ rudrārthapārīṇakā ye rudrāmalasatkathāsurasikāste madgaṇāśśaṅkari | bhasmatripuṇṭraśivajākṣadharāsteva hārā bhavāmbunidhitārakakarṇadhārāḥ || 41 || rudrādhyāyavicintanaikamatayaḥ pañcākṣare sādarā- stanmantraiśca śivābhiṣekaniratā liṃgārcane tatparāḥ | te hārā mama sammatāśca girije teṣāmiyaṃ vāsabhūḥ || 42 || śrutyuktācāradhārācaraṇaparikarāścāntarāyairvihīnā hīnācāravicāravarjitamanassvāntādarāśśāṅkarāḥ | pārāvārabhavograsāravirase tyaktādarāśśailaje te yānti prasabhaṃ mamālayamidaṃ nānye'dya satyaṃ bruve || 43 || kailāsācalarudramūrtaya ime candrārdhacūḍāśśive nīlendīvaralocanatrayayutāste nīlakaṇṭhāssadā | matpārśvaikagaṇā bhavanti girije te śāṅkarāssarvadā || 44 ||
skandaḥ– iti sarvagatīśśrutvā śaṃkarātparameśvarī | praṇamyāha mahādevī kailāsavaragopure || 45 ||
devyuvāca– asārasāraṃ pravadanti vedāsstriyaḥ prajānāṃ paśavo hiraṇyam |
pṛ0 96) guṇatrayīmadhyagatā prarocanā guṇāni gatvā na bhajanti ke'pi || 46 || pravṛtyunmukhā bālakāḥ kāmayante sukhāpārabuddhyā mahāduḥkhajālam | yathā bhakṣyabuddhyā mahāpāśajālairgṛhītāstu matsyā jale dhīvaraiśca || 47 || kathaṃ tvatpadābjaṃ khaniṃ vai vimuktessamāyānti duḥkhākulādurmukhāste | yathā tvāṃ cidānandarūpañca satyamasatyaikalīlā bhavantyeva bālāḥ || 48 || śaśeśṛṃgavārtā yathā syādyathā vā tathā kūrmadugdhaṃ marau vā yathāpaḥ | tathā viśvagāḥ prārthayantīha kāmānmanomūlametanmano nāsti yatra || 49 || bhūmā tvaṃ girijāpatiśśivatarassomārdhadhārī haro vāmārdhākṛtiraprameyavibhavastvaṃ somadhāmānanaḥ | kāmāṃgārirakāmasaktahṛdayastvaṃ sāmacarmāmbara- stvāmaprāpya maheśa sāmaravatastoṣapradaṃ śaṃkaram || 50 || kāmānprārthayate vimūḍhahṛdayāsteṣāṃ śramaḥ kevalaṃ sāmāgomanato ramāpatilasannetrāṃghrirīśassadā | dhūmākāraghanasthito'si bhagavaṃstvaṃ vyomakeśassadā dhaumyāgnyārcitapādapadmayugalaścomāpatiśśaṃkaraḥ || 51 || kāmānme diśa gautamādimunibhirvedaisstuto'si prabho || 52 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe śivagaurīsaṃvāde prāṇigatinirūpaṇaṃ nāma ekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 ||
kailāsaliṃgavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
