skandaḥ– kailāsātpūrvato bhāti niṣṭaptakanakaprabhaḥ | lakṣatrayāntaraṃ tasmādbhāti merussurālayaḥ || tadagravṛṣabhastambhe dhruvādyāstatpradakṣiṇe | kālacakrāntarā sarve bhramanti ca divāniśam || dhruvassaptarṣibhiścaiva rājñācātha triśaṃkunā | tadūrdhvaśailamaulisthāssmaraśāsanaśāsanāt || nānādrumalatopetaṃ ramyapakṣimṛgairyutam | sarastatrāsti vipulaṃ mānasākhyaṃ manoharam || 4 ||
pṛ0 97) utphullahemakahlārahemapaṅkajabhāsuram | tadagramaulau devānāṃ brahmaviṣṇuharātmanām || 5 || dikpālānāñca sarveṣāṃ gandharvāvasathāḥ kṛtāḥ | satyaloko brahmaṇaśca vaikuṇṭho vaiṣṇavaṃ puram || aṃśonatrīṇi rudrasya purāṇi kramaśo mune | tādṛśaḥ kanakākāraḥ paryante varṣabhūṣitaḥ || kumudākāravadbhāti bhūmeḥ paryantasāgaraiḥ | ratnasālavanaṃ tasya merormūrdhni suvistaram || tatrāsti gopuraṃ śambhormaṇimāṇikyabhūṣitam | kadācicchrīmahādevo devyā viharati svayam || 9 || śapto'sti devadevena tatprānto bhūdharasya hi | yo vātra kaścitpraviśetsabhavet strīvarākṛtiḥ || vṛṣastambhanibho meruḥ kailāsasyāsya sattama | tasmindevyā vasañchambhuḥ pārvatyā rudrakairvṛtaḥ || devyāssakhībhirabhito divyasihmāsane sthitaḥ | kadāciddevasaṅghānāṃ purāṇikramaśaśśivaḥ || merumaulau mahāliṅgamaurvīśākhyaṃ manoharam | tadgopuramahāsaudha rājatkanakavedikam || tatra sampūjayantyeva brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | talliṅgaṃ bilvapatraiśca hemapaṅkajakairapi || 14 || dhūpairdīpaiśca te devā naivedyaiśca manoharaiḥ | pradakṣiṇapraṇāmādyaisstuvanti ca surāsurāḥ ||
devāḥ– kundāmandamarandasaubhagamahāmandārasanmālikā- lolottuṅgataraṅgaraṅgitamahāgaṅgāmbujotkairavam | parvānanditaśarvarīramaṇatottuṅgāṅgamauliṃ śivaṃ dhyāyāmo'dya mahāghasaṃsṛtibhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ vihāyādarāt || 16 || āraktasundarataraiḥ kuruvindabṛndaraktāravindamakarandaparāgamaulim | bṛndāravanditapadāmburuhaṃ maheśaṃ sundopasundavaradaṃ jagadādikandam || 17 || mūrdhorddhaṃ madhupālijhaṅkṛtiyutaṃ cañcajjaṭānirjharaṃ śailānnirjharasāriṇīva bhavato dṛṣṭirbhavāmbhojharī | udyadrāgamalīmasāñjhaṭiti no nojjhanti pādau hṛdi te dhanyāssajalañjhalau sa bhagavānbhūyācchriyai sarvaśaḥ || 18 ||
sūtaḥ– evaṃ stuvanti te devā merumaulisthitaṃ śivam | gandharvāpsarasassiddhā munayo vītakalmaṣāḥ ||
pṛ0 98) kailāse'tra mahādevassannidhatte sadaiva hi | devyā maṇimaye saudhe viharatyeṣa śaṅkaraḥ || tadvihāraṃ śṛṇuṣvādya sarvapāpavināśanam | nānācitravicitrāśca krīḍāstāḥ parameśituḥ || devyā saha suraśreṣṭhāḥ kena vā varṇyate hi tāḥ || 22 || rudrāṇyo navayauvanoccalakucāstāssomadhāmnā nibhā ratnotthāmalakāntibhūṣitatanūvalyaḥ prabhābhāsurāḥ | sambaddhastanacelakeśavalayāssevādhikārādarā rājante kaladhautasānuśikhahe līlājhaṇannūpurāḥ || 23 || udyatkāvyanibhācchacampakamahānāsālasanmauktikā- stārākārasuhīrahāravalayaistāstatra vidyullatāḥ | rudrāścāpi maheśvaraṃ trijagatāmādhārabhūtaṃ haraṃ tattatkālasusevanairanupamaiśśrāntiṃ vihāyādarāt || 24 || snānodyanmaṇisundaraiśca kalaśaissraggandhadhūpārpaṇai- rdīpaiḥ keśasudhūpanaiḥ parikaraiḥ paryaṅkaviśrāṇanaiḥ | chatraiścāmaravījanaiḥ prapadakairādarśatāmbūlakai- rvīṇābhiḥ paṭavāsakhaṅgasukaraissevanti śarvaṃ śivām || 25 || rudrāṇyo navakoṭayaśca taruṇā rudrāśca koṭyo daśa bhairavyo'tha digambarāśca satataṃ koṭībhiranvāsate | yoginyo'tha trikoṭayaśca paritaste ḍākinīkoṭayo rohiṇyā sahitendudhāmavadanāssevanti śambhuṃ śivām || 26 || kailāse navaśaktiratnavilasatpīṭhe mahātatvavā- gjātenaikakakoṭivistarayute śrīcakramadhyaṅgate | bindau candradineśakoṭiyugale mañce catuṣpīṭhake pañcabrahmamaye vayaṃ girijayā sārdhaṃ hṛdādadhmahe || 27 || śaśiprasṛmaraiḥ karaissitasitāyamāno giriḥ prabhātatasudhāmbudheścalataraṅgahastotthayā |
pṛ0 99) samuccalitanaukayā sakalaratnasaṃkḷptayā sudhāṃśuśakalālako viharati sphuṭaṃ so'mbayā || 28 || svacchādripāradamahākaladhautaśailasānuprabhāsamadhikonnatapāṇḍarāṅgam | cañcadviṣāṇamukuṭītaṭalambamānasaccāmaraughaparivījitakarṇatālam || 29 || kāntyā svayā parimuṣantamivodyatāṃśumukṣāṇamadritanayāpatirakṣiphālaḥ | āruhya yāti nagarājasutāsahāyaḥ || 30 || ukṣādhastalapakṣati pracalito devasya pādāmbuje svaskandhe maṇipādukottamalasatsānandanāmā gaṇaḥ | pāhīśeti vadañchiva mahādeva prabho māṃ sadā tārānāthakalādhara śrutiśiraḥkoṭīrapālīgata || 31 || kailāsamaulidhavalottamaśṛṅgasaṃsthaliṅgāvaliṃ samabhivīkṣya mahoruharṣaḥ | paśyeti tāmagasutāṃ pravadatyabhīkṣṇaṃ tryakṣo'kṣatākṣamanasā paricintanīyaḥ || sauvarṇaratnakhacitairmaṇijālakḷptaiścakre mahonnatatale śaśidhāmakumbham | devyā rathaṃ rathapatiḥ prathito hi devairāruhya yāti nagamaulimaho dvijendrāḥ || nānāratnayutaprabhātatitataṃ muktācchagucchānvitaṃ pālīpālimarālarājanikarairmuktāvitānairyutam | bhrājaddivyapatākacāmarayutaṃ chatrairapārairyuta- ñcāruhyākhilaśailarājasutayā divyaṃ vimānaṃ haraḥ || 34 || kailāse navamaulipāliṣu sadā paśyanprayātīśvaro devādīnakhilānvilokayati vai tallokalokānapi | brahmāṇḍāntikatassphuratsurataṭinyāṭopamauliśśivo viśvaṃ citramapāracitrakayutaṃ yukto'nbayā kevalam || 35 ||
īśvaraḥ– suratarucitabhogajālatarṣāssuratarucitadevapuṇyavārbhiḥ | sarabhasamapayānti karmadevā girije paśya mahāvimānavaryāḥ || 36 ||
pṛ0 100) devastrīkarakaṅkaṇollasamaṇisphāraprabhābhāsurā devodyānanikuñjasīmasubhagaissraggandhavātairapi | tatratyācchasudhāsudhādhararasāsvādodanāḥ kevalaṃ te devāssaha bhogabhāgyanikaraiḥ puṣṇanti paśyāmbike || 37 || viṣṇubrahmamarudgaṇaissamamume māṃ paśyate yo'dhamo lālājālamukheṣu pūyakṛmijāpāre malābdhau sthitaḥ | śastrodyadvipināgragātrakavaceṣvākalpaviṣṭāśanā- stiṣṭhantyeva kaniṣṭhaniṣṭhuravacoduṣṭaḥ kaśātāḍitaḥ || 38 || dṛṣṭaḥ kaṣṭajabhogabhāgyaphalabhāṅmannindanādadrije || paśya nārakagaṇaṃ bahuduḥkhitaṃ liṅgamaṅgaladadarśanojjhitam | kumbhatailapacanena supakvaṃ bhakṣyavannigirate yama enam || 39 || rudrākṣakaṇṭhavarakarṇamahoruhārāḥ koṭīrakaṅkaṇakaśobhitabāhudaṇḍāḥ || 40 || pradoṣaliṅgārcanaliṅgadhāmasandarśanānanditavṛttayo ye | yāntyeva kailāsavaraṃ mamālayaṃ teva hārā mama sammatāśśive || 41 || kailāsācalamaulisaṃsthitamahāliṅgālayeṣūdyatā bhrāntiṃ te janayanti ratnakalaśā nānārkasomāiva | atratyāmalaliṅgamaulijajaṭācūḍendugaṅgādayo dyotacchailaśikhāvirājitaśikhākāro'dya śailo mama || 42 || paśyādrije girivarodyataliṅgasaṅghaṃ sampūjitañca vilasannavabilvapatraiḥ | tatraiva gāṅgajapayojavaratnamīlanmaulisthacandrajakarairvikacotpalābham || 43 || gaṇakarasampuṭotthaśaṅkhanādairmadhurairmaddalaḍiṇḍimotthanādaiḥ | śivaliṅgāgragatā gaṇā virejurmama śailo'pi sadaiva ghoṣayuktaḥ || 44 || kailāso'pyayamadrirājatanaye malliṅgamaulissadā jāto mandaradānataśca sumahattenāpi taptantapaḥ |
pṛ0 101) tattādṛṅnasurādisaṅghanikaraistaptaṃ munīnāṃ gaṇai- śśaivendrairmama sadgaṇairapi śive tasmindayā me parā || 45 || ityambāvadanaṃ nirīkṣya bhagavānāha pramodāspadaṃ kailāsasya guṇaughavarṇanamaho devyāḥ puraśśaṅkaraḥ | ramyaṃ tatra mamālayaṃ karivarāsyasyāpi vakṣye mudā tasyāpyadbhutamīśvarasya samukhe saṃsthāpya dharmyasya hi || 46 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe śivagaurīsaṃvāde kailāsaliṃgavarṇanannāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 ||
kailāsavarṇane skandakṛtastutirnāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– śṛṇudhvaṃ brahmaviṣṇvādyā jaigīṣavya gaṇottamāḥ | tatrāntare'sti prākāro gomedamaṇikalpitaḥ || 1 || gomedagopuraścaiva caturdikṣu virājitaḥ | caturdikṣu gopurāṇi lakṣamānena sattamāḥ || vedikāpaṭṭikābhiśca toraṇālaṅkṛtāni hi | rājatkumbhapatākāgrairvṛṣabhaistanmaṇiprabhaiḥ || rudrāvatāraracitairgavākṣaissphāṭikairapi | kumudairvyālipīṭhaiśca daivagoṣṭha yutānyapi || 4 || maṇṭapāvalisaṃkḷptaissahasrāyutaśo gaṇaiḥ | maṇikāñcanacitraiśca muktāvitatatoraṇaiḥ || 5 || sarobhissāgarākārai ratnasopānamaṇḍitaiḥ | tatprāntamaṇṭapavaraissahasrastambhaśobhitaiḥ || saromadhyamaṇibhrājanmaṇṭapairucchitairapi | tatrāntare tu prākāre gopurāntaradakṣiṇe || tatra matsadanaṃ divyaṃ nānāratnacitaṃ śubham | lakṣastambhayutaṃ saudhaṃ navaratnāgraśṛṅgakam || tatsālabhañjikāniryadratnakāntivibhāsitam | tataḥ [tamasstomatiraskārīti pāṭhāntaram |] paścādaṃśumadbhirmaṇibhiḥ kṛtaśekharam || gavākṣitaṃ vicitraiśca navaratnaprabhādhikam | harinmaṇikṛtaiścaiva mayūravarakukkuṭaiḥ || 10 || śobhitairmaṇṭapāgraiśca varaprāsādatoraṇaiḥ | prākāraissundaratarairgopurāvalibhāsuraiḥ || 11 || maṇidvārakavāṭaiśca śātakumbhaśalākakaiḥ | dhūpāmodayutāpāraramyoddāmasugandhitam || 12 ||
pṛ0 102) maṇidīpaprabhābhāsirañjitākhiladiktaṭam | tatra divyasumāmodi vanaṃ caitrarathādhikam || maṇyālavālakalitaratnaveditviṣātatam | nānādevadrumāpāravallīgucchavirājitam || 14 || kaumārannāma tatrāsti saraścotphullapaṅkajam | maṇisopānapālībhistatprāntamaṇimaṇṭapaiḥ || krīḍāmṛgaiśśukaiścāpi maṇipañjaraśārikaiḥ | tatra tatsaudhamadhyasthaṃ mama saudhavarāśrayam || sihmāsanaṃ ratnakḷptaṃ pañcayojanavistṛtam | tatrāhaṃ sevito vīrairnavalakṣairudāyudhaiḥ || 17 || sihmasaṃhananairvīraiḥ kaumārairudyadāyudhaiḥ | mattadvipakarākārabāhubhiśśaktisaṃyutaiḥ || 18 || vīrabāhuprabhṛtibhiḥ puṣpavastrāṅgalepanaiḥ | chatracāmarahastaiścāpyāse'haṃ sevitastadā || 19 || mahārhavasanopeto navaratnavibhūṣaṇaḥ | ṣaḍvaktramukuṭodbhāsi ratnakuṇḍalakāṅgadaḥ || 20 || ratnāṅgulīyavilasattalāṅgulipadāmbujaḥ | maṇimāṇikyamañjīraraṇannūpuramekhalaḥ || 21 || devavalyā senayā cāpīndrādyairapi sevitaḥ | ṣaḍbhiśca vadanairdevaṃ stuvandvādaśalocanaiḥ || paśyanliṅgaṃ hi kailāse kaumāreśvaramīśvaram | hīrasāramahādhārāprākāre dakṣiṇe sthitaḥ || tannīlagopurottuṅganīladhārātatā diśaḥ | rudrāvatārakrīḍāditalaśobhaikabhāsuram || 24 || rājallalāmavṛṣabhaṃ śambhoḥ kailāsagopuram | pañcalakṣapramāṇena kalpitaṃ vistarāyatam || dakṣiṇe gopuraprānte śambhoḥ prākāramadhyame | tatkaumārapuraṃme'dya nānāsaudhavirājitam || kaumārairmadgaṇaśreṣṭhairmayā ca paripālitam | tatra matpuramadhyasthaṃ kaumāreśasya gopuram || navaratnaprabhābhāsvatprākārāṭṭālasundaram | garbhāgāramahākāntidhagaddhagitadiṅmukham || maṇikumbhodyataśikhāvalīḍhagaganāṅkaṇam | mameṣṭaliṅgantatraiva devadevasya śūlinaḥ || trikālaṃ tatra talliṅgaṃ pūjayāmi gaṇairvṛtaḥ | dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyaiḥ pañcāmṛtaniṣecanaiḥ || vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgādiśaṅkhakāhalanisvanaiḥ | madhuroddāmagītaiśca kaumārīṇāñca nartanaiḥ || hāvabhāvamanohāritauryatrikamanoharaiḥ | ṣaḍvaktraphālakalitatripuṇṭratilakojvalaḥ || 32 || bhasmarudrākṣavalayasarāvalivibhūṣitaḥ | ṣaḍvaktrapaṅkajasyandisudhāsamamahārasaiḥ || 33 || staumi stotravaraiśśambhuṃ tatstutiṃ ṇuśṛ sattama || 34 || chadmasvargavinutāgamavarya karkāryāgamadūrvayārcita | merumaurvikṛtadarvihastaka pāhi māṃ bhava maheśa sarvaga || 35 || vikramākramitalokacaṅkrama pādamūlamapi no trivikrama |
pṛ0 103) prāptakūpasadanaḥ kimu bhekassāgarottaraṇahetave hara || 36 || svarṇavarṇakṛtalocana karṇāpārahāraka mahārṇavasaṃstha | varṇitāgama aparṇayārcita parṇapatrarathapūjyapadābja || 37 || karṇakuṇḍalakṛtāhivareśa pārayārṇavabhavaṃ sukarṇadhāraka | gandhabandhumadhupāvalibhāsvadrājarājaśakalāmalamaule || 38 || devalokataṭinīgatapullairnīlakairavakulaikasupūjya | vāhājihvātisaṅkhyākṛtanayanayugaṃ talpasaṅkhyāpi tādṛ- gdaśayugalalalāmaṃ devamandārasālam || 39 || kaumāra śaṅkaragirāṃ manaso'tidūra karpūragaura suśarīradhṛtoragendra | mārāpahāra puravargaharāvyayeśa viśveśvarāva dayayā tava bālamiṣṭam || 40 || itthaṃ ṣaḍvadanaisstaumi kaumāreśaṃ maheśvaram | madgaṇairnavalakṣaiśca tatkaumārapurasthitaḥ || 41 || gopuraṃ nīlamaṇibhiḥ prākāraṃ tacca kalpitam | tatkailāsaṃ maheśasya śaktihastairudāyudhaiḥ || rakṣāmi sarvadā vipra śāsanāccandramaulinaḥ || 43 || tannīlasāraparikalpitagopurodyatkumbhāvalīvitatahemapatākajālam | śakropalākalitagovṛṣabhālirājatprākārasaudhavihitorumaṇīndraliṅgam || 44 || sampūjayan gaṇavarairbhagaṇeśamauliṃ kailāsaparvatavare nivasāmi vipra || 45 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsavarṇane skandakṛtastutirnāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 ||
kailāsavarṇane gaṇeśakṛtastutirnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– paścādbhāge harijyotiharinmaṇivirājitam | pañcalakṣapramāṇena prākāraṃ maṇigopuram || mahāmarakataiḥ kḷptagavākṣāvalibhiryutam | aṣṭāśīti sahasrāṇi yojanaiḥ parikalpitam || paścādbhāge tu tadyoti harinmaṇinibhā diśaḥ | tatra gārutmatamaṇīkḷptamaṇṭapaśobhitam ||
pṛ0 104) udyadindukarasvacchaniryajjharibhirāvṛtam | tatrācchasphaṭikoddāmasihmāsanaśatairvṛtam || dhūpadīpādibahulaṃ nānāsumavanāvṛtam | maṇimāṇikyakhacitamaṇṭape svāstṛtāsane || 5 || tasmiṃstiṣṭhati viśveśassvagaṇairarcitāṅghrikaḥ | saptalakṣagaṇendraiśca vighnādrikuliśo mahān || nānāratnacitānekabhūṣaṇaiḥ pariśobhitaḥ | sindhūravilasatphālo mahāsindhūravaktrakaḥ || māṇikyamukuṭodbhāsiphālacandravirājitaḥ | śuṇḍādaṇḍamahoccaṇḍabṛhmitānanditāmbaraḥ || kumbhāntaralalanmuktāgucchasacchāyitāsyakaḥ | karṇapatramaṇibhrājaccalatkarṇayugachaviḥ || dantāvalimahāratnadantaveṣṭanasundaraḥ | tadadhastāllalanmuktāmaṇipatravirājitaḥ || 10 || sitabhasmatripuṇṭrāṅkakumbhamadhyavirājitaḥ | sindhūratilakotphullavadanānandaśobhitaḥ || muktāgumphitakarṇāgravījitoḍḍīnaṣaṭpadaḥ | sravatkaṭataṭodbhāsi madagandhitadiktaṭaḥ || śivapādāmbujadhyānānandonmīlitalocanaḥ | gaṇasandarśanānandasadonmīlitalocanaḥ || mahānāganibaddhorupiṭharodarasaṃyutaḥ | phullapadmāmalapadassurāsuragaṇānataḥ || 14 || pāśāṅkuśaradadyotimodakāsaktasatkaraḥ | ratnāṅgadaiśca keyūrairbhrājatkarikaraprabhaḥ || 15 || pādakḷptaraṇatsiñjadratnamañjīraśobhitaḥ | divyāṅgarāgasubhago maṇihārāmbarāvṛtaḥ || 16 || pārśvadvayavirājacchrīsiddhibuddhivirājitaḥ | sarvābharaṇabhūṣābhyāṃ sevitaḥ pārśvayordvayoḥ || gaṇendraiśchatradaṇḍodyanmaṇicāmarasatkaraiḥ | sevitaśśrīgaṇeśānastasminkailāsamaṇṭape || calaccāmaravātaiśca calatkarṇāgracāmarāḥ | tādṛśā gaṇapāstatra pāśāṅkuśadharāstathā || 19 || mahābalā mahotsāhāḥ kuṭhāravarapāṇayaḥ | sindhūrāruṇaphālāgrāstripuṇṭrapariśobhitāḥ || rakṣanti te gaṇāstatra prākāraṃ tacca gopuram | saptalakṣāmitabalā gaṇeśā gaṇapāstathā || tatraiva devadevasya śāsanāccandramaulinaḥ | gaṇeśo'pi sadā dhyāyan gaṇeśeśvarapūjakaḥ || tatreṣṭaliṅgaṃ tasyaiva varaprākāragopuram | navaratnacitandivyaṃ maṇistambhacitāntaram || gaṇeśvarākhyaṃ talliṅgaṃ maṇidhāmagataṃ tathā | prodyatkumbhapatākāgrapavanādhūtasāñcalam || svapuṣkaradhṛtottuṅgakumbhapañcāmṛtairapi | sudhādhārābhirāsicya candanālepisundaram || phaṇāmaṇimahāmauliratnābharaṇaśobhitam | so'dyasampūjayatyeva bilvamandāracampakaiḥ || dūrvābhiḥ kamalairīśaṃ dhūpairdīpairmanoharaiḥ | naivedyairvividhaiścaiva tāmbūlaiśchatracāmaraiḥ || 27 || gānairnṛtyairmṛdaṅgābjakāhalānāñca nisvanaiḥ | bhasmarudrākṣasampannasstauti devaṃ maheśvaram ||
pṛ0 105) gaṇeśaḥ– gaṇeśa triguṇātīta bhagaṇādhīśamastaka | garjanmeghagaṇodbhūtataṭidgaṇajaṭāmala || 29 || vyomakeśa bhagavan śrutimaulistomasāmavinitākhilasoma | bhūmabhaumamahimāgamakāma dhūmadhāmabahaladyutikaṇṭha || 30 || kṣayadvīramārāpahārādya śambho vīra dhīra suraśekharapāda | ghorāndhakāsuranibarhaṇa kālakāla krūrāntara tripuragarvaharāvyayeśa || 31 || daharagahanaśekharo'si śambho niravadyākhilalokasaukhya bhūman | triguṇagatividūra darśitādya prakaṭitavedavacobhirīḍyapāda || 32 || kare kuraṅgaṃ svakapardagaṅgaṃ hāre bhujaṅgaṃ yamihṛtsusaṅgam | bālākṛtāṅgaṃ sitabhasmasaṅgamanaṅgamātaṅgaharaṃ bhajāmi || 33 ||
skandaḥ– iti stauti sadā śambhuṃ kailāseśagaṇeśvaraḥ | gaṇanātho gaṇavṛtassadāśivagaṇāgraṇīḥ || tatpāti gopuraṃ śambhormaṇiprākāramapyasau | svakīyairgaṇapaissārdhaṃ candracūḍasyaśāsanāt || harinmaṇikṛtaṃ varaṃ haritagopuraṃ paścime virājitatalāṅkaṇairvṛṣalalāmaśṛṅgaprabhaiḥ | garunmaṇivaraprabhaṃ vitataratnasaudhottamaṃ varapravarasundaraprakaṭavapraprākārakam || 36 || svabāhubalamāśrito dviradavaktrajaissadgaṇaiḥ prapāti [prayātīti pāṭhāntaram |] gaṇanāyakaśśivapadābjasaṃsevakaḥ || 37 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsavarṇane gaṇeśakṛtastutirnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 ||
pṛ0 106) kailāsavarṇane vṛṣastutirnāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– kailāsāntarataḥ prācyāṃ puṣparāgavinirmitam | pañcalakṣapramāṇena prākāravaragopuram || udyadbhānuśatādhikyacākacakyamanoharam | puṣparāgamaṇiprodyadvṛṣabhaissamadhiṣṭhitam || prākāraṃ lakṣamānena manasā śūlinā kṛtam | rudrāvatāracaritairvedikāpaṭṭikānvitam || rājadvṛṣabhakumbhāgradodhūyitapatākakam | puṣparāgamaṇijyotitiraskṛtaśaśidyuti || 4 || tatraivāntarmahāratnagarbhamaṇṭapamuttamam | stambhaiśca daśasāhasraissamunnatimanoharam || 5 || śikhābhirmaṇikḷptābhirvalibhiścumbitāmbaram | nānāratnamahāvedipīṭhavidrumaputrikaiḥ || śobhitaṃ ratnagucchāccha mālālambitapīṭhakam | tatra sihmāsane divye navaratnagaṇaiścite || dhūpadīpādibahule muktāmālāpariṣkṛte | vitānadyotidikcakre nānārudragaṇairyute || 8 || ṣaṣṭisāhasrasaṅkhyākairahimanyubhiruddhate | tripuṇṭravilasatphālai rudrākṣavarabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 9 || triśūlodyatkaraiśśubhrairheticāpaśarāvṛtaiḥ | jaṭātaṭanibaddhenduśekharairindusaprabhaiḥ || 10 || samantātsevito nityaṃ vṛṣo dharmākṛtirmahān | dharmādhāramahāpādo yuganābhorupādakaḥ || sandhyāṃśasukhuroddāmavarṇāśramakṛtāṅghrikaḥ | maṇimañjīraninadanānādharmaikaśabdavān || caturvedopavedodyadvedāntimatadantakaḥ | purāṇanyāyamīmāṃsādvayatantrorughaṇṭakaḥ || 13 || pūrvasiddhāntarāddhāntatatvaśabdaghaṇāghaṇaḥ | graiveyaśobhitodāraghaṇṭākalitakandharaḥ || kailāso jaṅgama iva śṛṅgadvayavibhūṣitaḥ | sudhāmaṇḍalajottuṅgasupāṇḍaramahāchaviḥ || 15 || saṃsthito devadevasya sannidhau nandikeśvaraḥ | pañcalakṣapramāṇena gaṇaiḥ [gātrairiti pāṭhāntaram |] karpūrasannibhaiḥ || 16 || udyatsudhāṃśupūrṇāṅgo lakṣayojanapṛṣṭabhūḥ | kakudā daśasāhasrayojanonnatavṛttayā || 17 || mukhena triṃśatsāhasraṃ netrayordvisahasrakam | karṇayoḥ pañcasāhasraṃ viṣāṇe ca sahasrakam || 18 || nāsāvivaramuktācchanāsāpañcasahasrakam | sahasrayojanāyāmalelihānāgrajihvakam || 19 || paśyannanimiṣeṇaiva locanābhyāṃ maheśvaram | svapṛṣṭāstṛtaratnācchapalyaṅkālambimauktikam || svanāsāvivarotthānavātoddhūta mahāgirim | tadvātoddhūtavelāśca codyatodyattaraṅgakāḥ ||
pṛ0 107) samudrāssaritaścaiva taccalatkhuradāritā | bhūrbhāti kampitā śailaissāgaraiśca vilolitā || śṛṅgakoṭimaṇibhrājimukuṭena virājitam | karṇālambiśaśijyotidhavalālambicāmaram || pañcāśallakṣamānena padaiḥ khuravarairyutam | daśasāhasravistārairindranīlamaṇiprabhaiḥ || 24 || khurāghṛṣṭagirivrātaṃ nādamoditakandaram | sāsnayā lambitāsvacchapañcasāhasrayojanam || humphāravamahābhīta trailokyatalavāsinam | kāmadhenugaṇaiścaiva koṭibhiḥ paritovṛtam || śaraccandraprabhābhāsvadgirimaulividāraṇam | lambinā vṛṣaṇenāpi śatayojanakena ca || vālena triṃśatsāhasrayojanena vilambinā | cāmarāgramahākeśapucchabhāreṇa śobhitaḥ || muktāmāṇikyajālaiśca protthitena maṇiprabhaḥ | tatrāsti gopuraṃ śambhordhāmatatra vṛṣeśituḥ || prākārarājadvṛṣabhaṃ tasyeṣṭaṃ liṅgamaiśvaram | kāmadhenūdhasodbhūtaiḥ payobhirabhiṣicya ca || 30 || gandhairbilvaiśca mandāraiḥ paṅkajairdhūpadīpakaiḥ | naivedyaiḥ pāyasāpūpatāmbūlachatracāmaraiḥ || 31 || sampūjyastautidharmeśaṃ bhasmarudrākṣabhūṣitaiḥ | muktātripuṇṭraphālāṅko śaśidhṛkchṛṅgayordvayoḥ || 32 || paśyantsaṃstauti hṛṣṭātmā nādakīlitadiktaṭaḥ || 33 ||
dharmaḥ– dakṣapakṣakṛtaśikṣa mahokṣodvāhitākṣitilakāsuravīkṣa | kukṣigākhilajagadgatadhākṣiḥ pakṣivāhasutakāyavilakṣam || 34 || bhūmimaṇḍalatalātigamūlaṃ kolarūpahariṇā na viloki | abjajāṇḍajagatī vivadete pādamaulikalane tava śambho || 35 || sindhūniṣaṅgaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ turaṅgaṃ mahāṅgacarmāmbaramudyatāṅgam | indūttamāṅgaṃ haraye rathāṅgaṃ bhūte mahokṣāṅgagataṃ hṛdakṣagam || 36 ||
skandaḥ– itthaṃ stauti mahādevaṃ dharmo vṛṣavapurdharaḥ | sa eva dharmo deveśaṃ vahatyatyantabhāsuraḥ || 37 || prācyāṃ tadgopuravaraṃ prākāragaṇapairvṛtaḥ | pāti taddevadevasya smarahantuśca śāsanāt || 38 || śrīmatkailāsaśṛṅge śivavaragaṇapaissindhurāsyānugaiśca kaumārairgaṇapairvṛṣendragaṇapai rudraissamantādvṛtam |
pṛ0 108) nikhilajagadadhīndrairviṣṇunā devasaṅghaiśśrutigaṇamunivaryaiścintituṃ cākṣamantat ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsavarṇane vṛṣastutirnāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 ||
kailāsavarṇane devīprastāvavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– taduttare'sti prākāro vaiḍūryamaṇirañjitaḥ | vaiḍūryānantasūtraiśca pītāstatrasthadiktaṭāḥ || tatra gopuramuttuṅgaṃ vaiḍūryamaṇiśobhitam | āpīṭhaśikharaprotarudracāritraśobhitam || 2 || pañcalakṣapramāṇena mahāvaiḍūryasadvṛṣam | paṭṭikādevakoṣṭhaiśca kāpotaiḥ pālipālikaiḥ || 3 || maṇikumbhollasacchubhraṃ tattu pañcaśatāñcitam | navalakṣaṃ rudragaṇāśśambhorudyatarāstrakāḥ [udyataśastrakāḥ iti pāṭhāntaram |] || 4 || tripuṇṭravilasatphālāḥ kapardadhṛtacandrakāḥ | mattamātaṅgasaṅkāśā yuvāno mṛṣṭakuṇḍalāḥ || rakṣanti paritastacca prākāraṃ varagopuram | tasyāntare hi sumahannānāmaṇigaṇāñcitam || devyāstu bhavanaṃ śrīmatsaudhapaṃktivibhūṣitam | ramyamāṇikyakhacitastambhāpārasahasrakaiḥ || hīrasāramahādhāraiḥ puṣyarāgāṅganīlakaiḥ | vaiḍūryakaiśca gomedairmuktāvidrumakalpitaiḥ || 8 || puṣparāgamaṇīkḷptairgomedavalabhīyutaiḥ | harinmaṇivarodbhūtairmuktāmaṇisarojvalaiḥ || 9 || supravālalatāstambhaiḥ kuruvindoruvedikaiḥ | tatra prākāramastyekaṃ candrakāntaśilānvitam || 10 || viṃśatsahasramānena yojanena prakalpitam | caturdvāraparīkḷptamahāgopuravedikaiḥ || 11 || ratnahīrakagomedapuṣparāgavinirmitaiḥ | bālaprabhākarākārairmaṇiśṛṅgavirājitaiḥ || 12 || devīkrīḍārasaissihmaiḥ [śṛṃgairiti pāṭhāntaram |] paryantāvaliśobhitaiḥ | śaraccandrasamākāraissphaṭikottamarañjitaiḥ || 13 || vikṛtāsyalalajjihvaissaṭāśobhitakandharaiḥ | tatrāntarbhavanaṃ devyā daśasāhasrakalpitam || 14 || yojanānāñca parito navaratnavicitritam | udyadindukaraprakhyaṃ nānāśilpaikasundaram || 15 || tatra devyā mahāpīṭhaṃ koṭibhāskarasannibham | hīratārāgaṇākāraprabhāvalivirājitam || 16 || navaratnamahāsaudhamadhyagā śrīmaheśvarī | kamalāmodabahulaparyantasarasojvalā || 17 ||
pṛ0 109) saudhamadhyamaṇīkḷptasihmāsanavarāśrayā | harinmaṇimahāmañcadarāndolitavigrahā [dolāndolitavigraheti pāṭhāntaram |] || 18 || hallīsallāsyalalitayoginīgaṇasevitā | kadācitsā mahādevī pravālavarapīṭhagā || 19 || pravālavarapīṭhastharatnapīṭhavarāśrayā | māṇikyasaudhamadhyasthā bhūṣitā cārubhūṣaṇaiḥ || 20 || kadācitpuṣparāgottha saudhamadhyaikavāsinī | nīlakantukabhūtāccharavisomajakantukā [līlākutukabhūtāccha iti pāṭhāntaram |]|| 21 || hananācca tayorūrdhvādhogataissatataṃ dvija | udeti sūryaścandraścāpyastametyapyudetyapi || 22 || karatālena devyāstu tasmintsaudhavarāgrataḥ | ratnasaudhataloddāmajālakāntarasañcarā || 23 || sudhākarakarāsphāraprāsādavarakautukā | puṣpavāṭīparivṛtaratnasaudhavarāśrayā || 24 || kumārāgāramadhyasthā kadācidvaradā śivā | puṣpamañcakamadhyasthā puṣparāgagṛhāntare || 25 || ratnavīṭīkarā bhāsvadratnakaṅkaṇabhūṣitā | kadambavanamadhyasthahīrasaudhavarāśrayā || 26 || līlālālitaratnācchakīravīrakarā śivā | śārikāvyaktakagirā tuṣṭā nīlajasaudhagā || 27 || sudīpitamahānīlakabarabhrāntimastakā | varabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyā raṇacchiñjānapādukā || 28 || ratnapātrasthitānekaphalālokanatatparā | puṣpagucchamahāhārāpyāpīḍāmodahastakā || 29 || sudhāmukharitāmoda ratnapātrakarā kvacit | mukuṭoddāmacandrāṃśuraśmisārālakā śivā || 30 || suratnakantukāsrāvikeśapāśā manoharā | yoginīdarśitānekaratnādarśavilokinī || 31 || candrakāntaśilājālasaudhamadhyanivāsinī | nayanāñjanakākḷptaratnabhrājacchalākikā || 32 || karamudrāviniryacchrīrnakhakāñcitamudrikā | hīrabhrājitalā raktachavikā padabhāsurā || 33 || nīlaveṇīcitānekaratnasevantikātatiḥ | mahārhahemakhacitavasanāñcalamauktikā || 34 || paridhatte'mśukaṃ devī maṇibhrājigṛhāntaram | dhūpadhūmapariṣkāragandhabandhaikasundaram || 35 || maṇiharmyāntare pīṭhe sumanogucchabhāsure | ratnāṃśudīpakoddāmaprabhābhāsitadiktaṭe || 36 || saṃsthitā darśitānekarudrāṇīvadanāmbuje | sucandanadravāsāravarāṅkitatanuchaviḥ || 37 || suramandārapunnāgaketakodbhāsiśekharā | campakāśokadamanośīrakaṇṭasupāṭalaiḥ || 38 || mallikāmālatījātidhammillabharaśobhitā | kastūrīcandragandhāktapaṭavāsaikasundarā || 39 || mṛganābhisugandhodyatkucāntaritabhāsurā | nicolagranthitoddāmabhujāvalivirājitā || 40 || rudrāṇīkarasindhūrakṛtasīmantarekhikā | suratnatilakabhrājisomadhāmasamānanā || 41 ||
pṛ0 110) hastāṅgulīyavilasatprabhābhūṣitatiktatiḥ | vaiḍūryasaudhamadhyasthā rudrāṇīnṛttadarśinī || nīlaratnakṛtālābumaṇisārijahīrakaiḥ | ūrdhvabaddhamahātantrī vīṇāvādyādarā kvacit || gāyantī madhurodāraṃ śivanāmaiva sundaram | śaraccandrācchanikaracāmarairvījitā kvacit || māyūrairmaṇidaṇḍaiśca vyajanairvījitā śivā | parvotthaśarvarīnātha tiraskārimaṇīsaraiḥ || bhrājacchatrāvṛtamukhā tāmbūlarasamoditā | vīṭikālagnasukarā paśyaṃścitrapaṭaṃ sthitā || sadāśivasya tadrūpaṃ likhitaṃ lekhakeśituḥ | vidrumābharadachādibimbākārasuśobhitā || ratnagraiveyacintākalolamuktāṃśusaprabhā | kvaṇatkiṅkaṇikābhāsvadratnahastasarairyutā || 48 || tapanoḍupavibhrājitāṭaṅkayugalādhṛtiḥ | udyatkavinibhātyacchamuktānāsāvṛtāsyakā || ratnagaṅgāmahāsāradhārāgṛhavarāśrayā | kaṭītaṭanibaddhāccharatnakāñcīvirājitā || 50 || prabhāpataṅkajoddāmamaṇimañjīrabhāsurā | raṇacchiñjānamadhurahaṃsārāvaikasundarā || 51 || marālarājagamanā divyahārāvṛtāṅgakā | baṅkikānāgabandhodyadbāhuvallīvirājitā || kūrparāgralalanmuktāgucchasañchāditachaviḥ | phālalambitaratnālilalāmāvaliśobhitā || sūryacandrāṅkitodāraśirobhūṣaṇabhūṣitā | yoginīkoṭibhistatra sevitā parameśvarī || harinmaṇimahāsaudhe muditā saṃsthitā śivā | divyopadhānasaṃkḷptamaṇimañce kṛtāstṛte || dhūpāmoditadikcakre maṇidīpamanohare | vitānālambimuktodyadgucchasañchāditāmbare || pādabāhūpadhāneṣu svāstṛte'viharacchivā | rudrāṇīgānadhārābhirvīṇānādānugā śivā || śṛṇvantī śivanāmāni saṃsthitā vaidrume gṛhe | suvarṇakadalīgucchaharinmaṇinibhairdrumaiḥ || tanmadhye sphāṭikamaṇīkṛtasaudhavarāśrayā | tamālasālanīpādivṛtasaudhe garutmataḥ || 59 || maṇikḷpte mahāpīṭhe saṃsthitā mugdhadarśanā | lāvakānāṃ mayūrāṇāṃ kukkuṭānāṃ manoharam || meṣasāraṅgaśṛṅgodyatsphāranārāvidiktaṭam | ramyaṃ ratnābjinītīraṃ baddhairdikṣu maṇīndrakaiḥ || sopānatīrasaṃkḷptamaṇisundaramaṇṭape | ratnapañjaramadhyasthānratnaśārīśukāñchivā || 62 || paśyantī dāḍimībījaṃ dadāti śukavaktrake | pūgadruveṣṭitāpāradrākṣāvallīsugucchake || sandhyāvallīsumāraktacandrikāpuṣpaśobhite | paryantakulyātīrācchamaṇibandhasudhāpayaḥ || payojavikasatphullahallakāmodamodite | dhārāsāramahāyantraśobhite gandhamodite || 65 || pūgadrumaulisañchādimaṇiharmyorumañcagā | krīḍāśikhaṇḍivihitatāṇḍavaṃ paśyatī śivā || 66 ||
pṛ0 111) mahāmaṇīndrasaṃkḷptasaudhairuparikalpite | nānācitrapaṭīkḷptapaṭāmbaragṛhādarā || 67 || tiraskaraṇikākḷptacaturdikṣu manohare | maṇikumbhodyate devī maṇistambhavibhūṣite || sakhībhissaha sallāpaṃ kurvantī saṃsthitā kvacit | rathākāramahāsaudhairmaṇicakrairhayaistathā || paryantiva tatsaudhe sihmahaṃsavirājite | tatraivāntargṛhe devyāḥ krīḍābhavanamīśituḥ || śrīcakrākāramatulaṃ tanmaṇīndramanoharam | sahasrayojanāyāmaṃ maṇicitragavākṣakaiḥ || 71 || haṃsapadmamahāvyālipālīcitrairvicitrite | maṇistambhamahāsāradhārārañjitabhūtalaiḥ || 72 || vitānamālākalitairmuktāgucchālilambitaiḥ | maṇimañcairmahāpādairlambitādhasthitairapi || teṣūdyatā mahāśayyāssopadhānamanoharāḥ | candramaṇḍalasaṅkāśāḥ phenagokṣīrasaprabhāḥ || sumāmoditagandhāḍhyā mallikāpuṣpasaṃstṛtāḥ | bhramaddīpagṛhabhrājanmaṇicitravibhūṣitāḥ || devasya devyāḥ krīḍādirasacitrorukuṭṭimāḥ | dhūpavṛkṣairdīpavṛkṣairmaṇikḷptaissahasraśaḥ || 76 || tāmbūlakalpapātraiśca maṇibhṛṅgārakaiśśubhaiḥ | dhūpapātrairdīpapātraiḥ puṣpatāmbūlapātrakaiḥ || phalapūrṇai ratnapātrairmaṇikumbhaissudhāyutaiḥ | dhūpāmodamaṇidyotivirājitamanuttamam || 78 || maṇiputtalikākḷptacārucāmaravījanaiḥ | vyajanādarśatāmbūladhṛtaputtalikāyutaiḥ || 79 || gaṇaiśca rahito devassakhīvirahitā śivā | tasmiñchrīcakrasaudhe [madhye iti pāṭhāntaram |] tu krīḍatastau śivau mune ||
skandaḥ- kailāse navaśaktiratnavilasatpīṭhe mahātatvavā- gjāte naikagakoṭivistarayute śrīcakramadhyaṅgate | bindau candradineśakoṭiyugale mañce ca tatpīṭhake pañcabrahmamaye vayaṃ girijayā sārdhaṃ hṛdādadhmahe || 81 || kailāse navaratnaharmyavilasanmañce sudhāpānnidhau [sudhāmbhonidhermadhyekalpakavāṭiketi pāṭhāntaram |] kāñcadratnakavāṭikāparivṛte cintāmaṇībhāyute | sārddhaṃ yo jagadambayā ravimayaṃ caikaṃ sudhāvarṣmaṇo rūpaṃ kantukamutkṣipatyanudinaṃ tenaiva rātrindivam || 82 ||
pṛ0 112) mūrtīryo vidhiviṣṇurudrasurarāḍaṣṭau pumarthānapi catvāryeva yugāni vedanivahaṃ divyaṃ phalānāṃ gaṇam | kurvanneva caturdiśātmakamaṭhāvaicitryapīṭhe sadā dīvyantsārdhamaśeṣabhāgyanivahaiḥ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ sammatam || 83 || kṛtsnaprāṇikalāparamya phalakastomaṃ vidhāyātra vai kālaṃ karma ca pāśakaṃ sahi śivo dīvyantsahāste'mbayā || 84 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsavarṇane devīprastāvavarṇanannāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 ||
kailāsavarṇane devīpūjāstutikathanannāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– tatraiva devyāssadanaṃ punaranyanmanoharam | gārutmatamaṇībhāsvacchatayojanavistṛtam || valabhīrocitānekagavākṣodyatakumbhakam | maṇipīṭhojvalastambhakḷptavidrumaputrikam || suratnaphanasaiścaiva suratnakadalīphalaiḥ | suratnanārikelācchapūgasaṅghamanoharam || 3 || suratnaketakaphalālambitachannabhūtalam | puṣpamālārasāsvādabhramadbhramarasaṅkulam || 4 || tasmindivye mahāmañce puṣpaśayyāvirājite | damanośīrakāyuktavitānachāditāmbare || suratnapaṅkajalasanmālikāsamalaṅkṛte | amlāne sarvadā tasminmukurottuṅgakuṭṭime || rudrāṇībhiḥ parivṛtā nityamāste maheśvarī | supuṣpāmaladhammillāstārādhipasamānanāḥ || taruṇyo rūpasampannāḥ kumbhīkumbhābhasatkucāḥ | maṇigraiveyahārāḍhyā muktāratnāṅgadairyutāḥ || muktānāsāvṛtāssarvāścandrikākḷptaśekharāḥ | divyāṅgarāgasubhagā raṇanmañjīrakāṅghrayaḥ || tāstatra saudhavaryeṣu devyo vidyullatā iva | sañcaranti sadā devīṃ sevante jaghanonnatāḥ || mahārhavasanopetāstilakālaṅkṛtānanāḥ | tāmbūlarāgaraktācchabimbādharamanoharāḥ || 11 || cāmarāgrakarāḥ kāścitkāściccandanadhāriṇyaḥ | kāścitkālāñjikāpāṇyaḥ kāścicchatradharāstathā || 12 || tāmbūlaratnapeṭīṃ ca dhṛtvāñjanakarāstathā | kāścitkaṅkatikāhastā bhūṣāpeṭīdharāstathā ||
pṛ0 113) haridrākuṅkumāhastā cālaktarasadhāriṇī | sindhūradhāriṇī kācitpādukāsaktasatkarā || ratnahemāmbarādīni maṇiprodyannicolakam | ratnavīṇākarāḥ kāścillīlāśukakarāstathā || harinmaṇimahāpiñchamayūravaradhāriṇī | ratnādarśakarā kācitpraphullasumadhāriṇī || 16 || campakādimahāhastā ratnabhṛṅgārasatkarāḥ | khaḍgakheṭakanistriṃśaśarakārmukapāṇayaḥ || 17 || niṣaṅgasaṅgitakarā līlākantukadhāriṇī | hallīsallāsyaratnācchadaṇḍamaṇḍitasatkarā || akṣapeṭīdharāḥ kāścitkastūrīgandhasatkarāḥ | ratnapātrasthitāpāra gandhagandhitadiktaṭāḥ || paṭavāsasuvāsena hāragucchakaśekharaiḥ | pātraiḥ prodyatkarāḥ kāścidratnaśūladharāstathā || śārikābodhanodyuktā devīnāmāni sādaram | sudhūpavṛkṣadhāriṇyo dīpikādhāriṇī parā || gandhatailāvasiktodyadratnakumbhīkarāstathā | tāmbūlapātravitatakarāḥ phalakarāstathā || padmotpalakarāḥ kāścidaṅgarāgakarāstathā | phalaratnayutāpārasvarṇapātralasatkarāḥ || 23 || maṇikumbhasudhāpārakarāḥ kāścinmanoharāḥ | evaṃ sevanti tāndevīṃ rudrāṇyaḥ parito'mbikām || 24 || tattatsevārasābhijñā devyāścittānuvartakāḥ | prāsādeṣu ca mañceṣu maṇisihmāsaneṣu ca || puṣpaśayyāṃ tathā kāścitkurvanti sukuthāvṛtām | bhakṣyabhojyānnakuśalāḥ peye rasavare tathā || devīṃ sevanti tāstatra rudrāṇyo navayauvanāḥ | tatra devyā mahāsaudhe navaratnavicitritam || garbhāgāraṃ maheśasya ramyandevīśvarasya ca | prākāragopuropetaṃ ratnatoraṇamaṇḍitam || 28 || māṇikyamukuroddāmarudrakrīḍāvṛṣairyutam | suramyaratnakalaśapatākābhrājiśekharam || 29 || tatra liṅgaṃ sudhāpūradhavalīkṛtadiṅmukham | kākodaraphaṇābhrājibilvālaṅkṛtamastakam || sudhādhāmakakhaṇḍoptaratnagolakabhūṣitam | tadvai devīśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayatyambikā sadā || sudhāsāgaranīroptakalaśairnavaratnajaiḥ | pañcāmṛtamahādhārāgandhamodaiśca nīrakaiḥ || 32 || yakṣakardamajālepaveṣṭanāmbarasundaram | bilvacampakadhuttūraratnapaṅkajamālinī || 33 || jātīsarāvalīśobhiliṅgamaulimanoharam | takkolāgarujodbhūtadhūpadhūmaiśśivā tadā || kuruvindamaṇijyotidīpairudyotitāntaram | supuṇḍarīkamālābhirnavanīlotpalasrajā || harinmaṇinibhairbilvaissahasraiḥ pūjayecchivā | bhakṣyabhojyavarānnānāṃ rāśibhiśśailakanyakā || tāmbūlaiḥ khadirāsārasvarṇakarpūrakhaṇḍajaiḥ | nīrājanairmukharitaśaṅkhakāhalamaddalaiḥ || 37 ||
pṛ0 114) vīṇāveṇujamaḍḍūtthadundubhyādisunisvanaiḥ | rudrāṇīnartanaiścaiva yoginīgaṇavādanaiḥ || 38 || trikālaṃ pūjayatyevaṃ tripuṇṭralalitālakā | rudrākṣakīlitāpāramuktāmaṇisarojvalā || somaśauce vāsasī sāpyaraje dhāriṇī śivā | saṃstuvantī mahāliṅgaṃ devīśvaramatandritā || kṛtāñjalipuṭā devī prakṛṣṭañcāṣṭavigraham || 41 ||
devī– hara hara paripāhi dīnabandho purahara deva dayānidhāna dhīra | muraharaparipūjitāṅghripadma prakaṭasudhākaraśekharoruvīra || 42 || karivarakharacarmavastra śambho hyuragavarottamahāra māramāra | paripāhi dayānidhāna bharga trinayana kālakalāvihīnadeha || 43 || śrutivaraturagottamādya śambho garagalanīla tamālapuṣpamaule | bhavabhayahara kāraṇātigāntakāre harigiriśarakārmukāktapāṇe || 44 || paripāhi vibho triśūlapāṇe naraharikṛttivasāna bālapāla | vidhikandharahaṃsaśobhihasta[hantṛhasta śambho iti pāṭhāntaram |]padmānalanayanāgnividagdhakāmadeha || 45 || imaṃ davarasāmajaprakaṭastotrakumbhādaraṃ sanandanasanātanaiḥ kalitavandanaṃ śaṅkaram | aninditaguṇottamaṃ sumunibṛndabṛndārakaiḥ picaṇḍilasutundilairgaṇavaraughanṛttādaram || 46 ||
skandaḥ– iti saṃstuvate devī devīśaṃ parameśvaram | rudrāṇīgaṇasaṃvītā yoginīgaṇasevitā || 47 || mahākailāsamadhyasthā divyadevāṅkasaṃśrayā | sāpi devaṃ jaganmātā pūjayatyaniśaṃ śivā || devadevaṃ mahādevaṃ govṛṣottamagāminam | vataṃsitasudhādhāmaśekharaṃ śrutisaṃstutam || 49 || jaṭākalāpaniṭilānalanetraṃ maheśvaram | nīlakaṇṭhaṃ virūpākṣaṃ somasūryānalākṣikam || kuraṅgarañjitakaraṃ kālakālaṃ kṛpānidhim | bhasmābhyaktaṃ tripuṇṭrāṅkaṃ rudrākṣavarahārakam || mahoragaphaṇāratnamālākīlitakandharam | udyadindukaraprakhyakarpūrābhakalevaram || 52 ||
pṛ0 115) divyasihmāsanāsīnaṃ mahākailāsasaudhagam | gaṇaskandamahānandibhṛṅgicaṇḍīśasevitam || mukuṭoddāmagaṅgottharayaśobhitamastakam | abjamitrāgninayanaṃ somakhaṇḍojvalālakam || utphullapuṇḍarīkācchamālālalitakandharam | devaṃ nandanamandāravaramālāvibhūṣitam || khapaṭaṃ parito dagdhatripurāsuragopuram | andhakāntakamāśāsyaṃ svabhaktajanavatsalam || namitāśeṣadevādimukuṭojvalapādukam | vāmadevaṃ mahāsāmastomastutamatīndriyam || rathantararavaprītaṃ rājadrājanatoṣitam | mahāvairājarājaśrīrājarājakalādharam || 58 || sarvopaniṣadāṃ sāramekībhūtamiveśvaram | dhyāyantī sā mahādevī svamanaḥpadmasadmagam || tadhyānasāradhārābhiḥ plāvitānanapaṅkajā | nānyatsācintayaddevī jagajjanmādisaṃsthitim || itthaṃ dhyāyantī candraśekharapadaṃ cotphullahṛtpadmagaṃ devī nandananandane'pi girijā sāpāravaśyāntarā | nānyatkiñcana [nānyatkiṃcidamanyata iti pāṭhāntaram |] vidyate tribhuvane nissārametajjaga- ttucchīkṛtya mahācchamānasaparā svātmānamīśaṃ hṛdi || 61 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsavarṇane devīpūjāstutikathanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 ||
kailāsaprāsādavarṇanaṃ nāma aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– tasyāntare ca prākāro navaratnavicitritaḥ | aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇāṃ yojanocchrayakalpitaḥ || caturdaśamaheśena manasaiva prakalpitaḥ | brahmāṇḍordhvagamaulī sa prodyadbhānusahasrabhāḥ || 2 || na devā na ca gandharvā na yakṣoragarākṣasāḥ | gaṇendrairapi duṣprekṣyaḥprākāro ratnakalpitaḥ || tatra śailāśśivenaiva cāṣṭadikṣu pratiṣṭhitāḥ | niṣado hemakūṭaśca vindhyo malayadardurau || mandaro himavāṃścaiva nīlo'traiva prakāśitaḥ | teṣāṃ tapasyayā śambhussantuṣṭo nitarāṃ tadā || svāvāse'pi mahāśaile mahākailāsaparvate | teṣāṃ nityaṃ nivasatiṃ dadau kāruṇyataśśivaḥ || anyatra te śilāśailāḥ kailāse ratnasannibhāḥ | tatprākārāṣṭakoṇeṣu vihitāśśūlapāṇinā ||
pṛ0 116) pūrvato niṣadho bhāti cāgneyyāṃ hemakūṭakaḥ | vindhyo'sau dakṣiṇe bhāti malayo naiṛte sthitaḥ || 8 || vāruṇyāṃ darduro bhāti vāyavyāṃ bhāti mandaraḥ | himavānuttare bhāti caiśānyāṃ nīlaparvataḥ || aṣṭadikṣu sthitā ete mahākailāsaparvate | svamaulibhirbhāsayanti diśāṃ stomaṃ nagottamāḥ || tanmaulisaudhaśikharaissūryacandrātikāntikaiḥ | māṇikyakāntirnitaṣadhaścaindryāmindradhanuḥ prabhaḥ || 11 || indragopanibho bhāti bhābhāsitadigantaraḥ | abhraṅkaṣaissvaśṛṅgāgrairlelihāna ivāmbaram || tanmauliṣu sthitāpāraratnagopurabhāsuraḥ | nānārudrāvatāraiśca vṛṣabhaiścaiva śobhitaḥ || 13 || bhāti bhāsitadikcakro muṣṇaṃścakṣūṃṣi kāntibhiḥ | tacchailamaulijottuṅgagajaratnorukumbhakaḥ || 14 || sahasrasindhurottuṅgadharapīṭho'mitaprabhaḥ | mahātalo mahāsaudhassahasrastambhamaṇḍitaḥ || dāḍimībījasaṅkāśassvacchakāntitatorubhāḥ | sopānavedikopetasahasratalamaṇḍitaḥ || padmarāgamaṇistambhakalaśaiścaiva śobhitaḥ | nānāratnamahāmālāpariṣkṛtatadantaraḥ || 17 || tadratnaratnakāntyā ca saindrīdigratnavarṇakā | vibhāti maṇḍalaṃ bhānostatsaudhāruṇakāntibhiḥ || āraktaṃ hi nabho viprā bhāti tacchailakāntibhiḥ | tatrāgarumahādhūmairbahulairgandhavattaraiḥ || praphullavanajāpāragandhabandhitamārutaiḥ | tatra sihmāsanāsīno devyā sākaṃ maheśvaraḥ || krīḍatyatyantamudito gaṇabṛndaniṣevitaḥ | tadakhaṇḍamahāstambhānpadmarāgaprakalpitān || sa eva dyotayatyantaḥ koṭibhāskarasaprabhaḥ | paśyannaindrīndiśaṃ śambhustatraivāpyamarāvatīm || tatrendrasadanandevānindrādīnamarānapi | devānāṃ nandanotphullakusumāmodimārutam || jighrantsvāṅgamahāhārakākodarasupāraṇam | saptābdhicalanāsphālataraṅgāvalimīśvaraḥ || phenabudbudajālaiśca śivanandanananditaḥ | taraṅgahastaiśca sadā namanta iva sāgarān || 25 || tattadabdhimahādvīpamaṇḍalaṃ sarito nagāḥ | vanāni devayānañca svargiṇāñca gatīstathā || bhogaṃ pātaṅkarmiṇāñca paśyanhṛṣyati cāmbayā | niṣadheśālayaṃ tatra maṇikumbhamanoharam || niṣadho mūrtimāṃstatra talliṅgaṃ pūjayaṃstadā | bhasmarudrākṣasampanno divyaiḥ pañcāmṛtaistadā || gandhaiścaiva ca vāsobhirbilvamandāracampakaiḥ | dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyaistāmbūlaiśca namaṃstadā ||
pṛ0 117) pradakṣiṇābhissatataṃ niṣadheśaṃ stuvaṃsthitaḥ || 30 ||
niṣadhaḥ– niṣadheśaṃ bhavarogabheṣajaṃ suniṣaṇṇaṃ sakale'pi bhūtavarge | viṣamākṣaṃ kaluṣairvihīnadehaṃ praṇamāmīśvaramevameva nityam || 31 ||
skandaḥ– evaṃ stauti mahādevaṃ niṣadhaḥ prāgdiśi sthitaḥ | hemakūṭastathāgneyyāṃ diśi maulau mahāprabhaḥ || gomedakamahāratnabhāsuronnatamastakaḥ | svakāntibhistathāgneyīṃ diśaṃ samrāḍayaṃ sthitaḥ || gopurāpāraśikharaiḥ khamaulitaṭasaṃsthitaiḥ | maharlokātigaiśśṛṅgairmahāmaṇivarāṅkitaiḥ || rudrāvatāracaritairgovṛṣottamamastakaiḥ | maṇikumbhaiśca vitatai ratnamālāvalambitaiḥ || 35 || tatra saudho mahānuccairgomedamaṇisundaraḥ | gomedamaṇijottuṅga mahāpālīsahasrakaḥ || 36 || sahasrapālīpīṭhasthastambhavidrumaputrikaḥ | sahasraṃ pālayaṃstatra vaiḍūryavarapīṭhakam || 37 || sahasratalasaṃyukto maṇidhārācchapālikaḥ | tadāgneyamahākoṇa gopureṣvantarā sthitaḥ || vedikāpaṭṭikopeto devagoṣṭhaiśca maṇḍitaḥ | lalāmarājadvṛṣabho valabhīpariveṣṭitaḥ || 39 || bālārkavitatachāyassvacchāntasstambhakāntikṛt | tasminmaṇimaye mañce lambamāne ca saṃsthitaḥ || 40 || maṇiśṛṅkhalasaṃrājadvitānapariveṣṭite | kuthopadhānaissvāstīrṇe tiṣṭhatīśassahāmbayā || āgneyabahulāmodavanagandhaiśca sundaram | māruto vāti dhūpānāṃ pramodāmodasundaraḥ || tamālasundaravanamagnilokavibhūṣaṇam | agnidiksaudhagaṃ [ānalaissaudhagaistatreti pāṭhāntaram |] tatra sevitaṃ sumanoharam || 43 || agnīśvarābhidhaṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayanto hi vahnayaḥ | āgneyagaṇapaiścaiva tatra tallokavāsibhiḥ || purā samarcya talliṅgaṃ sarvabhakṣakṛtā dadhat | vimuktassa tadā vahnistaṃ paśyan śaṅkaro'mbayā || tatratyalokanicayaṃ saptābdhipariveṣṭitam | dvīpānvanāni saritaḥ paśyatyambāsamanvitaḥ || hemakūṭo mahāśailo mūrtimānliṅgamaiśvaram | hemakūṭeśvaraṃ nāmnā pratiṣṭhāpyātra bhāvanaiḥ || stauti devaṃ mahādevaṃ [hemakūṭo bhasmarudrākṣadhṛṅnagaḥ iti pāṭhāntaram |] hemakūṭaśśubhavrataḥ || 48 ||
pṛ0 118) hemakūṭaḥ– pāpādrikūṭakuliśottama hemakūṭa vīṭīkṛtākhila sumeruja hemakūṭa | prodyatsudhāṃśucayamaulitaṭorubhāsvatkoṭīra ghoṭakakṛtāgamakūṭa pāhi || 49 || itthaṃ sadā hemakūṭastatra stauti maheśvaram || 50 || śailasaudhakapare parameśyā cārucandraśakalāṅkitamauliḥ | nandibhṛṅgigaṇapaiśca sarvataḥ krīḍati śrutiśikhāmalavākyaiḥ || 51 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsaprāsādavarṇanaṃ nāma aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 ||
kailāsasaudhavarṇanaṃ nāma ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– yaḥ paspardha purā meruṃ vindhyo'sau cārukandaraḥ | yanmaulinilayā devī so'yaṃparvataśekharaḥ || indranīlamayastatra dakṣiṇe bhāti bhūdharaḥ | lihantsajihvayā lokānāste so'tyantasundaraḥ || tyaktvā svānatijātyantaduḥkhaṃ tatra ghaṭodbhavāt | sūryātigagatībhiśca śṛṅgairaṅkitadiktaṭaḥ || maheśāśrayajonmādamudito vindhyabhūdharaḥ | tanmauligopurottuṅgaśikharairvṛṣabhairapi || 4 || mahānīlagaṇodyadbhānīlīkṛtadigantaraḥ | tanmaulitilakoddāmapuṇḍarīkasahasrakaiḥ || 5 || daṃṣṭrākarālairvikṛtairdhāritassaudhasattamaḥ | vedikāpaṭṭikopetasahasrastambhamaṇḍitaḥ || 6 || tatrāgarumahādhūpairjvālojvalitadīpakaiḥ | sahasratalasaṃyukto nīlakumbhojvalacchikhaḥ || nīlasāraiśca vṛṣabhairmaṇinetraiśca śobhitaḥ | sphaṭikendramahānīlajālakāṅkitakuṭṭimaḥ || nīranīlotpalakṛtacārumālāvibhūṣitaḥ | gavākṣita ivābhāti cāmbaraṃ tatra sundaram || tasmintsaudhottame mañce cendranīlorupādake | tasminmañcoparilasannīlalohita īśvaraḥ || devyā sadāste nitarāṃ gaṇabṛndaniṣevitaḥ | paśyan yāmīndiśaṃ śambhuryamaṃ saṃyaminīśvaram || narakāṇāṃ vicitrāśca gatayastatra śaṅkaraḥ | kliśyamānāndahyamānānpacyamānānmahenasaḥ || aśaivānatha pāpiṣṭhānbhasmarudrākṣavarjitān | liṅgārcanavihīnāṃśca śivanāmojjhitāṃstathā || rudrādhyāyajapairhīnānpañcākṣaravivarjitān | śivanaivedyarahitānmalāśīṃstatra śaṅkaraḥ ||
pṛ0 119) saptābdhiveṣṭitāpārabhūmibhāgānmaheśvaraḥ | nagāṃśca saritaḥ puṇyā vanānyupavanāni ca || krīḍatyatyantamudito devo devyā maheśvaraḥ | vindhyamaulimahāsaudhe nīlendramaṇikalpite || vindhyo vindhyeśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ tatra sampūjya bhaktitaḥ | pañcāmṛtaiḥphalarasaiścandanairdhūpadīpakaiḥ || bilvacampakamandārakaravīrasupaṅkajaiḥ | pradakṣiṇānatībhiśca maṇinīrājanairapi || 18 || sampūjya vindhyassaṃstauti bhaktyā vindhyeśvaraṃ śivam || 19 ||
vindhyaḥ– vindhyeśa vandhyadivaso na bhavetkadācittvatpādapūjananatistutibhirmamādya | vandhyo'pi tvatpadaniveditabhojyabhuksyādvindhyopamaṃ dṛḍhataraṃ hi sutaṃ labheta ||
skandaḥ– itthaṃ stauti sadā vindhyo vindhyeśaṃ tatra śailarāṭ | malayo naiṛte bhāti rājatsundaraśekharaḥ || 21 || puṣparāgamaṇiprakhyo nānānirjharakandaraḥ | ramyaśṛṅgāgravilasadgopurāvalibhāsuraḥ || 22 || rudrakrīḍādisahito lalāmavṛṣabhāñcitaḥ | svaprabhābhāsitollāsisarvalokātigo nagaḥ || bhāti bhūmidharastatra saudhottamavibhūṣitaḥ | sahasrasārasottuṅgaśirobhirdhārito mahān || puṣparāgamaṇīkḷptasahasrastambhamaṇḍitaḥ | suratnakalaśopetassahasratalamaṇḍitaḥ || 25 || parārdhyaratnakhacitasihmāsanavarāśrayaḥ | ratnagucchamahāpuṣpasarālambitapīṭhabhūḥ || 26 || tatrasthabhūṣaṇopeto devyā krīḍati śaṅkaraḥ | mahāmalayajodbhūtacandanāmodimārutaiḥ || candracandanaliptāṅgo mahākalpakapuṣpadhṛk | guggulūddāmasubhagadhūmāmoditadiktaṭaḥ || tānnaiṛtīṃ diśaṃ śambhuḥ paśyanniṛtijāngaṇān | kṛṣṇānkarālānvikaṭānnistriṃśavaradhāriṇaḥ || 29 || saptāmbudhīnāṃ koṇāni tadantargatabhūmapi | dvīpāṃśca saritaśśailānvanāni ca maheśvaraḥ || malayena svanāmnā vai liṅgantanmalayeśvaram | maṇidhāmamayaṃ tatra pūjitaṃ sarvakāmadam || pañcāmṛtaiścandanaiśca bilvamandāracampakaiḥ | dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyaiḥ praṇāmaprakramādibhiḥ || saṃstuvanparayā bhaktyā giriṇā malayena ca || 33 ||
pṛ0 120) malayaḥ– malayeśa maheśa śaṅkara pramathādhīśvara cārucandramaule | tvayi jātamidaṃ jagatkilāpi śambho pralayaṃ yāti laye tvadīyakukṣau || 34 ||
skandaḥ– itthaṃ stauti sadā devaṃ malayaśśailasattamaḥ | darduraḥ paścime bhāti nānāśṛṅgavarāśrayaḥ || vaiḍūryasārasubhagatatsūtrachavinā tataḥ | tanmauligopurāpāraśikharairatibhāsuraḥ || 36 || rudrāvatāracaritairmahokṣagaṇasaṅkulaḥ | dodhūyamānaśṛṅgāgrapatākāvaliśobhitaḥ || 37 || mahāśārdūlasāhasradhāritastanmaṇiprabhaiḥ | sahasrastambhasaṃyukto vedikāpaṭṭikānvitaḥ || muktācchagucchasañchādivitānavitatāntaraḥ | dhūpāmodātibahulagandhananditadiktaṭaḥ || vaiḍūryasāragarbhācchasundarāntarakāñcitaḥ | tatra sihmāsanaṃ divyaṃ pañcayojanakalpitam || parārdhyāstaraṇopetaṃ tasmindevyā maheśvaraḥ | viharatyantaragaṇairvaruṇo vāruṇīṃ śritaḥ || diśaṃ payodhināthena pālitāṃ yādasāṃ tadā | vaiḍūryaratnamakuṭataṭabaddhenduśekharaḥ || 42 || maṇikuṇḍalagaṇḍodyatprabhādhavalitāṅgakaḥ | valayāhīśvarodbhāsiphaṇāphaṇitahastakaḥ || kṛṣṇāgarusudhūpotthadhūmadhārānurañjitaḥ | mahārhavasanopetaścalaccāmaravījitaḥ || 44 || tadvaiḍūryamahāsūtradhārāvidyoditāntaraḥ | paśyanpaścimadiṅnāthaṃ varuṇaṃ tadgaṇānapi || 45 || pāśahastānharidvarṇānkarālāruṇadaṃṣṭrakān | tatra saptābdhivalayaṃ nadīnadavanāni [nadīnāṃ vadanānica iti pāṭhāntaram |] ca || 46 || devabhāgāṃśca tatratyān kṣetrāṇi ca maheśvaraḥ | viharatyambayā sārdhaṃ saudhe tasminpinākadhṛk || 47 || dardureśābhidhaṃ tena pūjītaṃ divyadhāmagam | pañcāmṛtāsecanaiśca gandhairbilvaiśca campakaiḥ || 48 || dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyairnamanaprakramastavaiḥ | tuṣṭāva darduro devaṃ dardureśaṃ maheśvaram || 49 ||
darduraḥ– pāpāpāramataṅgakumbhaharaṇe tvaṃ śaṅkaro darduro bhīmo'hīśvarakaṅkaṇottamalasatpāṇīnakhodyatprabhaḥ |
pṛ0 121) sihmassarvasureśvaro hi bhagavānindūkapardojvala- ssarveṣāṃ janitā garāñcitagalaḥ [garaṃjarayitā keśaṃ guṇairiti haraṃjarayitākośo guṇairiti ca pāṭhāntaram |] kāśe guṇairvācakaḥ || 50 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsasaudhavarṇanaṃ nāma ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 ||
śailakṛtastutirnāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– vāyavyāṃ mandarastatra maṇisundarakandaraḥ | maheśasya priyo nityaṃ sarvamandārananditaḥ || mandāratarubhistasya maulisthairdyotitā diśaḥ | harinmaṇiprabhājālapariṣkṛtadigantaraḥ || so'yutaṃ yojanāyāmairvistārocchrāyavistaraḥ | atulassarvaśikhariśikhāvrātaikasundaraḥ || candanānanditamukhassumagandhojvalacchikhaḥ | ratnasālatamālālimaulipālivirājitaḥ || tatraiva mandaroddāma śekharairamitaprabhaiḥ | vibhānti taddharimaṇiharitāśśāḍvalopamāḥ || 5 || cakāsti taddiśāṃ vaktraṃ nānāpakṣimṛgairyutam | tanmauligopurāpārakalaśadyotitāmbaraḥ || rudrāvatāracaritairdhenupotagaṇaiśśubhaiḥ | sahasrahaṃsamaulisthasaudharājivirājitaḥ || 7 || vedisopānakopetassahasrastambhamaṇḍitaḥ | talairvallitapālībhirvalabhībhirvicitritaiḥ || 8 || tasyāntarmaṇipādācchasvacchasihmāsanaṃ varam | sāmrāṇidhūpabahalagandhagandhavahāśrayaḥ || ratnajālamahāsālajālakāvalikīlitaḥ | mandarotthamahānanda sumasundaramārutaḥ || 10 || divyamandārajāmodaphullamālāvṛtodaraḥ | harinmaṇimahādīpa sāradhārāvṛtāntaraḥ || 11 || tatra devyā haritkāntyā vāmabhāgasthayā śivaḥ | sevito haritoddāmapādamañce'dhisaṃsthitaḥ || vāyuṃ satyavadālokāṃstatratyāngaṇapānapi | sāgarāntarajāndvīpānvanāni sarito nagān || devalokāṃstathādevo devyā lokānpratīkṣayan | mandareṇārcitaṃ tatra liṅgaṃ sundaramandire || nāmnaiva mandareśānamindukundasamaprabham | pañcāmṛtaistathā nīraiścandanairbilvapallavaiḥ || aravindamarandaiśca mandāratarujaissumaiḥ | dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyairnamanaprakramaistathā || 16 || ānandasundarodārastavaissaṃstauti bhaktitaḥ || 17 ||
pṛ0 122) mandaraḥ– śrīmandareśa vividhāgamamaulibṛndasandohananditapadāmbujabhṛṅgabhāvam | samprārthayāmi taruṇendukalālalāma bṛndāravanditapadāmbujasevayāham || 18 ||
skandaḥ– itthaṃ stauti sadā devaṃ mandaraścārukandaraḥ | mama mātāmahoddāmaśekharairarditā diśaḥ || hīrasāramayo bhāti himavān gaganātigaḥ | himasāramahādhārāśaśikāntaśilāmayaḥ || tatkāntikāntitā lokā mahāgopurabhāsuraḥ | rudrāvatāracaritairvṛṣastomavirājitaḥ || niyutaṃ yojanāyāmaḥ kailāsottarabhāgagaḥ | sahasrakesarisaṭātaṭabhrājisupāṇḍaraḥ || 22 || taddhāritamahāhīraprāsādodyacchikhāśrayaḥ | sahasrastambhasaṃyukto ramyasopānavedikaḥ || mahāhimaghanībhūtacandrasphaṭikapīṭhakaḥ | samphullamodivipinasumagandhitamārutaḥ || 24 || śilārasamahārītigandhamādyatsumadrumaḥ | takkolāgarukastūrīmodicandanamastakaḥ || 25 || kuravāśokavakulacampakoddāmagandhakaḥ | karṇikāramahāvaktrastilakāṅkitamastakaḥ || 26 || kuṭajoddāmamakuṭo vaṭāsaṭajaṭādharaḥ | tripuṇṭrakakṛtākāratakkolāṅkolasundaraḥ || 27 || mahāhimakarākāra mahāhivaradhṛṅnagaḥ | haramaulijaṭollāsi himadhāmojvalaprabhaḥ || 28 || divyagaṅgāpayaḥpūranirjharāvṛtakandharaḥ | svakīyamaulisaudhastha paṅkajākārasaprabhaḥ || 29 || gaurīśaṅkarapādābja dhyānanirdhūtahṛttamaḥ | jāmātṛkanyakānandaṃ prītyā śaileśvarastadā || nitarāṃ harṣavarṣāśrukaṇānmuñcanniva sthitaḥ | nīlapītāruṇāpārarītibhāsurakandaraḥ || tatra tacchailaśikhare mahāhīropalaiḥ kṛte | hīrajālakasañchanne hīramañcācchapādake || 32 || parārdhyāstaraṇāstīrṇe tagaroddāmadhūpite | hīrakāntimaṇijyotsnānivāritatamogaṇe || mahāhīndramaṇivrātākalpabhūṣitavigrahaḥ | devyā harinmaṇitataśarīravarakāntayā || 34 || nitarāṃ mañcamadhyastho bhāti bhābhirmaheśvaraḥ | svapituśśikhare devī nitarāṃ toṣaveṣabhūḥ || ramayatyeva deveśaṃ yathā kanyā pitṛkṣaye | bhartrā nityaṃ pramodeta na tathā śvaśurālaye || devyā viharatīśānaḥ paśyandhanapaterdiśam | yakṣogaṇoṣitāṃ tatra tathaivailabileḥ purīm || śātakumbhamahābhūmimuttarāṃśca kurūṃstathā | devodyānāni puṇyāni saptābdhipariveṣṭanam || svarṇatālaphalaṃ tatra tatphalāmodigandhabhūḥ | tāmrapṛṣṭāṃ tathā bhūmiṃ sahasraṃ yojanāyatām ||
pṛ0 123) sudhāsāgaramadhyasthamaṇidvīpaṃ śivapriyam | nīpāpāravanaṃ tacca ratnanīpaissamāvṛtam || 40 || himaśailāmalākāradhārāsaudhe maheśvaraḥ | devyā viharati svairaṃ calaccāmaravījanaiḥ || 41 || ratnacāmpeyamālābhirbhūṣitastatra śaṅkaraḥ | gaṇendrairudyatalasattriśūlakarabhāsuraiḥ || 42 || himācaleśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ candraspaṭikadhāmagam | apāravarivasyābhirhimaśailena cārcitam || 43 || pañcāmṛtaiḥ phalarasaissugandhairyakṣakardamaiḥ | bilvāravindakahlāraiścampakairbakasambhavaiḥ || 44 || dhūpadīpopahāraiśca praṇāmaprakramādibhiḥ | astauṣīddhimaśaileśaṃ himavāṃśca kṛtāñjaliḥ || 45 ||
himavān– pariṇatahimadhāmakāntirājajjaṭayālaṅkṛtagaṅgayorubhāsam | bhavadānanapaṅkajotpalābhai ravisomānalalocanairvilokayāśu [vilokayāśumāntvamityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacit |] || 46 ||
skandaḥ– itthaṃ himācalasstauti himamaulimaheśvaram | nīlo vibhāti caiśānyāṃ kailāsāmalaparvate || 47 || ramyasānuśatopetassahasraśikharairvṛtaḥ | nīlo'pi vāmataśśailaḥ pravālamaṇibhāsuraḥ || 48 || udārataragambhīraśekharāleḍitāmbaraḥ | aiśānyāṃ gopurairbhāti rudrakrīḍāparīvṛtaḥ || 49 || udyaddyumaṇisaṅkāśakalaśairatibhāsuraḥ | bhūsurāṇāñca śaraṇaissubhāsuranagāvṛtaḥ || 50 || mahāgopatibhiryukto vidrumābho'ruṇorubhāḥ | tanmaulimaṇigātyucca pravālaparikalpitaiḥ || mahāśarabhasāhasrairdhāritassaudhasattamaḥ | hṛttamonāśakastatra ramyo bhūsurabhāsuraḥ || 52 || tatra rājanti vividhavedisopānapaṭṭikaḥ | sahasrastambhasaṃyuktaḥ pravālamaṇikalpitaḥ || saudharāḍagamaulistho bhātyudyattaraṇiprabhaḥ | sahasratalamaulisthapravālamaṇikumbhavān || pravālavartulātyacchamālāgucchaikaśobhitaḥ | tatraiva sumanāmodamādyadyuṅkṛtaṣaṭpadaḥ || 55 || tatpravālamaṇijyotsnānivāritatamastruṭiḥ | tasminpravālapādācchamañcake staraṇāstṛte || devyā viharati prītyā candracūḍo maheśvaraḥ | saptābdhiveṣṭitāpārabhūmayodvīpakānapi || vanāni saritaśśailānkṣetrāṇyapi maheśvaraḥ | īśānalokaṃ tatraiva nānārudragaṇairvṛtam || 58 || divyantarikṣabhūmisthairhetipāśadharairyutam | vṛkṣauṣadhīṣvathānne ca pathi śaileṣu ye carāḥ || 59 || lalāmarājaccandrārkairjaṭāmakuṭadhāribhiḥ | gaṇendrairuragendraiśca krodhāruṇitalocanaiḥ || 60 ||
pṛ0 124) brahmāṇḍadalanaiścaiva cāpītārṇavaghoṣakaiḥ | yutamīśānamāśāsyaḥ paśyatyambāsamanvitaḥ ||
skandaḥ- tattannagavaroddāmaśikhareṣu śivālayāḥ | paritassanti teṣāntu nāmnā liṅgottamā api || śṛṇuṣva jaigīṣavyatvaṃ pāpabhaṅgāya kevalam | niṣadheśo hemakeśo vindhyeśo malayeśvaraḥ || dardureśo mandareśo himaśaileśvaro haraḥ | nīleśvaro'hi parito mahāsaudhavarāśrayāḥ || ramyagopurakopetā nagāstatra vapurdharāḥ | pūjayantyatra liṅgāni bilvapatrairmanoharaiḥ || nīlo'pi tatra nīleśaṃ pūjyānekaissumairapi | dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyaisstauti nīleśvaraṃ śivam || svamaulimaṇijāpāradhāmagaṃ prāñjalistadā ||
nīlaḥ– nīlalohita mahāgarakandharāmalakapālabhujaṅgavibhūṣaṇa | kālakālabhagavankṛpāmbudhe tārayāśu bhavasaṃsṛtijālam || 67 || itthaṃ stuvanti te śailā girīśāṃ giriśaṃ tadā || 68 ||
girayaḥ– hara hara parameśa devadeva tripurayamāndhakajātabhītināśa | agapatitanayādhava prabho naḥ paripāhīśvara devasārvabhauma || 69 || bhavatā bhavatāpahāriṇā vasatā nākaśirotthasaudhamaulau | vayamapyamalā nagāśśilābhirnagavallītṛṇapakṣivīrudhaiḥ || 70 || sumṛgairapi candracūḍa śambho gatibhājassutarāṃ ca dhanyadhanyāḥ | vedeṣu prathito'si rudra bhagavan mīḍhuṣṭamaśśaṅkaro babhruśśambhurakhaṇḍaghoṣakaraṇaścogro'si bhīmo'si ca | asmākantvadhipo'si pāhi dayayā khyāto nirīśo'pi ca || 71 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe śailakṛtastutirnāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 ||
pṛ0 125) prākāravarṇane rudragaṇārcanaṃ nāma ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– tasmādatyuttame viprā gaṇā viṣṇvādayassurāḥ | kailāsamaulau tacchambhornavaratnapariṣkṛtaḥ || prākāro lakṣamānena cāyāmocchrāyasammataḥ | indragopakasaṅkāśasudhāmaṇimahopalaḥ || kalpito'sti maheśena manasaiva dvijottamāḥ | namayo viśvakarmāpi tatkailāsavarālayam || manasā kalpituṃ śakyaṃ kiṃ śilpairakhilairapi | nānāratnamaṇivrātabhāsuraścandrasundaraḥ || śāṇollīḍhāmalamaṇikāntisāro'yamuttamaḥ | ramyo gandharvanagarākārākāro'yamunnataḥ || tatprākāravarottuṅgamaṇīndravṛṣabhāñcitaḥ | antarikṣe rudragaṇāstacchrīprākārarakṣakāḥ || ekādaśasahasraṃ vai bāṇakārmukapāṇayaḥ | mahāniṣaṅgapraṣṭhāste kapardadhṛtacandrakāḥ || 7 || sihmasaṃhananāssarve yuvāno mṛṣṭakuṇḍalāḥ | kariśṛṅgābhavṛttorubhujadaṇḍavarāyudhāḥ || 8 || cintāmaṇigaṇāsāragopuraṃ kumbharañjitam | rudrāvatāracaritaiśśobhitaṃ sumanoharam || 9 || maulisaṃsthamahānandinanditākhiladiktaṭam | prācyāṃ tadgopuraṃśambho rakṣantigaṇapāssadā || 10 || prākārañcāpi te sarve triśūlodyatapāṇayaḥ | tatra śambhorgaṇairlliṅgaṃ pūjitaṃ sarvakāmadam || 11 || maṇirudreśvaraṃ nāmnā cintāmaṇigaṇakṣaye | prodyatkumbhaikavasatā pūjitaṃ taṃ gaṇeśvaraiḥ || 12 || saṃstutaṃ parayā bhaktyā cāntirikṣe gaṇaistadā || 13 ||
rudrāḥ– saṃsāratāpajamahārujamāśu ceśa sadyo vināśaya maheśvara cārudṛṣṭyā | rudro bhavān śrutiśikhāmalagītakīrte pāhīśa vedavacanairbhiṣajāṃ tvamīśaḥ ||
skandaḥ– evaṃ stuvanti taṃ devaṃ maṇibhadreśvaraṃ gaṇāḥ | taddakṣiṇe'pi prākāraṃ muktāratnavinirmitam || tanmadhyagopuravaraṃ maṇimāṇikyanirmitam | mahāmaṇiśikhākīlakalitaṃ śekharānvitam || rudrāvatāracaritairvṛṣabhaiśca samanvitam | ekādaśasahasraṃ vai tomarāsivarāyudhāḥ || 17 || mahābalāmahotsāhā divyāstatra gaṇāśśubhāḥ | jaṭāmukuṭaśobhāḍhyāstārānāthakalādharāḥ || śivājñākāriṇassarve yauvanonmattavigrahāḥ | tatra sampūjayantyeva divyarudreśvaraṃ hi te || maṇidhāmni mahāliṅgaṃ sampūjya stuvaṃtīśvaram || 20 ||
pṛ0 126) rudragaṇāḥ– divyeśvara tridaśavargajajātaduḥkhasantāpabṛndapuranāśana te vinītam | deveśa te varadayārasapātramīśa tvasmāntsadāśiva sadaiva surakṣatānnaḥ || 21 || evaṃ stuvanti te rudrā divyarudreśvaraṃ tadā | gopuraṃ tacca prākāraṃ rakṣanti satataṃ gaṇāḥ || tatpaścānmaṇisaṅkḷptaprākāraṃ maṇigopuram | rudrāvatāracaritairlalāmavṛṣaśekharaiḥ || 23 || prollasatkakudaiścaiva maṇīndramukuṭairapi | tatra rakṣanti gaṇapā hetiśūlavarāyudhāḥ || 24 || tripuṇṭrāvaliphālorukapardavaramaulayaḥ | bālāruṇapratiprakhyacañcaccandrakalādharāḥ || 25 || ekādaśasahasraṃ vai rakṣanti gaṇapāssadā | dakṣādhvaravināśāya maheśāṅgādvinirgatāḥ || raumyā nāma gaṇaśreṣṭhā mattamātaṅgavikramāḥ | tatra te pūjayantyeva raumyeśaṃ maṇidhāmagam || pūjayanti stuvantyeva raumyānāma gaṇāśśivam || 28 ||
raumyāḥ– tvadromajātavidhayo haraviṣṇusaṅghā rakṣanti deva jagatāṃ sthitināśake'pi | tvatpādapaṅkajarajaśśirasā vahantaḥ pāhīśa no'dya kṛpayā sarasārdradṛṣṭyā || itthaṃ stuvantite raumyā maheśaṃ bhaktibhāvitāḥ | uttare bhaumakānāma gaṇāśśambhormahātmanaḥ || ekādaśasahasrantu vikośīkṛtahetayaḥ | daṃṣṭrākarālavadanā jaṭābaddhendukhaṇḍakāḥ || 31 || sajaloddāmaghanabhāssadehāste'tulaprabhāḥ | bhasmadigdhāstripuṇṭrāṅkā rudrākṣāvalibhāsurāḥ || kheṭaṭakkādhvanibhṛtastaṭitkūṭasamāravāḥ | uragendrādhikakrodhā uragendrādhikā jave || śivājñākāriṇo bhaumā balavīryaparākramāḥ | tatottare ca prākāre maṇisālojvalaprabhe || tanmadhyagopure cāpi rudrakrīḍāvṛṣairyute | maṇirājanmahākumbhe rañjite bhānusaprabhe || 35 || tiṣṭhanti te ca rakṣanti prākāraṃ tacca gopuram | taiśca bhaumeśvaro nāmnā maṇidhāmagato'rcitaḥ || saṃstutaḥ parayābhaktyāliṅgasaṃstho maheśvaraḥ || 37 ||
bhaumāḥ– bhaumeśa bhīmarathatuṅgarathāṅgadāne sammodito hariharāmbujalocanena | bhūmātigākhilagate paripāhi somadhāmottamāṅga lalanāñcitacārudeha || 38 ||
pṛ0 127) skandaḥ– iti stuvanti te bhaumā mahādevaṃ ghṛṇānidhim | viṃśatsahasraṃ paritaḥ prākāramaṇigopuraiḥ || śobhitaṃ vṛṣabhaiścitrairnānāśilpaikasundaraiḥ | manasāpyanumānena nopameyaṃ manoharaiḥ || 40 || caturdikṣvapi te rudrā brahmaviṣṇvindrahantṛkāḥ | hetiśūlakarāssarve bhasmapāṇḍaravigrahāḥ || rambhopamānavṛttoruūrudvayavirājitāḥ | vakṣaḥkavāṭapaṭṭābhahiraṇyakavacāvṛtāḥ || 42 || uṣṇīṣiṇomukuṭinaścoragendrorumaulayaḥ | dhāvantassaṃsthitāḥ kecinniṣaṇṇāssvāpakāḥpare || niṣaṅgiṇaḥ kavacinaśśarakārmukapāṇayaḥ | varṣantaśśaravarṣaiścāpyaśaivānnunnasāyakaiḥ || 44 || pathi vṛkṣe jale caiva sāgarai bhuvisaṃsthitāḥ | vipine ca tathā grāme pure kharve [kharve'ṭake tathā iti pāṭhāntaram |] vṛke tathā || śivājñākāriṇassarve cāgnidīptā mahaujasaḥ || 46 ||
sūtaḥ– evante varagopuraiśca sahitā rudrāścaturdikṣvapi prākāraṃ maṇisārasuntaratamaṃ rājadvṛṣādhiṣṭhitam || 47 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe prākāravarṇane rudragaṇārcanannāma ekatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 31 ||
sabhāvarṇanaṃ nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 ||
skandaḥ– tasyāntare śivenaiva manasā parinirmitāḥ | viṃśatsahasramānena āyāmochrāyatastadā || prāgdakṣiṇe pratīcyāṃ vai cottare śūlapāṇinā | maṇiprabhādhikajyotikailāsanagamauligāḥ || kaladhautanagoddāmaśikhare tilakāyitāḥ | pumarthā iva rājantyaścaturvedaśikhopamāḥ || 3 || raṅgasthānaṃ maheśasya śambhossandhyānaṭasya ca | śātakumbhamahākumbhasahasreṇopaśobhitāḥ || niṣṭaptahemakḷptāste mahāmeruguhopamāḥ | tattatkumbhamahāstambhasahasrapariśobhitāḥ || 5 || subaddhamaṇisopānā vedikāpaṭṭikojvalāḥ | marālarājavalyutthamuktābhakṣitacañcukāḥ || utkocanīlapītāccharatnajālakacitritāḥ | muktāgucchāvṛtāpāramālājālakitāntarāḥ ||
pṛ0 128) pravālalatikākḷptastambhavidrumaputrikāḥ | harinmaṇikṛtāpārapālibandhoruhastakāḥ || 8 || puṣparāgamahāsihmasaṭāmaṇḍalakīlitāḥ | gajaśuṇḍorudhārācchanīlakumbhorumaulikāḥ || vaiḍūryadhārāsūtrodyannāgabandhavirājitāḥ | molipālijahaṃsālikapotakulasundarāḥ || ratnotkīrṇācchavalabhīvṛtorumaṇimaulayaḥ | kuruvindamahotphullamālājālāvṛtāntarāḥ || sphaṭikottamagarbhācchadhārāsopānakīlitāḥ | vicitrajālikāpālicitanīlamahopalāḥ || bimbābhapadmarāgotthakelipālivirājitāḥ | suvarṇaparisaṃkḷptarambhāpūgaikabhāsurāḥ || harinmaratakoddāmagarbhasaptacchadāvṛtāḥ | dantidantāvalīlagnahaṃsālīvṛṣakīlitāḥ || 14 || kapotapālīpīṭhastha maṇiśārdūlanāsikāḥ | suvarṇaketakīgucchatatphalāvalibhāsurāḥ || maṇipānasajāmrādiphalāliparilambitāḥ | mātuliṅgaiśca likucaiḥ protamālāvṛtāntarāḥ || maṇidhārāvṛṣaiḥ kumbhaissupallavasumairyutāḥ | damanoruvitānācchasañchāditatalāmbarāḥ || uśīrapaṭagucchaiśca lambalolitabhāsurāḥ | gandhabandhānubandhodyanmandamārutasundarāḥ || mahāgarumahoddāmadhūpadhūmaśikhāvṛtāḥ | maṇidīpāvalīvṛttabhramadgṛhavarāñcitāḥ || 19 || sahasradīpapātraiśca dhūpavṛkṣaiśca lambitāḥ | maṇisāraiśca vividhavarṇakḷptorukuṭṭimāḥ || 20 || spaṭikāktatalāssarvā ramyādarśakalambitāḥ | suvarṇarekhāvilasanmaṇicitravicitritāḥ || nānārudrāvatārādidevyāśca naṭanaṃ tadā | śambhorgaṇendratilakairvṛtacitravicitritāḥ || 22 || suramyamaṇivedībhissaṃyutā dhūpamoditāḥ | vistārāyāmabahulāssahasrastambhamaṇḍitāḥ || ṣaṇṇavādimahātatvajālāpārāvṛtāntarāḥ | rājallalāmavṛṣabhā ratnakumbhapariṣkṛtāḥ || ratnadaṇḍāyutāpārachatracāmaraśobhitāḥ | dodhūyitapatākāgrā maṇighaṇṭāvṛtāntarāḥ || 25 || kastūrīcandrapāṭīrasugandhasumavarṣitāḥ | maṇidarpaṇajottuṅgabimbitāmalajālikāḥ || mandaroddāmagambhīranādāpūritadiṅmukhāḥ [maddaloddāma iti pāṭhāntaran |] | śaṅkhadundubhinissāṇapaṇavānakagomukhaiḥ || kāhalāpāraninadaveṇuvīṇāravākulāḥ | maṇimandāravakulapāṭalāśokacampakaiḥ || 28 || vilambitācchamālāstāstamālatalasundarāḥ | kṛtamālamahāmālāgucchasañchāditāṃbarāḥ || 29 || kundamallījamullījajājīmālāvṛtāntarāḥ | galanmadhujharībhāragucchaguñjadalivrajāḥ [gacchadalivrajā iti pāṭhāntaram |] || 30 || kadambadāmasubhagā damanoddāmagandhitāḥ | kuravāmoditośīramaruvāmodamoditāḥ || 31 ||
pṛ0 129) uśīrakakṛtāpāramālāndolanasundarāḥ | tārottarkitabhūbhāgamuktājālāvṛtābhuvaḥ || 32 || gaṇahastamahātālajhallarīnādahuṅkṛtāḥ | ratnamaḍḍujahuṅkāragarbhitāntarasundarāḥ || 33 || kāhalāpāragambhīranādāpūritadiṅmukhāḥ | naṭajjhaṇajhaṇārāvaśiñjanmañjīranisvanāḥ || 34 || gomukhānakajoddāmagaṇavaktrābjakāravāḥ | śaṅkhāvalīkṛtāpāradhūtkāraravagarjitāḥ || 35 || caturvedaśikhoddāmabrahmavaktrakṛtastutiḥ | vāmadevamahāsāmarathantararavākulāḥ || 36 || rāthantarotthaphūtkārabhāṅkṛtākhiladiktaṭāḥ | rājadrājanahiṅkāravairājavarabhūṣitāḥ || 37 || aṣṭāvaktroditātyacchacāṣṭadaṃṣṭrāravākulāḥ | mahāgaṇeśaśuṇḍāgralagnakuñjotthanāditāḥ || 38 || ṣaḍānanakṛtoddāmakāhalāravasundarāḥ | nandibhṛṅgikṛtānekatalaghātorumaddalaiḥ || 39 || dhiktāndhiktānitiravairaśeṣamativārakaiḥ [aśaivamatirāvakairiti pāṭhāntaram |] | taṇḍuḍiṇḍimanādottharavasundaradiṅmukhāḥ || 40 || vāṇī pāṇi mahāvīṇā śivanāmālimūrchanāḥ | tantrīyantritagāndharvagītanādaikasundarāḥ || 41 || nāradādimuniśreṣṭhastuvaduddāmagāyanāḥ [tumburūddāma iti pāṭhaḥ |] | hāhāhūhūkṛtānekamurakṣarataśikṣitāḥ [bharatākṣaraśikṣitāḥ iti pāṭhāntaram |] || 42 || yakṣaśikṣākalālāparaṅgatuṅgataraṅgikāḥ | rāgarāgiṇikākḷptaramyatristhāyimūrchanāḥ || 43 || tālamaddalajoddāmatāndhigityuttamadhvaniḥ | barhipiñchābhasubhagasphāṭikottamabhittikāḥ || 44 || maṇinissāṇanārāvaprabuddhavarakokilāḥ | kokilākākalīramyadhvanidhvananarañjitāḥ || ratnapañjaramadhyastha śukaśārikajāravāḥ | mṛdaṅgaghanaghoṣeṇa śikhaṇḍīkṛtatāṇḍavāḥ || 46 || gāyadgandharvanikaramukhavīkṣaṇakṛnmṛgāḥ | ratnadhāragajāsārapuṣkaroddāmabṛhmitāḥ || 47 || puṇṭrekṣubaddhasubhagastambharambhāvṛtāssabhāḥ | maṇivallītoraṇādilambitāndolitāḥ punaḥ || mandamārutasañcāra vitāna calitālakāḥ | śātakumbhamahākumbhapūritāmṛtadhārikāḥ || supallavamukhāpārarājadbhṛṅgārasundarāḥ | pūgāpāramahāsārāśśambhostatra mahāsabhāḥ || 50 || kḷptāstatra śivenaiva manasā mananena hi | śātakumbhamayī tatra sabhā prācyāṃ diśi sthitā || mahāratnasabhā śambhordakṣiṇe ca prakalpitā | rājatī rajatādrau tu śambhoḥ paścātsabhā tadā || citsabhā cottareśaṃbhoḥ kaladhautā calesthitā | evaṃ caturdikṣvapitāssannāhānanditāssabhāḥ || tatsabhāvarṇanaṃ devairbrahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraiḥ | mūrtimadbhistathā sāṅgairvedaniśvāsa īśvaraḥ ||
pṛ0 130) ṛgvedastu tathāprācyāmekaviṃśatiśākhakaiḥ | stauti tasyāṃ sabhāyāntu devadevaṃ maheśvaram || yajurvedastathā ratnasabhāyāṃ śataśākhakaḥ | stauti devaṃ virūpākṣaṃ baddhāñjalipuṭo mudā || kaladhautasabhāyāntu sahasravaraśākhakaḥ | stauti tatra mahādevaṃ sāmavedo'tha sāmabhiḥ || citsabhāyāṃ tathādharvavedoviṃśatsvaśākhakaiḥ | stauti devaṃ śirobhissvairatharvairīśatuṣṭidaiḥ ||
skandaḥ- sabhāsu ca divaspatiprakaṭabhānuśītāṃśuṣu | sphuratviṣi śikhidyutiprathitaratnagarbhodbhava- prakāśakalitāspade naṭati nṛttapāraṅgataḥ || 59 || sabhāpatiratīndriyaḥ pramathanāthasaṅghairvṛto- 'pyanantamahimārasaśśrutiśikhācchapālīgataḥ | surendramakuṭītaṭīvighaṭitāccharatnachaviḥ prasannanakhasantatirvidhiharīndradevaisstutaḥ || 60 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe sabhāvarṇanaṃ nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 ||
sabhāsu nṛttavarṇanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
śrīskandaḥ– sanātanasanandena sānandena maheśvaraḥ | pārvatīhṛdayānando devo yatra ca tāssabhāḥ || sadasaspatirīśāno gaṇabṛndaniṣevitaḥ | mayā dviradavaktreṇa nandibhṛṅgiriṭīśvaraiḥ || taṇḍuhuṇḍatuhuṇḍādyairbāṇarāvaṇacaṇḍikaiḥ | devyāstadagre naṭanaṃ sāṭopaṃ kartumudyataḥ || 3 || sabhāsu tāsu sarvāsu sabhāpatirumāpatiḥ | sāyaṃ sāyaṃ pradoṣeṣu mahātāṇḍavapaṇḍitaḥ || 4 || apasmāroparilasatpādapaṅkajabhāsuraḥ | gajendrakṛttivasano jaṭācūḍataṭiddyutiḥ || 5 || jaṭākuharagarbhastha gaṅgātuṅgataraṅgadhṛk | tatraivotphullakahlāramitrācchādita mastakaḥ || 6 || garanīlamahākaṇṭhaḥ kuṇḍalīśvarakuṇḍalaḥ | somadhāmasamānāsyaścāmpeyaradanāsikaḥ || 7 || nayanatritayotphullapaṅkajotphullasundaraḥ | tripuṇṭrarekhāsatphālo bhasmācchāditavigrahaḥ || 8 ||
pṛ0 131) vāmena pāṇinālambinakharaktāgrālaktakaḥ | dhagaddhagitaratnācchapadakālambimālikaḥ || 9 || mahāhīramaṇivrātamuktārudrākṣamālikaḥ | kākodaraphaṇāratnamālākīlitakandharaḥ || 10 || ratnagraiveyalalitaḥ kaṅkaṇāsaktasatkaraḥ | kvaṇatkiṅkiṇikājālakṣudraghaṇṭālikāñcikaḥ || pāṇinānyena ḍamaruṃ tathānyenojvalaprabham | saptajihvakṛtordhvāṅgaśikhākāśitasatkaraḥ || bhaktābhayakaraṃ sākṣādratnormikavarāṅguliḥ | kaṭītaṭapaṭodbhāsi puṇḍarīkājinojvalaḥ || tatpucchagucchasubhagalambamānacaladyutiḥ | brahmamuṇḍamahāṣaṇḍamālālalitakandharaḥ || nṛtyajjhaṇajhaṇārāvamaṇimañjīraratnapāt | sākuñcitena nṛtyena poṣayantaṃ jagattrayam || mahāratnapariṣkāripīṭhasaṃsthāṃ maheśvarīm | paśyandaradalāmbhojasannibhāmalalocanaiḥ || sudhādhāmatiraskāri devyā vadanapaṅkajam | līlālakodyattilakaṃ ratnatāṭaṅkamaṇḍitam || udyatkavinibhātyacchamuktānāsāmanoramam | kaṇṭhatrivaligambhīraratnagraiveyabhāsuram || lalaccintākasubhagaṃ kaṇṭhamaṇḍalamīśvaraḥ | uttuṅgakarikumbhābhasvarṇakumbhakucāṃ śubhām || trivalīlalitodāratrijagatsampuṭodarām | mṛgendrakaṭisaṅkāśaratnakāñcitakāñcikām || kanakāmbarajāpāradhārāsārajitāmbarām | campakāśokapunnāgasaugandhikalasatkacām || veṇīmaṇḍalamadhyastha ratnasīmantasundarām | alikālambilālaṃhiśobhisindūrarekhikām || kvaṇanmaṇigaṇāpārakaṅkaṇairnāgabandhakaiḥ | ratnahastasarāpāracaladvalayasatkarām || 23 || ratnāṅgulīyavilasadvalayāṅguṣṭhaveṣṭitām | mahāhīraikaphalakakalpitāṅguṣṭhaveṣṭanīm || 24 || āraktāraktapādābjaraṅgarañjitapādukām | pādāṅgulīkṛtāpārajhaṇajjhaṇamadhuvratām || 25 || maṇimañjīrajārāvajhaṇajjhaṇitabhūtalām | pāṭīrāgarukastūrīkarpūrāgandhamedurām || 26 || paṭavāsamahāgandhananditākhiladiktaṭām | saundaryadhārāsarvasvākārāṃ tārādhipānanām || 27 || hallakākrāntasukarāṃ tathānyena vilambinā | pāśāṅkuśābhayavaradharāṃ śrībhuvaneśvarīm || 28 || niryatkaṭākṣāṅkurataḥ paśyantīmānanaṃ vibhoḥ | paśyantsabhāsu tāndevīṃ sadānṛtyati śaṅkaraḥ || 29 || nandibhṛṅgimahākālaskandaherambasaṃvṛtaḥ | ramyavādyaravaissāyaṃ vedaghoṣaiśca śaṅkaraḥ || 30 || tatra tatra sabhāsthāne nṛtyatyambāsamanvitaḥ | tacchṛṇudhvaṃ muniśreṣṭhā gaṇendrāssurasattamāḥ || rājadrājakalāvirājitajaṭārājīrajoghnaṃ satāṃ rāmālaṅkṛtavāmabhāgamaniśaṃ śrīrājarājārcitam |
pṛ0 132) nṛtyantaṃ nṛśiraḥkapālakalikāmālāsphuradvakṣasaṃ nṛtyantaṃ rajatādrihemasadasi śrīdhūrjaṭiṃ bhāvaye || 32 || nṛtyadbrahmakapālaghaṭṭanapatadbrahmāṇḍakoṭisrava- dvarṣādhārasupūrapūritajaṭāgaṅgātaraṅgodbhaṭam | sevārthāgataviṣṇumukhyasuratābaddhāñjaliprārthanaṃ nṛtyantaṃ rajatādrihemasadasi śrīdhūrjaṭiṃ bhāvaye || 33 || taṇḍau vādini ḍiṇḍimaṇḍamarukāmākhaṇḍale vādyati brahmaṇyambujalocane ca namati śrīcaṇḍikeśe karaiḥ | ghaṇṭāḍolanatatpare suranutaṃ śrītāṇḍave paṇḍitaṃ nṛtyantaṃ rajatādrihemasadasi śrīdhūrjaṭiṃ bhāvaye || 34 ||
śīrṣābaddhakapālamālamamalaṃ nṛtyajjaṭāmaṇḍalaṃ bhūṣāveṣaviṣāgnimiśritasudhādhāreṣaduṣṇārciṣam | nṛtyantaṃ ramaṇīmude nigamavāṅmūrdhādhirūḍhaṃ śivaṃ nṛtyantaṃ rajatādrihemasadasi śrīdhūrjaṭiṃ bhāvaye || 35 || pādābaddhaharīśakaṅkaṇaraṇatkāraughaniṣpandita- brahmādyākhilajaṅgamaṃ bahubhujālaṅkāradevyāḥ puraḥ | mandasmeravirājamānavadanāmbhojaṃ naṭantaṃ śivaṃ kailāsācalaśātakumbhasadasi śrīśambhumālokaye || 36 || itthaṃ nṛtyati deveśassāyaṃ devyā sadāśivaḥ | kailāsahemasadasi prācyāṃ gaṇavarairvṛtaḥ || taddakṣiṇe ratnakḷptasadomadhye maheśvaraḥ | nṛtyatyambāmude devastacchṛṇuṣva munīśvara || 38 ||
skandaḥ– gaṇḍāndolitakuṇḍalīśvaramahāśrīkuṇḍalaṃ tāṇḍave pāṇḍityaṃ ghaṭayantamaṇḍajamukhaiścaṇḍeśvarādyairgaṇaiḥ | stoṣyantaṃ nigamāntasāravacasāmoghairamoghaiśśivaṃ nṛtyantaṃ rajatādriratnasadasi śrīnīlakaṇṭhaṃ bhaje || 39 ||
pṛ0 133) taṇḍūddāmagiro jayanti savidhaṃ śrīkaiṭabhāre tyaja brahmanbrahmaravāṃśca saṃhara hare dūraṃ paraṃ sāraya | itthaṃ nartakacakravartinikaṭe nṛtyonmukhe tādṛśaṃ nṛtyantaṃ rajatādriratnasadasi paśyāmi śambhuṃ sadā || 40 || nṛttāndolacalacchikhāmṛtagalatkhaṇḍendusāndroccaye bhrājatpāṭalamaṇḍalāruṇalasadbṛndārakāṇāṃ gaṇe | magnobhugnavalagnanagnanibhṛte cūḍāhibṛndochavasa- nnṛtyantaṃ rajatādriratnasadasi paśyāmi śambhuṃ sadā || 41 || nartārtasya padadvayoḥ pluticaladdhemādrisomāryamā- kṣmāśeṣādikakampanaṃ vidadhataṃ nṛtyantamīṣatsmitam | devī paśyati śaṅkaraṃ ca sumahatsānandanandonmukhaṃ nṛtyantaṃ rajatādriratnasadasi paśyāmi śambhuṃ sadā || 42 || yasminnṛtyatvamīśe vidadhati bharitānandasandohadhāmni bhūṣāspandanahāniśaṅkihṛdayo mandaṃ vidhatte padam | yo vāsaśśithilaṃ bhavediti karānātanvate nisyadā- nkeśākuñcanataḥ karoti bhagavānkendūca cakrottamau || 43 || nānarti prasabhaṃ prasannahṛdayo rātne sabhāyāṃ śivaḥ || 44 || itthaṃ rājataśaile ca devo ratnasabhāntare | nṛttaṃ vitanute devyāḥ puratassāyamīśvaraḥ || paścātsabhāyāṃ rajatakalpitāyāṃ maheśvaraḥ | nṛtyatyambā mukhaṃ vīkṣya gaṇabṛndasamanvitaḥ ||
śrīskandaḥ– nṛtyantaṃ haribhūṣaṇaṃ vidhiśirobṛndālimālālasa- dvāmāṅgākṛtisatstriyā yutapade keyūraśiñjatsvanam | kaṭyāṃ sāmajacarmavastrakalitaṃ nṛtyantamāśāvasaṃ baddhārddhāṅgakalena bālakalitottaṃsānvitāṃsā vayam || nṛtyantaṃ kaladhautasārasadasi dhyāyāmi nṛttonmukham || 47 ||
pṛ0 134) vāggumbhānvividhānakṛtrimamayānambhojajāte vada- tyānandāmbudhimagnacetasi pare govindapūjye hare | mandaṃ mandamarandapābhirakhile bṛndārakāṇāṅgaṇe nṛtyantaṃ kaladhautasārasadasi dhyāyāmi nṛttonmukham || 48 || yasmin nṛtyati jaṅgamācaramidaṃ viśvaṃ narīnṛtyati yasmādbhinnatayā nakiñcidapi vai vaktuṃ naśakyaṃ budhaiḥ | tādṛkṣaṃ naṭanārbhaṭīkṛtaruciṃ bhūṣāhiśeṣojvalaṃ nṛtyantaṃ kaladhautasārasadasi dhyāyāmi śambhoḥ padam || 49 || cetastvaṃ bhaja yadgato na punarāvṛttiṃ bhajenmānavo yasmāccitrataraṃ na kiñcidadhikaṃ tattādṛśantāṇḍavam | kurvantaṃ karuṇāmbudhiṃ triṇayanaṃ śrīkālakūṭojvalaṃ nṛtyantaṃ kaladhautasārasadasi dhyāyāmi śambhoḥ padam || 50 || yasminbhrāmyati bambhramīti sakalaṃ viśvañcarādyātmakaṃ yasminnutplutimācaratyavikalaṃ brahmāṇḍamudbhidyate | yadbhāsā pravibhānti bhāskaraniśānāthādayassantataṃ nṛtyantaṃ kaladhautasārasadasi dhyāyāmi śambhoḥ padam || 51 || yasminnāpatite na śarma labhate kūrmo'pi bhagnāsthiko nṛttāyāsavinirgatorunayanaśrotrotthaphūtkārakaḥ | sāṅgā sā śrutirityupendrasadṛśāstasyāśrayājjīvinaḥ || 52 || yasya svedajalaṃ mahodadhirapi prodyanmaṇīnāṃ gaṇo raupyādrau kaladhautasārasadasi śrīnīlakaṇṭhaṃ bhaje || 53 || evaṃ sa nṛtyatīśānaḥ kailāsakaladhautaje | sadasi svairamambāyāḥ purataśśaśiśekharaḥ || uttare citsabhāyāntu nṛtyatyambāṃ vilokayan | gaṇendraissevitapado mahādevo maheśvaraḥ ||
pṛ0 135) śrīskandaḥ– hrīrmūrtyā śivayā virāṇmayamayaṃ hṛtpaṅkajasthaṃ sadā hrīṇānāṃ śivakīrtane hitakaraṃ helahradāṃ māninām | hrīberādisugandhavastraruciraṃ hemādribāṇāsanaṃ hrīṅkārādikapādapīṭhamamalaṃ hṛdyaṃ naṭeśaṃ bhaje || 56 || śrīmadjñānasabhāntare pravilasacchrīpañcavarṇākṛtiṃ śrīvāṇīvinutāṅghripaṅkajayugaṃ śrīvallabhenārcitam | śrīvidyāmanumodanaṃ śṛtajanaśrīdāyakaṃ śrīdharaṃ śrīcakrāntaravāsinaṃ śivamahaṃ śrīmannaṭeśaṃ bhaje || 57 || navyāmbhojamukhaṃ namajjanavidhiṃ nārāyaṇenārcitaṃ nāgaukonagarīnadīvilasitaṃ nāgājinālaṅkṛtam | nānārūpakanartanādicaturaṃ nālīkajānveṣṭitaṃ nādātmānamahaṃ nagendratanayānāthaṃ naṭeśaṃ bhaje || 58 || madhyasthaṃ madhuvairimārgitapadaṃ madvaṃśanāthaṃ prabhuṃ mārārātimatīva mañjuvapuṣaṃ mandāragauraprabham | māyātītamaśeṣamaṅgalanidhiṃ madbhāvanābhāvitaṃ madhyevyomasabhāguhāsthamakhilaṃ mānyaṃ naṭeśaṃ bhaje || 59 || śiṣṭaiḥ pūjitapādukaṃ śivakaraṃ śītāṃśurekhādharaṃ śilpaṃ bhaktajanāvane śithilitāghaughaṃ śivāyāḥ priyam | śikṣārakṣaṇamambujāsanaśirosaṃhāraśīlaṃ prabhuṃ śītāpāṅgavilocanaṃ śivamahaṃ śrīmannaṭeśaṃ bhaje || 60 || vāṇīvallabhavandyavaibhavayutaṃ vandārucintāmaṇiṃ vātāśādhipabhūṣaṇaṃ varakṛpāvārānnidhiṃ yoginām | vāñchāpūrtikaraṃ valārivinutaṃ vāhīkṛtāmnāyakaṃ vāmāṅgāttavarāṅganaṃ mama hṛdāvāsaṃ naṭeśaṃ bhaje || 61 ||
pṛ0 136) yakṣādhīśasakhaṃ yamapramathanaṃ yāminyadhīśānanaṃ yajñadhvaṃsakaraṃ yatīndravinutaṃ yajñakriyādhīśvaram | yājyaṃ yājakarūpiṇaṃ yamadhanairyatnopalabhyāṅghrikaṃ yānībhūtavṛṣaṃ yatīndravinutaṃ yājyaṃ naṭeśaṃ bhaje || 62 || māyāśrīvilasaccidambaramahāpañcākṣarairaṅkitān ślokāntsapta paṭhanti ye'nudivasaṃ cintāmaṇīnāmakān | teṣāṃ bhāgyamanekamāyuradhikaṃ vidyāvarān satsutān sarvābhīṣṭamasau dadāti sahasā śrīcitsabhādhīśvaraḥ || 63 ||
śrīsūtaḥ- taṭinnibhajaṭārbhaṭīpaṭuriṭīḍyavāgarbhaṭī- niṭālakakṛpīḍakaṃ bhaja bhajāmahe dhūrjaṭim | śivaṃ kaṭataṭāraṭadyamakaṭhoratuṇḍārbhaṭī- capeṭivaraśūlakaṃ karaṭicarmaśobhatpaṭam || 64 || haṭātkṛtaśaṭhāsuramasukhabhedakṛttīraṭa- dvipāṭhaśaradhāriṇaṃ kamaṭhapṛṣṭapādaṃ śivam | bhajāmi jaṭharīdhṛtatrijaganmūlapīṭhotthita- janārdanapaṭustavaṃ hṛdi suniṣṭhitaṃ yoginām || 65 || kuṭhāravaradhāriṇaṃ kumudanāthacūḍāmaṇiṃ kuraṅgavarabhūṣaṇaṃ bhajata nīlakaṇṭhaṃ sadā || 66 || utkośakāśitamahāśivarātakheṭanīlo'cchatācchasukaroruśirodharāṃsam | rakṣasmṛtiprajanitāpagatādisaṃjñāpasmāramaulipadapaṅkajaniṃ bhajāmi || 67 || nādotthaḍambaramahāḍamaruprakāṇḍamutphullapaṅkajavarānalamīśitāram | ārāt praṇemuramarā rajatācalasthaṃ kekyākhuvāhagaṇapaiḥ parameśamevam || 68 || nandīśabhṛṅgiriṭayassuranandikasomanandicaṇḍīśatuṇḍavarahuṇḍatuhuṇḍabhadrāḥ | śrībāṇarāvaṇagaṇānanakoṭicaṇḍā brahmā harīśvaramukhā amarendrasaṅghāḥ || 69 ||
pṛ0 137) stambhairvidrumaputrikaughaghaṭitairhaimairmahāmātṛkai- rbhāsvatsvāvaraṇaiśca śaktibhirapi proddaṇḍamāyāmaye | raṅge sarvajagatkaraṇḍamakhilaṃ yasyekṣaṇājjṛmbhate yasyaivekṣaṇataśca rakṣitamidaṃ tatraiva līnaṃ kṣaṇāt || 70 || so'pyetādṛśaraṅgamaṇṭapagatassarvaiśca bhūtairvṛto rudrāṇīsahito gaṇeśaguhayukpārśve surendrairapi | pāthojāsnabhavena śrīdharabhavairanvāsyamānaśśivo- rudrāṇīgaṇapaiśca sevitapado modānvito raṅgagaḥ || 71 || īṣatpādatalāhatitruṭitabhūbhāgāsahiṣṇutruṭa- tsphūrjatkarpaṭaśarmadurvidhamahākūrmastavāmreḍitam | aṅgulyagrapatattadīyapavanotkṣiptasvadhāmasthira- brahmāṇḍaṃ parameśiturvijayate nṛttaṃ samastādbhutam || 72 || namrānpāṇigaṇāndiśāvadhikṛte svīyānkapardānapi vyomānte natikuñcitāmapi punaḥ pātālamukhyānadhaḥ | lokākhyān samatītya svīyacaraṇānkurvannirālambano nṛttaṃ kevalamīśvaro vitanute devyagrataḥ kevalam || 73 ||
sūtaḥ– sabhāsu ca sabhāpatirharihiraṇyagarbhādibhi- ssanandanasanātanairharasunandinandyādibhiḥ | karāhatimahāmaṇipravaramaddalādutthitai- ssutālavarakalpanairnaṭati nṛttaraṅgasthitaḥ || 74 || vedādhīśvara veda eva bhagavanbhaktyā tvadīyāssabhā nauti stauti bhavantameva hi tato devaṃ sabhādhīśvaram | vedo veda na vedarūpamapi te nīrūparūpaḥ kathaṃ tasmādevamaho maheśvara sadā vācānivṛttastvayi || 75 ||
pṛ0 138) provācāvacanena rūpamapi te jñātuṃ na śakyaṃ paraiḥ || 76 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe sabhāsu nṛttavarṇanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 33 ||
caturvidhapuruṣārtha maṇṭapavarṇanaṃ nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– tacchailamauliprākāro nānāsaudhāntare sthitaḥ | candropalaśilāsāraiḥ kalpito'sti śivena hi || 1 || khaṇḍasphuṭitasandhānarahito'khaṇḍa eva hi | parvodyaccharvarīnāthakalāniṣyandasārakaḥ || triṃśatsahasramānena cāyāmordhvavirājitaḥ | śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkḷptavṛṣabhaiḥ pariśobhitaḥ || indranīlāmalākṣaiśca viṣāṇaiścaiva śobhitaiḥ | tatprākārākhaṇḍabhittau saṃsthitā gopureṣu ca || prākāragopuraṃ tatra daśasāhasramuchritam | rudrāvatāracaritaṃ maṇikumbhavarāñcitam || 5 || śobhitaṃ pūrvabhāgasthaṃ tatprākāravarasya ca | dakṣiṇe cāpi tādṛkṣaṃ mahāsphaṭikakalpitam || 6 || rudrāvatārakrīḍābhirañcitaṃ vṛṣabhairapi | paścime cāpi tejiṣṭaṃ sphaṭikopalagopuram || 7 || rudrāvatārakrīḍābhirvṛṣabhaiḥ kalaśairapi | śobhitaṃ tatra tadbhāti daśasāhasramānataḥ || 8 || taduttare'pi sphaṭikadhavalaṃ gopurottamam | rudrāvatāraiḥ kalaśaiśśobhitaṃ vṛṣabhairapi || 9 || sahasratalabhāgaiśca śikharodyatpatākakaiḥ | muktāgucchaiḥ pravālālimālājālikaśobhitaiḥ || devakoṣṭaiḥ koṇakoṣṭaiḥ kapotaiḥ pālipālibhiḥ | mahāvalabhikoddāmastambhavidrumaputrikaiḥ || prāk saṃstho maṇṭapastatra vyāyāmocchrāyasundaraḥ | sihmaśārdūlaśarabhamātaṅgaturagākṛtiḥ || śukabheruḍahaṃsābhaisstambhairmaṇikṛtairyutaḥ | sihmamaulimahāpālikanyakālivirājitaiḥ || ratnayuktastambhayutaścāgarbhagṛhagopuram | vistṛto vedikābhiśca raktapadmachavirmahān || 14 || svacchādarśatalākāramaṇisundarabhittikaḥ | dhūpaistanmaṇidīpaiśca vidyoditadigantaraḥ || 15 || pāṭīrasārakarpūragandhasārādisiktabhūḥ | sumanāmodimandāraratnamālāpariṣkṛtaḥ || 16 || tatrācchahariduddāmamaṇisaptacchadāvṛtaḥ | tatrācchavidrumāpāramuktāsaravilambitaḥ || 17 ||
pṛ0 139) amlānakusumodriktaradantarakṛtāntaraḥ [kusumāmoditadantara iti pāṭhaḥ |] | tatra tadbhittigānekanavaratnavicitritaḥ || 18 || rudrāvatārakrīḍāditattanmaṇisuvigrahaḥ | mokṣalakṣmīvilāsākhyo maṇṭapo bhāti pūrvataḥ || 19 || dakṣiṇe'pyayutastambhanānāmaṇigaṇaiścitaḥ | āgarbhagṛhamutsedhavistṛto gopurāvadhi || 20 || sārūpyamokṣadānākhyo bhāti ratnapariṣkṛtaḥ | gomedakāntivilasadvīradhīrāvṛtāntaraḥ || 21 || suratnamukurākārabhittiraṅgaikasundaraḥ | tatratyamaṇimāṇikyagaṇakāntitatāntaraḥ || 22 || kastūrītagarāmodagandhavārisupaṅkilaḥ | nandanāpārakusumamālājālavṛtāntaraḥ || 23 || rambhāpūgīphalālambigucchapālīvirājitaḥ | ratnodgīrṇāgarustambhairmarālāvaliśobhitaḥ || 24|| tadbhittinicitāpārarudrakrīḍādivigrahaiḥ | tattadbhūṣāviśeṣeṣu yo yo rāgastathā tathā || 25 || tattanmaṇikṛtānekasundaraiśśivavigrahaiḥ | guggulūddāmasubhagagandhadhūpavidhūpitaḥ || 26 || paścimegarbhagṛhatogopurāvadhivistṛtaḥ | subhagobhātiniyutastambhamaṇḍitabhūtalaḥ || 27 || sālokyamokṣadānākhyo maṇṭapo'yutapādabhāk | tatra vaiḍūryaracitasstambhākhaṇḍaikasārabhūḥ || 28 || tatsūtrāpāradhārābhirvismayākarakāntibhūḥ | sihmamaulimahāpīṭha kapotāvalisundaraḥ || 29 || maṇiratnacitāneka pālipālī varāśrayaḥ | kesarāmbuyutāsāramṛgamodayutairghaṭaiḥ || 30 || gandhāmbusiktatalako maṇimālāvibhūṣitaḥ | hīrasāramahāmuktāmaṇihārāvalambitaḥ || 31 || tatra vaiḍūryaphalakacitordhvatalakāntikaḥ | niryatkāntyākāntataro vicitākhilacitrakaḥ [bimbitākhilacitrakaḥ iti ca pāṭhaḥ |] || 32 || kṛṣṇāgarumahāramyadhūmadhūpasamākulaḥ | maṇikḷptācchabhittiśca rudrakrīḍādiśobhitaḥ || 33 || śobhano nitarāṃ bhāti maṇiratnālisundaraḥ | suratnaketakītālīphalālambitapadmakaiḥ || 34 || mahāsihmāsanaiḥ pīṭhaiḥ pālīpālivirājitaḥ | pravālamuktāpādaiśca suraupyamaṇipādukaiḥ || 35 || mañcordhvamaṇṭapālambimuktājālavitānakaiḥ | puṣpaśayyāparikarairupadhānairmanoharaiḥ || 36 || vāsitairgandhabahalaśubhāstīrṇapaṭāvṛtaiḥ | surudravīṇānādaiśca nāditairdundubhīravaiḥ || 37 || tatra maṇṭapavaryeṣu caikākāratayāsthitam | paścādāgopuratalamāgarbhagṛhasannidhi || 38 || taduttare cakāstīśamaṇṭapo ratnasundaraḥ | āgopuragṛhaṃ śambhorayutocchritapādukaḥ || 39 || puṣparāgamaṇīkḷptaścordhvādhastalamaṇḍitaḥ | tatkāntikāñcitoddāmavidrumāmalaputrikaḥ || 40 || sāraṅgaśukamātaṅgakuraṅgavihagākṛtiḥ | stambhaiśśobhitabhūbhāgamaṇisārālikīlitaḥ || 41 ||
pṛ0 140) ratnajālakaniryadbhātalarañjitadiṅmukhaḥ | suratnavalabhīkīrṇa svacchabhittivarāñcitaḥ || 42 || tatra rudrāvatārādimaṇikalpitavigrahaḥ | śaraccandraprabhājālatiraskāritalocchrayaḥ || 43 || suratnaketakoddāmalalannārelagucchakaḥ | gandhakarpūrapāṭīradravabhāraikagandhabhūḥ || 44 || vitānottānitatalo ratnarambhāpariṣkṛtaḥ | sāmrāṇyagarudhūpaiśca nityaṃ ghumughumāyitaḥ || 45 || praphullaratnacāmpeyaratnarājivirājitaḥ | nīlanīlotpalotphullapīṭhālaṃbisarairvṛtaḥ || 46 || tatratyastambhavitatapuṣparāgamaṇiprabhaḥ | tatrāntarmaṇṭapavaraṃ rañjitaṃ maṇikāntibhiḥ || 47 || sugandhagandhajāmodapaṭavāsānumoditaḥ | vātapotasamānītai ramyaśītatarāvṛtaiḥ || 48 || tanmaṇṭapavare devyā divyasihmāsanāśrayaḥ | āste gaṇaiḥ parivṛto'paśyaṃstaddṛṣṭikautukam || 49 || tatratyamaṇṭapasyākhyā śrīmaheśena kalpitā | sāyujyalakṣmīdānākhyo ratnasundarakalpitaḥ || 50 ||
skandaḥ- tatratyāmalamaṇṭapeṣu bhagavānāste sahāmbo mudā bhaktānāṃ nivaheṣu tatra sukṛtāpāraiśca bhūṣādibhiḥ | svasvāpārarasairvaraissumadhurodārairgaṇendrairvṛta- stattatsthānavarārhabhūṣaṇavaraṃ [dayārasairiti pāṭhaḥ |] bhakteṣu dhatte śivaḥ || 51 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe caturvidhapuruṣārtha maṇṭapavarṇanaṃ nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 ||
kailāsaliṃgavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– tatrācchamaṇṭapāntasthaṃ gopurāntarasundaram | indracāpanibhaṃ divyaṃ nānāmaṇivirājitam || prākāraṃ daśasāhasrayojanāyāmavistaram | kvacitpūrveṣu haritaṃ kvacitkajjalasannibham [kvacicca jalasannibhamiti pāṭhāntaram |] || kuruvindāmalamaṇibhāsvatkāntatarākṛti | taṭitkūṭanibhañcāpi nīlāmbudanibhaṃ kvacit || bālasūryakarābhāsañcodyadindunibhaṃ kvacit | palāśaśalmalīpuṣpasaṅkāśaṃ kvacideva hi ||
pṛ0 141) indranīlāmalamaṇiprabhāsannibhakāṇḍakam | indragopakasaṅkāśaṃ mayūragalasannibham || 5 || pārāvatagalābhāsaṃ karṇikārachavīyutam | candrabhāsvatkarākārakanaddhīranibhaṃ kvacit || 6 || gomedapuṣyarāgodyadvaiḍūryarasarañjitam | pravālamaṇimuktācchadhārāchavinibhaṃ kvacit || 7 || tatprākāraprabhājālairnabho vividhabhāyutam | maṇimāṇikyakhacitagopurālivirājitam || 8 || rudrāvatāracaritairmaṇirājadvṛṣairyutam | lalāmaśobhikalaśaiścaturdikṣu virājitam || 9 || tatrāntargṛhamīśasya garbhāgāraṃ manoharam | navaratnākhaṇḍakḷptastambhapīṭhavirājitam || 10 || taccintāmaṇibhājālabhāsitaṃ garbhadhāma tat | tadagrato bhāti śambhossahasrastambhamaṇḍitaḥ || 11 || sumuktimanṭapo nāma sarvavedaśikhāstutaḥ | tatprabhābhāsitā lokā brahmaviṣṇvādayassurāḥ || 12 || dikpālayakṣarakṣaughanāgāpsarasakinnarāḥ | uragāsturagāścaiva sāraṅgāścāmarāssṛmāḥ || 13 || mayavassāmajālāvā harayaśśarabhāstathā | bhallūkabhekakhaṅgaiśca hariṇairmahiṣaistathā || 14 || kalpitā maṇijottuṅgastambhadhārāsu koṭiśaḥ | maṇijālakasañchanno ratnasopānavedikaḥ || 15 || paṭṭikātoraṇopetaḥ pīṭhagopānasīyutaḥ | tadagraratnakalaśairatnajālakaśobhitaḥ || 16 || ratnagucchamahāmālājālākīlitasundaraḥ | prabhākarasahasrābhaścendukoṭisamaprabhaḥ || 17 || dhūpāmodaikabahulo maṇidīpaprabhātataḥ | vitānatānasubhago harinmaṇinibhassadā || 18 || nandanānanditasumamālāgucchakalambitaḥ | amlānāraktakamalotpalamālālasacchaviḥ || 19 || pratyagraketakoddāmagandhodyadratnapiñjaraḥ | utphullacampakoddāmamālāgandhitadiktaṭaḥ || 20 || kadambabandhurāmodasundaro maṇibhāsuraḥ | tatra sihmāsanaiścitraiḥ kalpitairmaṇibhistataiḥ || 21 || padmarāgāmalamaṇikāñcitādarśabhittikaḥ | patākākumbhakoṭībhirmaṇikoṭivṛṣaiścitaḥ || 22 || liṅgāgre
