maṇṭapo bhāti kailāseśvarasannidhau | tato'ntare garbhagṛhaṃ kailāseśasya sattama || 23 || navaratnamaṇīpīṭhaṃ vedikātalasundaram | garbhakoṣṭaiḥ paṭṭikābhirdevakoṣṭairvirājitam || 24 || valabhītalasañcārimarālakulasundaram | kapotapālīpālisthamaṇisihmavṛṣairyutam || 25 || dikpālairbrahmaviṣṇvādyairdakṣiṇāmūrtivistṛtam | dakṣiṇe paścime cāpi prāguttaradiśi prabhāḥ || 26 || liṅgodbhavāndhakārātitripurāsurasaṃhṛtiḥ | brahmaviṣṇūdbhavaścāpi tāṇḍaveśaśca sundaraḥ || 27 || karicarmaparīdhāno herambaskandasaṃyutaḥ | bhikṣāṭanaśca kaṅkālaśśūlāsaktakaro haraḥ || 28 || mekhalāvṛtakaṇṭhodyatpādāmbhojāktapādukaḥ | jaṭājālitasanmaulirindukundaśatācchabhāḥ || 29 ||
pṛ0 142) somāvataṃsokṣavāho gaṇabṛndavṛtaḥ kvacit | umayā saṃsthitaḥ pīṭhe paśyan gaurīṃ manoharaḥ || 30 || gaurīprasādanaparaḥ paśyaṃstaddhanukekaram | ardhenanārīvapuṣā śobhito harihīrabhāḥ || 31 || ratnāhikuṇḍaladyotisomadhāmasamānanaḥ | vyāghraratnāmbaradharastripuṇṭratilakojvalaḥ || 32 || maṇiriṅkhatsubhūṣāḍyo nānābhūtijagandhadhṛk | kvaṇanmañjīrapādārdhaśeṣārdhapadapaṅkajaḥ || 33 || garakaṇṭhārdhako divyamaṇikaṇṭhārdhadhṛkchivaḥ | napacandrottamāṅgotthagaṅgārayavarāśrayaḥ || 34 || vāmadakṣiṇabhāgastha lokeśaharisevitaḥ | caṇḍāṃśutanayodbhītaliṅgāliṅgadvijāvanaḥ || 35 || gaṅgātaraṅgakalitakapardeṇāṅkaśobhitaḥ | muravairimahānetra pūjitāṅghrisaroruhaḥ || 36 || brahmamuṇḍalaladgaṇḍakarṇakuṇḍalaśobhitaḥ | evaṃ rudrāvatāraiścāpyakhaṇḍamaṇikalpitaiḥ || 37 || candrasphaṭikahāraiśca puṣpagomedanīlajaiḥ | śrīmaheśamahādivyavigrahaiḥ parito vṛtaiḥ || 38 || devyā harinmaṇibhavaiḥ padmarāgabhavaistathā | indraviṣṇuvidhātṛṇāṃ dikpālānāñca mūrtayaḥ || 39 || tattadbhāgamaṇīkḷptāḥ kalpitā maṇigarbhajāḥ | madhurasmitanetrāsya tattadaṅgaikabhāsurāḥ || 40 || maṇimuktāpravālādibhūṣaṇāvalibhāsurāḥ | tattatkoṇagatātyaccharājadvṛṣabhabhāsurāḥ || 41 || sahasradaśamānena yojanāyāmakalpitāḥ | tatratyamūrtyassarvāḥ pañcayojanamānataḥ || 42 || kalpitāśśrīmaheśena manasaiva manoramāḥ | hīrasāraghanottuṅgapañcāśadyojanocchrayam || 43 || vṛttāyāmamahāślakṣṇakoṭibhāskarabhātatam | kadalīpuṣpasaṅkāśasamucchrāyorumaṇḍalam || 44 || jvaladindumahāvṛttabrahmāṇḍodaradāraṇam | garbhagehaṃ tatra śambhorvedavedāntasaṃstutam || 45 || kailāsasārasubhagamaṇivedivirājitam | tatraivāntarmahāpīṭhe koṭidyumaṇisannibhe || 46 || prabhābhāsijagajjālaṃ candrācchasphaṭikojvalam | āyāmavṛttagomukhyāharibrahmorupīṭhakam || 47 || mahāliṅgaṃ mahākāramakhaṇḍasphaṭikojvalam | talliṅgasāradhārābhiḥ kailāso'pyatipāṇḍaraḥ || 48 || bhāvibhāsitadikcakraṃ saudhagopuramaṇḍitam | anarghyavarasaṃveṣṭaveṣṭitaṃ gandhasundaram || 49 || ratnakahlārakamalamālājālairvirājitam | sahasranīlamaṇijanīlotpalasarāñcitam || 50 || akhaṇḍaharitoddāmamaṇibilvottamāṅgakam | utphullasūtravaiḍūryacampakācchasarairyutam || 51 || puṣparāgamaṇīkḷptaṃ supāṭalasarāvṛtam | niṣṭaptahemajātyacchakarṇikārasarāvṛtam || 52 || hīrasāramahādhārāmallikācchasarāvṛtam | gomedakamaṇīkḷptakaraṇḍakasarāvṛtam || 53 || mandārakundabandhūkabakadroṇārkaratnajaiḥ | sarakīlitasanmaulisphaṭikopalakalpitaiḥ || 54 ||
pṛ0 143) maṇiprabhātatātyācchaśobhitottuṅgamauktikam | sahasrāsyamahāśeṣaphaṇāmaṇivirājitam || 55 || padmarāgamahārāgatripuṇṭratilakojvalam | tatkāntikāñcitālokāstaddhārāsārasāgarāḥ || 56 || tatkailāsamahāsārapiṇḍaśekharapūjitam | kailāseśākhyamamalaṃ liṅgaṃ maṅgaladāyakam || 57 || maṅgalāpatidṛkpātadhārāsāravijṛmbhitam | talliṅgamahimāvedairapāraśikharāśrayaiḥ || 58 || brahmaviṣṇvādibhirdevai rudrairvā munibhistathā | naśakyo jñātumīṣadvā mūkāvedoktayo yathā || kailāsaśailamaṇidhāmani divyaliṅgaṃ kailāsanāmakamaho trijagadvicitram | talliṅgamauliśakalendukalāsubhābhi[jharībhiriti pāṭhāntaram |]rāplāvitoruśikharo'tra vibhāti śailaḥ ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsaliṃgavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 ||
kailāseśvarapūjāvidhānakathanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
skanda uvāca–
talliṅgajātāssarve'pi bhuvanāni caturdaśa | talliṅgajātā devādyā brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥ || talliṅge saṃsthitā lokāssaptadvīpavanākarāḥ | pralaye'pi layaṃ yānti sarve lokāssuraissaha || layanālliṅgamityuktaṃ līnaṃ yasmiñjagadrutam | tasmālliṅgaṃ mune proktaṃ tatkailāseśvarasaṃjñitam || yato vāco nivartante aprāpya manasā saha | bhūmau tacca mahāliṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpucchamevatu || ekaṃ brahmaiva talliṅgamaliṅgamapi bhūsurāḥ | tadeva jyotiṣāṃ jyotistadvai cetanacetanam || talliṅgaṃ satyamānandamakhaṇḍaikarasaṃsadā | talliṅgadarśane vā'pi navāggacchati no manaḥ || neti neti ca vedāntaistalliṅgaṃ pratipādyate | tadeva brahma tvaṃ viddhi neha nānāsti kiñcana || ṛtaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ brahma tadātmāmanaso'tigam | nirindriyaṃ niṣkalaṅkamasaṅga majaraṃ hi tat || prabhuṃ samastabhūtotthasarvadharmavivarjitam | ākāśaṃ tadanākāśaṃ sākārañca nirākṛti || kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāñca brahma talliṅgameva hi | nāmarūpātigaṃ śāntaṃ guṇātītaṃ guṇāspadam || apāṇipādamatyacchamānandaghanamadvayam | śivasya nirguṇaṃ rūpamadṛśyamakṛtātmabhiḥ || 11 ||
pṛ0 144) tadeva vyāpakaṃ bhāti talliṅgantamasaḥ param | tanna vedaiśca vedāntairgurubhiśśrutibhissadā || 12 || naprāpyaṃ sarvadā sarvairdraṣṭuṃ taccāpyathā śritum | tadeva devadevasya nirguṇaṃ rūpamadbhutam || 13 || nirguṇañcā'pi lokānāṃ dṛṣṭigocaravatsthitam | talliṅgaṃ sarvadā śambhurdevyā pūjayatisvayam || 14 || bāhyairābhyantaraiścā'pi pūjābhiḥ parameśvaraḥ | triṇetro nīlakaṇṭhaśca candrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ || 15 || ahambhāvādirahito bhāvābhāvavivarjitaḥ | ahaṃ brahmaivedamiti yaṃ [turyātīto'jaro'maraḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] vadanti narāmarāḥ || 16 || dhyānadhyeyātigo bhūtvā sthitassamahimātigaḥ | evaṃ sambhāvayandevyā śiveva hi kevalaḥ || 17 || tamaḥ paro mahādevo devyā saguṇanirguṇaḥ | pūjāṃ bāhyopacārādyairmanovācāmagocaraḥ || 18 || kalpayatyeva manasā sarvakāleṣu śaṅkaraḥ | pradoṣeṣu viśeṣeṇa kailāse candraśekharaḥ || 19 || tatpūjāṃ sāvadhānena samāhitamanāśśṛṇu | caturdehātigo bhūtvā sarvendriyavivarjitaḥ || 20 || ahambhāvaṃ parityajya śivo'haṃ kevalo'dvayaḥ | vyāpyeṣu vyāpakaścāhaṃ guṇeṣu nihatosmyaham || 21 || nānto nacādissakalaścāhaṃ viśvaṃ sadaivahi | viśvātītohamajaro'saṅgo'saṅgavivarjitaḥ || vyāpako'haṃ sadā pūrṇo guṇajālavivarjitaḥ | nīrūpo viśvabhūtātmā dehadharmavivarjitaḥ || ākāśo vyāpakaśśīryaśśīrṇeṣvahamavasthitaḥ | satyaṃ jñāno'hamānando bodhabodhakavarjitaḥ || mayyeva sakalaṃ jātaṃ mayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | mayi sarvaṃ layaṃ yāti tadbrahmādvayamasmyaham || ityevaṃ bhāvayandhīro bāhye liṅgaṃ samarcayet | dhṛtabhasmatripuṇṭrāṅko rudrākṣavarabhūṣaṇaḥ || pañcāsyadhyānanirataḥ pañcākṣaraparāyaṇaḥ | prāṅmukhodaṅmukhovā'pi sthitaścelakuśāsane || dhyātvā svahṛtpadmasaṃsthaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibham | prasannāsyaṃ triṇayanaṃ tripuṇṭrapariśobhitam || candrārdhamukuṭaṃ devaṃ nīlagrīvamumāpatim | āvāhayedbāhyaliṅge sphāṭike bāṇadhātuje || mṛlliṅge sikatāyāñca pūjayetsthāvare'pi ca | pañcāmṛtaiḥpañcagavyairnīradhārādibhiśśivam || pañcabrahmaiḥ pāvamānai rudrairvedasamudbhavaiḥ | abhiṣicya prayatnena sāmabhiśca maheśvaram || 31 || vastrairāveṣṭya talliṅgaṃ gandhalepena lepayet | akṣatābhistathā ratnagolakairbhūṣayecchivam || bilvapatraiśca kahlāraiścampakaiḥ karavīrakaiḥ | puṣpairāraṇyakaiścaiva tathānyaiśca sugandhibhiḥ || dhūpaiśca dīpairnaivedyaistāmbūlairmaṇidīpakaiḥ | nīrājanaiśchatramukhyaiścāmarairvyajanairapi || 34 || praṇāmastotrapaṭhanaiḥ pradakṣiṇasunartanaiḥ | punaḥ pradakṣiṇaiścaiva pañcākṣarajapaistathā || 35 ||
pṛ0 145) hṛtpadme sanniveśyeśaṃ pūjodvāsanamārabhet | evaṃ pūjāvidhānena pūjayetparameśvaram || 36 || ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ yo'rcayennaraḥ | sa eva labhate jñānamābhyantaravarārcanaiḥ || kailāseśvaraliṅgametadamalaṃ svargāpavargapradaṃ tannaivākhilavedajālatilakairjñātuṃ na tatpāryate | īśenāpi gajānanena ca mayā devyā gaṇendrairapi viṣṇubrahmaharāmarairmunigaṇaistantraistathaivāgamaiḥ || 38 || talleśāyutaleśaleśamahimā koṭyaṃśakoṭyaṃśakaṃ vaktuṃ śrotumathekṣituṃ tribhuvane nāstīti manye dvija || 39 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāseśvarapūjāvidhānakathanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 36 ||
kailāsavāsamahimānāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– evaṃ kailāsaśailo'yaṃ vihitaśśūlapāṇinā | maṇiprākārasaudhāśca gopurāṇyapi bhūsura || 1 || ratnānāṅgirayastatra gaṇāvasathakalpanāḥ | nānārudrāvatārāṇāṃ sabhāmaṇṭapanirmitāḥ || 2 || tathānānyatraramate sarvāvāso'pi śaṅkaraḥ | devyāpi skandaherambanandikeśādibhiḥ [nandikeśādapīti pāṭhāntaram |] priyaḥ || 3 || maheśasya nivāso'yaṅgirīśo giriśasya hi | nāvimukte'pi ramate na tathā himabhūdhare || 4 || mandare niṣadhe'pīśastathādrau gandhamādane | tathānyeṣu nagendreṣu prītirnaiva pinākinaḥ || 5 || liṅgālayo'yaṅkailāso ramyasānutarūjvalaḥ | suramyamaṇiśṛṅgāgraścārusundarakandaraḥ || 6 || kaladhautaprabhādhūtadiktamasstomasantatiḥ | sarvatīrthamayaśśailassarvaliṅgamayo nagaḥ || 7 || gaṇeśvaro'yaṅkailāsassarvadā śivavāsabhūḥ | sarvakṣetramayaśśailaḥ kṣetreśāśrayatassadā || 8 || sarvauṣadhimayaścāyamoṣadhīśasamāśrayāt | vanāśrayo'yaṅkailāso vanādhipasamāśrayāt || 9 || mṛgāvāso hi satataṃ sadā paśupatipriyaḥ | nāsya rūpamahovedairjñātumeva na śakyate || 10 || kailāsāpāraśikharaissarvaloko'tipāvanaḥ | tanmaulitalasaṃspṛṣṭā vātāḥ pāvanapāvanāḥ || 11 ||
pṛ0 146) brahmādayassvalokasthāḥ prārthayantyanilantataḥ | viṣṇubrahmādayodevā munayo'pi munīśvara || 12 || kadāsmānpāvayedvāyuḥ kailāsaśikharāgataḥ | asmābhirnatapastaptaṅkailāsālokanāya tu || 13 || aṇḍajānāmapi gatirniṣiddhā śaśimaulinā | sūryacandrānalānāntu prabhāvidyotanaṃ na hi || 14 || tasyaiva śikharoddāmaprabhābhirbhāsitā diśaḥ | kailāsamaulisaṃsthasya yatsukhaṃ kṣaṇamātrataḥ || 15 || na hi tadvaiṣṇave brāhme kalpāvadhi sukhottaram | na caindre merumaulau vā nandane svargamaṇḍale || 16 || dikpālānāṃ puraughe vā saure cāndramase'pi vā | na caturdaśa lokeṣu tatsukhāṃśāṃśakoṭikam || 17 || prasādena vinā śambhorgamanantatra durlabham | na karmaṇā na tapasā dharmaiśca vividhairapi || kailāsācalavārtāpi na śakyā gamanaṅkatham | surā viṣṇvādayaḥ pūrve brahmāpi bhagavadgaṇāḥ || munayastapate'dyāpi kailāsanagavīkṣaṇe | kailāsagamane lipsāndhṛtvā te surasattamāḥ || śivaprasādasidhyarthaṃ tapyante paramantapaḥ | kecitpañcāgniniratāssamīraṇasupāraṇāḥ || vṛntaślathachadāśāśca kecidvāriṣu saṃsthitāḥ | kaṭadhūmaśikhāpānāḥ keciccaivordhvabāhavaḥ || bhasmachannābhasmasaṃsthāḥ kecicchrīrudrajāpakāḥ | bhasmāṅkābilvamūleṣu kecitpañcākṣarādarāḥ || rudrākṣavarakoṭīrāśśivanāmaparāyaṇāḥ | kecilliṅgārcanaparāstrikālaṃ bilvapallavaiḥ || evaṃ tapobhiratyugraistapyanti munayassurāḥ | sadāśivaprasādo hi teṣāmbhāvi munīśvarāḥ || sarvalokeṣu gantārassarvadharmaparāyaṇāḥ | punarāvṛttinassarve na kailāsagatā mune || 26 || yatayo'pi nivartante jñānanirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ | śivaprasādalabhyo'yaṅkailāso hyatidurlabhaḥ || meruśṛṅgagakailāsaśikhare varaśāmbhavāḥ | pūjayā śraddhayā śambhorīśānasya padaṅgatāḥ || sukhinassampramodante svargakoṭiguṇādhike | mahākailāsagamanamasmākaṅkiṃ punarnṛṇām || śivaprasādahīnānāṃ tatkathāśravaṇaṃ na hi | anekakoṭikalpotthatapasā prāpya eva saḥ || merumandarasaṅkāśaratnasvarṇādidānataḥ | satrātirātrakalanairvedādhyayanakoṭibhiḥ || 31 || gavāṅkoṭipradānairvā vidyayā tapasāpi vā | iṣṭāpūrtādidharmairvā kailāsāprāptireva na || 32 || śivaprasādāllabhyo'yaṃ prasādo durlabho nṛṇām | devyā mayā gaṇeśena nandyādyairgaṇapairapi || kailāsabāhyaprākāre tapasā yācitā sthitiḥ | anekayugasantaptatapasā toṣitaśśivaḥ || śivaprasādena vayaṃ tadbāhyaśikharāśrayāḥ | gaṇyante sikatā bhūmau gaṇyante divi tārakāḥ || kailāsāpāraśṛṅgasthaliṅgānāṅgaṇanā na hi | tatrāpi koṭiliṅgānāmuttamānāṃ śrutā mayā ||
pṛ0 147) tato'pi lakṣaliṅgānāṃ tato'yutasahasrakam | uttamānāñca devyai tadgadatā śrīśivena hi || gaṇanā gaṇyate kena kalpakoṭiśatairapi | anirvacanamāyasya māyinaśśrītriśūlinaḥ || ko veda mahimānaṃ tu tatra tanmauliliṅgagam | sa veda vedaniśvāsassarvajñaśśaśiśekharaḥ || śivasannidhireva sannidhissyādvibudhādhīśapadābjaratnavāridhiḥ | janināśaprabhavāparādhasandhiḥ plutijāpāraviśeṣatoṣagādhiḥ || 40 || nidhirevākhilasampadāṃ yugādhirbhavabhaktāmalacetadāritākhilādhiḥ || evaṅkailāsaśailāmalaśikharavarairmaulikumbhaikajālai- statrāpāraśivālayasthitamahāliṅgaughaliṅgāśrayaiḥ | īśāpāramanovilāsajanitairdṛṣṭvā maheśassvayaṃ bālārdhākṛtirindumauliranalālaṅkāraphālākṣakaḥ || 41 || kālāriḥ kaladhautaśailaśikharaṃ liṅgālipūrṇaṅkarot || 42 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsavāsamahimā nāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 37 ||
kailāsaliṃgavarṇanaṃ nāma aṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
jaigīṣavyaḥ– bhagavaṃstārakārāte śivabhaktavarāmala | namāmi tvatpādāmbhojaṃ kintaddevyai śivoditam || rahasyaṃvā prākāśaṃvā tanme vyākhyātu marhasi | taduktaṃ sampradhāryaiva skandomandasmitādharaḥ || bhavabhaktaṃ mahāprājñaṃ surāṇāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tadā || 3 ||
sūtaḥ– munīnāñca surāṇāñca gaṇeśānāñca sannidhau | proktavāñchrīmahādevandhyātvā hṛtpaṅkaje'male ||
skandaḥ– devyā kailāsajottuṅgaśikhare varagopure | ekākinā sañcaratā vismitākṣeṇa paśyatā || śivena nanditā devī prāha prāñjalirīśvaram || 6 ||
pṛ0 148) devyuvāca– devadeva mahādeva śaṅkara [karuṇāvaruṇālaya iti ca pāṭhaḥ |] karuṇālaya | eṇāṅkamaule sarvajña gaṅgājalajaṭādhara || 7 || bhava bhargāmarendrendra phaṇāmaṇivibhūṣita | vṛṣadhvajeśa kāmāre purāntaka yamāntaka || 8 || khaṭvāṅgaḍamarūddāmaghoṣaghoṣitaviṣṭapa | triśūlapāṇe bhūteśa vyomakeśa digambara || 9 || trijagajjālanirmāṇasthitināśakara prabho | vismayastava nāstyeva līleyaṃ tava śaṅkara || lokā lokyā brahmaviṣṇuharāmaravarāssurāḥ | teṣāmutthānasaṃsthānavināśanamapīśvara || tvadapāṅgaikasaṅgena sarveṣāṃ pralayodayau | tava ko vismaye hetustadbrūhi parameśvara || 12 ||
īśvaraḥ– śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi girīndravaranandini | tvayigopyaṃ na me kiñcittriṣu lokeṣu vidyate || na prakāśyaṃ tvayā devi rahasyaṃ mama hṛdgatam | tathāpi tvayi vakṣyāmi liṅgādhyāyamimaṃ śive || kailāsācalamaulisthaṃ liṅgamaṇḍalamambike | tajjñātunnaiva śakyaṃ hi mayaiva manasā tatam || koṭiliṅgākṛtirahaṃ tatpūjākalpako'pyaham | na tāni devamunibhirgandharvaiḥ pūjitānyume || nāmarendravarairdevi [namadgaṇairiti pāṭhāntaram |] śrutāni kimu darśanam | pūjane kā kathā devi cāgamyo mama bhūdharaḥ || tatpaśyāmi prasannena manasā vismayena ca | madīkṣaṇena sarveṣāṃ liṅgānāṃ pūjanaṃ bhavet || śive paśya mahādevi yāvatte dṛṣṭisantatiḥ || 19 || liṅgamaṇḍalamidannagātmaje candrakhaṇḍalalitottamāṅgakam | kuṇḍalīśasuphaṇāvibhūṣitaṃ pāpajālasugirīndrakhaṇḍanam || 20 || puṇṭraśobhitakapālamālakaṃ bilvacandanasupaṅkajārcitam | paśya paśya girije nagamaulau toṣadāyakamatīva mameṣṭam || 21 || kailāso'yamatīva sundaramahāliṅgālayānāṃ śive koṭībhiḥ parito vṛto maṇigṛhaistādṛkṣaliṅgairapi | mālūrottamaśākhiśekharaśikhastasyācchapuṣpaiḥ phalai- rānamrachadabhārapallavayutaistadgandhabandhānilaḥ || 22 || śikhiśikhakulāgrapiñchabhārairmama liṅgālayamārjanaṃ sadaiva |
pṛ0 149) vanaveṇūdbhavadāvamadhyalagnaissagarāmodasudhūpitaṃ sadaiva || 23 || maṇigarbhagṛhottharatnadīpaissatatandīpitameva liṅgasaṅgham | vanabilvachadapuṣpagandhavāhairabhinītaiśca supūjitāni paśya || 24 || pāṭalapaṭalaiśca karṇikāraissarasotphullasumullasaptarāgaiḥ | aravindaiḥ kuruvindabṛndavarṇairnavanīlotpalahallakaissuphullaiḥ || 25 || sitaraktāmalavarṇaśīryavṛttairatigandhairmakarandabṛndalīlaiḥ [śīrṇavṛntairiti pāṭhāntaram |] || 26 || mandārairatisundarairmama śive liṅgālimaulaissadā mallīphullasupuṇḍarīkakumudaissatkarṇikāraiśśive | sañchannāni tarāṃ sadādhanaphalaiḥ prodyatsudhāsārakai- rnaivedyeṣu śive sadā suracitaṃ liṅgālayeṣūdyatam || 27 || karikarapuṣkaraśīkarotthasārairabhiṣiktāni svamaulicandrasāraiḥ | kastūrikāmṛgamadāṅgajagharṣaṇena gandhāyitāni nagamauliṣu paśya devi || 28 || utphullacāmarakulairabhivījyamānaṃ nṛttaṃ śikhaṇḍivihitaṃ pikahaṃsarāgam | sampūjya pūjitamidaṃ mama liṅgasaṅghaṃ pāpāpahāri sugatipradamuttamañca || 29 ||
skandaḥ– itthaṃ kailāsaśailenavaratakathayā svardhunītulyayāsau devīṃ paśyannagaughandalitaśivavaroddāmaliṅgāni paśyan | kālārirniyatīnduśekharavarottaṃsodyamāṅgo mahā- mauliṃ svaṃ dhunayannatīva karuṇādṛṣṭyā prapaśyannagam || 30 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsaliṃgavarṇanaṃ nāma aṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 38 ||
pṛ0 150) kailāsaśailaliṃgamahimānāma ekonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
īśvaraḥ– paśya liṅgāni me devi maṇidhāmagatānyume | dhāmamaulimahākumbhadhārāvyāptāni śaṅkari || candracandanaliptāni tripuṇṭrojvalitāni ca | maṇisundaramandārapuṣpamaulīni śaṅkari || bilvottamāṅgasaundaryasāragarbhāṇi pārvati | varakākodarānaddhaphaṇābhūṣaṇakānyapi || 3 || nandanānandamālābhiścandanālaṅkṛtānyapi | dāvadagdhāgarurasairdhūpitāni sadāmbike || dīpitāni maṇijvālājālakāntīti paśya me | yathā me devadeveśi mano liṅgaprapūjane || na tathā jagato jālanirmāṇe me mano'mbike | tatpālane taddhanane nānyadharmeṣu me manaḥ || nago'yaṃ mama kailāsassarvānandapayonidhiḥ | etasya tapasā tuṣṭaḥ prāyacchaṃ varamuttamam || tavamaulau nivatsyāmi nānāliṅgasamāśrayaḥ | pralayenaiva nāśo'sti matsānnidhyabalāttava || ityukto girirājo'yaṃ mamānandapradassadā [pradaśśivaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] | pralaye sāgārāssarve kailāsasya śatottare || pādamūle sthitiṃ devi yāsyanti ca nagā api | maharlokāvadhi mahāvīcīkallolasaṅkulaiḥ || saptabhiḥ pavanairvāpi cālitāste tadādrije | himācale mandare'pi kedāreśvarasaṃjñakaḥ || nivatsyāmi śubhāpāṅgi sadā liṅgāśrayo hi saḥ | merāvayi mahādevi śikharaṃ mama sundaram || taduttare'pikailāse nānāliṅgaikabhāsuram | śikharaṃ tatra devaiśca pūjito nivasāmyaham || eka evāhamadvaito nīrūpo'hamihādrije | tvayā kailāsaśikhare tuṣṭo vāsamarocayam || sarvāvāso'pyahaṃ devi kailāse nivasāmyaham | anantārbudaliṅgāni mama kailāsaparvate || tatprāsādamaṇīrāgaśikharādyoditaprabhāḥ | tiraskṛtārkacandrendrā na tacchakyaṃ hi varṇitum || tatrāpi koṭiliṅgānāṃ gaṇanā kila sundari | uttameṣu mahādevi tatrāpāreṣu pārvati || tatrāpi liṅgasāhasraṃ mamaiva prītidāyakam | darśanātsaṃsparśanācca pūjanānmokṣadāyakam || vinā jñānena tapasā karmaṇā śraddhayā śive | nayajñairna vratācārairyogaissāṅkhyairmaheśvari || sāgatirnaiva labhyeta yathā talliṅgapūjayā | kailāsācalamaulisthaliṅgānāṃ darśanaṃ śive || durlabhaṃ sarvadevānāṃ nṛṇāṃ kimuta śaṅkari | kailāseśvaramukhyāni liṅgānyatyadbhutāni ca || maṇigarbhagṛhādhārasaṃsthitānyagaje sadā | prodyatkumbhapatākāni mayā sampūjitānyapi ||
pṛ0 151) prātassaṅgavasāyāhnapradoṣeṣu maheśvari | teṣu liṅgāvaliṃ bhadre śṛṇu vakṣyāmi sādaram || kīrtanaśravaṇenāpi pāpabhedīni śaṅkari | svargāpavargadānyāśu nṛbhisptaṅkīrtitānyapi || pūrvato mama kailāse nānāliṅgakuleṣvapi | tadgirerdakṣiṇe cāpi paścādapi śubhānane || taduttare'pi deveśi nānājyotirmayāni ca | na śakyaṃ varṇituṃ devi devaiśśeṣeṇa bhāmini || kalpāyutairapi śive talliṅgamahimā nu kim | na śakyaṃ vistarādvaktuṃ tannāmāni śṛṇu priye || pañcāśaduttarandevi śatadvayamitaṃ diśi | prathitāni mahādevi hyapāreṣvapi sādaram || kailāsāpāraśikharagarbhadhāmorumauligam | kumbhamaṇḍalamānākaṃ lihanniva ca saṃsthitam || śuddhācchaphalakāratnakalpitaṃ yojanonnatam | śaraccandrācchadhavalaprabhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam || ratnagarbhagṛhāntasthaṃ suramyamaṇivedikam | maṇiprabhātataṃ divyaṃ nīlapītāruṇaprabham || pravālapuṣparāgādigomedakaviḍūrakaiḥ | pīṭhojvalaprabhākāntaṃ śuddhasphaṭikamapyume || 32 || carcitaṃ candanādyaistu hyarcitaṃ bilvapallavaiḥ | mandārakundamālābhirindukhaṇḍaikabhūṣaṇam || bhujaṅgamaṇisañchannaṃ maṇidīpaprabhojvalam | divyāgarumahādhūpairdhūpitaṃ gandhamoditam || hīrasāratripuṇṭrāṅgaṃ kastūrītilakāñcitam | mahākailāsaśṛṅgāgrasaudhaśekharaśobhitam || maṇikumbhodyatāpāralasatkānticitāmbaram | paśya liṅgakulaṃ bhadre bhadradaṃ darśanena ca || tatsaudhakumbhadhārāgradarśanenāpi muktayaḥ | prāpnuvanti surā devi narāśśravaṇasādarāḥ [mātrataḥ iti pāṭhāntaram |] || praṇāmaṃ kuru deveśi śṛṇuṣvāvahitā bhava | liṅgānāṃ nāmadheyāni vedāntotthāni śailaje || bhāti liṅgakulaṃ bhadre muktyaṅkuramivodyatam | puṇyapradaṃ śravaṇatodarśanānmukta eva saḥ || bhūloke caiva pātāle svarge vai satyalokake | naitādṛśāni liṅgāni kiṃ punarbhārate bhuvi || bhūlokaliṅgādutkṛṣṭaṃ liṅgaṃ pātālalokagam | pātālātsvargalokasthaṃ tato viṣṇu vidhīndragam || ādyaṃ maṅgaladaṃ devi kailāseśvarasaṃjñitam | yannavedairapijñātaṃ vedāntairakhilairapi || 42 || asminneva [atraivāntelayamiti pāṭhāntaram |] layaṃ yānti brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | layanātsarvajagatāṃ liṅgamityucyate budhaiḥ || mamaiva nirguṇaṃ sākṣādrūpametanmaheśvari | asyaiva bhāsā sarve'pi bhānti lokāścaturdaśa || asyaiva cetanātsarvajagaccetayati priye | asyaivānandaleśena sarvānandamayaṃ priye || 45 || liṅgametadbhūmadhāmasomadhāmaprabhādhikam | etadbrahmaiva deveśi mamaiva paramaṃ priyam || 46 ||
pṛ0 152) yato vāco nivartante aprāpya manasā saha | svacchasphaṭikasaṃśuddhamākāśātmakamuttamam || yato bhūtāni jātāni yatra saṃsthāni sarvadā | yatraivānte layaṃ yānti talliṃgamidamadrije || yato brahmeśaviṣṇvindrāssamprajātā nagātmaje | yatsatyaṃ jñānamānandaṃ brahmaivedaṃ sanātanam || sūkṣmātsūkṣmataraṃ sākṣānnaiva sthūlaṃ na cāṇukam | sarvendriyavinirmuktaṃ sarvadharmavivarjitam || agandhamarasasparśaṃ tanna gandharasāśrayam | tadidañcakṣuṣāñcakṣussarvaprāṇamayaṃ sadā || 51 || sarvendriyaguṇātītaṃ bhūteṣu ca tataṃ sadā | sadā hyaśīrṇaṃ śīrṇeṣu neha nānāsti kiñcana || yasmintsampūjite jñāte dhyāte svātmaniśailaje | liṃgī liṃgātigobhāti tadidaṃ liṃgamuttamam || nāmarūpātigaṃ bhāti kailāseśvarasaṃjñitam | tannāmāni śṛṇuṣvārye sādaraṃ kamalānane || bilvorusundaravanacchaditācchaśākhāsañchannabhūtalamume mama śailapāliḥ | samphullapuṣpajapacelimagandhabandhasandohagandhavahajātaphalo mameṣṭaḥ || 55 || utphullapaṅkajaparāgajadhūlipāliruddāmakelirabhiyāsitaśītavātaḥ | puṣṇāti gātravaramambikayā sametaṃ kailāsaśailasarasīruhapālilagnaḥ || 56 || ratnasālakulamūlagasaudhapūgajālaparisarpisudhābdhau | aṇḍajāviva śivau ramaṇīyau krīḍaturdivasanāthajatāpaiḥ || 57 || tvamekākinī saudhajāle'smadīye viśiṣṭāsi kāntyā tavādyānanenduḥ | na caivopamīte manākchailakanye sa doṣākaro naiva te somadhāma || 58 || kailāsācalamaulipālivilasalliṃgāni tuṃgāni me vyālīmaulijapālikālivilasatpucchotthadhūlībharaiḥ | kelībhirnagakuñjarotthamadajairdhārālipālībharai- śśrāmyadgandhaphalīkadambajarajaḥ puñjālikīlāni ca || 59 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsaśailaliṃgamahimānāma ekonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 39 ||
pṛ0 153) kailāsaprāgdvārasthaliṃgābhidhānannāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
īśvaraḥ– śrīkailāseśvaro devi bhūteśaścāmbikeśvaraḥ | sūteśvaro gaṇeśeśasskandeśastārakeśvaraḥ || gaṅgeśvaro nandikeśo bhṛṅgīśo vāṇakeśvaraḥ | caṇḍīśvaro muṇḍikeśo [muṃjikeśa iti pāṭhaḥ |] ratneśo gandhakeśvaraḥ || garbheśvaro'tha vīreśo jyeṣṭheśaḥ kusumeśvaraḥ | vīrabhadreśvaro devi kandukeśaḥ phaṇīśvaraḥ || sudheśvaro gabhastīśo rudreśo bhairaveśvaraḥ | karavīreśvaraścaiva niṣadheśo vaṭeśvaraḥ || 4 || kacchapeśaḥ kāśyapeśaścāvaṭeśo ghṛṇīśvaraḥ | kalaśeśo devikeśaḥ padmeśo magadheśvaraḥ || tuṇḍeśaścaiva huṇḍeśassaureśo varuṇeśvaraḥ | naiṛteśo vaidyuteśo mokṣeśo daṇḍakeśvaraḥ || 6 || maṇḍalīśaḥ kuṇḍalīśaḥ khaṇḍeśo bhāṇḍalīśvaraḥ | gaṇḍeśo garuḍeśaśca candreśo māruteśvaraḥ || vidhīśvarassudhīśaśca tuṇḍakeśo munīśvaraḥ | umeśvaraḥ kapardīśo bhadrakarṇeśvarastathā || 8 || vegeśvaro'tha viṣṇvīśo vairājeśo'mareśvaraḥ | ahirbudhnyeśvaraścaiva jamadagnīśvarastathā || 9 || viśvāmitreśvaraścaiva rāvaṇeśo balīśvaraḥ | manonmanīśvaraścaiva sudhādhāmeśvaro'drije || 10 || mārtāṇḍeśo lalantīśassvarlīneśo dhruveśvaraḥ | gandharveśo'tiviśveśaḥ pāribhadreśvarastathā || 11 || garbheśo marudhanvīśastoraṇeśo dhṛtīśvaraḥ | utpaleśo mahendreśassthāṇveśo bhariteśvaraḥ || 12 || ananteśaḥ kardameśo mṛḍeśo babhrukeśvaraḥ | vāgurīśo varmakeśaḥ paṭabhadreśvarastathā || 13 || śrāmareśo mṛgendreśo hiraṇyeśaḥ pavīśvaraḥ | āgnīdhrīśassannatīśo bṛhatīśo raṇeśvaraḥ || 14 || kirāteśo garjakeśo veṇudāreśvarastathā | jayanteśo madhyameśassaṃgameśo'gatīśvaraḥ || 15 || vidyudgarbheśvaro devi tripureśo harīśvaraḥ | balapramathaneśaśca sarvabhūtadameśvaraḥ || 16 || uśīnareśvaraścaiva gargeśo mantrakeśvaraḥ | tantreśvarassāmakeśo vyomakeśo digīśvaraḥ || 17 || kapālamocaneśāno maṇigarbheśvarastathā | jātukarṇeśvaraścaiva nṛgeśaḥ pāṭaleśvaraḥ || 18 || karṇikeśaśchatrakeśaḥ piṃgaleśaśśileśvaraḥ | madhvīśvaro vāmakeśo yauvaneśassthireśvaraḥ || 19 || bhrāntīśvarojahnukeśo gomedeśo'khileśvaraḥ | viśāleśassihmikeśo ghaṇṭākarṇeśvaro'drije || 20 || vyāghreśo jambukeśaśca laliteśo dhṛtīśvaraḥ | vedeśvaro diṇḍikeśaḥ kaholeśo dhvanīśvaraḥ || 21 || bindukeśo gaṇḍakīśo narmadeśo'nileśvaraḥ | picaṇḍileśvaro'trīśaḥ kanakeśo'dhvareśvaraḥ || 22 ||
pṛ0 154) sadyojāteśvaraścaiva kuliśeśaḥ plaveśvaraḥ | someśvaro vāruṇeśaśśarabheśo jaṭeśvaraḥ || 23 || bhāgakāreśvaro mugdhakeśo rogeśvarastathā | bhallūkeśo virāgeśaḥ krathaneśo dhaneśvaraḥ || 24 || urageśaḥ kaṭhoreśo dardureśorvarīśvarau | kṣipreśvaraśca dālbhyeśo vinateśaśśaśīśvaraḥ || 25 || kakudeśo mukundeśo bhavānīśaśśanīśvaraḥ | vṛṣabheśo dhenukeśassaṃvarteśaḥ kaṇeśvaraḥ || 26 || ṛkṣeśvaraśca candreśo matsyeśo bhāvaneśvaraḥ | turaṃgeśo mataṃgeśaḥ kaṇādeśo bhagīśvaraḥ || 27 || jalandhareśvaraścaiva śvetāśveśaḥ pikeśvaraḥ | raibhyeśo mucukundeśaḥ kaṅkaṇeśaḥ pratheśvaraḥ || 28 || vidyādhareśo nīleśaḥ kakṣībeśaḥ prabheśvaraḥ | maruteśaścarkutīśassvargeśo malayeśvaraḥ || 29 || maṅkaṇeśo jāgatīśo vibudheśo girīśvaraḥ | carvaṇeśo nighūrṇeśo gorakṣo vā gajeśvaraḥ || 30 || kandarpeśassūryakeśaḥ puṣṭeśastuṣṭakeśvaraḥ | vināyakeśvaraścaiva maṇikaṇṭheśvarastathā || 31 || randhreśaḥ pārvatīśaśca vidrumeśo lateśvaraḥ | viriñcīśo bhadrakeśaḥ prasanneśo viśeśvaraḥ || 32 || bhārabhūteśvaraścaiva lokeśaḥ prāṇikeśvaraḥ | andhakeśo muktikeśo harikeśo ṛṣīśvaraḥ || 33 || gāruḍeśaḥ pataṃgeśaḥ kanyeśo dhavaleśvaraḥ | jātukarṇeśvaraścaiva gandhabhadreśvarastathā || 34 || cakreśvaro'ruṇeśaścāpyadālbhyeśaḥ khageśvaraḥ | triyambakeśvaraścaiva gautameśaḥ khaleśvaraḥ || 35 || vitaṇḍeśaśca kaṇṭheśo varāheśaḥ kuleśvaraḥ | kedāreśaḥ phaleśaśca kinnareśo'mṛteśvaraḥ || 36 ||
skandaḥ- kailāsaśailāmalamaulivarye prāgdvāraliṃgālayakalpanaṃ śive | īśānakoṇānalakoṇasaṃsthitaṃ kailāsa īśādyamṛteśvarāntam || 37 || prodyatpatākāvalimaulikumbhaṃ maṇīndradhāmasthasuliṃgamaṇḍalam | bilvottamāṃgaṃ phaṇibhūṣaṇāñcitaṃ tripuṇṭrasaṃśobhitaphāladeśam || 38 || paśyādrije liṃgakulaṃ mamedaṃ sandarśanātpāpaharaṃ sadaiva || 39 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsaprāgdvārasthaliṃgābhidhānannāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 40 ||
pṛ0 155) kailāsadakṣiṇadvāraliṃgakathanaṃ nāma ekacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
īśvaraḥ– evaṃ liṅgakulaṃ bhadre prākkailāsaśikhāśrayam | tathaiva dakṣiṇe cāpi pravakṣye śṛṇu śailaje || 1 || aghoreśaḥ kapālīśaḥ kukkureśo'naleśvaraḥ | indreśvaro yameśaśca naiṛtīśo nabheśvaraḥ || 2 || udāvartīśvaraścaiva dakṣiṇāvartakeśvaraḥ | vikuṇṭheśaḥ kuṭhāreśo mānaveśaḥ kuleśvaraḥ || 3 || jāpakeśo maulikeśaścārjuneśaḥ kanīśvaraḥ | bhagadanteśvaraścaiva nahuṣeśo'mṛteśvaraḥ || 4 || taṅgaṇeśaśca sandhīśo madhyameśo galeśvaraḥ | vidyeśvaraḥ pannageśaḥ krathaneśo niśeśvaraḥ || 5 || divodāseśvaro rāthīratheśaśśaunakeśvaraḥ | gaṇabhadreśvaraścaiva śeṣeśo vāsukīśvaraḥ || 6 || śaṅkhapāleśvaraścaiva citragupteśvarastathā | daṇḍapāṇīśvaraścaiva durgeśassāraseśvaraḥ || 7 || haṃseśvaro mayūreśaścakravākeśvarastathā | manthāneśo manmatheśoratīśo gandhakeśvaraḥ || 8 || bhāṇḍīreśo vaneśaśca purandhrīśaḥ phaleśvaraḥ | kāraṇeśastāraṇeśaḥ kṛttivāseśvarastathā || 9 || janārdaneśo viśveśo mahākāleśvarastathā | sarasvatīśo lakṣmīśaśśacīśaśśakrakeśvaraḥ || 10 || pulaheśaḥ pulastyeśo vṛddhakāleśvarastathā | bhāradvājeśvaraścaiva sāgareśo rameśvaraḥ || 11 || vilekhaneśvaraścaiva citreśaḥ [bilveśa iti pāṭhāntaram |] pādakeśvaraḥ | piṇḍāreśo vasīśaśca tilakeśo dhruveśvaraḥ || 12 || bhaveśvaro'rṇaveśaśca [babhreśvara iti pāṭhāntaram |] kṣībhraṇīśo daleśvaraḥ | karandhameśaḥ kṛṣṇeśo rameśaḥ karṇakeśvaraḥ [parṇakeśvara iti pāṭhāntaran |] || 13 || gaṅgādhareśo mauneśaḥ kurubhadreśvarastathā | kandaleśaśca sāleśastāleśo bilvakeśvaraḥ || 14 || apsareśo mokṣakeśo bhūdāreśaḥ patheśvaraḥ | virādheśaḥ koṅkaṇeśo rabhaseśaścaleśvaraḥ || 15 || haridreśaḥ kuṅkumeśo narakottāraṇeśvaraḥ | sukheśvaro jñānakeśo bhaktīśo muktikeśvaraḥ || 16 || ṛṇamoceśvaraścaiva [ṛṇamocaneśaḥ kāntīśo dharmeśaḥ pāvaneśvaraḥ iti pāṭhāntaram |] kāntīśaḥ pāvaneśvaraḥ | pavaneśaḥ purañjeśo gokarṇeśo vaṭeśvaraḥ || 17 || śālikeśo viśāleśo vītihotreśvarastathā | viśveśvaraśca bhīmeśaśśaṅkareśo'miteśvaraḥ || 18 || pārijāteśvaraścaiva mandāreśo jaṭeśvaraḥ | trijaṭeśaśśikhaṇḍīśo barhīśaḥ panaseśvaraḥ || 19 || phaṇāmaṇīśvaro devi rāmeśo lakṣmaṇeśvaraḥ | arundhatīśo vāgīśaḥ padmagarbheśvarastathā || 20 || harinmaṇīśo bhakṣyeśaḥ kuśalīśastarīśvaraḥ | uddālakeśvaro naktañcareśo'parṇakeśvaraḥ || 21 ||
pṛ0 156) śāṇḍilyeśaśchāgaleśo niriccheśaḥ kuśeśvaraḥ | dūrveśvaro'namitreśaḥ karkandheśo'guṇeśvaraḥ || 22 || kuruvindeśvaraścaiva paṭṭīśaḥ kuṭajeśvaraḥ | śrīśaileśo gaṇeśaśca haridvāreśvarastathā || 23 || gaṅgādvāreśvaraścaiva kurukṣetreśvarastathā | surābhāṇḍeśvaraścaiva yayātīśaḥ kutheśvaraḥ || 24 || vārāṇasīśvaraścaivāpyavimukteśvarastathā | kālahastīśvaraścaiva viṣṇucakrapradeśvaraḥ || 25 || romantheśo'pyagastyeśo mālaveśo bhageśvaraḥ | aṅkoleśaḥ pradhāneśo māruteśo bhaveśvaraḥ || 26 || nakṣatreśastālakeśo bhallikeśaḥ kuheśvaraḥ | rogahārīśvaraścaiva trijaṭeśo ghaneśvaraḥ || 27 || suparṇeśastāṇḍaveśo maṇḍaleśo matīśvaraḥ | takṣakeśaḥ pravāleśo haribhadreśvarastathā || 28 || virodheśastumbureśo nāradeśo gareśvaraḥ | ramyeśvaro vidrumeśaḥ kardameśastṛṇeśvaraḥ || 29 || śūlaṭaṅkeśvaraścaiva chadmakeśo balīśvaraḥ | marudhāmeśvaraścaiva sindhūreśo ghṛṇīśvaraḥ || 30 || vrāteśvaraḥ prayāgeśaḥ pratiṣṭhānapureśvaraḥ | godāvarīśvaraścaiva tāmraparṇīśvarastathā || 31 || marudvṛdheśvaraścaiva pampeśaḥ paṅkileśvaraḥ | pheneśo budbudeśaścāpyāvarteśassumeśvaraḥ || 32 || kuleśvaro virāṭeśaḥ palāśeśassthitīśvaraḥ | pralayeśo jāgradīśastrilokeśaḥ kṣitīśvaraḥ || 33 || pañcakeśo vratīśaśca yajñeśo dumbareśvaraḥ | bālīśaścaiva pālīśaḥ palīśo babhraveśvaraḥ || 34 || gandhadvāreśvaraścaiva ghaṇṭeśo varuṇeśvaraḥ | prabhāseśaḥ puṣkareśo rudrakoṭīśvarastathā || 35 || valmīkeśassundareśastṛṇajyotīśvarastathā | gāyatrīśassavitrīśaḥ kāladvāreśvarastathā || 36 || tuṅgeśo bhīmacaṇḍeśo ratnagarbheśvarastathā | deveśvaro hīrakeśo rantideveśvarastathā || 37 || kālañjareśvaro'bdhīśaḥ paippalādeśvarastathā | gandharveśastriśūleśo rajanīśo dineśvaraḥ || 38 || citraghaṇṭeśvaraścaiva dvārapīṭheśvarastathā | trikūṭeśo maṅgaleśastathaivāmalakeśvaraḥ || 39 || mudreśastāṭakeśaśca tridaṇḍīśo'gajeśvaraḥ | kātyāyanīśvaraścaiva yājñyavalkyeśvarastathā || 40 || tvaṣṭreśo viśvakarmeśo yameśo rathakeśvaraḥ | vasundhareśvaraścaiva kṣaumeśo nālakeśvaraḥ || 41 || mitreśvaraśca kartrīśaḥ [kaṇṭheśa iti pāṭhāntaram |] kāvyeśo vibudheśvaraḥ | bhaumeśvaro bhartṛkeśaḥ karahaṭṭeśvarastathā || 42 || gṛdhreśaḥ kaṅkatīśaśca kāvyeśassvarṇadeśvaraḥ || 43 || etāni divyamaṇidhāmagatāni devi liṅgāni yāmyasubhagodyatasomamauli |
pṛ0 157) candropalākalitaliṅgatatīni paśya cāgneyanaiṛtatatāni śive'ghahantṛ || 44 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsadakṣiṇadvāraliṃgakathanaṃ nāma ekacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 41 ||
kailāsapaścimadvāraliṃgakathanaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
īśvaraḥ– kailāsadakṣiṇāpāraśṛṅgaughe te śivālayāḥ | anantānyapi liṅgāni teṣūtkṛṣṭā mayoditāḥ || 1 || pāścātyāpāraśṛṅgeṣu śṛṇu liṅgakulaṃ śive | prasiddhānyapi liṃgāni mameṣṭāni śṛṇu priye || 2 || tatpūruṣeśassthāṇvīśaḥ paiṃgeśo ruḍajeśvaraḥ | sālveśvarassthānakeśo vainateśassaleśvaraḥ || 3 || musaleśo hāṭakeśo rudradhanvīśvarastathā | jvarāpahārakeśaśca tathā kṣayahareśvaraḥ || 4 || prāṇeśaśca vidarbheśo deveśastvacaleśvaraḥ | anaṃgeśaśśambareśa ugreśo dhānyakeśvaraḥ || 5 || balāśaśīśvaraścaiva ghanaghoṣeśvarastathā | vedagarbheśvaraścaiva oṅkāreśaśśikhīśvaraḥ || 6 || gadādhareśvaraścaiva bilvamūleśvarastathā | sūtreśvaro bhāratīśastuṃgabhadreśvarastathā || 7 || sanātaneśo vaidyeśaḥ kuliṅgeśaḥ prajeśvaraḥ | māṇḍavyeśastāmbakeśo bodheśo vighaseśvaraḥ || 8 || praghaseśo'tha ṛbhvīśo gaṇagīteśvarastathā | śukleśvaraḥ prasiddheśassiddheśaśca śanīśvaraḥ || 9 || pakṣīśaḥ patrikeśaśca kulīśo'thavanīśvaraḥ | parveśvaraḥ parvateśassarveśaḥ kāntikeśvaraḥ || 10 || barhidhvajeśvaraścaiva kapoteśaḥ khaṇīśvaraḥ | śateśvaro romakeśaḥ kāvyeśo varṣakeśvaraḥ || 11 || somanandīśvaraścaiva triphalīśaḥ khareśvaraḥ | hanehatīśvaraścaiva [hanahetīśvara iti pāṭhaḥ |] śatarceśo bhaveśvaraḥ || 12 || viḍūratheśvaraścaiva karambhīśassruveśvaraḥ | gaṇeśvaro vardhikeśassaddhrīśaḥ krikakeśvaraḥ || 13 || citravyādheśvaraścaiva raupyeśo bandhakeśvaraḥ | tathā paśupatīśaśca bhayahārīśvarastathā || 14 || janmahārīśvaraścaiva duḥkhahārīśvarastathā | brahmayonīśvaraścaiva viṣṇugarbheśvarastathā || 15 || rudralomeśvaraścaiva cendradhāmeśvarastathā | candracūḍeśvaraścaiva agnigarbheśvarastathā || 16 || vāyavīśo jaleśaśca megheśo vaidyudeśvaraḥ | amodeśastittirīśo dyāvābhūmīśvarastathā || 17 || gajājinadhareśaśca narasihmeśvarastathā | aupāsaneśvaraścaiva havyeśo gaṇakeśvaraḥ || 18 ||
pṛ0 158) karṇikeśodadhīceśo jhaṅkeśaḥ karkaṭīśvaraḥ | jābāleśassubāleśaḥ purahāreśvarastathā || 19 || ṛgvedeśo'tharvakeśaḥ purāṇeśorvaśīśvarau | itihāseśvaraścaiva dharmasāreśvarastathā || 20 || sāṅkhyeśvaraśca yogeśo maulīśaḥ pālikeśvaraḥ | kujambheśaśca jambheśo rājarājeśvarastathā || 21 || kauthumīśo viśākheśasskanneśaḥ phalikeśvaraḥ | kadalīśaḥ pṛṣṭakīśaḥ pṛthvīśaḥ kārmukeśvaraḥ || 22 || antarikṣeśvaraścaiva maitreśaḥ kumudeśvaraḥ | udāvaseśvaraścaiva malleśo brahmakeśvaraḥ || 23 || taraṅgeśaḥ kuraṅgeśo makarandeśvarastathā | sudhādhareśvaraścaiva dhṛtakeśeśvarastathā || 24 || vyāleśvaro vitarkeśaḥ kānaneśo munīśvaraḥ [timīśvara iti pāṭhaḥ |] | bhadramāleśvaraścaiva ketumāleśvarastathā || 25 || mandareśo vindhyakeśo himeśo nīlakeśvaraḥ | mahendreśaḥ karmakeśo ṛtvīśo dhūnaneśvaraḥ || 26 || vītahavyeśvaraścaivāpyaśvatthāmeśvarastathā | śiśireśastīrthakeśo himeśo nīlakeśvaraḥ || 27 || mahendreśaḥ karmakeśastrinaveśobjakeśvaraḥ | apasmārahareśaśca somacaṇḍīśvarastathā || 28 || tathā mārgasahāyeśo devīśo'ruṇajeśvaraḥ | jvalaneśaḥ pāvakeśastathaivāṅgiraseśvaraḥ || 29 || dakṣeśvaro vidakṣeśo mainākeśassatīśvaraḥ | pramatheśaḥ pramāthīśo bhojeśo vikrameśvaraḥ || 30 || īḍyeśvaraśca yājyeśaḥ karṇavedheśvarastathā | tarṇakeśaḥ pāṇḍareśo meghavāheśvarastathā || 31 || kaniṣṭeśaśca jyeṣṭeśastāmreśaśśaunakeśvaraḥ | anāhateśvaraścaiva pīteśo dhūmrakeśvaraḥ || 32 || bandhamocanakeśaśca tathā devi śateśvaraḥ | bhramareśaḥ kāṇṭhakeśo drumacaṇḍīśva * stathā || 33 || viśālākṣeśvaraścaiva vasanteśaḥ khageśvaraḥ | gajāsurahareśaśca nīlakaṇṭheśvarastathā || 34 || sumitrāvaruṇeśaśca kalahaṃseśvarastathā | sāvitrīśo gomatīśo gonardeśo vṛṣeśvaraḥ || 35 || gatipradeśvaraścaiva vyāseśo golakeśvaraḥ | mahābhūteśvaraścaiva raseśo gandhakeśvaraḥ || 36 || bāḍabeśo bhaṭeśaśca sarvaprāṇātigeśvaraḥ | taṭātakeśvaraścaiva garbhakośeśvarastathā || 37 || toraṇeśo rathīśaścāpyātapeśaśśaśīśvaraḥ | dundubhīśassindhureśo javaneśaḥ kṛpeśvaraḥ [kṛṣīśvara iti pāṭhāntaram |] || 38 || varabhadreśvaraścaiva karṇadāreśvarastathā | tāmradhvajeśvaraścaiva kovidāreśvarastathā || 39 || śatadrutīśvaraścaiva mahārogahareśvaraḥ | kāmadāneśvaraścaiva bilvādeśo nimīśvaraḥ || 40 || rudreśo nāgakeśaśca tāraṇeśo'mbikeśvaraḥ || 41 ||
pṛ0 159) īśvaraḥ- śaracchaśigalatsudhārasasamānaliṅgāvali- rharinmaṇinibhachaviprathitabilvamaulīndukam | phaṇīndraphaṇimaṇḍalākalitaphālapuṇṭrāṅkitaṃ maṇīndravaradhāmagaṃ vasitagandhabandhāmbaram || 42 || paścādbhāganage mamaiva vihitāṃ liṅgāvalīndu prabhām || prapaśya girikanyake nayanayugmadhanyottarāṃ mahāghakuladāriṇīṃ sakalaśokasaṃhāriṇīm | ravīndukarapeṣiṇīṃ mama gaṇendrasantoṣiṇīṃ phaṇīndravarabhūṣaṇīṃ madanadehasaṃploṣaṇīm || 43 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsapaścimadvāraliṃgakathanannāma dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 42 ||
kailāsottaradvāraliṃgasaudhakathanannāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
īśvaraḥ– evaṃ paścimabhāgasthaliṅgasaṅkhyā mayoditā | taduttarāpāraśṛṅge śṛṇu tatkathayāmyaham || 1 || tadapi śṛṇu bhaktyā tvaṃ sumanaskā sadāmbike | liṅgasaṅghaṃ supuṇyānāṃ mukuṭaṃ paśya pārvati || 2 || vāmadeveśvaro devi girikeśassukeśvaraḥ | bṛhaspatīśvaraścaiva vardhaneśaḥ pikeśvaraḥ || 3 || kokileśaḥ picaṇḍeśo vāmakarṇeśvarastathā | ānandeśaḥ karmareśaścāmareśaḥ patīśvaraḥ || 4 || vairāgyeśaḥ kalpakeśo haribrahmeśvarastathā | gaṇeśastriguṇeśaśca brahmāṇḍeśaśśaṭheśvaraḥ || 5 || vilāseśassukeśeśaścāmakeśaḥ plaveśvaraḥ | annakośeśvaraścaiva prāṇakośeśvarastathā || 6 || vijñāneśo'ghanāśeśaścatmeśorakṣakeśvaraḥ | āhananyeśvaraścaiva mugdheśaḥ koṭikeśvaraḥ || 7 || nisarpīśo nāmaneśaścāmreśaḥ kamaṭheśvaraḥ | śanāśaneśvaraścaiva corugāyeśvarastathā || 8 || kapiñjaleśvaraścaiva karkeśaṣṣaṇḍakeśvaraḥ | asaṃgeśaśca saṃgeśo jyotīśaḥ kāraṇeśvaraḥ || 9 || harirudreśvaraścaiva kṛpāṇeśo nimīśvaraḥ | kanakāvartakeśaśca harīśo bhāruṇeśvaraḥ || 10 ||
pṛ0 160) āmreśvaro [abhreśvara iti pāṭhāntaram |] dabhrakeśo dandaśūkeśvarastathā | udāreśendumaulīśau makheśaśca sabheśvaraḥ || 11 || harikeśaḥ kiśoreśaḥ kuddāleśo'rbhakeśvaraḥ | yuveśvaraśca vṛddheśo dardureśo brasīśvaraḥ || 12 || matīśvaro vanastheśo grahastheśo'rijeśvaraḥ | sahasreśaśśateśaśca lakṣeśaḥ koṭikeśvaraḥ || 13 || cāṣeśvaro bhānukeśo dandirāvartikeśvaraḥ | kastūrīśo madantīśo manasvīśo'rbudeśvaraḥ || 14 || airāvateśvaraścaiva tañjeśo lindukeśvaraḥ | ahaṅkāreśva * ścaiva phālanetreśvarastathā || 15 || tathaivailabileśaśca kṛkeśaścarakeśvaraḥ [krakeśo'carakeśvara iti pāṭhāntaram |] | padmāsaneśvaraścaiva vāreśastarageśvaraḥ || 16 || vaṭamūleśvaraścaiva trasanneśo lutīśvaraḥ | nakuleśo'tha vaṃśeśaḥ padmanetreśvarastathā || 17 || upaśānteśvaraścaiva dameśo vratakeśvaraḥ | ulūkeśo'tha ruṇḍeśaḥ kāleśaḥ kamaleśvaraḥ || 18 || bhagandhareśvaraścaiva bhadreśo bharaṇīśvaraḥ | aśvinīśo rohiṇīśaḥ paṅkajeśo'vaṭeśvaraḥ || 19 || nidhaneśastathordhveśo bhasmeśaśca sameśvaraḥ | bhaveśaścaiva sarveśo vedeśaśśāśvateśvaraḥ || 20 || jvāleśvarassālakeśastamāleśaḥ puṇyakeśvaraḥ | upadhyeśo'ṇimāṇḍeśassarvarakteśvarastathā || 21 || śunaḥ parṇeśvaraścaiva mādaneśaḥ pratheśvaraḥ | śipiviṣṭeśvaraścaiva aṃśeśo'tha mṛgeśvaraḥ || 22 || gajānaneśvaraścaiva bāṇeśo vīrakeśvaraḥ | caṇḍeśvaraśca muṇḍeśaścakreśaḥ phaṇikeśvaraḥ || 23 || anasūyeśvaraścaiva gandhamādeśa īśvaraḥ | bhaṇḍeśvaraḥ prajaṅgheśaḥ kālakaṇṭheśvarastathā || 24 || mṛtyuñjayeśaśśaileśassāraseśo'gatīśvaraḥ | svapneśo jāgratīśaśca suṣuptīśo'hanīśvaraḥ || 25 || śitikaṇṭheśvaraścaiva sūryeśaḥ kāntikeśvaraḥ | sphaṭikeśaśca rudreśo varadeśo'nṛṇīśvaraḥ || 26 || śārdūleśo rabhasyeśaḥ puṇṭreśo naṭaneśvaraḥ | rudrākṣeśaḥ kavīndreśaḥ kavaceśo maṇīśvaraḥ || 27 || pilippileśvaraścaiva āmardeśo druṇeśvaraḥ | pitāmaheśvaraścaiva kuṭileśo jhaṣeśvaraḥ || 28 || bharateśaḥ kesarīśaścakṣuśśrotreśvarastathā | daṇḍakeśaśca laṅkeśo maṇibhadreśvarastathā || 29 || ghaṭotkaceśvaraścaiva pureśo'tha naṭeśvaraḥ | karamardeśvaraścaiva tathaivāmrātakeśvaraḥ || 30 || phaṇibhūṣeśvaraścaiva ratnabhūteśvarastathā | biḍālakeśvaraścaiva aṇīśo mahatīśvaraḥ || 31 || pūruṣeśoparambheśau girīśo ramaṇīśvaraḥ | kavaṅgeśaḥ karīndreśo māgheśo vāṣkaleśvaraḥ || 32 || mahānādeśvaraścaiva maṇṭapeśo balīśvaraḥ | jariteśaḥ [rajateśaḥ iti pāṭhāntaram |] kūrmakeśaścaturbhadreśvarastathā || 33 || puṣparāgeśvaraścaiva gomedeśo laveśvaraḥ | tṛtīśvaraḥ kṣapeśaśca prasādeśaḥ kuleśvaraḥ || 34 ||
pṛ0 161) vajreśvaraḥ kṣetrakeśaḥ karṇikāreśvarastathā | karavīreśvaraścaiva puṇḍarīkeśvarastathā || 35 || vīṇāpāṇīśvaraścaiva tantrīśo nāgakeśvaraḥ | hāhāhūhvīśvaraścaiva payodeśaḥ kratheśvaraḥ || 36 || guḍasāreśvaraścaiva śvetadānapradeśvaraḥ | pradāneśaśśilādeśaḥ kandeśaḥ padadeśvaraḥ || 37 || trilocaneśo bhāṅkṣeśassthūlakarṇeśvarastathā | prakaṭeśo dhārakeśaḥ kośātīteśvarastathā || 38 || yantreśvaraśca mantreśastathā kanakhaleśvaraḥ | gargareśaḥ pratāpeśa ātāryeśaḥ kuṇīśvaraḥ || 39 || bhagīratheśvaraścaiva dilīpeśaḥ kṛtīśvaraḥ | anādīśo mantravideśvaro guṇahareśvaraḥ || 40 || śaṅgeśvaraḥ piśaṅgeśaḥ pāryeśastāraṇeśvaraḥ | kakāreśo mātṛkeśaḥ kuṣṭahārīśvarastathā || 41 || hārīteśastathākṣeśo bakadālbhyeśvarastathā | lopāmudreśvaraścaiva surābhāṇḍeśvarastathā [kumbhajanmeśvarastathā iti pāṭhāntaram |] || 42 || maṇihastīśvaraścaiva tathā citradhvajeśvaraḥ | ratnadhvajeśvaraścaiva kāmeśo rudraṇīśvaraḥ || 43 || avantīśaḥ karpaṭīśodhvajeśaśchatrakeśvaraḥ | devakanyeśvaraścaiva nāgakanyeśvarastathā || 44 || satyeśvarassunātheśaḥ kubereśo vaneśvaraḥ | pavitreśo valakṣeśo mahokṣeśo nageśvaraḥ || 45 || sudheśo vibudheśaśca phullaśaulālikeśvaraḥ | śayaneśo dhāvateśassamāsīneśvarastathā || 46 || sarvakāmasamṛddhīśassaccideśassukheśvaraḥ | praṇatārtihareśaśca pañcagavyeśvarastathā [pañcagaṃgeśvarastathā iti pāṭhāntaram |] || 47 || padmanābheśvaraścaiva pañcavaktreśvarastathā | pañcākṣareśañcandeśassudeśaḥ kauśikeśvaraḥ || 48 || ādarśeśaḥ kālakeśaḥ kālāvarteśvarastathā | tāmradhvajeśvaraścaiva tathā haṃsadhvajeśvaraḥ || 49 || vṛṣadhvajeśvaraścaiva tathā sihmadhvajeśvaraḥ | piccheśvaraḥ kumāreśo niṣaṃgeśaḥ kulīśvaraḥ || 50 || īśāneśo vikarteśassurabhīśo'ṇukeśvaraḥ | sāraṃgeśaḥ khaṅgakeśo bandhureśo gameśvaraḥ || 51 || śacīśvaro sādhureśastathā rudragaṇeśvaraḥ ||
īśvaraḥ- etatte divyaliṃgānāṃ nāmāni kathitānyume | yidaṃ prātarutthāya pūjayeta paṭhetavai || 52 || sakailāsasthaliṃgānāṃ pūjāphalamavāpnuyāt | liṃgādhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ paṭhanrudragaṇo bhavet || 53 || sahasraṃ kathitaṃ teṣu teṣūtkṛṣṭatamaṃ śive | anantānyapiliṃgāni koṭīśaḥ kamalānane || 54 || sārabhūtāni liṃgāni kathitāni tavāmbike | santi kailāsaśikhare mayātūktāni pārvati || 55 || kimpunarbahunoktena sarvaliṃgamayonagaḥ || 56 ||
pṛ0 162) kailāsaśailamaṇidhāmagadivyatuṃgasomopalākalitaliṃgakulaṃ kiledam | tanmaulipālivihitendukalājharībhirāplāvito'dritanaye nagamaulireṣaḥ || 57 || tanmaulisaṃgaśivaliṃgamaṇīndradhāmakumbhairvibhāti kila śailakulāvataṃsaḥ | nānārkasomaśatakoṭisahasrakāntaḥ kāntyādhiko nagavaraḥ pravibhāti devi || kulācalakumārike madhuharākṣi paṅkeruha- prabhāyutapadāmbujāśrayaṇato'tikāntyā mama | vibhāti sumaśekharadrumavanotthagandhānilai- rmamāṃgakalitākṣijaśravaṇapāraṇaiśśailarāṭ || 59 || kaladhautakalāvilāsaśailo mama maulistha kalādharorubhāsā | dhagadhagitajaṭorujātaharṣo mama saudhottamakumbhaśekharairgirīndraḥ || 60 || śrīliṃgadhāmavilasaddyumaṇiprabhābhiḥ kumbhairvicumbitamahāmbarakośakāśaḥ | bhrājatpatākanivahāruṇavātapotadodhūyitākhilaśikho nagarāḍvibhāti || 61 || udyadbāladivākarendusadṛśaiḥ kailāsaśṛṅgāgragai- rmāṇikyāmalahīrakaiśca kalitaiḥ kumbhaiśśivāgāragaiḥ | tattallokanivāsibhiśśivagaṇaissañjātavismāpakai- rnānāsūryaśaśāṅkasambhavamahākāntyādhiko'yaṃ nagaḥ || 62 || tārārājavirājamānamukuṭālaṅkāraliṃgārcakaiḥ prāpyeyaṃ kaladhautaśailavasatirdhūtāghasaṅghairapi | naprāpyaiva yamānilāśanatapoyogādiyogairapi brahmendrādimarudgaṇairapi sadā prāpyāndhakārairmama || 63 || bhaktyāliṃgitamānasaiśca sukaraṃ nānyaḥ panthāstasya hi dhanyaḥ kailāsaśailo nagakulatilako liṃgasaṅghaikamauliḥ | santoṣyāmbujamitracitraviśikhassvarbhānubhakṣākṣako matto'pārayugotthaśuddhatapasā lebhe varaṃ śaṅkarāt || 64 ||
pṛ0 163) tasminneva nivāsa īśituriti premāspadatvaṃ purā saṃyāce'khilamuktaye kila girīndreśaśśivaprītikṛt || 65 ||
skandaḥ– iti śivavacanaṃ niśamya gaurī praṇanāmendukalādharasya pādau | parito'bhisamīkṣya liṃgasaṅghaṃ ghanagātrotpulakairuvāca devī || 66 ||
pārvatī– śambho bhīma bhavāndhakāsurahara tryakṣākṣaromāpate mannātha pramathādhinātha dayayā me khaṇḍaparśo vada | kiṃ vānena tava prasādajanakaṃ taptaṃ tapastena hi kailāsena tavaiva vāsakaraṇaṃ puṇyairagaṇyairapi || 67 || kiṃ vānena tapaḥparaṃ suvihitaṃ cīrṇaṃ cirādyatprabho liṃgārādhanameva kevalamaho premāspadaṃ te prabho | kiṃ vākāri nagendradhanyatilakenārādhitastvaṃ kathaṃ liṃgāpāraśikhālayo'yamadhunā nānyaṃ nagendrātparam || 68 || dhanyo'yaṃ girirājarājatilako liṃgālimaulissadā caikaṃ vā kṣaṇasaṃsthitaṃ tvaghakulaṃ liṃgaṃ haratyeva te | yatrāpāramaheśasaudhavaragaṃ liṃgottamānāṃ kulaṃ caitatsaṃgatavāgupetagatito lokā vimuktākhilāḥ || 69 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsottaradvāraliṃgasaudhakathanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 43 ||
kailāsatapaścaryānāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
īśvaraḥ– śṛṇvaparṇe tapaścaryākāraṇaṃ bhūdharasya ca | mama kailāsavaryasya sarvaliṃgālayasya ca || 1 || nagendratilakaścāyaṃ nānānirjharakandaraḥ | nānāśākhiśatopeto nānāpakṣivirājitaḥ || 2 || devi pakṣigaṇārāvaisstoṣyanniva sa māṃ sthitaḥ | nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇo nānā drumalatāyutaḥ || 3 ||
pṛ0 164) nānāśikharigodbhāsiśṛṃgamaulirayaṃ śive | purā mayaiva manasā kalpito'yaṃ mahīdharaḥ || 4 || matsṛṣṭimātrādatyantaṃ manasaḥ prītimānabhūt | matprasādāya ca punastapaścakre yugadvayam || 5 || dharādharendro deveśi tacchṛṇuṣvākhilaṃ mama | jvaladaṃgārasantāpaissantaptākhilagātrakaḥ || 6 || ūrdhvaṃ ravikaraistaptaśśatarudrajapādaraḥ | sahasrahāyanaṃ śailaḥ parṇabhugvāyubhuktataḥ || 7 || sahasraṃ dhūmabhakṣaśca sahasraṃ salilāśanaḥ | nirāhārassahasraṃ syādbhasmachannassadaiva hi || 8 || yugamekamathovāsa mama liṃgārcane rataḥ | śaileśvarābhidhaṃ tatra talliṃgambilvapallavaiḥ || 9 || trikālamarcayadbhaktyā dhyāyanmāṃ svahṛdā nagaḥ | triṇetraṃ nīlakaṇṭhañca rājaccandrakalādharam || 10 || gaṃgātaraṃgavilasatpadmamālāvirājitam | bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṃgaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitam || 11 || nāgayajñopavītañca phaṇibhūṣāvirājitam | bhasmoddhūlitasarvāṃgaṃ tripuṇṭrapariśobhitam || 12 || umayā sahitandevamaṃgarāgojvalāṃgakam | mandārakundadāmodyatkandharālaṅkṛtorasam || 13 || karikṛttipaṭībhāsvatkaṭītaṭavirājitam | phaṇimaulimahāratnagaṇāñcitasukuṇḍalam || 14 || hīratāramahāsārapadmarāgasukaṅkaṇam | āraktorumahāpaṭṭarājatpādāmbujadvayam || 15 || mahārhavasanaṃ devaṃ prasannāsyaṃ sadāśivam | aṣṭamīsomasaṅkāśanakharājivirājitam || 16 || utphullapuṇḍarīkākṣavadanaṃ smarasundaram | dāḍimībījasaṅkāśaradanāvalibhūṣitam || 17 || pakvabimbaphalodāraradapracchadaśobhitam | nīlendīvarasaṅkāśamānīlāraktalocanam || 18 || prasādasumukhaṃ sākṣājjagatāṃ sākṣimīśvaram | harinmaṇinibhākārāṃ mamāṅkasthāñca tvāmapi || 19 || dadhyau nagendratilakaḥ puṣpadhaṃmillaśobhitām | cāṃpeyakalikodbhāsidivyanāsāvirājitām || 20 || udyatkavinibhātyacchamuktāphalasunāsikāṃ | sīmantarekhāsindūrarājatphālasuśobhitām || 21 || maṇidhvajamahācāpasannibhabhrūyugojvalām | kastūrītilakollāsiphālabhāgamanoharām || 22 || udyadutphullanīlācchadalaraktadṛśā yutām | hīrasārakaṇātyacchadantapaṃktivirājitām || 23 || dāḍimīpuṣpasaṅkāśādharadhārārasāṃ śivām | tāmbūlāpūritamukhīṃ prasannāṃ sasmitāmumām || 24 || tapanoḍupavibhrājatkarṇatāṭaṅkamaṇḍitām | karṇapatramaṇivrātabhāsvanmaṇḍitagaṇḍakām || 25 || kapolapālikādarśadhagaddhagitadiktaṭām | campakoddāmakahlāravakulāśokanāgakaiḥ || 26 || maruddamanakodbhāsimallīmullīsarāvṛtām | veṇumaṇḍalaratnāṅkacandrakhaṇḍaśikhaṇḍakām || 27 || graiveyalagnamaṇijasarāvalilasadgalām | cintākallolamuktāccharājatpadakasantatim || 28 ||
pṛ0 165) navaratnamaṇibhrājaddhīrahāroruvakṣajām | suratnapuṣpagucchācchadhāritāyataveṇikām || 29 || parāketotthitāpārapītodyatketakairyutām | ketakīgandhasubhagaśītavātāyitāṅgakām || tribhaṅgīsubhagākāratalodaravirājitām | tārāsvacchamahāvṛttamuktāhāravirājitām || sphuratpadakaratnācchakāntikāñcitadiktaṭām | ratnahāramaṇībhāsvannavaratnāliśobhitām || unmattakaraṭīkumbhasuvarṇābhakucojvalām | pāṭīrasārakastūrīcandracandanacarcitām || paṭavāsāgarubhavatailagandhaikabhāsurām | nicolaratnaparyantamuktājālalasatkucām || 34 || trivalīlalitodārasunābhyudaraśobhitām | mṛṇālanālasubhagaratnabāhudvayāñcitām || nānādalacitānekābāhubhūṣaṇabhūṣitām [ratnacita iti pāṭhāntaram |] | nāgabandhaphaṇāratnalolitāpāramauktikām || vaṅkikāphallikābhrājadratnapaṅkajaśobhitām | maṇimāṇikyakhacitahastakaṅkaṇaśobhitām || ratnāṅgulīyavilasannakhapaṃktivirājitām | mahāhīrācchaphalakāṅguṣṭhaveṣṭanaveṣṭitām || tadaṅguṣṭhaśirottuṅgacalanātkāntadiktaṭām | suratnakāñcīkhacitanavaratnaprabhotkaṭām || tadadhastāllalatkṣudraghaṇṭāraṇitasundarām | dāḍimīphullakusumakāntirañjitacelikām || ratnaparyantasārācchadhārāpluṣṭakucottarām [kacottarāmiti pāṭhāntaram |] | maṇimañjīraśiñjānalagnapādāmbujadvayām || padapāthojakāṅguṣṭhaveṣṭanāgrotthagucchakām | pādāṅgulīyabhūṣābhirālaktāṅkitapadvayām || brahmendraviṣṇujananīṃ mamāṅkaghanavidyutam | etādṛśīṃ tvāṃ dhyāyantsa nagarāṭsthiramānasaḥ || umāsahāyaṃ māmevaṃ dhyāyannāste sadā mudā | svahṛdutphullapāthojavikāsanaraviṃ śivam || bahūnvarṣagaṇāndevi kailāsadharaṇīdharaḥ | nidāghe pañcavahnistho varṣāsu gaganāśrayaḥ || 45 || hemante jalaśāyī ca kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ | parṇāśanoyugaṃ sāgraṃ yugaṃ kandāśano'bhavat || yugañca vāyubhakṣassyādvātāśana iva sthitaḥ | mama liṅgārcanaparo maulirudrākṣabhūṣaṇaḥ [bhūtirudrākṣabhūṣaṇa iti pāṭhāntaram |] || pañcākṣarajapāsaktaḥ pañcāsyadhyānapūrvakam | rudrādhyāyajapāsakto rudravinyastamānasaḥ || evaṃ yugānāṃ daśakaṃ tapyamāno nageśvaraḥ | ugrārcanarato'pyugraṃ tapaścakre nirargalam || 49 || sa tvanugramanā devi devānāṃ vismayāvaham | munīnāñca gaṇendrāṇāṃ māmayaṃ toṣayan giriḥ || sa pidhāyendriyagrāmaṃ nāsāgranyastalocanaḥ | yamādiniyamopetaḥ prāṇāyāmahatāśubhaḥ ||
pṛ0 166) praṇavapravaṇo nityaṃ yogaṃ yuñjanmadāśrayaḥ | aṣṭāṅgayoganirataścāṣṭamūrteḥ padāśrayaḥ || 52 || uṭajaikaniketaśca kūṭastho vikaṭojvalaḥ | dhūrjaṭipremasadanaṃ mānasaṃ kṛtavānnagaḥ || 53 || valmīkenāvṛtatanurgirirapyatikarśitaḥ | tapaikarāśirvārāśiriva mānasapaṅkajam || 54 || hṛdutphullamahāmbhojamadhyagaṃ māmanusmaran | dhyānadhārānavicchinnaṃ kadācinnākarodayam || śākhāgrātpatitaiḥ pravātacalanādālūnavṛntaiḥ phalaiḥ patraiḥ kesarakarṇikādibhirubhe kurvantsvavṛttiṃ nagaḥ | parṣāṇāmayutaṃ cacāra niyataṃ bhūyastapomeduraṃ kurvanprāṇavidāraṇaṃ vanagavāṃ romanthaphenāśanaḥ || 55 || madbhaktastu saritpatiṃ culukavatkhadyotavadbhāskaraṃ meruṃ paśyati loṣṭavacchivarataḥ kalpadrumaṃ kāṣṭhavat | cintāratnaśilāmaṇiṃ śakalavadbhūmeḥ patiṃ bhṛtyava- tsaṃsāraṃ tṛṇarāśivatkimaparaṃ dehaṃ nijaṃ bhāravat || 56 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsatapaścaryānāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 44 ||
kailāsavarapradānaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
īśvaraḥ– tasya taṃ bhāvamālokya tvayāhaṃ preritastadā | kālena bahunā devi tasyāhaṃ nikaṭaṅgataḥ || 1 || śāradābhraghanākāravṛṣabhopari kalpite | ratnasihmāsane bhāsvatprabhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍite || 2 || ratnapalyāṇavilasanmuktānāsāvirājite | suśṛṅgamukuṭodbhāsikarṇālambitacāmare || 3 || udyaddyumaṇisaṅkāśaṃ netrakāntivirājitam | maṇighaṇṭācaṇatkārarañjitagrīvayā yute || 4 || dhavale śarvarīnāthakāntigharṣitaketuke | tvayāhaṃ vṛṣabhe devi saṃsthitaḥ kāmage śive || 5 || tasyaiva nikaṭaṃ prāpto gaṇabṛndaniṣevitaḥ | nandiprotsāritasuro munibṛndasusaṃstutaḥ [munigandharva iti pāṭhaḥ |] || 6 || tuhuṇḍadhṛtaratnācchachatrāvṛtamahojvalaḥ | somanandituhuṇḍubhyāṃ maṇidaṇḍaiśca cāmaraiḥ || 7 ||
pṛ0 167) vījito vyajanodyadbhābhāṇḍakenātha caṇḍinā | śobhitassevito vātaissugandhataraśītakaiḥ || 8 || patākāprojvalākārabāhubhirme gaṇeśvaraḥ | bāṇabāṇāsanadharobāṇobāhusahasrakaiḥ || 9 || śobhitaḥ parito devi kalāpadharamuṇḍinā | bhṛṅgitāṇḍavasannāhadarśanānanditāntaraḥ || 10 || taṇḍuḍiṇḍimanādena ḍambarāmbaradiṅmukhaḥ | sānandaśaṅkhadhavalaravāsphoṭitadiktaṭaḥ || 11 || caṇḍīśamaddaloddāmadhvanidhvanitavyomabhūḥ | herambabṛhmitāpāraghanaghoṣorusundaraḥ || 12 || ṣaḍvaktrakāhalāpāranādāpūritadiṅmukhaḥ | ratnapādukamaulistha bhairaveṇānumoditaḥ || 13 || ukṣādhastalasañcāribhadramaulikapādabhūḥ | nāradodāramadhuravīṇākvaṇanasundaraḥ || 14 || devavandiravāpāranamasāṃ stutisundaraḥ | maṇibhadramahāhetipāṭitaiḥ [mahāhastapaṭahāhatipāṭitairiti pāṭhaḥ |] paṭahairyutaḥ || 15 || lekhottamamukhaistatra sevito'haṃ tvayāmbike | jhallarīvarakoddāmaravānandena keśinā || 16 || sukeśamukhavāyūtthaśṛṅgadhvaniyutā diśaḥ | ānakoddāmajārāvasubhadreṇa prakalpitaḥ || 17 || viṣṇubrahmāmarendraiśca sukṛtistutisaṃstutaḥ | tamadrākṣamahaṃ devi dhamanīkṛśavigraham || 18 || malloko'yaṃ girivaraṃ kailāsaṃ munivatsthitam | svato'pidhavalañcomebhasmanācāpipāṇḍaram || 19 || chāyācchannamahaṃ maulimapisūryāṃśutāpitam | nīrajāvalisañchannasaraḥ pūritamapyume || 20 || nīrasaiḥ pāṇḍupatraiśca kṛtāhāraṃ nagottamam | dṛṣṭvā me karuṇā jātā vareṇa chandito'pi saḥ || 21 || kamalāmalasamphullakareṇāsparśi [sparśito mayā iti pāṭhaḥ |] so mayā | matkarasparśamātreṇa tadottasthau nagendrarāṭ || 22 || dṛṣṭvā māṃ praṇataḥ prahvaḥ kṛtāñjaliridaṃ jagau | nayanasrāvisalilairnṛttatālakarāravaḥ || 23 || sundarāṅgotthapulakairgadgadapravaṇaṃ vadan || 24 ||
kailāsaḥ– bhava śiva bhagavan pinākapāṇe suravarakinnaramauliśobhitāṅghre | niravadhikaruṇāpayodhirājacchaśidhāman praṇato'smi te padābjam || 25 || guṇagaṇananditanāmarūpahīna triguṇātīta jarāvihīna śambho | harirudrābjajasārvabhauma bhūman stutavedotthitadevajālamaule || 26 || śaśisūryānalaśobhitākṣiphāla sphuradurusomakalādhara prasīda |
pṛ0 168) sphuradurugāṅgasatkaparda [jaṭadhāritagāṃga iti pāṭhaḥ |] śambho mayi dṛṣṭiṃ vitarāśu saprasādām || 27 || munijanakuvalotthacandramaule duritāpaha pāratāra dhīra | dṛśi śaśivihitena cakṣuṣā māṃ paripāhīśa dayākaṭākṣasāraiḥ || 28 || suragaṇanuta vedavedya śambho uragendrāmalahāra nīlakaṇṭha | ava śiva dayayā mamaiva maulau vasatiste'stu gaṇendratā mamādya || 29 || itthaṃ girīndravacanātprasanno'smi maheśvari | tasmai dattaṃ mayā devi gāṇāpatyamanuttamam || 30 || girīndrasārvabhaumatve girīndrastvabhiṣecitaḥ | himavānniṣadho vindhyo mandaro merureva ca || 31 || nīlo mahendro ṛṣabhastrikūṭaścitrakūṭakaḥ | kaṅkato raivato devi pāriyātro'tha kesarī || 32 || airāvato'tha bhadraśca maināko gandhamādanaḥ | irāvānhastiśailaśca malayo dardarastathā || 33 || sahyo govardhanaścaiva udayāstamayastathā | ete prādhānyatastatra śailendrāssmṛtimātrataḥ || 34 || mamāgrataste samprāptā mānnatvā tuṣṭuvurnagāḥ || 35 ||
nagāḥ– bhagavanbhava bhūtanātha śambho uragendrāmalahāra pārvatīśa | paripaśyāmalacakṣuṣā prasādaistava pādābjarajotthamaulayo naḥ || 36 || tava sannidhireva śokahārī smṛtimātreṇa tavāgatā vayam | vada kiṅkaravāma devadeva tava dṛṣṭyā vivaśeṣu [vitatāṃ vidhehi cājñāmiti pāṭhaḥ |] dehi cājñām || 37 || iti śailavacaśśrutvā tānavocamahaṃ priye | prāñjalīnpraṇatānprahvānabhinandyāhameva hi || 38 ||
īśvaraḥ– kailāso mama vāsabhūssuvihito dattā gaṇādhīśatā śailendratvamapi prasādavihitā diṣṭyā mayā toṣitaḥ | tenāpāratapaḥpracārakṛtitastuṣṭo'smi kaṣṭāpaho yūyaṃ śailavaraṃ mamaiva vasatiṃ sampūjya natvā mudā || 39 ||
pṛ0 169) yāta sthānamaho'bhiṣicya sughaṭaissauvarṇanīrairapi cetyuktvā girayastadā puraharaṃ natvā samāninyire [samāninyuḥ kumbhottarairityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacit] | sihmasyāsanamuttamaṃ śaśinibhaṃ chatrañca saccāmare cendropendramarudgaṇaissaha tadā kailāsaśaileśvaram || 40 || śaileśaṃ tvabhiṣicya śaṅkaragirā devā nagāḥ procire dhanyo'syadya surāmarendragirirāḍviśveśabhakto hyasi | tvanmaulau nivasañchubhāni vitaratveṣeśvaraḥ kevalaṃ tanmaulisthitacandraraśminikaraissaṃśodhitastvaṃ sadā || 41 || nānānirjjharasanmṛgāyutayuto vardhasva naśśreyase || 42 || iti girivacanācchivaikatāno vavṛdhe'tyantaśikhāsamūhameghapāliḥ | kaladhautarasairvivardhikeva prasabhaṃ vākyamidaṃ jagāda harṣāt || 43 ||
kailāsaḥ– prāleyācalakanyakāparilasadvāmārdhabhāgaṃ sadā jvālājālayutānalākṣitilakamphāle tripuṇṭrojvalam | līlāvīkṣitadagdhakāmavapuṣaṃ kalpadrumūle sthitaṃ līlācālitalokajālamaniśaṃ kālāntakaṃ bhāvaye || 44 || triśūlavilasatkaraṃ tadapareṇa bālādaraṃ kuraṅgavilasatkaraṃ kumudinīśabhūṣāmaṇim | nīloddāmatamālasannibhagalaṃ gaṅgājalāplāvitaṃ sphārotkūṭajaṭākuṭīravilasatsomārdhacūḍaṃ sadā || 45 || vandesundaratāṇḍavādicaturaṃ kailāsamaulisthitam || 46 || ilāmilanmauliruvāca [apīndu mauliṃ prāhasvamaulau nivaseti śailaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] śambhuṃ namo namaste giriśeti śailaḥ | svamauligāpāramahoruliṅgapālīṣu ca prītiyutaśca bhūyāḥ || 47 ||
pṛ0 170) vedo'pi svayamādyamāha bhagavanrudrairnamontaiḥ padai- stvatsarvātmakatāṃ gadatyatha tarāṃ bhaktyā paraṃ tvāṃ sadā | tvatsānnidhyabalena māmapi vibho stoṣyannamasyanpuna- rmantrairyatra niṣīdasīti ca punardhanyo madanyo hi kaḥ || 48 || itthaṃ kailāsaśailasya śrutvā vacanamambike | tamabruvaṃ mahāśailaṃ kailāsaṃ varabhūdharam || 49 ||
śivaḥ– kailāsaśaila varasānugatordhvasaudhaliṅgāvalīṣu satatannivasāmi kāmam | pāpaṃ harāmi sutarāṃ janatādilokaduḥkhaṃ ca muktimatha bhuktimatho diśāmi ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsavarapradānaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 45 ||
kailāsacālane rāvaṇakṛtastutirnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
īśvaraḥ– matto labdhavaro devi kailāso dharaṇīdharaḥ | kiñcitsmayayutaścāsītpriyo'haṃ pārvatīpateḥ || 1 || namatsamaśśikhariṣu sarvaliṅgāśrayassadā | mayi devassadādhyāste maṇiprāsādamauligaḥ || 2 || kvameruḥpāriyātraśca maināko mandaro'pivā | vindhyovāniṣadhogauri himavānvānagādhiḥ || 3 || nīlo'sta udayo vāpi bhavo? vā śataśṛṅgakaḥ | raivatovāmanaśśrīkaḥ kumudogandhamādanaḥ || 4 || mahendro malayassahyo darduraścitrakūṭakaḥ | ke vā kulācalāssarve śambhoḥ priyatarā iti || 5 || ahameva priyaśśambhossarvadā vāsa eva hi | garvaparvatasaṅkrāntassakailāsaḥ purāmbike || 6 || śailasārasvahṛdayakāṭhinyena nagottamaḥ | tasya tadbhāvamālokya devānāmapi śailaje || 7 || dakṣamanyau mamaivāghamanyunā devatāgaṇāḥ | viṣṇurudrādayassarve śikṣitā bhadrakeṇa hi || 8 || nirdagdhānnindanāddevi sadakṣānbrahmapūrvakān | punaḥ punastānduḥkhaughairdaityairdevi yuge yuge || 9 || pātayāmi surānyuddhe bhavābdhau bhaktivarjitān | duḥkhāmbudhau mahādevi mama bhaktivivarjitāḥ || 10 || patanti sarvadā sarve mama [janmamṛtyu jarāsuca iti pāṭhāntaram |] bhaktivivarjitāḥ | svargeṣu narakeśveva tānaśaivāntsadāśive || 11 ||
pṛ0 171) mayi bhasmani rudrākṣe śaive vā ye ca dūṣakāḥ | śivaliṅge śivakṣetre tripuṇṭre vedavartmani || madbhaktaṃ dūṣayedyastu yo vā ko vā suro'pi vā | bhūpatirvā yatirvāpi tanduḥkhe pātayāmyaham || vedānte vā gurau mohādavimukte maheśvari | pañcākṣare muktide tu rudrādhyāye'pi vā mama || śataśākhāśrutaṃ mantraṃ pāpastomanivārakam | sarvaśrutistutindevi śrīmahādevapūjane || 15 || eka eva mahārudraḥ pūjya ityāha hi śrutiḥ | rudraṃ viśvādhikaṃ māntu yo'nyatulyataya vadet || sarvamanyatparityajya dhyeyo'haṃ pārvatīpatiḥ | namatsamaścābhyadhiko dṛśyate śrūyate'pi vā || aṇustvaṇīyasāmasmi mahatāñca mahattaraḥ | indramitrādivākyaiścāpyahameko'khilāntaraḥ || māmevavedāvedāntā vadantiśrutayo'khilāḥ | turīyo'haṃ śivādvaitassatyaṃ jñānaṃ priyastvaham || māṃ nayatyanyathā vākyairvedoktairmohitā janāḥ | tānpātayāmi narake durbuddhīnpāpayoniṣi || mamaiva hi parā śaktistvaṃ jagatkāriṇī śivā | tavekṣaṇājjagajjālaṃ sambhaveta yuge yuge || mama sarvāntarastvaṃ hi avijñāya surādhamāḥ | narā vā bhūsurā vāpi mama liṅgasya pūjane || matirna teṣāṃ pāpānāṃ kalau devi bhaviṣyati | tasmādduḥkhāmbudhau magnābhaviṣyanti surāsurāḥ || mama bhaktivihīnā ye brāhmaṇāścāpi saṅkarāḥ | bhavanti te mahāpāpāsteṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ pade pade || anarcita maheśānāma śaivānāṃ durātmanām | bhavanti vipadassadyo narakāścāpi dāruṇāḥ || ajaptaśatarudrāṇāmaśaivānāṃ durātmanām | bhavanti vipadassadyo narakāścātidāruṇāḥ || ajaptapañcabrahmāṇāmaśaivānāṃ durātmanām | bhavanti......................dāruṇāḥ || 27 || ajaptaliṅgasūktānāmaśaivānāṃ durātmanām | bhavanti......................dāruṇāḥ || 28 || adhyātapañcapañcāsya dhyānahīnāntarātmanām | bhavanti......................dāruṇāḥ || 29 || ajaptapañcavarṇotthapañcākṣaranivartinām | bhavanti......................dāruṇāḥ || 30 || anuddhūlitadehānāmaśaivānāṃ durātmanām | bhavanti......................dāruṇāḥ || 31 || tripuṇṭrarahitāṅgānāṃ phālakaṇṭhorubāhuṣu | bhavanti......................dāruṇāḥ || 32 || adhṛtākṣasarāṇāñca aśaivānāṃ durātmanām | bhavanti......................dāruṇāḥ || 33 || adṛṣṭa mama liṅgānāmaśaivānāṃ durātmanām | bhavanti......................dāruṇāḥ || 34 || pradoṣārcanahīnānāmaśaivānāṃ durātmanām | bhavanti......................dāruṇāḥ || 35 || bhūtārcanavihīnānāmaśaivānāṃ durātmanām | bhavanti......................dāruṇāḥ || 36 ||
pṛ0 172) somavāravihīnānāmaśaivānāṃ durātmanām | bhavanti......................dāruṇāḥ || 37 || aṣṭamyarcanahīnānāmaśaivānāṃ durātmanām | bhavanti......................dāruṇāḥ || 38 || mama kṣetrojjhitānāñca aśaivānāṃ durātmanām | bhavanti......................dāruṇāḥ || 39 || anyakṣetrasthitānāñca aśaivānāṃ durātmanām | bhavanti......................dāruṇāḥ || 40 || mama nāmavihīnānāmaśaivānāṃ durātmanām | bhavanti......................dāruṇāḥ || 41 || mama naivedyahīnānāmaśaivānāṃ durātmanām | bhavanti......................dāruṇāḥ || 42 || mama liṅgasamaṃ devi viṣṇvādiparipūjanam | ye kurvanti mahāpāpāsteṣāṃ duḥkhamanargalam || 43 || bhavanti vipadassadyo narakāścātidāruṇāḥ | bilvapatrojjhitānāntu aśaivānāṃ durātmanām || bhavanti vipadassadyo narakāścātidāruṇāḥ | māṃ paśyanti samaṃ devi ye tu viṣṇvādibhissaha || teṣāṃ nadūragā devi cāpado nirayā api | madbhaktamanyabhaktaiśca samaṃ paśyanti ye jaḍāḥ || teṣāṃ nadūragā devi cāpado nirayā api | evaṃ dharmojjhitadhiyo narā api surāśśive || ta eva rāsabhā jātā vidvāṃso bahuviśrutāḥ | mṛdordhvapuṇṭraṃ ye kuryuraśaivā jaḍabuddhayaḥ || teva nārakāḥ pāpāste yamātithayo'mbike | bhasmatripuṇṭrarudrākṣe yeṣāṃ lajjā śivārcane || teva rāsabhā devi te yamātithayo'mbike | sarvaśrutiśrutaṃ nityaṃ liṅgārcanamume mama || tyaktvānyadevapūjāyāṃ ye [ratārāsabhabhūdharāḥ iti pāṭhāntaram |] ratā rāsabhādharāḥ | grahasthā yatayo devi te yamātithayo'mbike || mṛtphālā dagdhacakrāṅkā ye viprā vedavarjitāḥ | ācārabhāsurāścāpi asurā bhūsurāśca te || ye'nyadevasamaṃ matvā māṃ tiṣṭhanti kṣaṇaṃ śive | te sarve'pyantyajā eva karmānarhāsta eva hi || malliṅgañcānyaliṅgaiśca pūjayanti ca ye'dhamāḥ | teva liṅgadagdhāṅgāssūkarīyonisambhavāḥ || tasmānmadarcanaṃ dhyānaṃ natyājyaṃ vaidikairdvijaiḥ | teṣāmevātmavijñānaṃ mama liṅgārcaneratāḥ || ye bhasmaniṣṭhāssatataṃ rudrādhyāyārthavittamāḥ | teṣāṃ......................ratāḥ || 56 || ye tu pañcākṣarāsaktāssadārudrākṣadhāriṇaḥ | teṣāṃ......................ratāḥ || 57 || ye tu matkṣetraniratāśśrutyuktenaiva vartmanā | teṣāṃ......................ratāḥ || 58 || tasmānmatparamo bhūyādahaṃ teṣāntumocakaḥ | pāpasaṃsāraduḥkhābdhestārako'hammaheśvari || surāṇāṃ garvanāśārthaṃ sṛṣṭo viśravasassutaḥ | viṣṇuśca bhṛguśāpena mānuṣeṣu janiṣyati ||
pṛ0 173) tasya bhāryāpaharaṇānmunisaṃpīḍanādapi | kadācidāgāddharṣeṇa kailāsaṃ mama rāvaṇaḥ || akharvagarvasaṅkrāntaḥ kailāsasyāpi garvahṛt | tolayāmāsa vāhubhyāṃ kailāsaṃ mama śailaje || kailāsaścālitastena nānāliṅgasamāśrayaḥ | mahāmanyormama tadā manyunāso'dharīkṛtaḥ || tena stuto'smivedaiśca vedavedyo'hamīśvari | sāmnā sahasraṃ śaradāṃ tuṣṭāvāṣṭākṛtiṃ himām || madaṅguṣṭhāgranirmagnadharaṇīdharamūlagaiḥ | bāhubhiḥ pīḍito devi daśāsyairmāmaroravīt || dayayā mocitaṃ rakṣastadā stotreṇa māṃ stuvat | stutvānatvānirjagāmadiśammenāvalokayan || kailāso'pi mahādevi tyaktagarvo babhūva ha || 67 ||
devī– kathaṃ tena mahādeva saṃstuto'si vadādya tam | kiṃ vā tena tapastaptaṃ śrotumichāsti me prabho ||
īśvaraḥ– tatstutiṃ sāvadhānena pārvati śṛṇu te vade | rāvaṇo roravīddevi macchailavaramūlagaḥ || dīnasvaro'tivikṛtaṃ sāmnāvilavilocanaḥ [sāsrāvilavilocanaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] || 70 ||
rāvaṇaḥ– tārārājavirājamānamakuṭaṃ kākodarākalpakaṃ karpūrābhaśarīrakāntivilasanmārāṅgabhasmādaram | kailāsācalatolanena kupitāṅguṣṭhāgrasampīḍitaḥ || śailāghātasvabāhubhagnajaraṭhadvairājasāmaśravā- dunmuktākhilarāvaṇaṃ puraharaṃ devaṃ bhaje śaṅkaram || 71 || vairājarājanagahiṅkṛtikātituṣṭaṃ [hiṃkṛtigānatuṣṭamiti pāṭhaḥ |] rājacchaśāṅkadhavalaṃ lalitottamāṅgam | yakṣādhirājakṛtasakhyamumāsahāyaṃ devaṃ namāmi surarājakṛtapraṇāmam || 72 || ilādharasutāpriyaṃ varasunandivāhapriyaṃ surendravarasupriyaṃ prabhavakundamālāpriyam | mukundanayanārcitaṃ bhavaharaṃ sumerusthitaṃ ramāramaṇasundarākṣiyugapūjitaṃ śaṅkaram || 73 ||
pṛ0 174) gandhabandhamadhurālakalolaṃ rudranetrasucaritramapāram | dayānidhānākhilamitraśakte kṛpāmbudhe kāmada kāmavairin || 74 || staumi prakṛṣṭavacasā parameśa mitra sāmairbhavantamagataḥ parimocayāśu || 75 || parvānanditaśarvarīramaṇavatkāntendudhāmānana gātrārdhādhikṛtasvakāntivadane netre ca maulau tathā | deveśena sadaiva śobhitakalāyuktena bālāṅkadhṛ- ktādṛkṣaṃ jagatāṃ guruṃ trijagatāṃ pāpāpahaṃ tambhaje || 76 || evaṃ tuṣṭāva cāṣṭākṛtimakhilatanūdbhāsikośaikakāśaṃ māmīśaṃ jagadārtināśanamume cārtastadā rāvaṇaḥ | kailāsācalato vimuktabhujadhṛṅnatvā yayau dhāmakaṃ laṅkāmūlaniketanaṃ mama sadā liṅgārcakaśśaṅkari || 77 || suraśaragajajorusadviṣāṇaiḥ paridhṛtakiṇataḥ [paridhṛṣṭaḥpraṇataḥ kiṇatsuvakṣāḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] kiṇāktavakṣāḥ | raṇabhuvi rāvitadevarājasaṅghaḥ paṇitaprāṇagaṇassarāvaṇeśaḥ [paṇitaprāṇagaṇeśarāvaṇo'drikanye iti pāṭhaḥ |] || 78 || nālīkāsananandanodbhavabhavaḥ paulastya eṣo'mbike māmārādhya gaṇendratāmagasute prāpto hyavadhyassuraiḥ | yenākāri tapassvakīyamanalecotkṛtya māṃsañjahau || 79 || malliṅge avidadhādayaṃ svaśirasaḥ padmālimālāṃ purā bhrātṛbhyāṃ nijavīryanirjitamahāsīmaikabhūmāyaśaḥ || 80 || vairūpavairājabṛhadrathantaraiśśrīvāmadevyairvararudraśāṅkaraiḥ | śrīraivatelādharakairmahendrairmahāṣṭadaṃṣṭrāvaravaiścamitraiḥ || 81 || tuṣṭāva sāmaiśśaśimaulimambike | sarāvaṇorāvitasarvaloko ravaistadā sāmasugānatoṣitam || 82 ||
pṛ0 175) dhīrodārapayojajāpatikṛtāpārāravindārcanā- ttuṣṭaṃ kaṣṭaharaṃ prakṛṣṭavacasā sraṣṭrā punassaṃstutam | tvaṣṭrā [ayaṃ pādo'pūrṇatayāvartate |] śātakarābjagandhasahanāsaktairavī || 83 || mitrāye'dya śivasya netranivahāḥ pāntvadyadṛṣṭyādimāṃ tenaivāmitagandhaparvatamahāpāpādapāyācchivaḥ || 84 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe kailāsacālane rāvaṇakṛtastutirnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 46 ||
vedarahasyakathanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
devyuvāca– devadeva mahādeva karuṇārasavāridhe | viśva viśvādhikāśāsya praṇatānandadāyaka || 1 || candraśekhara bhūteśa praṇatānandadāyaka [triṇetramadānandaka iti pāṭhaḥ |] | kiñcidvijñaptumicchāmi tanme kāruṇyato vadā || 2 || sugopyamapi deveśa karuṇāpātratāṃ mayi | jñātvā tadvada deveśa rahasyamapi śaṅkara || 3 ||
skandaḥ– tadā devyā vacaśśrutvā kailāsaśikhare sthitaḥ | maṇiprāsādamadhyastha mahāmañcāsana sthitaḥ || somadhāmaśatodbhāsimukhenendukalāvatā | trilokodyatprabhākāra somasūryāgnilocanaḥ || sajaloddāmaghanavatkaṇṭhamaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ | phūtkṛtoruphaṇibhrājanmaṇikuṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ || navaratnacitānekamālājālavirājitaḥ | tripuṇṭratilakabhrājatsulalāṭataṭojvalaḥ [sukuṇḍalataṭojvalaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] || kundenduhimadhāvalyanindakottamadehakaḥ | candanāgarukastūrīpāṭīrāsāragandhadhṛk || divyamandāramālānāṃ bṛndasandohabandhuraiḥ | āmododdāmagambhīra vātaissaṃsevitaśśaivaḥ || mahārhakāśivāstīrṇe ratnaparyaṅkamaṇḍale | vararatnāmbaracita upadhānasuśobhite [upadhānaśatottare iti pāṭhaḥ |] || 10 || nānādarśakulodbhāsimaṇikuṭṭimamaṇḍite | dīpite maṇidīpena prabhāvidyoditāntare ||
pṛ0 176) tadvātāyanajālaiśca paśyanlokaviceṣṭitam | nimīlanonmīlamiṣāccandrasūryānalekṣaṇaḥ || svargaukasāñca devānāṃ daityānāṃ vairayātanam | teṣāṃ bhāgāśca vividhā nandanādiṣu sundarāḥ || bhūmaṇḍale nṛpāṇāñca parasparajayaiṣiṇām | yuddhaśraddhāsakhānāñca dharmācaraṇamuttamam || tapasvināñcāśramiṇāṃ tanusaṃśoṣaṇakriyām | svargādigamanañcaiva tatra bhogaparamparāḥ || bhogānte patanañcaiva punarjanmaparamparāḥ | pāpināṃ patanañcaiva narakāṃścātiyātanāḥ || gatāgatañca lokānāṃ janmanāśasthitīrapi | paśyantsarvaṃ svanayanaiḥ kurvankālagatīstathā || udayāstamane caiva rātryahāni krameṇa tu | nāśavṛddhī ca bhūtānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhūtanāyakaḥ || devyā prāsādamadhyastho viharatyevamīśvaraḥ | kālakālo mahādevaḥ kālāvacchedavarjitaḥ || kālāvacchedayuktānāṃ brahmaviṣṇuharātmanām | indrādīnāṃ munīnāñca grahāṇāñca ṛṣestathā || saptarṣiṇāñca siddhānāṃ pitṛṇāñca sanātanaḥ | bhūtānāñca bhaviṣyāṇāṃ sāmpratānāñca śaṅkaraḥ || karoti sṛṣṭiṃnāśañca sthitiṃkālasya kalpanāṃ | māyābhirmohitānāñca brahmaviṣṇuharātmanām || śarīrāṇipraviśyaiva karotīdañcarācaram | sa eva sarvabhūtānāṃ prāṇānādāyodeti ca || sa eva sarvabhūtānāṃ prāṇānādāyāstameti ca | stryannapānopabhogaiśca tattaddeheṣu sarvadā || parāṃ prītiṃ vitanute jaḍeṣvajaḍa īśvaraḥ | sa eva jāgradādyāsu hyavasthāsvapi śaṅkaraḥ || avasthārahitaścāyaṃ sarveṣvantargatasthitiḥ | sa eva jāgradbhūteṣu svapityeko maheśvaraḥ || sa evānandamūrtirhi tasyānandaikaleśataḥ | priyātmakaṃ jagajjālaṃ kurute duḥkhadāyakam || asatyametaccajaḍaṃ svasatyātsatyavatsthitaḥ | karoti ca jaḍaṃ sarvaṃ cetanānāṃ sacetanaḥ || asaṅgo'pi sadā bhāti jagatsveteṣu śaṅkaraḥ | samavānapi [saṃgavāniva viśveśo'saṃgassarvāntaraṃgakaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] viśveśaśśivassarvāntaraṅgataḥ || buddherbodhayitā mantā manasaśca gatāgatiḥ | aprāṇaḥ prāṇarūpeṇa hyākāśādapi cottaraḥ || brahma brahmamayo bhāti śiva eva sanātanaḥ | na tasya karaṇaṃ kāryaṃ na kriyā paramārthataḥ || śīrṇeṣu dehajāleṣu hyaśīrṇassarvadā sthitaḥ | vikārabhūte jagati nirvikāratayā sthitaḥ || na [nasandṛśe rūpamasya śiva eveti pāṭhaḥ |] naśyanna ca sīdāno śiva eva hi kevalaḥ | guhāhito niricchohi sadā bhedavivarjitaḥ || kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāñca amahānhi tamasaḥ paraḥ | yasmādbrahmendraviṣṇvādyā rudrāssarve marudgaṇāḥ ||
pṛ0 177) samprasūtā mahādevānna tato'styadhikaḥ paraḥ | yasya niśvasitaṃ vedā nānāśākhāvibhūṣitāḥ || yasya jñānena sarveṣāṃ muktayassarvato dvijāḥ | sa santarati saṃsāramasāraṃ bhayadāyakam || saraso'yaṃ yadrasena jagadrasamayaṃ bhavet | sa eva jyotiṣāñjyotissa cakṣussa tapo mahat || sa bhūmā kevalānandassa bodhaḥ kevalaṃ śivaḥ | sa eva sthūlamanaṇū rudro viśvārtināśakaḥ || nirindriyaścendriyāṇāṃ gatiśśāstā maheśvaraḥ | nirābhāso nirāsaṅgo viśvabhāsapravartakaḥ || sarvaṃ tasminmahādeve jagadbrahmaṇi [brahmapipīlikamiti pāṭhaḥ |] līyate | vibhāti māyayā sākṣāttasmin jñāne munīśvarāḥ || sarvaṃ śivatayā bhāti prasādena maheśituḥ | sa ṣoḍaśātmā puruṣo neha nānāsti kiñcana || vikārametatsarvaṃ hi avikāre vikāritam | tasyaiva tapasā dhyānāttalliṅgārcanatodvija || sarvaṃ śokaṃ taratyeva nātrakāryā vicāraṇā | bhidyante granthayassarvā ekatvenānupaśyataḥ || tamātmānaṃ mahādevaṃ viśvākāratayā sthitam | vahnirvāyurjalaṃ kṣmā ca vidyate [viyadetaditi pāṭhaḥ |] tanmaheśvaraḥ || eteṣāmānulomyena prātilomyena sṛṣṭayaḥ | sañjātā atra līnāśca tasminneva maheśvare || tasmādbhūtāni jātāni tatra jīvanti tānyapi | tasminneva layaṃ yānti īśasaṃsthaṃ carācaram || īśāvāsyamidaṃ sarvaṃ [dṛśyaṃ yasminniti pāṭhaḥ |] tasmiṃtsarvaṃ pravartate | evaṃ yo vedavedāntaiḥ prasādātpārameśvarāt || gurośca [gurūktyeti pāṭhaḥ |] śraddhayā caiva sarvajñassa ca śāṃbhavaḥ | samunissaśivaścāpi sa śivajñānavittamaḥ ||
skandaḥ- apāṇipādo'si nirindriyo'si rūpasparśaśśabdagandho rasādiḥ | sarvasya vettā tvaṃ tvāṃ na vetti kaściddṛṣṭerdraṣṭāraṃ tvāṃ na vetyeva kaścit || 49 || vṛddho bālaḥ pūruṣastvaṃ yuvāsi strītvaṃ klībo na tvamevāsi kiñcit | sthāṇurgacchadbhūtabhavyaṃ jagadvai dehairyukto bhāsi tasmānnato'smi || 50 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe vedarahasyakathanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 47 ||
pṛ0 178) śivāgaurīsaṃvādonāma aṣṭācatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– etādṛśaṃ mahādevaṃ nīrūpaṃ rūpavatsthitam | prāha devī mahādevaṃ prāñjaliḥ praṇatā tadā ||
devyuvāca– karuṇāsāgarāpārasudhākaraśikhaṇḍaka | brahmamuṇḍamahāṣaṇḍamālākalitakandhara || 2 || anādhāra mahādeva jagadādhāra dhūrjaṭe | prayatnajitamandāra [prapannajanamandāra iti pāṭhaḥ |] sundarānandavigraha || 3 || kathaṃ kailāsamaulisthaliṅgānāmudbhavaśśiva | śrotuṃ me kautukaṃ śambho vada sarvajña matpriya || 4 || śailamaulau mahādeva liṅgānāmudbhavo'tra hi | kathaṃ samabhavacchambho tanme vistarato vada ||
skandaḥ– itthaṃ gauryā tadā pṛṣṭo mahādevo dayāparaḥ | tāmuvāca prahṛṣṭātmā jagadātmā maheśvaraḥ ||
īśvaraḥ– śṛṇu śailasute bāle kamalāmalalocane | rahasyametadgopyante nākhyeyaṃ yasya kasyacit || madbhaktāyaiva deyaṃ syādanyathā patito bhavet | yo bhūtibhūṣaṇāsakto yastripuṇṭraikabhāsuraḥ || yo rudrākṣāṅkitakaro rudrākṣāmalabhūṣaṇaḥ | yo rudrajapasuprīto yomalliṅgārcane rataḥ || 9 || yo bhasmaśāyī satataṃ pañcākṣarajapādaraḥ | yo bilvārcanasuprīto yaśca bilvārcanapriyaḥ || yo madbhaktisudhāpārakathāśravaṇatatparaḥ | yo mannaivedya bhojī syādanyanaivedyavarjitaḥ || yo madhyānamanā nityamanyadhyānavivarjitaḥ | mannāmaparamo yaścāpyanyanāmavivarjitaḥ || yo matkṣetranivāsīsyādanyakṣetravivarjitaḥ | yo madbhaktajanaprīto'pyanyabhaktaparāṅmukhaḥ || dhanaiḥ [annairiti pāṭhaḥ |] puṣṇāti yo bhaktānmadīyāntsatataṃ śive | yamādiniyamopetassarvadā śivapūjakaḥ || vedāntasārapārajñaḥ prakāśyaṃ teṣvidaṃ śive | nānyeṣu me'dya deveśi rahasyaṃ gopyameva hi || vidyāvidi kathāsāraṃ datvā muktimavāpnuyāt | prarohaṃ yāti subhage subhūmau vaṭabījavat || mūḍhe'lpaprajñatāpanne datvedaṃ śāmbhavaṃ rahaḥ | yathāmakumbhe kṣiptāmbho vṛdhā bhavati śaṅkari || tadvadbhavati mūrkheṣu paśudharmeṣu śaṅkari | mahāpāpamavāpnoti tasya naiveha niṣkṛtiḥ || 18 || yathā sugandhakarpūracandanairbhūṣitaḥ kharaḥ | rathyābhasmakarīṣeṣu svāṅgaṃ saṃlepayetsahi ||
pṛ0 179) tathaivāśāmbhave dattaṃ nopakārāya bhāmini | śāmbhavapravare dattaṃ vistāraṃ yāti śaṅkari || yathotsṛṣṭaṃ jale tailaṃ vistāramupagacchati | tasmādgopyatamaṃ devi sādhuṣveva vidarśayet || mamaiva manasā sṛṣṭaḥ kailāso'yaṃ mahīdharaḥ | nānātarugaṇachannassarvapakṣivarāśrayaḥ || 22 || ratnasaudhavaropeto ramyapuṣkaraṇīyutaḥ | koṭiyojanavistāraśśūnya eva mahīdharaḥ || 23 || ramyo'yamapi śailendro vipināvalimaṇḍitaḥ | mṛgāśrayo'pi satataṃ śūnya eva vibhāti me || tasmānmayā mahādevi manasedaṃ suniścitam | tatsarvaṃ maṅgalākāraṃ śivaliṅgāśrayaṃ hi tat || liṅgojjhitaṃ hi yaddevi tadamaṅgalamīryate | yasmingrāme'pi vā devi pure vā vipine'pivā || madīyaliṅgahīnañca smaśānasadṛśaṃ śive | yatra vā śivaliṅgaṃ syāduttuṅgālayamadhyagam || grāme vā vipine vāpi tatkṣetramavimuktakam | prātastadgrāmanivasāḥ paśyannapi śivālayam || na teṣāṃ pāpasambandhastadahnātpratimucyate | yatra liṅgālayaṃ [liṃgakulamiti pāṭhaḥ |] devi dhanyo deśassa eva hi || yatraiva śāmbhavā viprā yatra liṅgārcanapriyāḥ | bhasma tripuṇṭrarudrākṣamālālaṅkṛtavigrahāḥ || yatra rudrajapāsaktā yatra pañcākṣarapriyāḥ | yatra bilvavanaṃ bhadre taddhanyaṃ paramaṃ śive || 31 || taddarśane'pi pāpānāṃ pralayo bhavati kṣaṇāt | tryakṣaliṅgekṣaṇādeva kṣaṇānnaśyati pātakam || dhigbhasmarahitaṃphālaṃ dhiggrāmamaśivālayam | dhiganīśārcanaṃjanma dhigvidyāmaśivāśrayām || śivaliṅgakulaṃ bhadre kalpitaṃ maṇisaudhagam | samādhiniṣṭo hyabhavaṃ śataṃ varṣāṇi śailaje || vyāghracarmaparīdhāno bhasmadhṛgbhasmasaṃśrayaḥ | tripuṇṭravilasatphālo jaṭāgaṅgenduśobhitaḥ || samāsīnaśirogrīvo nāsāgranyastalocanaḥ | ātmanyevātmanā dhyāyaṃstadvaktuṃ naiva śakyate || śarvaṃ sarvātigaṃ śāntamotaprotaṃ sanātanam | ajamavyayamāśāsyaṃ hṛtsthaṃ vyāpya [vyāptajagattrayamiti pāṭhaḥ |] jagacca yaḥ || akriyaṃ manasā vācā vedairvā vaktumakṣamam | kośātigaṃ kośabhānaṃ deśakālādivarjitam || asthūlamaṇukāhīnamasaṅgamarasaṃ vibhum | akhaṇḍatejasāṃ [agandhaṃ tejasāmiti pāṭhaḥ |] rāśiṃ tejohīnaṃ guṇātigam || vyāpyavyāpakatāhīnaṃ mahāntaṃ vistṛtañca tat | ānandamarasaṃ bhogyaṃ bhogabhogyādivarjitam || viśokaṃ virajaṃ sūkṣmamajighṛkṣaṃ guṇātigam | satyakāmañca saṅkalpaṃ kalpanājālavarjitam || nānyatkiñcicca vedāhaṃ satyajñānādivarjitam | ānandarūpo niśceṣṭastadahaṃ brahma kevalam ||
pṛ0 180) evaṃ sthitasya me gātrātpulakassambabhūva ha | dehīdehyaṅganāśotthasvātmaikyaparamātmanoḥ || ānandāmbunidhermattaḥ kāścavīcyassamutthitāḥ | madromakaṇaliṅgāni kailāsasthānipārvati || tataḥ kālāntare devi samādhivirate mayi | paśyāmi tāni sarvāṇi liṅgākārāṇi śailaje || prodyatsudhāṃśudhavalajvālāmauliṣu śaṅkari | kailāseśvaramukhyāni trīṇi koṭyadhikāni ca || maṇīndrasārasubhagamaulikaṇṭhorubhāsuraiḥ [kumbhorugopurairiti pāṭhaḥ |] | prāsādāvaraṇopetairdivyapūjābharairapi || 47 || bilvamandāramaulīni phaṇāmaulitatāni ca | dṛṣṭvāścaryeṇa talliṅgakulammaṅgaladāyakam || kailāsaśaile talliṅgaṃ pūjyaṃ tāni ca pūjaye | lokalīlāvinodāya kāryametanmama priyam || etatte kathitaṃ devi nākhyeyaṃ yasya kasyacit || 50 || aśāmbhavajane'rpitaṃ gaditametadādyaṃ yadi vṛdhā bhavati taddrutaṃ nigamahīnabhasme hutam | marūṣarabhavastarurna bhavati prarūḍho yathā tathāpi tṛṇakopamo bhavati bhāgyahīne nare || 51 || aśāmbhavajanāśrayo narakavargaduḥkhāmbudhi- ssa eva tadupāśrayo bhavati bhasmapuṇṭrojjhitaḥ | mamārcanakathāsudhāśravaṇahīnapīnāntaraḥ kathaṃ malajalāvilo bhavati sūkarassihmavat || 52 || agādhajanināśanaprabhavabhūtiduḥkhāmbudhiṃ na santarati mānuṣaḥ kumatiriṣṭaviṣṭāśanaḥ | ariṣṭamaraṇonmukhaśśivamaheśanāmojjhitaḥ karaṇṭakakulodbhavo bhavati bhāgyahīno'dhamaḥ || 53 || eṣā sā śivanāmasanmadhurasā śrīdivyanāmāni me vyākhyeyeta sujihvayā karayugaiśśrībilvapatrārcakāḥ | kathāsu mama śāṅkarāḥ prathitaśrotrapātrādarā bhavanti sukṛtaiḥ paraṃ paramananyabhāvaṃ gatāḥ || 54 ||
pṛ0 181) teṣāṃ muktaya eva labhyata ume madbhāvasārādarā hīrodārakumāradāranikaraissaukhyekasārāśca te | pārāvāravikārasaṃsṛtibhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ na teṣu dhruvaṃ matpādābjaparāgasaṃhatamanastāpādirāgādayaḥ || 55 || sukhāmbudhisudhāmbudhipracalalīlalīnā hi te nidhānakalaśāssadā bhuvi sadaiva teṣāṃ sukham | śarīravigame'pi te prathitacandracūḍārcakā nageśvaramimaṃ śive samadhivāpya me sadmagāḥ || 56 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe śivagaurīsaṃvādo nāma aṣṭācatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 48 ||
devavākyaṃ nāma ekonapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ
īśvaraḥ– purā māṃ sukhamāsīnaṃ mandare cārukandare | nānātaruvarāpāraśobhite citrakandare || 1 || ramyapuṣkaravistīrṇe puṣkariṇyāstaṭe śubhe | devadāruvanachanne devodyānamanohare || 2 || nānāsiddhasamākīrṇe munigandharvaśobhite | nagāgrakusumāpārastabakocchinnagucchake || 3 || muditāligaṇācchācche śalmalīkusumāvṛte | punnāgatarusambhūtamārute cātiśītale || 4 || mayūravarasāraṅgamattavānaravāraṇaiḥ | puṃskokilakalālāpaśukasārasaśobhite || 5 || kalahaṃsakulārāvakuraradhvanisundare | mandārakusumodbhūtamandamārutaśobhite || 6 || kiṃ pūruṣakṛtāpāramṛdaṅgadhvanidiktaṭe | vaikhānasairvālakhilyairmunibhiśca marīcibhiḥ || 7 || udyaccaṇḍāṃśunicayairūrdhvabāhubhirunnataiḥ | tāpasairmaulivilasatkapardotkīlaśobhitaiḥ || 8 || kapardakṛtanīḍaiśca pakṣipakṣotthamārutaiḥ | viśrāntaissūryakiraṇaistaptagātrairmunīśvaraiḥ || 9 || ramyasānuśatākīrṇe niryadrītivirājite | tagarāgarujodbhūtadāvāgnivaradhūpite || 10 || varasaudhe gandhalipte sukhāsīnaṃ tvayā saha | udyaccandrāṃśudhavalavālendukṛtaśekharam || rājatphaṇiphaṇāratnakanatkaṅkaṇaśobhitam | uragendra mahāhāraṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ trilocanam ||
pṛ0 182) vyāghracarmottarāsaṅgaṃ gaṅgāpiṅgajaṭādharam | triśūlavilasadbāhuṃ mṛgahastaṃ maheśvaram || 13 || mamaiva māyāparimohitāssurā rudrendraviṣṇvabjajamitrasomāḥ | bhago'ryamā varuṇo gandhavāhastathānalo vasavo mārutaśca || 14 || ūcuḥ prāñjalayassarve praṇamyātha surottamāḥ | mattejasā dharṣitāśca bhītā mama [māmāhurojaseti pāṭhaḥ |] mahaujasā ||
devāḥ– ko bhavāṃstava kiṃ rūpaṃ nānāścaryaikabhāvanaḥ | nagno'si devadeveśa brahmamuṇḍalasadgalaḥ || 16 || triṇetraśca garādaśca nīlakaṇṭhaśca śaṅkaraḥ | mahāhivalayodbhāsiratnamālāgaladyutiḥ || 17 || pitṛkānanasambhūtabhasmadhāryāsi sarvadā | jaṭilo'si mahādeva mahāvṛṣabhavāhanaḥ || 18 || matsyakūrmavarāhādinarasihmājinapriyaḥ | gajakṛttidharo nityaṃ candramūrdhāsi śāśvataḥ || 19 || mṛgabālamahāśūladhārako'si maheśvaraḥ | vāmabhāgaikavilasatkāminīno'si viśvabhuk || 20 || sadā giripriyaścāsi hyasaṅgaśca cariṣyasi | gaṇaughagaṇanāṃ deva gaṇituṃ te na śakyate || kā niṣṭhā tava deveśa vada tvaṃ karuṇānidhe | saśarīro'si cāritryaṃ tava jñātuṃ na śakyate || tava māyāmayaiḥ pāśairmohitāścaiva [mohitāśca vayaṃ surāḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] bhūsurāḥ | śarīriṇaṃ tvāṃ dṛṣṭvaiva hyasmābhissamupāsyase || putrābhyāṃ prītiyukto'si dvipānanaṣaḍānane | ṣaḍūrmirahitaṃ devadevaṃ tvāṃ manmahe vayam || vayañca lokapāssarve brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | rudrādayaśca dikpālā graharkṣamanavassurāḥ || brahmā sṛjati lokāṃśca viṣṇuḥ pālayate jagat | rudrassaṃharate cānte candrendrasuranāyakaiḥ [indro'yaṃ suranāyakaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] || hantyājau sarvadaityāṃśca makhabhugviṣṭapādhipaḥ | viśve ca ṛbhavassomaṃ te'pi yajñe pibantyapi || somaṃ tavājñayā śambho hyaśvinau somapīthinau | vasavaśca tataśśambho sūryaḥ pāti gabhastibhiḥ || niśānāthassadā candrastārāścānye grahādayaḥ | indro'gnissūryatanayo niṛtirvaruṇomarut | yakṣendro'yaṃ dhanādhīśa īśāno'yaṃ [īdṛśo'yaṃ maheśvara iti pāṭhaḥ |] maheśvaraḥ | manavo ṛṣayaścaiva svaṃ svaṃ kāryamupāsate || tārācakramidaṃ sarvaṃ lokāścaiva caturdaśa | eteṣāmatiriktastvaṃ kastvaṃ deva vadādhunā || caritrāṇyapi te deva viśvātītāni darśaya | naiva viśvaparo'si tvaṃ devo viśvādhiko hyasi || tava deva kathaṃ rūpaṃ rūpavāniva dṛśyase | na sajjase guṇeṣu tvaṃ guṇavāniva dṛśyase || 33 ||
pṛ0 183) viśvātigo'si bhūteśa viśvavāniva dṛśyase | nirguṇo'pi ca deveśa saguṇeṣviva dṛśyase || devyānayā viharase kailāsācalamūrdhagaḥ | niṣkiñcano'si ca sadā sarvabhāgyasudhodayaḥ || vata dṛkkoṭisaṃlagnā bhavantyeveśvarā hi te | sasurāsuragandharvamānavāḥ paśavo'pi hi || yatra yatrotkṛṣṭatamāstavakāruṇyato'khilāḥ | ramase pramathādhīśaisskandaherambasaṃyutaḥ || tavāpāracaritrāṇāṃ jñeyatādya maheśvara | vedairīḍyo'si bhagavannaiva kiñcitkaroṣi ca || tavaliṅgaṃ suraissarvairasurairmunipuṅgavaiḥ | pūjyase bilvapatraiśca teṣāṃ tvaṃ mocako hyasi || 39 || bhavajālamayaiḥ pāśaiḥ kinte rūpaṃ maheśvara | bhasmapriyo'si bhagavanbhasmaniṣṭhe tu te kṛpā || rudrākṣadhāriṇo ye tu te'pi tvadbhaktasattamāḥ | pañcākṣaraparāṇāñca tvaṃ sadā mokṣado hyasi || rudrādhyāyārthakathanatajjapāsaktacetasām | teṣāṃ tvaṃ pāpajālāni vināśayasi śaṅkara || bhaktipriyo'si bhagavanmohitāstava māyayā | saṃśayāviṣṭahṛdayāstvāṃ pṛcchāmo maheśvara || tavaivarūpaṃ deveśa kṛpayā vada tacchiva | asmābhiriva lokeṣu rūpavāniva dṛśyase || 44 || stryannapānādibhogaiśca viharasya jarāmaraḥ | arimitreṣvapi sadā tulyo hyasi maheśvara || smaratripuradaityendrayamāndhakagajādihṛt | uttamo'si kathaṃ deva hyasmābhirapi te sadā || caritraṃ dṛśyate śambho vada tatkaruṇābalāt || 47 ||
