skandaḥ– itthantairmohitairdevaiḥ paripṛṣṭo maheśvaraḥ | uvāca tān śṛṇu mune vedavedāntasambhavam || viśvākṣo bhagavānutota iṣumān khyātaśca sarvātmako rudrāṇāñca gaṇaissahasravadanassarvātmakaśśaktimān | nānākārajagatkṛtīṣu viharatyeko'pi sarvātmaka- stadvattatra śivāyuto girivare krīḍārasairnirbharaḥ || 49 || kvaciddhīre saudhe viharati sahāmbo hi bhagavā- nkvacilliṅgam sāṅgaṃ tvapacitiviśeṣairviharati | kvacinnīle saudhe viharati ca vātāyanagataḥ kvacitpauṣpe mañce viharati kathāsārasurasam || 50 ||
pṛ0 184) kvacittiṣṭhandhāvanmṛgamanudhanurbāṇasahitaḥ kvaciddevyā puṣpaṃ tvapacinuti puṣpadrumakule | kvacijjalpannāste jalasarasi devyāvagahate kvacitpuṣpairgandhaiḥ kvacidapimaṇījālasadanaiḥ || 51 || kvacinnṛttaṃ paśyankvacidapica vīṇādaninadaiḥ kvacidbhakṣyaṃ bhuṃkte viharati ca ḍolāsu śivayā | kvaciddīvyatyakṣaiḥ kvacidapi na hallīsarayuto mahāratnaiḥ kḷptairvarataragavākṣaikavasatiḥ || 52 || krīḍākandukamutkṣipatyavirataṃ devyā nu lokādaro dhyāyan svātmatayā kadācidapi vai hyeko'pi nānākṛtiḥ | itthaṃ kailāsaśaileṣvanavaratamīśo'dhivasati bhavānyā tādṛkṣyā kimiha mahamīḍe'dya caritam || 53 || tataḥ kiñcit kiṃ vā haracaritamātraṃ kathamapi bruve śambhoḥ pādāmbujabhajanabhaktyaiva sahasā || 54 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe devavākyaṃ nāma ekonapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 49 ||
suropadeśo nāma pañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– nilimpavacanaṃ śrutvā nirlepo nirmalaśśivaḥ | anukampārasākrāntaḥ kampitānāhatāntsurān ||
īśvaraḥ– iti gīrvāṇabṛndānāṃ śrutvāhaṃ vacanaṃ śive | mandasmitādharo devi vismayānanditāntaraḥ || manmāyāmohitānjñātvā tānavocamathāmbike | brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyā indrāgnyanilamitrakāḥ || vasavo'śvimukhāssarve [bhagādityā iti pāṭhaḥ |] marutaścarṣayo'khilāḥ | śṛṇudhvaṃ mama sārvātmyaṃ yadajñānātsurāsurāḥ ||
pṛ0 185) manmāyāmohitā yūyamabhijātāsstha sattamāḥ | bhavantaḥ paśavassarve cābrahmastambhapūrvakāḥ || ahaṃ māyāmayaiḥ pāśairīṣaṇābhissurāsurān | vadhvā krīḍāmi devyā ca jagatyasmiṃścarācare || ahameva surāntsarvānmocako bhaktibhāvitaḥ | mama rūpamavijñāya bhavanto vigrahaṃ mama || dṛṣṭvaiva ceṣṭāṃ vividhāṃ guṇabhūtāṃ guṇātigāḥ | viṣayeṣvanuraktaṃ māṃ jñātvā mohaṃ paraṃ gatāḥ || tadadyaivāpaneṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ paramaṃ mama | gopyādgopyataraṃ jñānamatharvaśirasi sthitam || 9 || sarvaśrutiśirodbhūtaṃ sākṣādajñānanāśanam | ahameko nirādhāro vartāmyākāśavatsadā || naiva lepo'sti manaso mama kāryendriyaissadā | na mahābhūtasaṅghaiśca na kālena diśā surāḥ || vastuto hyaparichinno hyasaṅgo'sminirāmayaḥ | avyaktaḥ paramātmāhaṃ sarveṣāmantarāsthitaḥ || ahamādiśca madhyañcāpyahamantassanātanaḥ | jagajjanmādināśotthaṃ kriyābhirnāhamīśvaraḥ || matta evākhilaṃ viśvaṃ mayyevedaṃ sthitaṃ surāḥ | brahmaviṣṇvīśvaredendrā bhavanto matta eva hi || nirgatāsstha bhavanto vai jagajjālamidaṃ surāḥ | somo'haṃ janitā devāssarveṣāṃ bhavatāṃ surāḥ || bhavadbhissaha mayyeva vidyate taccarācaram | na matto'sti pṛthakkiñcinneha nānāsti kiñcana || māṃ vijñāyedamakhilaṃ jānantyekaṃ sanātanam | mamaikatvaparijñānātko moho'tra nilimpakāḥ || māṃ viditvaiva paramā śāntisteṣāṃ sadaiva hi | granthibhirnābhibhūyante kāmyakarmamayaissurāḥ || badhyante'tra bhavanto hi vivaśā [paśavaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] mama māyayā | vākyairguṇamayairdevāstatphalaṃ prāpyate divi || ye yathā māṃ prapadyante nānopāsanayā surāḥ | tāṃstathaivāhamevādya tadbhāvānāṃ prapūrakaḥ || tathaiva prerayāmyadya so'haṅkāraparo bhavet | māṃ prerakamavijñāya kartāhamiti manyate || 21 || sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam | sarvasya prabhumīśānaṃ sarvasya [surāssarvasyakāraṇamiti pāṭhaḥ |] śaraṇaṃ surāḥ || 22 || apāṇipādo'javanaḥ paśyāmyahamatandritaḥ | acakṣuśśrotrahīno'smi manaḥprāṇātigo'smyaham || 23 || mayāvāsyamidaṃ sarvaṃ māṃ vijñāya vimucyate | ahaṃ sarvaśarīreṣu vijānāmīdamevahi || 24 || na vetti māṃ surāḥ ko'pi yogayukto'pi kaścana [muktaye iti pāṭhaḥ |] | sarvāśrayo'haṃ hi sadā sarvādhāraśca sattamaḥ || pañcakośavihīnaśca pañcabhūtātigo'smyaham | pañcaprāṇātigaścāhaṃ kvedaṃ dehendriyaṃ surāḥ ||
pṛ0 186) apakṣapātasahitassarvabhūteṣu sarvadā | lokotthasukhaduḥkhaiśca ṣaḍūrmibhirapi drutam || 27 || naiva lipto'smi deheṣu hyaśīrṣṇohamavasthitaḥ | sūryo yathā sarvalokaṃ pravartayati karmabhiḥ || lokakāryavihīnaśca tadvatsākṣirahaṃ sthitaḥ | kāyaprāṇamanodharmairnānāhaṅkārasambhavaiḥ || 29 || dharmairvā pāpajālairvā naiva lepo'sti me surāḥ | kāṣṭāhaṃ paramaścāhaṃ bhāsako'haṃ jaḍeṣvapi || 30 || bhīṣāsmādanilo vāti bhīṣodeti gabhastimān | bhīṣaiva candrayamakā bhīṣaivedaṃ sthitaṃ jagat || jyotiṣāṃ jyotirasmīha bimbābimbātigo'smyaham | ekatvaṃ vā tathā dvitvaṃ bahutvaṃ vā na kiñcana || 32 || naiva muktirnaiva bandho mayi sarveśvare surāḥ | sarvabhūmātvahaṃ devāssākṣyasākṣivivarjitaḥ || na cāṇurna mahāṃścāpi nirguṇassaguṇo'pi vā | na māyā māyi vā kiñcinnaivāhamapi ceśvaraḥ || eṣo'haṃ paramānando raso'haṃ sarvavastugaḥ | eṣa brahmādisarvañcāpyahameva sadā surāḥ || yūyamādissarva eva sīmā bhūmāhameva hi | na vedavādavedāntairna gurūktyā na [na cejyayeti pāṭhaḥ |] cecchayā || na karmaṇā vā tapasā prāpnotyeko'pi vā surāḥ | matprasādenaiva devā vṛṇutaṃ bhaktameva hi || manniṣṭhāṃ sarvabhāvena kaścijjānāti vā na vā | athānyathā nayatyarthaṃ vedāntānāṃ durātmavān || māmavijñāya duḥkhaughānnaiva mukto bhaviṣyati | vibhūtiṃ mama vakṣyāmi śṛṇvantu paramāṃ surāḥ | yallābhānnāparo lābho matprasādena labhyate | ye bhasmaniṣṭhāssatataṃ teṣāmeva prakāśayet || ye tripuṇṭralasatphālāsteṣāmetatprakāśyate | ye rudrākṣamahādehāsteṣāmetatprakāśyate || 41 || ye rudrādhyāyaniratāsteṣāmetatprakāśyate | ye malliṅgārādhanechāsteṣāmetatprakāśyate [bilvapatrādisādhanairiti pāṭhaḥ |] || ye pañcākṣarasanmantrajapadhyānaikamānasāḥ | teṣāṃ śrutiśirodbhūtaṃ jñānaṃ vipreṣu jāyate || ye śivakṣetraniratāsteṣāmetatprakāśyate | ananyabhāvāssatataṃ vedānte mayi ye gurau || ananyabhāvā ye devāssadā kauṭilyavarjitāḥ | mannāmaniratā ye vai teṣāmetatprakāśyate || sarvebhyo devasaṅghebhyo variṣṭhaṃ manvate hi ye | madhyānaniratā ye vai teṣāmetatprakāśyate || madhyānaṃ vedavedāntasāratātparyacintanam | teṣvaśakteṣu madrūpacintanaṃ tatprabudhyate || 47 || cintayennīlakaṇṭhaṃ māṃ triṇetraṃ candraśekharam | umārdhavigrahaṃ rūpaṃ svahṛtpadmasya sadmagam || bhāvayantsatataṃ yuktastajjñānaṃ prāpnuyātsurāḥ | aparokṣaṃ hi me jñānaṃ tasya jāyeta niścitam ||
pṛ0 187) evaṃ sādhanahīnānāṃ jñānaṃ taddurlabhaṃ surāḥ | śṛṇvangurumukhairbhāvairbuddhyā śabdārthavedanaiḥ || naiva tatprāpnuyājjñānaṃ koṭikalpaśatairapi | matprasādavihīno yo gṛhī vātha yatirvanī || tannaiva prāpnuyājjñānaṃ sākṣātsaṃsāramocakam || 52 || yasmin grāme pure vā satataparicitāpāraśaivapracārā rudrādhyāyajapādarāssitalasadbhasmatripuṇṭrādarāḥ | śambhorliṅgasamarcakāstu sutarāṃ te nāturaṃ naiva te samprāpyanti yamādbhayaṃ janijarārogapraṇāśena vā || 53 || jñānametadatidurlabhaṃ surā bhuktimuktijanakaṃ mama bhaktyā | yuktiyuktagurusūktisudhābdhau ruddhamādyamanaghaṃ satatañca || 54 || labhyate kila pacelimapuṇyaiḥ kasyacinmamakṛpāvaśato hi | bandhahṛddhṛdayabhedakaṃ surāhyanyathāsya na pathā na karmaṇā || 55 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe suropadeśo nāma pañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 50 ||
śrutisāranirūpaṇaṃ nāma ekapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ
īśvaraḥ– vibhūtiṃ mama vakṣyāmi śṛṇvantu munipuṅgavāḥ | yad jñātvā na punarjñeyaṃ vidyate surasattamāḥ || ahameko'khilādhāraścāhaṃ viśvapravartakaḥ | ahaṃ viśvamidaṃ sarvaṃ mayyevāntye viśatyapi || ahaṃdhātā vidhātā ca matto'nyo nāsti kaścana | sṛjāmīdaṃ grasāmīdaṃ bharāmīdaṃ surottamāḥ || yathorṇanābhissūtrāṃśca grasate sṛjatītyapi | tathaivedaṃ jagajjālaṃ bhavadbhissurasattamāḥ || 4 || kālātmāhaṃ brahmakṣatramodanaṃ mṛtyupādaśam | ahaṃ jīvaṃ praviśyaiva sarvabhūteṣu saṃsthitaḥ || sarvabhūteṣu bhūtāntarguhāyāṃ sarvadā sthitaḥ | sarvendriyaguṇātītassarvendriyavivarjitaḥ || madādhārā ime lokā lokyā yūyaṃ surāsurāḥ | tapane tāpakaścāhaṃ candrecaiva prasādakaḥ || anile calanaścāhamanale hyuṣṇako hyaham | indre yame pratāpo'haṃ lakṣmīścāhaṃ dhanādhipe ||
pṛ0 188) aśvine'pi ca bhaiṣajyaṃ marutāṃ mātarassadā | viśveṣāṃ hṛdayañcāhaṃ vasūnāṃ hṛdgatassadā || asurāṇāṃ surāṇāñca sampadā samavasthitaḥ | tamasā sātvikenaiva munīnāṃ rājasassurāḥ || guṇatrayo'haṃ vibudhā guṇahīno'smi kevalaḥ | ahaṃ hi nirguṇassākṣāttamaḥpāre pratiṣṭhitaḥ || apāṃrasastathaivāhaṃ jyotiṣāṃjyotirasmyaham | bhūtākāśe cetayitā vyāpakaśśabdagosmyaham || pṛthivyāñca tathā gandho guṇo devāśca saṃsthitaḥ | vāyuścāhaṃ tathā devā eteṣāmādyasṛṣṭayaḥ [eṣāṃ sandhāvisṛṣṭayaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ ] || carācaramidaṃ proktaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam | eteṣāmānulomyena sṛṣṭayassyuḥ pravartitāḥ || eteṣāṃ prātilomyena sthitau pralayasaṃjñitāḥ | eteṣāṃ kāryakaraṇe naiva kiñcidahaṃ surāḥ || nilimpā naiva lopena kintu sākṣī sanātanaḥ | matsannidhānavirahe jagannaiva prarocate || ayaskāntamaṇeryadvatsannidhau lohasūcayaḥ | ceṣṭanti vividhaṃ devāstathaivedaṃ jagatsurāḥ || sannidhau ceṣṭate me'dya sarve krīḍanakā mama | mama rūpaparijñānaṃ bhavatāmatidurlabham || 18 || ṣaḍūrmirahitaścāhaṃ pañcakṛtyavivarjitaḥ | brahmāpyahaṃ sṛjāmīdaṃ rajasā kevalaṃ jagat || 19 || viṣṇuḥ pālayitā cāhaṃ sātvikaṃ guṇamāsthitaḥ | rudro bhūtvā saṃharāmi tāmaso'haṃ carācaram || sadāśivo'haṃ deveśo hyanugrahakaro'smyaham | manmāyāmohitaṃ caiva karomīśvararūpadhṛk || pañcakṛtyaparaścāhaṃ pañcakośātigo'smyaham | pañcaprāṇavihīno'haṃ pañcabhūtaikavartanaḥ || iyaṃ mama parā śaktirvikṣepāvaraṇātmikā | yayā sammohitā yūyaṃ jagatsāsuramānuṣam || sthāsnurgachatsurendrāśca parāśaktiriyaṃ mama | sṛṣṭau sthitau tathā nāśe kāraṇaṃ tviyameva hi || mamaiva śaktiḥ paramā vividhajñānadāyinī | enāṃ praṇamata kṣiprametasyāḥ kṛpayā surāḥ || matprasādādāvaraṇaśaktināśaḥ prajāyate | yāvatkarmavipāko hi dehināṃ bhavatāṃ surāḥ || vikṣepāya ca sā śaktiranuvarteta sattamāḥ | mamaivāṃśo jīva eva svājñānātparijṛmbhate || nānāyoniśarīreṣu hyaśīrṇo duḥkhabhāgabhuk | evaṃ dvidhā dehagehe vṛkṣe pakṣivadāsthitau || ekaḥ karmātmakaṃ bhuṃkte phalaṃ vai sukhaduḥkhayoḥ | tathānyassākṣivadbhāti dvāsuparṇeti mantrataḥ || brahmaiva saṃsaratyeṣa svāvidyāto divaukasaḥ | svavidyayā mucyate ca tapasākevalena hi || ahammānatayāpannaḥ phalabhuksukhaduḥkhayoḥ | svarge ca narake caiva sadā vai sampravartate || madjñānānmuktimāpnotinānyathākarmakoṭibhiḥ | jīvāpetammriyatyetannajīvomriyatesurāḥ ||
pṛ0 189) ṣaḍūrmirahitaścāhaṃ sarvadeheṣu sattamāḥ | ṣaṭkośakamidaṃ dehaṃ praviśyākhilabhāsakaḥ || 33 || ṣaḍūrmirindriyorthaiśca [ṣaḍvargairindriyārthaiśceti pāṭhaḥ |] kāmayāmi carācaram | satyakāmaśca saṅkalpassarvalokāntsṛjāmyaham || saṅkalpātpitarodevā upatiṣṭhanti māmiha | nameśoko'sti moho vā jighṛtsācapipāsakā || aśarīraśśarīreṣu hyanavastheṣvavasthitaḥ | mahāṃścāhaṃ vibhuścāhamātmāśīryo'hameva hi || avasthātrayadūro'hamasaṅgaḥ puruṣastvaham | sarvākāśassarvabhāsassarvāvāso'hamīśvaraḥ || yo māṃ veda sa vededaṃ yo māmajñānamohitaḥ | parādātsa parādedaṃ jñātvānandaṃ vibheti na || śāntiṃ parāṃ gacchati ca na kāmī bhavati sthiraḥ | brahmā māṃ veda sa brahma māṃ [bhavatyeva surāsurāḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] vetyeva surāsurāḥ || asti brahmeti māṃ veda tasyāhaṃ mocako'smi ca | nāntaḥ prajñaśca na bahiḥ prajñānaṃ brahma cāsmyaham || eṣontarmāyica sadā hyamṛtyormṛtyurūpataḥ | ahameva sadā brahma sākṣyasākṣyādivarjitaḥ || ayamātmā sadā brahma deśakālasthito'pyaham | tatvametatsarvamasītyādivākyaikarūpataḥ || ahaṃ vākyeṣu sarveṣu cāhamevāsmi bhāsakaḥ | ānandaṃ paramaṃ jñātvā taratyeva bhavārṇavam || upāsyaṃ māmabhijñātvā śokamohau taratyapi | yūyaṃ māmeva jānīthāpyanyatsarvaṃ vṛdhaiva hi || satyaṃ jñānamananto'haṃ matsatyātsatyatā [asatyātsatyatā jagat iti pāṭhaḥ |] jagat | matsattayaiva hi jaḍaṃ cetate vividhaṃ jagat || mahānandāmbudhessarvaṃ śīkaraṃ jagadeva hi | raso'haṃ sarvabhūteṣu rasatāṃ jānate tu ye || 46 || rasāste nandamātrañca jīvantyevasurāssadā | kovānyaḥ prāṇiti sadāmadākāśaṃvināsurāḥ || na tatra gacchati mano navāggacchati cendriyam | paramātmāhamevādya sa evādya sa uśvakaḥ || asaṅgastvarasasparśo hyaghrāṇo gandha eva hi | apāṇipādakāryādiḥ pāyūpasthādivarjitaḥ || pramāprameyarahitastarkadūro'hameva hi | ahaṃ jānāmi sarvaṃ hi na māṃ jānāti kaścana || 50 || parāñci khānyakṛṇavaṃ tasmānmāñca na paśyati | matprasādayutaḥ kaścijjānātyeva hi vā na vā || draṣṭāhaṃ dṛśyarahito darśanañcāhameva hi | ṣoḍaśo'haṃ suraśreṣṭhāśśrotā ghrātāhameva hi || 52 || buddherboddhā manaścāpi prāṇaprāṇo'hamīśvaraḥ | sarvā eva kalā dehe cendriyāṇyahameva hi || sarve mayyeva līyante nāhaṃ [tenāhaṃ teṣvavasthitaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] teṣu vyavasthitaḥ | eka evāhamadvaitaścaturthaśśiva eva hi || 54 || majjaṃ mallañca madanaṃ jagadviddha surāssadā | bhūmāhaṃ paramānando māṃ na jānāti kaścana ||
pṛ0 190) eko'haṃ bhuvane jaḍājaḍagatissvairaṃ hi nānājaga- nnāstyeva pratibhāti kiñcidapi vai tanmārgatṛṣṇopamam | tenādrī na bhavetkṣamā suragaṇā nāstyeva kiñcijjaga- tsarvaṃ śambhutayā vibhāti sakalaṃ kasyasvidetatsurāḥ || 56 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe śrutisāranirūpaṇannāma ekapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 51 ||
devānāṃśodhanaṃ nāma dvipañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ
īśvaraḥ– so'haṃ nityo'pyanityaśca brahmābrahmāhamevahi | prāñco'hañcaiva paścācca dakṣiṇodīceva hi || adhaścordhvamahaṃ lokā diśaśca vidiśo'pyaham | pumānnapuṃsakaścāhaṃ strīcāhaṃsarvadevatāḥ || naiva strī napumāṃścāhaṃ naiva cāhaṃ sanātanaḥ | aśarīraśśarīreṣu hyaśīrṇaśśīryakeṣvaham || jyotiṣāmahamevāsmicātmajyotissadāvyayaḥ | analānilasūryeṃdubhūtānāmantarāsmyaham || māṃ na jānanti bhūtāni bhūtādiścāhameva hi | chandasāmahamevādirgārhapatyo'hamevahi || dakṣiṇāgnyāhavanīyassatyo'haṃ gaurahaṃ surāḥ | gauryahañca variṣṭho'haṃ kaniṣṭho'haṃsanātanaḥ || ṛgyajussāmādharvāṇi madgiro hi sureśvarāḥ | akṣaro'haṃ kṣaro'hañca guhyo'haṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā || aṇoraṇīyo'smi surā mahato'haṃ mahāṃstathā | viśvataścakṣurevāhaṃ viśvatobāhurīśvaraḥ || viśvamauliviśvapādassahasrākṣassahasrapāt | daśāṅgulamidaṃ sarvamatyatiṣṭhāmi bho surāḥ || amṛtasyāhamīśānassarveṣu puruṣo'ntaraḥ | vyapohyaśīrṣakapālaṃ sarveṣāṃ saṃsthito'smyaham || aiṣo'ntarāhaṃ puruṣo hiraṇyaśmaśrurevahi | manaso'haṃ javīyāṃśca mayāvāsyamidaṃ jagat || mayyeva līyate cānte matto'nyannāsti kiñcana | aprāṇo'smyamanāśśubhro nirgatākṣo'hamevahi || 12 || na prajño'haṃ na cāprajño nobhayaprajña eva hi | ahaṃ bhūteṣu supteṣu jāgarmi satataṃ surāḥ || ahamavyakta eveśovyaktobhūtahṛdisthitaḥ | sthāṇurnirguṇa evāsmikāryakāraṇavarjitaḥ || kṣarākṣarādirahitaḥ paramātmāhameva hi | ahaṃ ca na divā rātrirna sannāsatsadāśivaḥ ||
pṛ0 191) ākāśakośassaṃveṣṭuṃ sukaro yadi jāyate | tadā māṃ tva na vijñāya duḥkhasyānto bhaviṣyati || vedaissarvaiśca vedyo'haṃ vedānteṣvahasāsthitaḥ | sve mahimnyahamevaiko hyahamaupaniṣatparaḥ || vedādissvara evāhaṃ praṇavo'haṃ sanātanaḥ | praṇavāditrimātro'haṃ sarvamantrātmakastvaham || pañcākṣaramayaścāhaṃ pañcapātakavarjitaḥ | nāsaṅgo naiva me saṅgo'pyahaṃ bhuvanamevahi || 19 || viśvātīto viśvadhāmā viśvādhika umāpatiḥ | bhavantaḥ paśavassarve bhavatāṃ patirasmyaham || matprasādādbhavantohi muktaye yatatādhunā | majjñānaṃ vedavākyotthamanyacchilpaṃ surottamāḥ || brahmaivāhaṃ saṃsarāmi vidyayāvidyayā surāḥ | nirmukto mocayāmyeva sarvaṃ sāsuramānuṣam || śravaṇāyāpi labhyo'haṃ karmabhirnasurāsurāḥ | śṛṇvanto'pi yatiśreṣṭhā na māṃ vindanti kecana || atonyadārtaṃvibudhāssarvaṃjagadidaṃ dhruvam | kathaṃ bhavanto manyante tadbruvantu mamāgrataḥ || 24 || vibhūtirmama yā proktāśraddhayā veda nānyathā | nāviśvastacetasedeyaṃ jñānaṃ vedāntavākyajam || datvā narakamāpnoti sahapūrvapitāmahaiḥ | sarvopaniṣadāṃ sāraṃ mayaitatsamudāhṛtam || 26 || bhavadbhyassamyagadhunā hṛdayagranthibhedanam | nāśiṣyāyāpyabhaktāya nāputrāyedamevahi || dadyādetacchāmbhavebhyo yatibhyassurasattamāḥ | deyametatsuraśreṣṭhāstasyamuktirayatnataḥ || matprasādena sarveṣāṃ muktayassyuḥ kare sthitāḥ | śirovrataṃ yaiścaritaṃ deyaṃ teṣāmidaṃ surāḥ || śirovratamidaṃ devāḥ purā cīrṇammayaivahi | agnirityādibhirbhasmagṛhītvāṅgāni saṃspṛśet || vratametadidaṃ devāḥ paśupāśavimokṣadam | śraddhayā tapasā devā mama liṅgārcanena hi || 31 || bhasmatripuṇṭrakaṇṭhaiśca pāpādbhinnobhavennaraḥ | pañcākṣarāvartanaiśca pañcapāpapraṇāśanam || 32 || rudrāddhyāyajapaścaiva bilvamūle viśeṣataḥ | mama kṣetreṣu niyataṃ vāsācca surasattamāḥ || 33 || avimuktanivāsācca tatraivānte tanukṣayāt | umāsahāyamanmūrti dhyānenaiva surāstathā || etadeva paraṃ jñānaṃ labhyate matprasādataḥ | nānyathā labhyate jñānaṃ karmopāsanatassurāḥ || idamakhilarasyaṃ vedajālotthasāraṃ kathitamidamaśeṣājñānanāśaikahetu | hṛdi sadayamadīyaṃ bhedanaṃ jñānamādyaṃ jagati na hi vidheyaṃ mūḍhamartyeṣu devāḥ || bhavaśatajanināśaṃ mokṣamārgapradīpaṃ hyapi duritaśatotthaiḥ pāpatāpairvihīnaḥ | mama varadasupūjāddhyānataḥ prāpyamevaṃ gurujanavarabodhairvedavākyairdurāpam || 37 ||
pṛ0 192) kiṃ vīryaṃ bhavatāṃ surā hariharau padmāsanassendrakā- ssūryendū hyanilānalāśca maruto viśve'śvinau brūtame | vasvādityagaṇā ṛbhūmarugaṇā yūyaṃ kuberādaya- statpaśyāmi balābalaṃ mama purassandarśayantvādarāt || 38 ||
skandaḥ– ityuktaṃ tridaśeśvarā hariharāśśrutvā vacaśśāṅkaraṃ devāgre mahimānamuttamamaho prākaṭyamīṣurvṛtāḥ | garvorīkṛtamānasāssuragaṇāḥ procurhi natvā śivaṃ svaṃ svaṃ kāryamathādhipatyajanakaṃ śṛṇvantu tadvākyajam || 39 ||
brahmā– sṛjāmi vividhaṃ jagatsuranarādigandharvakaṃ samudragirigahvaraṃ nadanadīvanañcāpyaham | namatsamasurādyakaḥ prativadāmi śambho tava prasādasumukhe mukhe vihitavedajālo'smyaham || 40 ||
viṣṇuḥ– ahaṃ hi daityapravarānanekānnikṛttacakrāravidāritājau | carācaraṃ viśvamidaṃ hi pālaye na matsamaḥ kaściditi prabho mataḥ || 41 ||
rudraḥ– macchūlamūlavarakoṭivilagnadhārāchannaṃ tathānte pralayādhiko'bdhiḥ | carācaraṃ viśvamidaṃ mamāsyagaṃ phalālivaccarvayāmīdamiṣṭam || 42 ||
indraḥ– triviṣṭapaniviṣṭito madakarīndrakumbhasthita- ssurendravalayāvṛtaḥ prakaṭaratnamaulisphuran | prapādatalapaṅkajaḥ kuliśapāṇirindro'smyaham || 43 || savṛtramurajambhakapramukhavairimanyuḥ prabhuḥ prapītavarasomapā na hi kadācidanyassuraḥ || 44 ||
pṛ0 193) vāyuḥ– mamānilacalācalā nadanadīnagāḥ kāmagā vilolataramarṇavāḥ pratibhavanti lokākhilāḥ | mahādrumakulāvalīprapatanoruvāyussadā sadevamarutāṃ surairnaravarādidehasthitaḥ || 45 ||
sūryaḥ– pracaṇḍataramaṇḍalo mama mayūkhajālairjaga- tpayodharapayaḥ kaṇairatisuvṛṣṭavṛṣṭyutthitaiḥ | dinodayadināntime prathitabījadhānyādibhi- rjagatparipuṣāmi vai sakalamarcirādeḥ pathā || 46 ||
agniḥ– śikhāśatavidīpitassuragaṇeṣu tṛptiprado- makhādiṣu susaṃsthitaḥ pitṛgaṇeṣu kavyapradaḥ | mahārṇavamukhe sthito mama śikhāsupakvaṃ rasaṃ pavitritajagattrayastava ca phālanetro'smyaham || 47 ||
yamaḥ– yamo [yamo'samavatāmiti pāṭhaḥ |] hyaghavatāmahaṃ narakavargagarvāpahaḥ pracaṇḍataradaṇḍadhṛk samadṛgasmi sarvatra vai | mamottasabhaṭāravairjagati jāgatāḥ pātakā nasanti bhayabhītitastava śivāṅghridattekṣaṇaḥ || 48 ||
kuberaḥ– dhanaiśca dhanavarjitānparipuṣāmi tvatprerita- stavābjapadamitratāmupagato'smi yakṣādhipaḥ |
pṛ0 194) samuccalitavarṇakaḥ prathitagītakāṣṭādhipaḥ kimuttaramidaṃ mama pravaṇametadevaṃ manaḥ || 49 ||
candraḥ– somo'haṃ sarasīruhālimalinīmutphullane mitraka- stvanmaulisphuradambare madhurimākāntirjaṭājūṭagaḥ | puṣṇāmyoṣadhijālamīśvaratavādyāhaṃ prakāśāspado netraṃ te'dya ca vāmamīśvaradayāpātraṃ praśāddhyadya mām || 50 ||
varuṇaḥ– apāṃ patirnadīnadapravaranīrapārābdhika- ssamullasitaketanassphuradapāragaṅgāpatiḥ | apuṇyajanapāśakṛdgaṇavaraiśca saṃsevita- stava prapadapūjako bhavaharastadevāstu me || 51 ||
sarvadevāḥ– viśve'śvinau samarutassarva eva vayaṃ sahendreṇa pibāma somam | tavājñayā jagatāṃ pālane ratā vibho pramathādhinātha || 52 ||
sūta uvāca- iti suragaṇavacanaṃ niśamya śambhuḥ praṇatāmarabhūruho'bhyuvāca devān | tadavinayajātavākyaharṣaḥ prasamīkṣyaiva vaco'pyudārarūpam || 53 ||
īśvaraḥ– etanme tṛṇakākṛtiśca puruṣassaṅkalpajaḥ kalpita- stasmin vo mahimārasaṃ suravarāssañcodayantu drutam | tatpaśyāmi bhavatprasādamakhilaṃ devāstarantu druta- mityuktvā jagadīśvaro'yamumayā śīghraṃ tirodhatta vai || 54 || viṣṇubrahmaharāmareśvarayamā vāyvagnayaḥ sūryakā- ścandreśānavasurvaruṇakā vitteśadikpālakāḥ |
pṛ0 195) tasmiṃstārṇanare svakāyudhavaraiśśaktībhirīśāstadā no kiñcitpravicālituṃ tvatha bhavannīśā anīśāstadā || 55 || devyā cāpi samanvitaṃ guṇagaṇairuddaṇḍabhaktiprabhā- ścānamrottamaśekharāssuragaṇā bhaktyā prapannā haram | samyaktuṣṭuvurabdhijātatanayānāthādikāssarvaśo viśveśaṃ bhuvaneśvaraṃ trijagatārādhyaṃ maheśaṃ śivam || 56 || sraṣṭuṃ pātumathāttumapyatibalāddagdhuṃ ca saṃśoṣituṃ baddhuṃ cālayituṃ ca daṇḍamakhilaṃ tatplāvituṃ vā jale | bhāgyaiḥ pūrayituṃ ca somajakarairneśāstataste surā lajjānamramukhā maheśacaraṇaṃ bhaktyā prapannāstadā || 57 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe devānāṃśodhanaṃ nāma dvipañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 52 ||
devakṛtadevīstutirnāma tripañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ
jaigīṣavyaḥ– atyadbhutakathāśrāvi caritaṃ śaṅkarasya ca | tirodhānaṃ gate deve kiñcakrussurasattamāḥ || 1 || śikhidhvaja namaste'stu tanme vistarato vada | nahi tṛpyāmi tvadvaktrasudhāniṣyandadhārayā || 2 || punaḥ punaśca śravaṇe bhūyasīcchā pravartate || 3 ||
sūtaḥ– ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā śāmbhavasya sa ṣaṇmukhaḥ | śṛṇvatāṃ gaṇabṛndānāṃ devānāṃ tu munīśvaram || sambodhya prāha tānviprāndevasya caritaṃ tadā || 5 ||
kumāraḥ– śṛṇuṣva caritodāraṃ paramaṃ dhūrjaṭermune | tataste brahmaviṣṇvādyāssendrāssarve marudgaṇāḥ || sūryacandrāssavaruṇāḥ karuṇāsāravigrahām | tuṣṭuvurjagadambāntāmumāṃ śobhitabhūṣaṇām || kṛtāñjalipuṭāssarve dhyāyantaste śivāṃ tadā || 8 ||
pṛ0 196) devāḥ– ayi girinandini nanditamodini viśvavinodini nandinute | girivaravindhyaśirodhinivāsini śambhuvilāsini viṣṇunute || 9 || jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute | bhagavati he śitikaṇṭhakuṭumbini bhaktajanāmitabhūtikṛte || 10 || ayi nijahuṅkṛtimātranirākṛtadhūmravilocanadhūlikṛte | jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 11 || samaraviśoṣitaśoṇitabījasamudbhavaśoṇitabījalate | śrīyutaśumbhaniśumbhamahāhavatarpitabhūtapiśācatate || 12 || jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute | ayi jagadamba kadambavanapriyavāsanivāsini saudharate || 13 || śikhariśiromaṇi tuṅgahimālayasaudhanijālayamadhyagate | madhumadhure madhukaiṭabhatarjanajātasasambhramabrahmanute || 14 || jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute | suraghanaghoṣiṇi durdharagharṣiṇi durmukhaharṣiṇi poṣarate || 15 || tribhuvanapoṣiṇi śaṅkaratoṣiṇi kalmaṣadūṣiṇi ghoṣarate | danujaviśoṣiṇi durmadaroṣiṇi sanmukhapoṣiṇi sihmavahe || 16 || jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute | dhanuranuṣaṅgamanukṣaṇasaṅgaparisphuṭavaṅkinaṭatkaṭake || 17 || kanakapiśaṅganiṣaṅgapṛṣatkarabhaṭasaṅghahate | surasaṅghavaccaturaṅgabalakṣitiraṅgaghaṭadraṇaraṅgataṭe || 18 || jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute | ayi śikhaṇḍavikhaṇḍanatuṇḍavituṇḍitaśuṇḍagajaughakṛte || 19 || ripugajagaṇḍagatodbhaṭabhaṇḍavidāraṇacaṇḍaparākramaśauṇḍamṛgādhipate | nijabhujadaṇḍavipāṭitamuṇḍanivāpitacaṇḍabhaṭādhipate || 20 ||
pṛ0 197) jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 21 || jaya jaya devi nagarājakulottāriṇi kacakucagamanajaghanavadanakaṇṭhodarakaṭitaṭorudvayakarabāhubhūṣaṇavirājite sajalajaladanagamātaṅgapulinenduśaṅkhakaratalasihmarambhāstambhāraktanīrajamṛṇālanibhe tārāmalamauktikasarakīlitakandhare bimbādhare madhyāṣṭamīcandrasamānabhrūkṛte tapanoḍupamaṇḍalāyitatāṭaṅke udyatkavimaṇḍalanibhanāsāmuktāmaṇidyotite sarvābharaṇabhūṣite tvanmāyāmohitān rakṣa rakṣa || 22 || iti saṃstutya te sarve praṇamya bhuvi daṇḍavat | baddhāñjalikarā maulau tadocuste surā iti ||
devāḥ– tvayā sammohitāssarve na jānīmo maheśvaram | sarvadevasamaṃ jñātvā kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam || patīnāṃ patimīśānaṃ cetanānāṃ ca cetanam | tasyaiva virahātsarve tṛṇametatpurogatam || 25 || jagatsṛṣṭyantakāryeṣu sphītāvapi maheśvari | kiñcitkartumanīśāhi tvāṃ prapannāssadāmbike || namaste'stu jaganmātaḥ prasannā bhava nassadā | tvayāvṛtamidaṃ sarvaṃ tvayā sampālyate jagat || tvayyevānte layaṃ yāti sadevāsuramānuṣam | tvaṃ śaktiḥ paramā devī maheśārdhāṅgabhāginī || tvatprasādena sarveṣāṃ mohanāśo bhavecchive | sarvatra rūḍhā śaktistvaṃ māyā māyī maheśvaraḥ || tvāṃ prapannā vayaṃ sarve mohitāstavamāyayā | ityuktvā brahmaviṣṇvādyāḥ praṇamya bhuvi daṇḍavat || athotthāya nabhomadhyaṃ dadṛśussarva eva te | nīlatoyadamadhyastha vidyullekhevabhāsurām || 31 || niṣṭaptakanakābhāsāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām | bālendubaddhamukuṭāṃ somadhāmasamānanām || 32 || nīlendīvaranetrāṃtāṃ pavitrākṛtisundarām | dṛṣṭvā punaḥ praṇamyeśīṃ rakṣa rakṣeti cābruvan || devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā hyumovāca surāṃstadā | pragalbhadhīramadhuraṃ devājñānavināśanam ||
devyuvāca– eṣa brahmaiṣa ātmā praṇavapadagato mātṛmātrādihīno māyī māyātvahaṃ vai śaktirasmīha devāḥ | sarveśaśśaktimāṃśca prakṛtiparavaśo viśvametadvicitraṃ viśvodbhūtābhavantassakalabhavaharaṃ tambhajadhvaṃ maheśam || 35 || yato vai haribrahmarudendrapūrvaṃ prajātāstha yasmiṃsthitā eva nūnam |
pṛ0 198) bhavadbhistataṃ lokajālaṃ kiledaṃ prapadyadhvamīśaṃ bhajadhvaṃ maheśam || 36 || śaktistvahaṃ yasya jagatsamagraṃ karomi līlāmiṣatāṃ bhavadbhiḥ | bhavaprasādena bhavaikamocanaṃ mamaiva śaktiṃ śaraṇaṃ prayāta || 37 || na tasya kāryaṃ karaṇaṃ śivasya sanātano nityaśuddhaḥ purāṇaḥ | yanmāyayā mohitāstha prajeśāstasyaivetadvirahātsarvamevam || 38 || vyarthaṃ bhūyāttārṇakasyopamānātsarve devā rudramīśānamārāt | drutaṃ tamiṣṭaṃ gaganāntarasthaṃ sarvendriyeṇoparataṃ bhajadhvam || 39 ||
skandaḥ– ityuktvā sā jaganmātā tirodhatta surānprati | devā devyuditaṃ śrutvā sarve prāñjalayastadā || vibhūtibhūṣitairgātraistripuṇṭrapariśobhitāḥ | kṛtvā vrataṃ pāśupataṃ kṛtaliṅgārcanāssurāḥ || rudrādhyāyajapenaiva pañcākṣaraparāssadā | pañcāsya dhyānasaṃsaktāssaṃvatsaramatandritāḥ || adṛṣṭvaiva mahādevaṃ jagatāṃ jananīmapi | ūrdhvabāhava īśānaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram || 43 || bhaktyā tvananyayā devāḥ prabaddhakarasampuṭāḥ | raudraiṛksāmasambhūtaistathādharvaśirogataiḥ ||
devyuvāca– praṇavapravaṇeṣu te kṛpāṇā bhītivināsya sukṛtaikarasārṇaveṣu | nirvāṇakāraṇabhavārṇavakarṇadhāratvadvācyaśabdamabhidhātṛgaṇāśśrayāmaḥ || 45 || tvāmagnimīliti mauliṛcābhidhatte vedoditastaditarastviṣamūrjamāha | tvāmandhasāṃ patimanuttamamīśitāraṃ sāmnādime'pyavanahetumathāgnimāha || 46 || tvāṃ śambhuvañjalamayaṃ tanuvaṃ taveśa sākṣādadharvaṇagirā prakaṭāṣṭamūrte | nīrūpavarṇakathane tava te nivṛttā vedāścatasrakamahāśikhaśākhabhedāḥ || 47 || vācā manastvatigataṃ bhagavantameva bhaktyā tavāṣṭagaṇitaistanubhisstuvanti ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe devakṛtadevīstutirnāma tripañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 53 ||
pṛ0 199) devakṛtopaniṣatstutirnāma catuḥpañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ
devāḥ– yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca brahmā tasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca viṣṇustasmai vai namo namaḥ || 1 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca rudrastasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yā comā tasmai vai namo namaḥ || 2 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavānyaśca vināyakastasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca skandastasmai vai namo namaḥ || 3 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavānyaścendrastasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavānyaścāgnistasmai vai namo namaḥ || 4 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavānyaśca vāyustasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavānyaśca sūryastasmai vai namo namaḥ || 5 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavānyaśca varuṇastasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavānyaśca yamastasmai vai namo namaḥ || 6 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavānyaśca niṝtistasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca īśānastasmai vai namo namaḥ || 7 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca kuberastasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavānyaśca nakṣatrāṇi tasmai vai namo namaḥ || 8 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaścāṣṭau grahāstasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavānyaśca ṛṣayastasmai vai namo namaḥ || 9 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavānyaścāṣṭau vasavastasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca dvādaśādityāstasmai vai namo namaḥ || 10 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca ekādaśarudrāstasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca pṛthīvī tasmai vai namo namaḥ || 11 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavānyaścāpastasmai vai namo namaḥ |
pṛ0 200) yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca tejastasmai vai namo namaḥ || 12 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca vāyustasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaścākāśastasmai vai namo namaḥ || 13 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca bhūstasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca bhuvastasmai vai namo namaḥ || 14 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca suvastasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca mahastasmai vai namo namaḥ || 15 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca janastasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca tapastasmai vai namo namaḥ || 16 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca satyaṃ tasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca prāṇāstasmai vai namo namaḥ || 17 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca manastasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca sarvaṃ tasmai vai namo namaḥ || 18 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca kālastasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca mṛtyustasmai vai namo namaḥ || 19 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca bhūtaṃ tasmai vai namo namaḥ | yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca bhaviṣyattasmai vai namo namaḥ || 20 || yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaśca vartamānaṃ tasmai vai namo namaḥ | omādāvante ca bhūrbhuvasvastriroṅkṛtiḥ || 21 || brahmaiva tvaṃ tridhordhvastvaṃ gatiḥ puṣṭirmaheśvaraḥ | viśvañca viśvātītastvaṃ hutaṃ prahutameva ca || kṛtaṃ cākṛtamete ca paramaṃ ca parāyaṇam | nārāyaṇādijanako hyaryamṇo varuṇasya hi || janitā tvaṃ tathā vāyordyāvābhūmyormaheśvaraḥ | sarveśassarvasākṣī ca sarva eva tvameva hi || agrāhyassarvabhūteṣu sarvendriyaguṇātigaḥ | aliṅgosya śarīrastvaṃ vyāpakaśca sanātanaḥ || vāmanaṃ tvāṃ mahādevaṃ sarvedevā upāsate | tvatto jātaṃ jagacchambho sthitaṃ tvayyeva līyate || tvatto nāsti pṛthakkiñcinna bhinnaṃ paramārthataḥ || 27 ||
pṛ0 201) ajāṃ māyāṃ lohitaśuklakṛṣṇāṃ bahūnasmāñjanayantīṃ sarūpām | ajastvameko juṣamāṇo'nuśeṣe jahātyenāṃ bhuktabhogāmajastvam || 28 || māyāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ vidyānmāyinaṃ tu maheśvaram | tavāvayavasambhūtairvyāptaṃ sarvamidaṃ jagat || neha nānāsti kiñcidvai tvadadhiṣṭhitameva hi | tvāmavajñāya durmedhāḥ kṛtakṛtyo'bhimanyate || na sāmparāyaṃ pravidāma bālā mūḍhā vayaṃ kevalaṃ tvadvihīnāḥ | kiñcittṛṇaṃ cālayituṃ ca neśāstvaṃ no gatiḥ paramaṃ cāsi śambho || 31 || tvayāvṛtaṃ lokamidaṃ samagraṃ ko vā hīnaṃ cetate tvadvihīnaḥ | eko rudrastvaṃ hi sarvasya kartā viśvātītaḥ paramaścetako'si || 32 || sarvabhūtātigaścātmā kośātītaḥ parātparaḥ | mahāgrāsastvameveśa mṛtyustvadupasecanaḥ || odanaṃ tava bhūteśa brahmakṣatraṃ jagattathā | brahmapucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā tvaṃ śāntirakṣarameva ca || hṛdisthā devatāssarvā hṛdi prāṇe pratiṣṭhitāḥ | hṛdayaṃ puruṣo'si tvaṃ tisro mātrāḥ paraśca saḥ || oṅkāraḥ praṇavo vyāpī hyananto'nantavikramaḥ | tāraṃ sūkṣmaṃ vaidyutastvaṃ śuklaṃ sarvaśarīragam || īśāno bhagavān rudro mahādevastvamīśvaraḥ | paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma paraḥ pāraḥ parāyaṇaḥ || śūro vīraḥ puruṣo bhūtasaṃstho viśvo viśveśaḥ prāṇadaścāvyayātmā | cakṣuṣaścakṣuśśrotra eva tvamīśa manaso mano buddherboddhā tvameva || 38 || patiḥ patīnāṃ paśavo vayaṃ cāpyasmānaho pāsi tathātsi deva | tvadudbhavaṃ sarvamīśastvameko nāneva bhāsi puruṣasya māyayā || 39 || tileṣu tailaṃ dadhinīva sarpirāpassrotasvaraṇīṣu vahniḥ | evaṃ protaṃ tvayyadvitīye maheśa tvajjaṃ tvallaṃ tvadanaṃ caitadeva || 40 || na vidyate guṇakarmādi nāmarūpādiśaktirjñānaśaktyā vibhinnaḥ | hṛdayastvaṃ bhūtabhavyaḥ purāṇo hyeko vīro vedaguṇaikavedyaḥ || 41 || oṅkārādisvararūpo maheśa vidhāmā tvaṃ varaṇīyastathāṇuḥ | mahān jetā jigyaścāparājito hyabhrāvakāśaḥ khañca kañca tvameva || 42 || vibhrāṭ samrāṭ bhūmadhāmā tvameva pitāsi mātā bhrātṛkaścādivedyaḥ | rujāṃ harastvaṃ bhiṣakpāpahīno hyapāṇipādo nirvikārastvamātmā || 43 ||
pṛ0 202) svayaṃ bhānaḥ para eko jyotireva tvatto na ojastviṣṭatamo'sti devaḥ | tvaṃ na divā naiva rātristvamīśastvaṃ sīmā viśvataścakṣurīśaḥ || 44 || na vedāntā nāpi vedāśca te vai tava jñānaṃ manasaivādya vṛttam | ākāśaḥ pṛthivī salilaṃ ca vāyustejaścāpi prathitaṃ te jagacca || 45 || viśvasya netā viśvabhartā tvamīśastava jñānātsarvameveha vindet | tavājñānānmohitāssarva eva tava prasādādambayā bodhitāssmaḥ || 46 || avasthātītaḥ para ātmā tvameva brahmaiva tvaṃ saṃsarasyādirūpaḥ | viśoko vimṛtyurajighṛtso'pipāsaśśarīrahīno'pyajaraḥ purāṇaḥ || 47 || ṛtaṃ satyaṃ nāmarūpātigastvaṃ tavāmeyarūpaṃ ko hi vededameva | ṛco akṣare paramastvaṃ maheśa nānyatvatto yadbhavededamārtam || 48 || nānyaddṛkpaśyati paśyakastvaṃ dṛṣṭerdraṣṭā vācyavācādihīnaḥ | vidyādhīśassvara eko maheśastvameva tvaṃ veda yo'sīśa eva || 49 || namaste harase śociṣe te namaste astvarciṣe devadevaviśvādhīśaśśaṅkaro vedavedyaḥ | anyattapantu hetayo ghorarūpā bhakteṣu tvaṃ śivo bhava śatrūnasmākaṃ jahi śūlena śambho || ya imaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ yāsi juhvaddṛṣṭiḥ prathamo vo manaḥ padmasaṃsthaḥ | tvamāśiṣaṃ draviṇaṃ dhehi śambho viśvakartā manasā sampradṛśyo dhātā vidhātā paramepyasandṛk | teṣāmiṣṭāni tava pādapūjayā sarvaṃ labhatyeva na hi saṃśayo'tra | tvaṃ no mātā tvaṃ pitā copanetā mātā bandhuḥ paramo vai gurustvam || 52 || tvaṃ deveṣu prathito nāmatastveka evedaṃ rudrastvā manākpūrvasūrāḥ | vettuṃ ca tvāṃ nūtanāścāpi śambho hyapūtapūrtaṃ jagadekaṃ tvayārtam || 53 || yadbhūtajālaṃ nikhilaṃ vai visṛṣṭametādṛśaṃ tvāṃ na vidanti keciddṛṣṭyāntareṇa paripaśyanti mūḍhāḥ | māyānīhāraprāvṛtāśāstrajanyāḥ asūstṛpyā bhogabhājo bhuvaḥ ke || 54 || yajñairdānaiḥ kāmakāmaiśca bālā divaḥ paraḥ pṛthivyāstvaṃ paraśca | devāsuraistvaṃ puro mūḍhagarbho bhūtānāṃ tvaṃ mahimā garbharūpaḥ || 55 ||
pṛ0 203) kastvāṃ veda bhūtavargairvihīnaṃ vedairviśvaṃ yatra līnaṃ tvayīśe | aja tvannābhau jagadetadvicitraṃ madhye'pitaṃ yasmin viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ ca tvameva || tato gandharvā oṣadhīśo'pi śambho sarvendriyāṇi manasā tvāṃ namāmaḥ | hṛdā paśyanti manasā manīṣiṇo ye brahmamanvāna upāsate tvām || 57 || tvāmīdṛśaṃ gūḍhamanupraviṣṭaṃ sahaiva santaṃ na vijānanti devāḥ | viśvasya cakṣurviśvavaktrorubāhurviśvaspatirbhuvanasyāsya goptā || 58 || dyāvābhūmī tvatta eveddharaśmissūryo bhrājatiṃ khe somatārairgṛhaiśca | nānye jānanti tava bhaktyā vihīnā hyajātaṃ tvāmīśaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ || 59 ||
skandaḥ- itthaṃ saṃstutya te sarve daṇḍavatsurasattamāḥ | praṇemuḥ paramātmānaṃ dadṛśurdevatāgaṇāḥ || tejorāśiṃ mahādevaṃ gaganasthaṃ sanātanam || 61 || baḍabānalabāḍabendramukhyairbaḍabājānibiḍaujasārcitāṅghrim | balinandanapūjyabāṇaliṅgalolaṃ balamānarcya subilvapallavaiḥ || 62 || balapramathanaṃ śivaṃ balibalāri bāṇārcitaṃ vileśayaphaṇāmaṇī vidhṛtapāṇipadmāṅkitam | balotkaṭasurāsurairnamitabālacandrārdhadhṛk dhṛtābalavarāṅgakaṃ harisubāṇamaikṣan surāḥ || 63 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe devakṛtopaniṣatstutirnāma catuḥpañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 54 ||
devyupaniṣatpratipādanaṃ nāma pañcapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ
skandaḥ– tadā devā mahādevaṃ gaganasthaṃ sanātanam | umayā varadaṃ devaṃ mandasmitamanoharam || 1 || utphullahallakalasanmālāśobhitakandharam | sudhāṃśūgrāṃśukīlābhirvikāsitadiśāmukham || 2 || kundācchaśāradābhrābhaghanakāntiśarīrakam | triṇetraśobhivaktrodyannāgakuṇḍalamaṇḍitam || 3 ||
pṛ0 204) kuṇḍalīśaphaṇābhrājatkuṇḍalānanamaṇḍitam | kapardataṭabaddhendugaṅgāplāvitamaulikam || 4 || śūlāmalalasadbālamṛgapāṇi manoharam | āśāvasaṃ mahātmānaṃ ratnakaṅkaṇamaṇḍitam || 5 || karaṭitvakkaṭitaṭavaddhakhaḍgavirājitam | devyā ca saṃyutaṃ cāruvadanasmerakāntayā || 6 || dhammillamallikāmodapaṅkajottamagandhayā | sindhūratilakāśobhiphālayācchamaṇitviṣā || 7 || nānālaṅkārasaṅkḷptatattadaṅkaikaśobhayā | koṭikandarpadarpaghnaḥ koṭisūryaśatādhikaḥ || 8 || koṭicandrādhikatanustanuhīno'pi śaṅkaraḥ | ghanaghoṣeṇa devāṃstānuccairghoṣo maheśvaraḥ || 9 || gambhīrayā madhurayā vācā saṃhlādayaṃstadā | prāha tānpramathādhīśassurādhīśān śivāsakhaḥ || 10 ||
īśvaraḥ– bho bho surottamāssarve brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | yamānilānalabradhnamaruto vāsavo'śvinaḥ || sūryacandrendravaruṇadhanādhīśā diśādhipāḥ | śṛṇvantu paramaṃ me'dya vacanaṃ sundaraṃ surāḥ || kṛtayatnā bhavanto hi cāsmiṃstārṇaka kalpite | puruṣe sarvaśaktyāpi bhavadbhiruruvikramaiḥ || jagatpālanadakṣaiśca na kiñcidudabhūtsurāḥ | dagdhuṃ sraṣṭuṃ tathādātumattuṃ nāśayituṃ drutam || mama tejovihīnāśca jaḍāhaṅkāramāśritāḥ | macchaktikaruṇāhīnāśśaktihīnāśca sāmpratam || iyaṃ mamāṅkasaṃsthā yā hyumākhyā śaktiruttamā | viśvanirmāṇabharaṇaśikṣaṇeyaṃ vicakṣaṇā || dakṣaśailendraduhitā kāraṇaiśca suraisstutā | na tasyāḥ kāraṇaṃ kāryamajaivaiṣā sanātanī || etasyāśśaktivaicitryaṃ bhavantassarva eva hi | mamaiṣā paramā mūrtiretasyā virahe mama || na kiñcidiha kartavyamakartāsaṅga eva hi | ahameko nirādhāro madādhārātviyaṃ surāḥ || bhavatāṃ kāraṇaṃ devāśśiveyaṃ citrakāriṇī | etasyāśśaktiyogena śaktimānasmi sarvadhā || parā me paramā śaktissvabhāvādeva vartate | kālaṃ svabhāvaṃ niyatimicchāmekevadantyapi || bhūtasaṅghantathaivānye carṣayaḥ parimohitāḥ | etasyāśśaktivaicitryaṃ jagadetaccarācaram || enāṃ praṇamata kṣiprametasyāḥ kṛpayā surāḥ | vikṣepāvaraṇābhyāṃ ca śaktibhyāṃ varjitā yadi || tāvadeva ciraṃ devā yāvadvikṣepaśaktitaḥ | na muktā me paraṃ jñānaṃ prāpyāpi surasattamāḥ || kintvāvaraṇanirmuktā bhaviṣyadhvaṃ kṛpādhikāḥ | bhavatāṃ sarvathā jñānaṃ matprasādena sattamāḥ || yāvadāvartanaṃ devāssajñānāścādhikāriṇaḥ | prāpnuvantu bhavanto hi vedavedāntasambhavam || jñānaṃ me pāramaiśvaryaṃ devyāśca kṛpayā surāḥ | tadā devāśśambhuvaco niśamya paramārthataḥ ||
pṛ0 205) jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā tuṣṭuvurjagadambikām | devadevaprasādāya bhaktyā baddhakarāssurāḥ ||
devāḥ– śaracchaśisamānane jitagajendrayāte śive sunīlajaladopamojvalakace subimbādhare | sunīlanayanāñcalotpalasamānanetrāñcale dayārasaghane śive sadayamadya naḥ pālaya || 29 || surāsuramunivrajairnatapadāmbuje śaṅkari maheśvaramahāṅkage vikacamallidhammillake | bhavāni bhavanāśini haritabhaktapāpavraje namāma padapaṅkajaṃ tava vimuktidaṃ kevalam || 30 || kadambavanasaṃsthite maṇikadambakāntipriye śaracchaśisubimbavatprathitavaktrabimbādhare | sugandhatarabandhurāyitasugātritāmbhoruho- jvalannayanakoṭike nataguhādiherambake || 31 || nagendrakulakanyake vidhṛtasāmisomālake maheśvari suyallake hyasurajālasambhallake | namāma padapallavaṃ tava sugallamaulisphura- tsurottamakirīṭakajvalitapāpamallāpaham || 32 || kulācalakulaṃ tvayā tilakakāntamīśe kṛtaṃ kulācalabhayāśrayātkuliśitāghasaṅghe [śayāśrayāditi pāṭhaḥ |] śive | kulīnajanamānasāśrayaṇapādapadmojvale prasīda pavanānalairnatapadāmbuje śaṅkari || 33 ||
sūtaḥ- devānāṃ saṃstavaṃ śrutvā prahṛṣṭā parameśvarī | prāha prasannā gambhīraṃ devāntsumadhuraṃ giram ||
pṛ0 206) devyuvāca– stutyā ca bhavatāṃ devāḥ prasādasumukhātvaham | dadāmi vāñchitaṃ sarvaṃ śivajñānamidaṃ surāḥ || majjñānena parāṃ śāntimadhigacchata suvrataḥ | ahaṃ mānaṃ parityajya śivasārvātmyavedinaḥ || vimuktāḥ paśavo yūyaṃ manmāyāśaktivaibhavāt | ahamevākhilārādhyā hyahaṃ dhyeyākhilairapi || saṃvicca sadasaccāpi cāhaṃ viśvamidaṃ dhruvam | manmāyayā mohitāsstha hyahametadbhavābhavam || ahameva svayamidaṃ dadāmi jñānamaiśvaram || 39 || ahaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ cetayāmi hyahaṃ viśvebhirvasubhiścarāmyahamādityairuta viśvadevaiḥ | ahameva vāta iva pravāmyārabhamāṇā bhuvanāni viśva || 40 || ahaṃ dadhāmi draviṇaṃ haviṣmate suvīryāya yajamānāya sunvate | paro divāhaṃ parayenāpṛthivyāṃ paraṃparā hi prathamā pṛthivyām || 41 || eṣo'ntaryāmyamṛtaḥ purāṇassadājanānāṃ hṛdaye sanniviṣṭaḥ | enamātmānaṃ gūḍhamanupraviṣṭaṃ hṛdā paśyanti manasā manīṣiṇaḥ || 42 || eṣa bhūtapatireṣa seturvidharaṇo lokānāmasambhedāya | eṣa supteṣu jāgarti bhūtambhūtaṃ puruṣo nirmimāṇaḥ || 43 || eṣo'ntarāditye hyamṛto hiraṇmayaḥ puruṣo dṛśyate śivaḥ | eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca svarāṭ sammrāṭ prajāpatiḥ || 44 || eṣa divyo deva ekaḥ purāṇo saṅgiṣvasaṅgo guṇanāmakarmabhiḥ || 45 || eṣa eva hi bhūtātmā bhūte bhūte vyavasthiteḥ | ekadhā bahudhā caiva dṛśyate jalacandravat || jalasya calanādeva yathācalati bhāskaraḥ | tathaiṣa sarvabhūteṣu taddharmairnaiva lipyate || 47 || aliṅga ākāśasadharma eṣo nānto na cādirna ca madhyameṣaḥ | jagadgato'yaṃ na jagadvicitrameṣo'khilādhāra urukramassadā || 48 || viśeṣahīnaśca kaviḥ purāṇa eṣa svatantraḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ | gūḍheṣu gūḍhaḥ parapārapārassadurdarśoyogayuktaiśca bhūyān || 49 || sahaiva saṃstho bhavatāṃ vai nilimpāḥ | na jānanti sarve hṛdā bhāsamānaṃ sadābhāsyabhāsaṃ mahokṣādvihīnam || 50 ||
pṛ0 207) asyaiva hi prakṛtiścāsmi devā na māṃ jānate ye sadā duḥkhabhājaḥ | prabhāsmīha devī śaśī sūryṛkṣe ṛṣau grahāṇāṃ paramāsthitaśca || 51 || na cāvayorbhedajālaṃ kadācinmāyā cāhaṃ hyeṣamāyī maheśaḥ | bhāvagrāhyo hyanīḍātmā bhāvābhāvakaraśśivaḥ || 52 || kalāvidaṃ puruṣaṃ devamīḍyaṃ nicāyyainaṃ śāntimatyantameti | eṣa ātmā tapasālokanīyo nānyairdharmairasya liṅgaṃ na caiva || 53 || yasyaiṣa ātmā vṛṇute tanūṃ svāṃ tasya prasādena hitasya lābhaḥ | yasyaiva lābhānna paraṃ lābhamīṣṭe janassurā jñānametasya durjñam || 54 || purāvidaḥ kavayo ye manīṣiṇo jñātvāpyenaṃ niṣprakampā maheśam | taranti śokaṃ ca pṛthakpṛthagjanā na jāyate [jānate iti pāṭhaḥ |] nityayuktā guṇeṣu || 55 || tathendriyādhāramanantarūpaṃ nīrūparūpaṃ paramākāśamenam | viṣvakprapañceṣu purīśayaṃ sthitaṃ vedāntasaṅghairapi ṣṭuḍyamāṇaḥ || 56 || rasaṃ rasānāṃ paramāsvādanīyamanāsvādaṃ rasavarjaṃ suguptam | turīyamindraṃ satatoditaṃ guṇairguṇātītaṃ vipluṣandivyadhāma || 57 || eṣo'nanto mahimādhāra īśo bhūmā sīmā sāra eko'dvitīyaḥ | nānaivāsti mahimāyaṃ pratiṣṭhā kaviḥ pradhāno rasavarjo'yamātmā || 58 || eṣa brahmaiṣa evendra eṣa sarvaṃ carācaram | eṣa ātmāpahatapāpmāvirajo viśoko vimṛtyurajighṛtso'pipāsaḥ || 59 || satyakāmo'guṇo hyeṣa bṛhaddhāmāyamīśvaraḥ | eṣo'śarīro viśvakartā guṇeśa eṣa devaśśīryamāṇairnaśīrṇaḥ || 60 || arajo'yamamṛto vai viśokaśśokātigo jātidharmairvihīnaḥ | eṣa devairvedasaṅghaiśca viprairabhiṣṭuto'pratarkyo hīndriyaiśca || 61 || eṣo'nantaśceṣṭate dehajālairyathorṇanābhissṛjate tantujālam | eṣa āditye tapati tejaseddhaḥ eṣa viprairmakhajālaiśca tuṣṭaḥ || 62 ||
pṛ0 208) yaḥ [apāti iti pāṭhaḥ |] pāti somamamṛtasya nābhiṃ kālātigaḥ pāti viśvaṃ sadaiva | asmadbhinnaṃ nāṇurastīha kiñcitsa eṣa bhartā mama devaḥ purāṇaḥ || 63 || nīrūparūpo'pyayamātmā maheśo nīlagrīvaśśipiviṣṭaśśāśvato'yam | na hanyate hanyamāne śarīre divyo devohyeṣa devaḥ purāṇaḥ || 64 || taṃ brahmavanvāna upāsate paraṃ buddhīndriyātītamanaupamaṃ śivam | nāntaḥ prajñaṃ na vahiḥ prajñamīśaṃ nobhayataḥ prajñamarhattamaṃ ca || 65 || viśvasya sraṣṭāramanekarūpaṃ viśvasyaikaṃ pariveṣṭitāram | guhāhitaṃ gahvareṣṭaṃ purāṇaṃ tvavasthātītaṃ praṇavaṃ cādimekam || 66 || mahaṃ mahāntaṃ paramātmānamīśamaṇoraṇīyāṃsamidaṃ tataṃ ca | vibhrājamānaṃ bhūtavargeṣvasaṅgaṃ velātigaṃ svaprabhābhāsamānam || 67 || vālāgramātraṃ hṛdaye pratiṣṭhaṃ jīvābhāsaṃ manyamānaiśca mūḍhaiḥ | na tveṣa jīvo na śivaścādikartā yasmātparaṃ nāparamasti kiñcit || 68 || bṛhat brahma śuklaṃ ṛtaṃ satyamīśaṃ pramodaṃ mahajjñānamānandamekam | ya enaṃ viduramṛtāste bhavanti hyathetare duḥkhamevāviśanti || 69 || sa eṣa paramānando pyānando brahma tatparam | asyaivānandamātrā hi bhavantaśca surāsurāḥ || ayameva parā kāṣṭā sa brahma sa śivassvayam | vedaparvatajālotthamantraiḥ kḷpto'yameva hi || ityuktvā sā jaganmātā devānāṃ paśyatāṃ tadā | prāha devaṃ mahādevamanādimajamavyayam ||
skandaḥ– ityambāvacanena nanditamanāssvāntāssurāste tadā nānāvedaśirogataiśca vividhairvākyaistadā harṣitāḥ | tāṃ devīmagajāṃ girīśaramaṇīmānandadhārāvṛtāḥ paśyanti śrutilocanaiḥ parivṛtaṃ devaṃ nabhomadhyagam || 73 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe devyupaniṣatpratipādanaṃ nāma pañcapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 55 ||
pṛ0 209) devakṛtakṣetrapūjanaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ
sūtaḥ- kukṣitrilokaṃ deveśaṃ mahokṣasthaṃ hi pārśvagam | prāñjalirvinayopetā nayādiguṇasaṃyutā || prāha devī virūpākṣaṃ viśālākṣī maheśvarī || 2 ||
devyuvāca– devāḥ kilaitadbhagavatprasādato mamaiva te jñānamahomahārthadam | tavādya toṣātsuhṛdo'dyabhedanaṃ samāpnuvandeṣasaṅghāḥ kṛtārthāḥ || 3 || bhavānanādiḥ puruṣaḥ purīśayo guhāhito gahvareṣṭaḥ purāṇaḥ | guṇātigo guṇabhūteṣvasaṅgohyaśīrya ātmā paramaḥ pāvanastvam || 4 || nānyattvatto bhedabhānaṃ na cāsti kavirmanīṣī paribhūssvayambhūḥ | tathāpi lokāyana uttamo'si sa sargajairudvahasīha dehān || 5 || vibhurmahāndyāṃ divaṃ rodasī khaṃ rodasyato rudra īśo'dvitīyaḥ | akāmakāmo mahimā tvaṃ hi bhūmā sīmā sa divyo deva eko ṛṣistvam || ajo'vyayastava vaktraṃ maheśa prapannāssarve dakṣiṇaṃ ghorarūpam | ete sarve paśavaḥ kāmakāmāsteṣāṃ tvaṃ pāśaṃ chettumarhasyato'dya || 6 || payonidhityāga eko hi nityo nityānāṃ ceccetanānāṃ ca cetāḥ | patiḥ patīnāṃ prathamo vidyudīśastvatto babhūvurbhuvanasya gopāḥ || 7 || manovācāmatigastvaṃ hi goptā sarvassarveṣāṃ śarva sarvādakharvaḥ | babhrurmadhuḥ piṅgalo viśvanetā sahasrabhāsptanakāḥ prītimīyuḥ || 8 || ete prasādābhimukhāstvayāto lokeṣu lokyāḥ pālanīyā maheśa | tavaiśvaryādāptakāmā bhavantu nānyatteṣāṃ tvatta evākhileṣu || 9 || samprāptāste pāramaiśvaryayogaṃ mucyantu te mama māyādipāśaiḥ || 10 ||
skandaḥ– tadā devyā vacaśśrutvā prāhadevo ghṛṇānidhiḥ | praṇatānamarāntsarvānviṣṇubrahmendrapūrvakān || hastamastakasaṃyogaṃ kṛtvā deva umādhavaḥ | girā prāha tato devāñchaktiṃ vai pātayaṃ stadā ||
pṛ0 210) īśvaraḥ– devyānayā bodhitā yūyamevaṃ vedāntavijñānasuniścitārthāḥ | maddhyānayogena surottamāściraṃ samprāpyatha jñānamajñairdurāpam || 13 || na cakṣuṣā dṛśyamidaṃ ca khe sadā na vedavādairna ca śāstratarkaiḥ | tapasaivānudṛśyo'hamātmā guruprasādena śivaprasādāt || 14 || bhidyante vai vipulā granthayo vaḥ anādisiddhāḥ ko hi vededamevam | na sāmparāyo bhavatāṃ bālakānāmanādyavidyāviṣayaikavartmanām || 15 || yūyaṃ mayā kalpitaivāstha loke lokādhīśā yāvadāvartanaṃ vaḥ | tāvat jñānaṃ prāpya madhye balīnāṃ bhaviṣyatha pratikalpaṃ sureśāḥ || 16 || sa māmanupratipadyadhvamadya sunirvṛtāstapasā kevalena | vijānanto'nyamanaso no ramante tasmādvedairīḍya eko maheśaḥ || 17 || yajñairdānaistapasānāśakena matkṣetravāsaiḥ paridhūlanādarāḥ | dhṛtatripuṇṭrā bhavapāśamuktāśśirovratairagnirityādimantraiḥ || 18 || uddhūlyagātrāṇi pavitrabhasmanā raudrāṇi cāvartayata prītaye me | pañcākṣarāvartanajātaharṣā malliṅgasampūjanamātratuṣṭāḥ || 19 || kaṣṭairvihīnāśśipiviṣṭamiṣṭairbilvaissamabhyarcya dine dine mām | prakṛṣṭamuktyaiva bhavotkaṭe ratāḥ pranaṣṭamohāḥ prakaṭāṣṭamūrtim || 20 || sarvārtighnaṃ hṛdaye sampraviṣṭaṃ dhyāyanta māmeva sadā hṛdi sthitam | samprāpyamajjñānamaho durāpaṃ koṣṭaṃ kaniṣṭaṃ paritoṣapuṣṭam || 21 || iṣṭaṃ ca yatkiñcidapi triviṣṭape nivedya tadyuñjata prītiyuktāḥ | tenaiva vo jñānamakhaṇḍamiṣṭamīṣṭe'dhunā saṃsṛtibandhanāśam || 22 || karomi pāśānbhavatāpasambhavātsanātanāṃste dadhāmyadya hṛṣṭaḥ | aho bhavadbhirapi pūrṇakāmaḥ kiṃ vismṛto hṛdaye sampraviṣṭaḥ || 23 || madaḥ pūrṇo'pūrṇa evāsmi pūrṇaḥ pūrṇātpūrṇo nāstyapūrṇaṃ mayā hi | devyāḥ prasādena vimuktakāmāścarantu tuṣṭāḥ paripūrṇasiddhayaḥ || 24 ||
pṛ0 211) tathāpi kiñcitpravadāmi vaibhavaṃ kaṣṭaṃ tadavyaktagataṃ mamādya | sarveṣu deveṣu sadaiva sarvadā liṅgākṛtirgirimaulau niviṣṭaḥ || 25 || sthāneṣu pūjyo'hamanādirīśo madrūpalokyaṃ bhavatāṃ sudurlabham | ahaṃ tvaliṅgasaṃsthassanātanaḥ pūjanīyo bhavadbhiḥ || 26 || tadeva liṅgaṃ mama liṅgamevaṃ jñātunnaśakyaṃ kṣuradhārakaṃ tat | rūpadvayaṃ me paramārthatassurāssākāranīrūpamidaṃ hi viśvam || 27 || triṇetramudyacchaśimaulisaṃyutamambāyutaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ mamādyam | tato'pi nīrūpamidaṃ hi liṅgaṃ jagatpavitraṃ [jagatsavitrīti pāṭhaḥ |] kurute'rcanādibhiḥ || 28 || tato hi tatkevalakaṣṭalabhyaṃ tasmādbhavantaśśaraṇaṃ prayāta | kailāsavāso bhavatāṃ sudustarastatra praveśo na hi sadma me sadā || 29 || sarvāvabhāso'pyahamīśa ekastatrāmbayā gaṇasaṅghaiśca yuktaḥ | mukto vijahrāmi sadāstamāyaḥ kailāsaliṅgeṣu sadā niviṣṭaḥ || 30 || kedāra oṅkāra athāvimukte mahālaye rudrakoṭau prabhāse | himālaye śrīnagamaulisaṃsthe tathānyadeśeṣu susaṃsthaliṅge || 31 || sampūjya muktāśca bhavantu vijvarā rahasyametatkathitaṃ surottamāḥ || 32 ||
sūtaḥ- ityuktaṃ girijāmanoharavacaśśrutvā vidhīndrādayo viṣṇvīśānamarudgaṇāssavaruṇā natvā maheśaṃ śivam | jagmussvābhimatapradeśamakhilā devā mudā śaṅkarā- tprāpya jñānamahodayaṃ suruciraṃ muktyaica liṅgārcakāḥ || 33 || himālayanagottame himasudhāmamaulisphura- ddhimādrivarakanyakājaṭilakāntikāntaṃ prabhum | payodhisutayā hariḥ payasijātapuṣpārcanai- rnināya divasānume varasuraṅgakedāragaḥ || 34 ||
pṛ0 212) oṅkāraṃ samavāpya bhāratipatissannarmadātīragaṃ puṣpairbilvadalārcanaiśśrutigatairmantraisstuvanmāmume | tatyājākhilapātakaṃ hṛdi gataṃ cājñānamapyantata- ssṛṣṭiṃ praṣṭutayā svakīyavadanaistuṣṭāva cāṣṭākṛtim || 35 || rudro'vimuktapadavīmavimuktametatsamprāpya liṅganilayaṃ varagaṅgayāpi | viśveśvaraṃ tribhuvaneśvaramīpsitāraṃ tvāmambikāmagasutāṃ suviśālanetrām || 36 || abhyarcya puṣpanikaraiḥ payaso rasaiśca nīraiśca secya varabilvadalaissamarcya | lebhe'pyalabhyamapi vedaśiraḥ pratītaṃ jñānaṃ tadā suvimalaṃ nagarājakanye || 37 || indro'pyathāmarasukaṇṭhakametadeva devaṃ maheśvaramume varabilvapatraiḥ | sampūjya tacchrutigataṃ vimalaṃ madīyaṃ jñānaṃ sadoditamakhaṇḍamavāpya tuṣṭaḥ || 38 || yamo'pi varaśailake vimalagandhamādrau śivaṃ samarcya nijapātakaiśśrutigatiñca lebhe śive | vimuktahṛdayastadā tridalabilvapatraiśśive sa eva sukhasampadāṃ pravaradakṣiṇāśādhipaḥ || 339 || śrīśailanāyakamume prathite pradoṣe śrīdaṃ dhanādhipatirarcya vimuktapāpaḥ | jñānaṃ ca yakṣapatirakṣamamāpa vīkṣya pakṣāśrayeṇa vimalaṃ salabhetsumokṣam || 40 || tāvaśvinau ca karahaṭṭapuraṃ tadāpya nāgeśamarcya vividhairlabhatāṃ supuṣpaiḥ | mokṣaṃ tathaiva bhiṣajāmadhipau tathā tau vedaṃ tathāyuṣamume samavāpatustau || 41 || vāyuḥ kāmadavaidyanāthavipinādhīśaṃ samabhyarcya māṃ bilvaiḥ komalapuṣpanīrajalavaissamprāpya mokṣaṃ drutam | agniḥ puṣkaramīśvaraṃ tribhuvanādhyakṣaṃ samabhyarcya vai sarvaṃ bhakṣasamudbhavaṃ prathitamapyaṃhovimukto'mbike || 42 || gokarṇaṃ samavāpya te hi marutaḥ pūjyeśvaraṃ māṃ śive bilvaiḥ komalapallavaiśca vasavo dityāstavaistuṣṭuvuḥ |
pṛ0 213) śrīmattryambakamapyagasute te dvādaśārkā hi māṃ homairhutvā maheśi rudrāstvabhipūjya tridalaiśca bilvapatraiḥ || 43 || pariṇatahimadhāmamaṇḍalo'pi śambhuṃ hṛdayāmbhojasupuṇḍarīkavāsam | goparvate samabhipūjya tathaiva śambhuṃ mārtāṇḍako'pi girije samavāpa muktim || kāñcīṃ kāñcitaditkaṭāṃ diviṣadastvekāmramūle haraṃ kāmākṣīmapi bhogabhogyanikaraissampūjya muktiṃ gatāḥ | anyecāpi grahāstathaiva munayo devāsurā mānavā gandharvoragayakṣarākṣasagaṇā muktāssamabhyarcya mām || 45 || śrīkaṇṭhe tṛṇaśaṅkare suvihite ratnādrimaulisthite śrīmātṛprabhave girīndratanaye śrīkālahastīgirau | jambūliṅgakaverajātaṭayuge japye tathā kumbhake puṇye śrīdhavalārjune vidhipuhe śrīvedakābje pure || 46 || puṇye śvetavane mayūravipine chāyāvane śaṅkari sampūjya tridaśeśvaraṃ girijayā muktiṃ parāṃ te yayuḥ || 47 || hālāsyanāyakamume varaśālivāṭīnāthaṃ ca kāntimatikāśapurāyatākṣīm | devāṅganā samabhipūjya halīsalāsyairnṛtyanti hemasarasīmavagāhya māṃ tvām || mārkaṇḍeyaghaṭodbhavau ghaṭaharaṃ sampūjya mṛtyuṃ kṣaṇā- dyojigye bhuvaneśvari tribhuvane matpādaśūlāhatam | skandassvāmigirau samarcya gaṇapastaddakṣiṇāvartake māmārādhya gaṇāśca bhūsuragaṇāstatratyaliṅgeṣu mām || 49 || kṣiprātīraniketane mayi sadā nāmnā mahākālaje samprāpyārcya gaṇatvamāpa sukṛtairmukto'pyabhūnmadgaṇaḥ | bhṛṅgī nandikacaṇḍikau balisutaḥ paulastyahuṇḍādayo māmārāddhya sadaiva tuṣṭuvurume tanme samākarṇaya || 50 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe devakṛtakṣetrapūjanannāma ṣaṭpañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 56 ||
pṛ0 214) sarvadevastutirnāma saptapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ
īśvaraḥ– devairgaṇendrairmunibhisstuto'haṃ tatra tatra hi | tatstutiṃ sāvadhānena mattaśśṛṇu nagātmaje || 1 || viṣṇubrahmādayo devāstathaiva gaṇapā mama | māṃ tuṣṭuvurmahādevaṃ padyairgadyairmanoharaiḥ || 2 ||
viṣṇuḥ– kanajjaṭākuṭīragāṃ vihaṅgasaṅgamaṇḍitāṃ karipriyāṅgasaṅgatāṃ mukhābjakāntiraṅgitām | kapardakoṭisaṅgatāṃ kathāsudhātaraṅgiṇīṃ bhajāmi śambhumauligāṃ maheśvaraṃ nato'smyaham || 3 || kharādikhaṅgasaṃhatiprapañcabandhanāntakaprakhāsacandrahāsadhṛk | akhaṇḍakhaṇḍaparśujaprabhāvitardikevatatkṣaṇajñapāraṇasphuratkharādiduṣṭagarvahṛt || 4 ||
brahmā– manotigaṃ vacotigaṃ gaṇātigaṃ guṇātigaṃ bhujaṅgarājabhogagārcitāṅghrihṛtpathojagam | taraṅgiṇītaraṅgajapraphullapadmanālagaṃ bhajāmi ratnaraṅgagaṃ kuraṅgapāṇimīśvaram || 5 || hiraṇyadaṃ mahīpradaṃ paśupradaṃ harājaviṣṇusarvadapradānabhogamokṣadam | bhajāmi devadaivataṃ guhāhitaṃ jagadgataṃ prabhāvitaṃ subhāṣitaṃ mahāśrutīḍitaṃ śivam || 6 ||
rudraḥ– mahāhirājakaṅkaṇaṃ dharādhṛgātmajāsakhaṃ jvalattriśūladhāriṇaṃ munīndrabālapoṣaṇam | kuraṅgabāladhāriṇaṃ sitatripuṇṭradhāriṇaṃ bhajāmi somadhāriṇaṃ karīndrakṛttidhāriṇam || 7 || prakṛṣṭasāmaghoṣiṇaṃ sudhāṃśukhaṇḍadīdhitipracaṇḍamaulimaṇḍalaṃ sukuṇḍalīkṛtācchagaṇḍakuṇḍalīśvaraṃ prabhum | akhaṇḍadivyadīdhimatsucandrakhaṇḍadehakaṃ vidhātṛmuṇḍaṣaṇḍajaprakāśamālajālakam || 8 || bhajāmi caṇḍatāṇḍavaṃ ghanāṇḍajāṇḍajapriyaṃ tuhaṇḍahuṇḍakapriyaṃ mahorubāhudaṇḍakam |
indraḥ– purāntakaṃ smarāntakaṃ bhagāntakaṃ makhāntakaṃ gajāndhakāntakāntakaṃ śivaṃ sadā hṛdambuje ||
vāyuḥ– sudakṣadakṣaśikṣakaṃ mahokṣavāhakakṣagaṃ supakṣivāhanapriyaṃ mayaskaraṃ yaśaskaram |
pṛ0 215) tiraskaraṃ mahenasāṃ mahaskaratatiprabhaṃ tiraskṛtaṃ durātmanām || 10 || sumaskarīmanogataṃ sutaskaraṃ haviṣkaraṃ bhajāmi śaṅkaraṃ sadā hṛdantare suvistaram || 11 ||
agniḥ– śubhāṅgadaṃ śubhāspadaṃ sureṣu dattatatpadaṃ mahāvibhūtidhāriṇaṃ subhūtidaṃ sumokṣadam | bhavādihīnabodhadaṃ karīndracarmavastrakamakhaṇḍasomamaṇḍalapradaṃ bhaje śivaṃ sadā || 12 ||
yamaḥ– haraṃ subhaktatatparaṃ garandharaṃ jvalandharaṃ prabuddhaśatrusaṃharaṃ mayaskaraṃ maheśvaram | harīśaraṃ mahīdharorukārmukaṃ bhajāmi bhūrathaṃ haram || 13 ||
sūryaḥ– śarīrabhogasaṃharaṃ bhajāmi devabhāskaraṃ harañca śaṅkaraṃ sadā | parātparaṃ naṭeśvaraṃ janārdanārdanaṃ phaṇīndrarājahārakaṃ sumāramārakārakam || 14 ||
kuberaḥ– dhanādhipaṃ gaṇādibṛndapādhipamumādhipaṃ vṛṣādhipaṃ jagatsukāraṇādhipam | bhajāmi citsukhādhipaṃ nagādhipaṃ hṛdādhipam || 15 ||
candraḥ– śaraccaśīsamachaviṃ mahokṣapucchacāmaraṃ mahācchatarukalpakaprasūnagucchamastakam | niricchajanavallabhaṃ taṭicchavikapardakaṃ hṛdisthaśivamavyayaṃ sukacchapastaveḍitam || 16 ||
varuṇaḥ– viśiṣṭādviśiṣṭādiśiṣṭeṣṭanaṣṭaṃ giriṣṭaṃ mahiṣṭaṃ tathā jyeṣṭamīśam | bhajāmīṣṭamaṣṭākṛtiṃ bhaktituṣṭaṃ kaniṣṭañca kaṣṭādikaṣṭaikanāśam || 17 ||
aśvinau– kaṭitaṭakaraṭitvacaṃ jaṭākuṭīrātsurapāṭīrataṭītaṭorugaṅgātaṭabaddhendukalāsaṭam | vaṭorudhārānikaṭāṭaṅkaṭakoṭiṭaṅkahastam || 18 ||
vasavaḥ– bhujaṅgarājahārakaṃ mahāviṣāgnidhārakaṃ bhavāmbudhessutārakaṃ bhayānakaṃ mahenasām |
pṛ0 216) bhajāmahe'ntakāntakaṃ maheśvaratvadāyakaṃ surāsurendranāyakaṃ jaṭāṅganārdhakāyakam || 19 ||
marutaḥ– mahārikhaṃ bhujāṃsukhāntaraṅgamadrijāsakhaṃ susāmajātasanmukhaṃ tridadvayonmukhonmukham | bahirmukhaissudurmukhaṃ hasanmukhaṃ samastaduḥkhadurmukhaṃ bhaje śivaṃ hṛdā sadā || 20 ||
śikhīsakhāsakhaṃ jalāsakhaṃ naṭatvaśeṣasanmukhaṃ hṛdi || 21 ||
rudrāḥ– dṛgañcalasphuliṅgaleśabhasmitāṅganaṅgabhasmasaṅgatam | pataṅgadṛksamāntaraṅgamindudhāmagaṃ vihaṅgavāhanārcitam || 22 || bhaje śivaṃ dṛgaṅgataṃ śivāṅgakaṃ pāthojagārcitāṅgamaulisaṅgatam | sudakṣadakṣaśikṣakaṃ mahokṣavāhakakṣagaṃ supakṣivāhanapriyaṃ bhajāmyadhokṣajārcitam || 23 || hṛdakṣahīnamakṣataṃ tvapakṣayādivarjitaṃ bhajāmi bhaktajālake hyupekṣayā suvarjitam || kṣapeśamaulimīkṣaṇīkṛtābjamitrakānanamalakṣamakṣatā- kṣadṛśyavigrahaṃ virūpakākṣamīśvaraṃ bhaje sadā hṛdantare || 24 ||
ādityāḥ– gaṇādhināthanāthitākhilaprapañcagādhijātasannutaṃ digādhigāyakātithīkṛtābjadivyapādukam | bhajāmi rātrināthamaulikasphuratsurañjanītaraṅgiṇīdivāsanāthagaṃ sadā || 25 ||
gaṇeśaḥ– aśeṣaśoṣitākhilaprapañcajātaśeṣakaṃ munīṣṭajātapoṣakaṃ mahāhiśeṣabhūṣakam | samudranīraśoṣakaṃ prakāmamiṣṭalocanaṃ mahāmbudaprakarṣaṇaṃ taṭitsamānaghoṣaṇam || 26 || bhajāmi vedabhāṣiṇaṃ vidhestu sṛṣṭikāraṇam || 27 ||
skandaḥ– ghanastanayugarkṣakaṃ ghanastanitanimnamerudāghaghṛṇāyutasucakṣuṣam | nirākṛtāghasaṅghakaṃ ghṛṇāyutaṃ svabhaktake dhṛtākṣabhūtisupriyaṃ ghanābhakaṇṭhamaṇḍalam || 28 || svanannakhāgranissṛtavidhījamuṇḍamaṇḍalaṃ bhaje'ntaraṅgacidghanaṃ sadāśivaṃ sadāhṛdi |
pṛ0 217) nandīśvaraḥ– carācaraṃ sucaṅkaraṃ kṛpīḍayonidhārakaṃ niśācarāntakaṃ catu- rmukhānanāravindavedajālasaṃstutaṃ śivam | vicāramātragocaraṃ supañcavaktragocaraṃ suniścalaṃ hṛdantare sucāmaraughavījitaṃ mahokṣagaṃ bhaje śivam || 30 ||
caṇḍī– harijjaṭātaṭīnikaṅkaṭebhacarmadhārakaṃ [naṭānaṭikadambacarmadhārakamiti pāṭhaḥ |] kavāṭa- hṛttaṭīnikāṭahaṃsakaṃ vaṭorumūlagaṃ śivaṃ mahotkaṭam || 31 ||
bhṛṅgī– mṛḍaṃ dṛḍhaṃ parībṛḍhaṃ subāḍhagāḍhahṛdgataṃ sumūḍhavyūḍhasanmukhaṃ kriyāsamūhatarpitam | anūḍhakanyakādrijāsakhaṃ samūḍhagūḍhahṛdgataṃ mahākarāmbujotthitaprakāśaḍhakkavādyakam || 32 ||
īśvaraḥ– gīrvāṇairakṛtārthibhiḥ kila śive kṣīrābdhidhārārṇave kṛtvā vāsukirajjumajjanavidhau manthānamandrācalam | tasmādapyudabhūnmahāmaṇigaṇaṃ dhenūgaṇaṃ paṅkajā- jjātā coṣadhināyakassuratarussāraṅgatīraṅgakau || 33 || dhūmotkīlitakālakūṭaśabalajvālātigaṃ te tatāḥ kāndīśīkṛtadevadaityanivahaṃ dṛṣṭvāhameko ghṛṇī | tatprāśyākhiladevasaṅghavinuto nīlācchakaṇṭho'bhavam || 34 || akapaṭapaṭuvākyamauligumphaistaṭinījālakamaulirāgahākhilāgraḥ | karaṭitvakpaṭabhūtabhūtaṭopo kapaṭitadūrahṛdabjanṛttaṭopaḥ || 35 || sandhyātāṇḍavaḍambaravyasanino bhargasya caṇḍabhrame pronnṛtyadbhujacaṇḍamaṇḍalabhuvo jañjhānilāḥ kevalam |
pṛ0 218) yeṣāmuccalatāṃ javena jhaṭiti vyūheṣu bhūmībhṛtā- muḍḍīneṣu biḍaujasā punarasau dambholirālokitaḥ || 36 ||
sarvadevāḥ– tvalliṅgārcanato maheśa śaradāṃ jīvema śambhośataṃ tvannāmāni sadā bruvāma ca vibho bhaktānhi nandāma te | liṅgaṃ bilvadalottamāṅgamasakṛtpaśyema puṇyāḥ kathā- śśṛṇvāmaḥ prativāsaraṃ ca vigatainaskā bhavāmo vayam || 37 ||
śeṣaḥ– vasudhādharadhārakaṃ maheśaṃ vasudhārādhipamitramitrasaṃstham | himakarahimabheṣajākṣiyugmaṃ himagirisutayānato'smi devamādyam || 38 ||
īśvaraḥ– pṛṣṭeṣṭalagnakamaṭhākṛtilokanāṭyaṃ [pṛṣṭoṣṭalagnakamaṭhākṛtilokanātha iti pāṭhaḥ|] bhūdāradāritarasātalato'tidūram | brahmāṇḍakharparamatītya gatordhvamauliṃ lokeśadṛṣṭivirahānmama liṅgametat || 39 || talliṅgapūjanamume śrutimaulivākyasiddhāntagarbhitapadaprapathena bhāvyam | tatkaścideva kurute mama ca prasādānno vā surā bharitabhaktirasā hi kecit || caṇḍāṃśuprakaṭapradīpitatamasstomaikasīmā diśaḥ khadyotadyotaneva prabhavati bhavatāṃ devajālaṃ samagram | kiṃ nimbākatarussuradrumasamo bhūyāttato me śive hyajñānaṃ kimu vedanena sadṛśaṃ viṣṇvādayaḥ kiṃ samāḥ || 41 || gaganātigaliṅgamaulimetadvarapātālatalāttamūlabhāgam | mahasādhavalīkṛtākhilāśaṃ bhavadāśāsyasamaṃ mameṣṭavāsam || 42 || gaganagatamapāratejaseddhaṃ janitānandabhareṇa devasaṅghāḥ | avanitalanivāsamastakāste paribaddhāñjalayo dadarśurīśam || 43 ||
pṛ0 219) sūtaḥ– surakuvalayasomaṃ somadhāmottamāṅgaṃ madhurimaguṇasīmaṃ bhūmasāmādigītam | sumasamamṛdukāyaṃ bhīmamīśaṃ ca somaṃ kumatipathavidūraṃ kāmadaṃ kāmanāśam || 44 || kamalāmalanetrapūjyapādaṃ kamalārātijaṭātaṭorubhūṣam | kalitālakagāṅgatuṅgalīlaṃ kalaśodbhūtamuniprapūjitāṅghrim || 45 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe sarvadevastutirnāma saptapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 57 ||
ātmaliṃgakathanaṃ nāma aṣṭapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ
jaigīṣavyaḥ– ahojñānamahānandadhārāmṛtanimajjanaiḥ | sānandamagnahṛdayāśśivajñānahatāśubhāḥ || 1 || dhanyā vayaṃ na sandehasskandānandaikamedurāḥ | kintalliṅgaṃ maheśena proktaṃ tadvada me'dhunā || 2 || kiṃ talliṅgaṃ kaśca liṅgī ko vā talliṅgapūjakaḥ | liṅgārcanena kiṃ prāpyaṃ vada vistarato'dhunā || 3 || tvadvāgamṛtadhārābhiḥ pāpadāvānalo mama | śāntaḥ praśāntaṃ cittañca mahānandābdhivīcigam || 4 ||
sūtaḥ– jaigīṣavyavacovīcīsamplāvitahṛdantaraḥ | skando nanditamandāro guhyantatpārameśvaram || 5 || devyai devena kathitamavādīcchāmbhavāya tu || 6 ||
skandaḥ– yathā mune tvayāpṛchi praśno'yaṃ sarvadustaraḥ | tathaiva pṛṣṭo bhagavāndṛṣṭvā kailāsamauligam || 7 || kailāseśvaraliṅgañca praṇamya stavyabhaktitaḥ || 8 ||
devyuvāca– liṅgaṃ kailāsamaulau janitativihitāpāratāpaikabhaṅgaṃ maccittābjaikabhṛṅgaṃ raviśaśiśikhijāpārakāntottamāṅgam |
pṛ0 220) dhyānānandaikasaṅgaṃ vividhajanijarānāśanenāpyasaṅgaṃ śāntaṃ svāntaikasaṅgaṃ kathaya bhavaharaṃ śāṅgamadhyānasaṅgam || 9 || vividhajanavidhīndrairviṣṇubhiścaiva rudrairamaravarasamūhairdaityagandharvasaṅghaiḥ | munivaragaṇabṛndaisskandaherambakādyairna hi khalu bhagavaṃste liṅgametaddhi dṛṣṭam || 10 || kathamidamanalākṣaṃ paśyati prītiyukto yamaniyamatapasyāpāradānairmakhairvā | janiśatatapasā vā prāpyametanmaheśa tribhuvanabhavane vā kaścidastīśadraṣṭum || 11 || kathaya rahasi śambho hyāḥ kimetadvicitraṃ hyahamapi bhagavaṃste jñāsiṣaṃ naiva liṅgam ||
skandaḥ– ityambāvacanena sundaratarasvāntendumaulistadā vīkṣyāmbāṃ mukhapaṅkajottamalasannetrālimālādaraḥ | vedāntāmbujabhāskarastrijagatāmādhārabhūto haraḥ prāhotphullamanoharāravindavadano devīṃ mudā śaṅkaraḥ || 13 || punaḥ praṇamya sā devī prāha kāmārimīśvaram || 14 ||
devyuvāca– devadeva mahādeva mahākāruṇikottama | kiṃ talliṅgaṃ kaśca liṅgī loke liṅgaṃ kimucyate || 15 || kathaṃ liṅgaṃ kaśca liṅgaṃ samarcayati śaṅkara | tadvadevānupūrvyeṇa yadi te mayyanugrahaḥ || 16 ||
skandaḥ– itthaṃ devyā purāpṛcchi maheśo bhaktavatsalaḥ | tasyai vā kathayatpuṇyaṃ śipiviṣṭaḥ kathānakam || 17 || niviṣṭahṛdayo devyāmaṣṭamūrtiḥ pratuṣṭimān | uvācāhlādayandevīṃ tacchṛṇuṣva gaṇottamaiḥ || 18 || surendraiśca munīndraiśca gopyametatsanātanam | nākhyeyaṃ kasyacidvāpi jñānahīnāya śāmbhavaiḥ || 19 ||
īśvaraḥ– sāvadhānena deveśi liṅgapūjāvidhikramam | śṛṇvaparṇe praṇayato mayoktaṃ hṛdaye dhara || 20 || nākhyeyaṃ kasyacidvāpi rahasyaṃ mama sarvadhā | layanātsarvajagatāṃ liṅgamityucyate śive || 21 || līnamarthaṃ gamayati tasmāttalliṅgamucyate | lamu krīḍāñca jagato gacchatīti taducyate || 22 || tasmālliṅgaṃ viduḥ prājñā binduhīnaṃ ca tatpriye | arcanaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi hyarcakañca viśeṣataḥ || 23 ||
pṛ0 221) liṅgaṃ guṇatrayāddhīnaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraiḥ | pīṭhapīṭhyādirahitaṃ pūjyapūjāvivarjitam || dhyānadhyeyādirahitaṃ nirguṇaṃ tamasaḥ param | jagajjanmodayāsthānavināśanavivarjitam || oṅkārādyaṃ sapraṇavaṃ trimātrāparivarjitam | bhāvābhāvādirahitaṃ bhāvābhāvavivarjitam || bodhyabodhādirahitaṃ vyāpyavyāpakavarjitam | jñānajñeyajñātṛhīnaṃ khaṇḍākhaṇḍavivarjitam || prabhavābhavasaṃhāratirodhānādivarjitam | dhyānadhyeyādirahitaṃ mahādhyānavidūragam [mamādhyānavidūragamiti pāṭhaḥ |] || 28 || alakṣyalakṣaṇāhīnaṃ gopyagopakavarjitam | na sannāsanna caivāsatsadasaccaiva nāpyasat || sattāmātrādirahitaṃ kevalaṃ svātmadarśanam | bhānābhānavihīnañca svabhāsā bhāsitākhilam || cetṛcetakarāhityaṃ kṣarākṣaravivarjitam | carācaravihīnaṃ ca pramāmeyādivarjitam || 31 || bindunādādikaṃsākṣātsākṣisākṣyādivarjitaṃ [bindunādātigamiti pāṭhaḥ |] | biṃbībiṃbātigaṃ caitatpratibhāsādivarjitam || naiva dṛśyaṃ na cādṛśyaṃ grāhyagrāhakavarjitam | navāgvākyavihīnaṃ ca vācāṃ dūramanaupamam || na mano nāmanaḥprāpyaṃ na prāṇaṃ prāṇabodhakam | na cakṣurūparahitaṃ taddṛśyajñānavarjitam || na śrotraṃ śravaṇāddhīnaṃ tadākāśamanaupamam | na ghrāṇaṃ gandhahīnaṃ ca pṛthivīparivarjitam || na rasaṃ tadapohīnaṃ jihvāsthānādivarjitam | na pāṇipādapāyvādimaruddhīnaṃ śive hi tat || na rūparasagandhādiśabdasparśavivarjitam | naivākāśamanākāśamākāśasyāpi cetakam || na bhūmirbhautikairhīnaṃ ghanabhāvavivarjitam | na tejastejasā hīnaṃ sarvatejaḥpravartakam || na vāyuścalanādhīnaṃ vāyorudbodhakaṃ hi tat | na caitatsalilaṃ sākṣātsaliladravakalpakam || bhūtādvihīnaṃ bhūtādi bhūtādāraṃ sanātanam | apāṇipādavadanamacakṣuśśrutivarjitam || sarvendriyaguṇātītaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam | sarvasya prabhumīśānaṃ sarvasya śaraṇaṃ suhṛt || sarvendriyaguṇaiḥ kāntaṃ nityakāntaṃ sadoditam | navadvāragṛhāntasthadivyapīṭhe pratiṣṭhitam || yadapratiṣṭhaṃ viśvāsyaṃ viśvahastorupādakam | viśvamauliṃ viśvapīṭhaṃ viśvapīṭhatamaḥparam || na tatra kiñcitpratibhāti rūpaṃ yasmātparaṃ nāparamasti kiñcit | vedāntavedyaṃ nirguṇaṃ yadvacogaṃ yato jātaṃ bhuvanaṃ vai vicitram || 44 || yasminliṅge sthitaṃ caitadyasminlīnaṃ jagacchive | yadādhāramidaṃ viśvaṃ triguṇaṃ parivartate || talliṅgaparimāṇaṃ hi kena vaktuṃ hi pāryate | parimāṇādirahitaṃ guṇakhaṇḍatrayātigam ||
pṛ0 222) akhaṇḍamekapiṇḍāṇḍabrahmāṇḍoparitassthitam | na pratiṣṭhā na ca sthānaṃ talliṅgasya maheśvari || nālayasthaṃ maheśāni sarvāvāsyaṃ mahacca tat | sarvabhūtamahākośa garbhāgārasthamambike || 48 || aṇoraṇīyo'pi mahanmahato'pi mahattaram | sarvādhāramanādhāraṃ viśvarūpaṃ prakāśakam || tejomātraṃ svaprakāśaṃ jīveśānādivarjitam | pratyakcaitanyamātmānamānandaghanamadvayam || brahmaviṣṇuharādyutthapīṭhajālavivarjitam | svātmaikavedyaṃ talliṅgaṃ svasminneva pratiṣṭhitam || tadbhūmā paramānandaṃ tatranonāstikiñcana | tasminliṅgedṛṣṭigate dṛgrūpoliṅgatāmiyāt || liṅgo'pyaliṅgo bhavati talliṅgasyaiva śīlanāt | nānye paśyanti talliṅgaṃ nānye jānanti kecana || talliṅgaṃ paramānandaṃ rasahīnaṃ rasātigam | upāsyaṃ sarvadā sarvaistadu nātyeti kiñcana || na tasya mahimā kaścitsvamahimni pratiṣṭhitam | sarvahṛtsaṃsthitaṃ liṅgaṃ nityaṃ sarvaprakāśakam || avasthābhedarahitaṃ māyāgarbhagṛhāntaram | sārvakālikapūjyantatṣaṭtrikālādivarjitam || praviṣṭaṃ svāvṛtatamorāśi svābhānabhāsakam || 57 || na tatra vāṅnamano vā kadācinna cendriya prāṇabhūtādisaṅgaḥ | svayaṃ prabhātaṃ bhāsituṃ no samartho dṛgrūpaṃ tatkevalaṃ bodhahīnam || 58 || jīveśvarau brahmaviṣṇū kadācittalliṅgamevaṃ svahṛddṛṣṭihīnau | kiñcidjñasarvajñavimohamānināvahaṅkāramāyāvivaśāntaraṅgau || 59 || haṃsībhavadvākyajapāmimāṃ vadan jīvo vidhirmohajāleṣu magnaḥ | ahaṅgrahopāsanāśastrajālaissarvajñamevābhimukhe [abhimukheṣu bodha iti yo'tha iti ca pāṭhaḥ |] yuyodham || 60 || viṣṇuṃ tadā ceśvaraprājñamajñaṃ sa cāpyahaṅkāravaśāntarātmā | ahaṃ ca sarveśvara ityathocya yaddṛṣṭaliṅgo'bhyuvāca viddhitam [vidhintamiti pāṭhaḥ |] || 61 || evaṃ ca te yuyudhāte'dyaśāstrairmithyābhūtaiḥ paśya mohāndhakau tau | kadācidaikṣanta vihāya mohaṃ kṣarākṣarau vidhiviṣṇū bhavāni || 62 || vyapetamohau bhavataṃ tadambike dṛṣṭvāhaturliṅgametadvilokya | punaśca māyāprabhavaiśca pāśairmauliṃ mūlaṃ cāsya paśyāva ceti || 63 || nānto na mūlaṃ na ca maulirasya liṅgasya dṛṣṭvoparatau tadā śive |
pṛ0 223) bhūdārahaṃsākṛtidehabhājau stutvā ca liṅge vyaramanta tau tadā || 64 ||
jīveśvarau- kṣarākṣarau tau harivedhasau śive haṃsākhyamantreṇa vibhāvya devam | jñājñāvanīśau yadādṛṣṭaliṅgāvaliṅgamākāśasadharmakau tadā || 65 || vyapetamohāvabhavanta tau tadā hyupādhihīnau na hi kiñcidatra | tadeva liṅgaṃ mama devyaliṅgaṃ na pūjanāyāsaparairnaraiśśive || 66 || kāryaṃ śilādhātujabāṇaliṅge care sthire cāpi viśiṣṭaliṅge | sampūjayedbilvadalairbhavāni bhavāmbudhessantaraṇāya lokaḥ || 67 || talliṃgapūjā na kadācidīdṛśairnaraissurairvāgaṇavipravaryaiḥ | kartuṃ na śakyā vividhairupāyairdānaistaponāśanayādibhiśśive || 68 || samarcanaṃ tatkathaye bhavāni gūḍhaṃ sadā prājñatamaikagamyam | tadarcanaṃ puṇyanaraikalabhyamalabhyamanyairnṛpaśutvadharmaiḥ || 69 || bhūtādhikāraṇadharādharadāraṇena sarvajñarūpahariṇā kiṭirūpakeṇa | kiñcidjñajīvavarahaṃsakabhūtapuṇyapāthojajātavadanaisstutamarcitaṃ ca || 70 || hṛlliṃgamātmakamume manasābhipaśya paśyaṃstadātmakatayā bhavatīva citram || 71 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe ātmaliṃgakathanaṃ nāma aṣṭapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 58 ||
śivagaurīsaṃvāde upaniṣalliṃgakathanaṃ nāma ekonaṣaṣṭhitamo'dhyāyaḥ
īśvaraḥ– ahamīśaśca jīvo'hamityahaṅkāramāninau | tāveva haribrahmāṇau talliṅgādarśakau śive || tanmaulimūlaṃ ca surau so'haṅkāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ | ahaṃ mānābhipannānāṃ nāsti tatpūjanaṃ śive || varṇāśramamahādharmaśramibhistadapūjanam | tatpūjārahitānāṃ tu nāsti muktiḥ kadācana || tatpūjayā vimucyeta nānyathā karmakoṭibhiḥ | surāṇāṃ rūpapūjāto mama liṅgārcanaṃ varam || mama bhautikaliṅgārcā bilvapatrairmaheśvari | talliṃgapūjātmaikyā hi pāramparyakrameṇa ca ||
pṛ0 224) sannipatyopakārādau pravarteta maheśvari | vibhūtidhāraṇaṃ cāpi jñānāṃgatvamudāhṛtam || 6 || rudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ cāpi jñānāṃgatvamudāhṛtam | pañcākṣarajapaścāpi jñānāṃgatvamudāhṛtam || 7 || rudrādhyāyajapaścāpi jñānāṃgatvamudāhṛtam | triṇetramambikāyuktaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ maheśvari || 8 || mannaivedyasya bhuktiśca cittaśudhyai śrutīritam | tadaśyāmeti mantreṇa trigupsāteti mantrataḥ || antarikṣeticṛcāsamprāpto'yaṃ vidhikramaḥ | jābālādharvaṇairmantraiśśikhākaivalyasambhavaiḥ || bhasmarudrākṣaliṃgārcārudrapañcākṣareṣu me | dhyāyīteśeti ca śive śiva eka itīritam || 11 || umāsahāyamityādimantrairdhyānāṃgakalpanaiḥ | sannipatyopakārīṇi hṛlliṃgārādhanāya hi || ijyādānavrataiścāpi varṇāśramanibandhanaiḥ | tadārādupakāraṃ hi na sākṣālliṃgapūjane || 13 || na ceyaṃ prāpyate pūjā pūjyapūjakavarjitā | dhūpadīpādirahitā gandhapuṣpavivarjitā || 14 || pañcāmṛtodasekādinaivedyaparivarjitā | bhāvanāmātrasulabhā durlabhā yogināmapi || 15 || prajñātīrthamahāgaṃgāniṣaṇṇomaunitākhilaḥ | nityaśuddho'hamasmīti snātvāsvātmajalāśaye || svātmajñānamahābhasmoddhūlito dhavalākṛtiḥ | jñānavairāgyabodhodyattripuṇṭrāvalibhāsuraḥ || śāntidāntiyamābhyāsayogarudrākṣamālikaḥ | pañcabhūtamahātatvapañcīkaraṇanirmalaḥ || 18 || pañcakośavidūrodyatpañcākṣaraparāyaṇaḥ | pañcaprāṇamanodharmasarvendriyavivarjitaḥ || 19 || īśo'haṃ brahma paramaṃ vācyavācakavarjitam | dhyāyan svātmaikyavijñānamahānandāmbumagnadhīḥ || gatamohamahāmāyāgarbhadhāmaikasaṃsthitaḥ | svātmaliṃgasthitāpāranirmalajñānavarjitaḥ || 21 || pañcakarmendriyarasapañcagavyaprasecakaḥ | pañcajñānendriyāpārapañcāmṛtaniṣecakaḥ || 22 || akhaṇḍaikyānusandhānarudrāvṛtyā niṣecakaḥ | manolayamahāgandhalepanādiprakāśakam || 23 || sārvātmyabhāvavilasadvastraveṣṭanaveṣṭitam | so'hamasmītyakṣatābhissvātmaliṃgaṃ samarcayet || mahāvākyānusandhānabilvaiḥ puṣpaissamarcayet | caturvedāntasārotthamahāvākyaiśca bhūṣaṇaiḥ || sambhūṣyadehajālotthabhakṣyabhojyanivedanaiḥ | vinivedyāhamasmīti tāmbūlairupacārakaiḥ || svātmabilvādikusumaiḥ paṅkajaiśca samādhijaiḥ | dehajālādirahitapraṇāmaprakramādibhiḥ || mahānandamahādhārāgānaiśca karatālakaiḥ | ahaṃ viśvamabhavamiti gānairnaṭananartanaiḥ || 28 || sarvasaṅgaparityāgachatracāmaradarpaṇaiḥ | sampūjyapūjāpūjyādi pūjakādilayakramaiḥ || 29 || naivāhamasmi kiñcidvai nedaṃ nānātmakaṃ jagat | sampūjyātmānamadrīndratanaye tatprapūjanam ||
pṛ0 225) na pūjānto nāsya śive navodvāsanakalpanam | na kāladeśaniyamo na sādhanaparigrahaḥ || sarvadā sarvabhāvena hyātmaliṅgaṃ prapūjayet | brahmakṣatramidaṃ dṛśyaṃ naivedyaṃ tanniveditam || 32 || bhuktvā sukhamavāpnoti tannivedanabhojanāt | guṇatrayādirahitaṃ triśśaṅkhāmbupibettataḥ || sadāśivo'hamasmīti tannirnodakapānakṛt | evamātmamahāliṅgapūjā te kathitā śive || evaṃ pūjayato nityaṃ pūjyapūjāvivarjitaḥ | pūjakaḥ pūjyatāmeti sadāliṅgamayo bhavet || na pūjānaliṅgaṃ na copāsanādi na vedāntadhārārasāsvādanaṃ hi | na vedapracārotthadharmaikajālaisśivematprasādaikalabhyaṃ kiledam || 36 || na ca prāṇakośaṃ na cānandakośaṃ na vijñānakośaṃ na cānnādikośam | na cāṇurna dīrghaṃ na baddhaṃ na muktaṃ na ca dvaitamekaṃ tvanīśaṃ paraṃ [sadeśamiti maheśamiti ca pāṭhaḥ |] ca || 37 || na ca vyāpakaṃ deśakālādihīnamavasthādihīnaṃ tvaliṅgaṃ rasādi [guṇādīti pāṭhaḥ |] | guṇātītamekaṃ cidānandarūpaṃ ghanaṃ cāpyakhaṇḍaṃ sadākhaṇḍiteṣu || 38 || manovāgatītaṃ tvanādiṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ sadā śuddhabuddhaṃ tvasaṅgaṃ mahāṅgam | sadā liṅgasaṅgaṃ tvaliṃgaṃ sutuṃgaṃ nabhassvāntaraṃgaṃ janānāmasaṃgam || 39 || na puṇyaṃ na pāpaṃ na tajjanmanāśe na cintā nacārtirna tallobhamohau | na vā deśiko naiva śiṣyastadevaṃ na vedāntavādairdurāpaṃ sadāpam || 40 || sahasrāsyahastaṃ sahasrorupādaṃ tadevādhunā pāṇipādāsyahīnam | tathāgandhamekaṃ rasaiścāpi hīna masaṃsparśakaṃ ghrāṇajihvādihīnam || 41 || turīyaṃ tvaśīrṇaṃ śarīreṣu nityaṃ vibhu sarvadehādidharmairvihīnam | tathātmānamiṣṭaṃ kaniṣṭaṃ ca jyeṣṭaṃ priyaṃ vastutassarvabhāgeṣu yuktam || 42 || tadevākhilairbhogajālairvihīnaṃ mahānandasandohadhāmaikasīma | tadevāsmi liṃgaṃ tadevāsmi bhūtaṃ tadetadbhaviṣyaṃ śive vartamānam || 43 || tadevākhilādhārapucchaṃ pratiṣṭhaṃ tadevādya brahma tadeva tvamīśe | tadeveśi tatvaṃ sadā tatvamasmītyahaṃbrahmacāsmīti vākyairdurāpam || 44 || tadevāyamātmeti brahmetyahaṃ vai sadā brahmabhūto bhavedeva brahma |
pṛ0 226) tadūrdhvaṃ hyadhasthāttadeveti devi tadeveśi paścātpurastāttadeva || 45 || tadevādya lokāstathālokalokyā diśo bhūtavargaṃ tathā vedajālam | surāścāsurā bhūsurābhāsuraṃ tatpraviṣṭaṃ samasteṣu niṣṭaṃ viśiṣṭam || 46 || kaniṣṭaṃ viśiṣṭaiśca śiṣṭairdurāpaṃ sadā lokanetre śivau cāpiviṣṭam | tadīyaprasādena vāyurddharitrī tathā sūryacandrādayo vahnayaśca || 47 || vibhātyasya bhāsaiva lokaṃ tvaśeṣaṃ yadajñānato nityametajjaḍaṃ ca | yadudbodhanenāpi sarvaṃ vibhāti yadālokane sarvametaddhipaśyet || 48 || dṛgetaddṛśau naiva rūpaṃ tadetanna dṛśyaṃ tathādarśanaṃ cāpi gauri | na tadjñānamajñānametadvicitraṃ na sūkṣmaṃ na ca sthūlamaṇvādihīnam || 49 || na tatkiñca kenāpi paśyañca jighraṃ na ca sparśagandhādiśabdādihīnam | tadetatsurāṇāṃ hṛdisthaṃ guhāsthaṃ na hi prāṇavācāṃ manasto'pi dūram || 50 || na ca strī na puṃśca na hi klībametadyadā kena kāryeṇa yuktaṃ hi taddhi | na bālaṃ yuvā vai na vṛddhaṃ na dīrghaṃ na ca hrasvadīrghaṃ na kṛṣṇaṃ na pītam || 51 || na vai vartulaṃ naiva tadvai catuṣkaṃ na cordhvaṃ na cādho na tadvistaraṃ hi | tadevādyakhaṇḍaṃ na khaṇḍādihīnaṃ samastāṇḍagaṃ vistṛtaṃ cāṇḍato'pi || 52 || na śuṣkaṃ na cārdraṃ ghanaṃ vāpi devi na kiñcittadeveha paśyāmi liṃgam | yato brahmaviṣṇvindrarudrāḥ prajātā yato vā mahābhūtasaṅghāni devi || 53 || anenaiva jīvanti nityaṃ sadāste jagajjālametanmahālokavargaiḥ | tathānte layaṃ yāti liṃge tvaliṃge tadetadvijijñāsasva brahmatvameva || 54 || yenaiva sarvendriyakalpanā tatā rūpañca cakṣuḥ paripaśyate tat | tadeva liṃgaṃ vimalaṃ prapaśya nānaiva nāsti paridṛśyate tat || 55 || yadaiva vāksarvarasāṃśca vetti rasātigaṃ tatparipaśyaliṃgam | tadeva tacchrotravaraṃ ca divyaṃ śrāvyaṃ śṛṇotīdamevādya liṃgam || 56 || yadeva cāghrāti sugandhametattadeva liṅgaṃ paripaśya devi | yatraiva tvaksparśamathaiva vetti tadeva liṃgaṃ mama devi paśya || 57 ||
pṛ0 227) yadeva [yenaiva ceti pāṭhaḥ |] ca prāṇiti prāṇivargaṃ buddhyādi yadbodhayate'dya liṃgam | pāṇyaṅghripāyuprajanādikeṣu visargajānandacalaṃ ca dharmam || 58 || talliṃgametaddhi vijānate janā mano mano yacca tadeva liṃgam | yathaiva nadyassaramāṇāssamudraṃ velātigā nāmarūpe vihāya || 59 || talliṃgasandarśanato naro bhavennāmātigo rūpaguṇātigaśca | tadeva liṃgaṃ dhvanibinduvarṇaṃ mātrākalātītaguṇātigañca || 60 || omomiti prāṇavarge ca vade vedāntasaṅghe ca vadatyabhīkṣṇam | īśānavāsyaṃ hi tadeva liṃgaṃ pūrṇāttathā pūrṇataraṃ supūrṇam || 61 || yadā tamastanna divā na rātrirna sanna cāsatsadatītaliṃgam | tadakṣaraṃ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ prajñā ca tasmātprasṛtā purāṇī || 62 || bhāvagrāhyaganīḍaṃ tadbhāvābhāvakaraṃ hi tat | kalāsargagataṃ liṃgaṃ ye viduste juhustanum || svabhāvameke vadantīśaliṃgaṃ kālaṃ tathānye parimuhyamānāḥ | liṅgasyaitanmahimānamiti vītaśoko jñātvā liṅgaṃ śāntimatyantameti || 64 || yasminliṅge adhiviśve niṣeduryasminnidaṃ sañcavicaiti viśvam | yasmādbabhūva bhuvanasyāsya gopāḥ prajñāpatirbhūtavargaikakartā || 65 || yalliṅgametadbhavanaṃ vicakrame tasyāṃśataḥ pādamidaṃ hi viśvam | aṇoraṇīyānmahato mahīyāṃstadeva liṃgaṃ nihitaṃ guhāyām || 66 || tadeva liṃgaṃ paśyati vītaśoko dhātuḥ prasādānmahimānamīśam || 67 || bhidyate hṛdayagranthiśchidyante sarvasaṃśayāḥ | karmāṇi tasya naśyanti liṃge dṛṣṭe parāvare || talliṃgaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiścetanānāñca cetanam | tatra ko mohaḥ kaśśokastalliṃgamanupaśyataḥ || taddarśanavihīnānāṃ vipadassyurbhave bhave | janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhairabhibhūtā hi nityaśaḥ || ānandaṃ tasya liṃgasya jñātvā bibhyennajātucit | talliṃgadarśanānandamātrājjīvanti sarvaśaḥ || apāṇipādaṃ talliṃgaṃ manaso'tajjavīya hi | sthānakālātigaṃ yacca sa evādyassa īśvaraḥ || talliṃgavettā tarati śokametatsanātanam | tadeva jānathaivaikaṃ liṃgametanmanassthitam || 73 ||
pṛ0 228) dhyātavyaṃ dhyānahīnaṃ ca dhyeyadhyānādivarjitam | jñānajñeyādirahitaṃ nāmarūpavivarjitam || anantamahimādhāramapratiṣṭhitavaibhavam | ajātametattalliṃgaṃ kaściddhīraḥ prapaśyati || 75 || talliṃgaṃ sarvato vaktraṃ jvālājaṭilitākhilam | yadā carmavadākāśaṃ veṣṭayiṣyanti mānavāḥ || tadā talliṃgamajñātvā duḥkhasyānto bhaviṣyati | nāntaḥ prajñaṃ hi talliṃgaṃ nobhayaprajñameva ca || na prajñaiva ca talliṃgaṃ nāprajñaṃ caitadīśvari | adṛśyaṃ caiva talliṃgamagrāhyaṃ tatsadaiva hi || 78 || ekātmapratyayaṃ liṃgaṃ prapañcopaśamaṃ hi tat | talliṃgajñā ime lokāstalliṃge līyate'khilam || talliṃge layanāddevi tajjalānīti te jaguḥ | tadvedādau svaraṃ liṃgaṃ vedānte ca pratiṣṭhitam || talliṃgaprakṛtaulīnābrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | tadbrahmatacchivassākṣāttadviṣṇustadvirāṭ svarāṭ || samrāḍviśveśi talliṃgaṃ taddṛśyaṃ sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ | hṛdā paśyanti talliṃgaṃ manasaiva manīṣiṇaḥ || śravaṇāyāpi talliṃgaṃ na labdhaṃ bahubhiśśive | śṛṇvanto'pi śive liṃgaṃ na vidurbahavo'pi ye || āścaryavatpaśyati kaścidetadāścaryavacchṛṇute taccaliṃgam | āścaryavadbodhate yaṃ tathānye hyāścaryavatpaśyati taccaliṃgam || 84 || na prāṇena nāpānena liṃgahīno na jīvati || 85 || ajāmekāṃ lohitaśuklakṛṣṇāṃ bahvīṃ prajāṃ janayantīṃ sarūpām | ajo liṃgī juṣamāṇo'nuśete jahātyenāṃ liṃgasaṃsthassa ātmā || 86 || talliṃgamāre draṣṭavyaṃ śrotavyaṃ vedaparvataiḥ | purīśayaṃ ca talliṃgaṃ sarvabhūteṣu saṃsthitam || 87 || kohyevānyāccakaḥ prāṇyālliṃgahīnomaheśvari | rasohyeṣamahāliṃgaṃ raseṣo'mbike sadā || 88 || etaddhi paramānandaṃ liṃgametatsvayaṃ prabham || 89 || yasmātparaṃ nāparamasti kiñcidyasmānnāṇīyo na jyāyo'sti kiñcit | vṛkṣa iva stabdhandivi tiṣṭhati liṃgamekaṃ tenedaṃ pūrṇaṃ liṃgabhāsaikasarvam || 90 || liṃgādvāco nivartante hyaprāpya manasā saha | tadatyatiṣṭhaddevi brahmāṇḍordhvāṅgulaṃ tatam || tasminbhāti svayaṃ liṃgaṃ candrasūryāgnayo na hi | bhāti tattejasā vyāptaṃ jagadetaccarācaram || yathā kṣetrajñavihitaṃ hi bhūmau guhāhitaṃ tacca liṃgaṃ mahāntam | hiraṇyaṃ na vindanti cordhvaṃ carantastathedaṃ prapaśyāmbike liṃgametat || 93 || jāgratsvapnasuṣuptīṣu yalliṃgaṃ manasā tatam | tadetadahamiti jñātvā liṃgī liṃgātigo bhavet ||
pṛ0 229) yathorṇanābhissṛjate tantujālaṃ gṛhṇāti vaktreṇa tathātti sarvam | tathā jagajjālamidaṃ hi liṃgato bhavatyato'nte vilayaṃ prayāti || 95 || brahmaiva talliṃgamidaṃ sanātanaṃ svavidyayā saṃsarate ca mucyate | tadetalliṃgaṃ tapasā veditavyaṃ nānyairdharmaistacca liṃgaṃ tvaliṃgam || 96 || tadeva liṃgaṃ tvavimukte niviṣṭaṃ bhūtātigaṃ viśvanāthābhidhaṃ ca | vārāṇasyāṃ bhrūyuge sanniviṣṭaṃ yogaiḥ paśyanti tatra te cotkramanti || 97 || tatraiva teṣāṃ tārakaṃ copadeśamoṅkārādyaṃ praṇavaṃ brahmamantram | na tasya prāṇo'nutkramatīva devi talliṃgasaṃgaṃ bhavatītyaliṃgam || 98 || tatrāvimukte copāsyaṃ talliṃgaṃ mahimātigam | tatrāśaktasya deveśi bhautikaṃ bhuvimuktidam || sandṛśyaṃ cakṣuṣā martyaiḥ kramāttanmuktidāyakam | tasminneke tate liṃge tvantareṇa bhavedbhayam || tatparādādidaṃ liṃgamastibrahmeti vākyataḥ | tadetadbrahma paramamātmaliṃgaṃ sanātanam || 101 || vedā yatraiva vedāntairnivṛttā yatra liṃgake | hṛtpuṇḍarīkaṃ virajaṃ talliṃgaṃ bhāsate'niśam || kañca khañcaiva talliṃgaṃ sarvavyāpi nirāmayam | ānandaghanamadvaitaṃ caturthaṃ manasaḥ [tamasaḥ paramiti ca pāṭhaḥ |] param || daharādvistaraṃ tacca sūryamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam | candrakoṭisahasrābhaṃ taddṛśyaṃ sarvadhā śive || 104 || yogenātmānusandhānairvītamohabhayaissadā || 105 || vedāntavijñānasuniścitārthaissanyāsayogairyatibhiśśuddhabuddhaiḥ | teṣāmevaitadvirajaṃ liṃgadhāma prāpyaprāpteścāvidūraṃ śive'dya || 106 || naiṣā tarkeṇa matirāpaneyā kṣuropamaṃ liṃgametaddhi satyam | ṛco akṣare parame tatpraviṣṭaṃ sargādihīnaṃ mahāliṃgametat || 107 || surādyairdurāpaṃ tathāyogibhiḥ karmabhiścāpyavaśyam | talliṃgatyāgena sarvadhā vītamoho bhavatyavaśyaṃ śrutiguhyametat || 108 || yo nāvirato duścaratitānnāśānto nāsamāhitaḥ | tasyaitaddurlabhaṃ liṃgamāsaktasyaiva sarvagam || 109 || yeṣāṃ na jihmamanṛtaṃ sadaiva teṣāṃ liṃgaṃ hṛdi bhātyeva śāntam |
pṛ0 230) ato liṃgaṃ pūjayedātmakāmo na kāmakāmī liṃgapūjādhikārī || 110 || etadarthaṃ gūḍhatamaṃ maheśi nānye vindanti jñānaniṣṭhā hi bhūyaḥ | na vā deśiko naiva śiṣyaḥ kadācinna pūjā na pūjyo na vā pūjakatvam || svadoṣātpradoṣo'pi nāstyeva liṃge jagannaiva śeṣaṃ viśeṣādbhavāni | mahāśeṣabhūṣāviśeṣo'pinātra sadoṣākarāpāramaulirna caiva || 112 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe śivagaurīsaṃvāde upaniṣalliṃgakathanaṃ nāma ekonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 59 ||
skandastutirnāma ṣaṣṭhitamo'dhyāyaḥ
īśvaraḥ– śṛṇu vakṣyāmi te devi hitamātyantikaṃ śive | yatproktaṃ pūjanaṃ devi surāṇāñca nṛṇāṃ sadā || 1 || sā pūjānantaphaladā janmakarmapraṇāśinī | saṃvideva parā pūjā sā tu tasyāṃ manolayaḥ || 2 || sādhāraṇānāṃ sā pūjā hyavyaktātīva durghaṭā | matprasādena deveśi pacelimatapaḥphalaiḥ || 3 || yogairyāgaiśca tapasā mahānandakadambakaiḥ | bhasmaniṣṭhasya satataṃ rudrāvartanaśīlinaḥ || 4 || bhasmatripuṇṭrayuktasya sadā rudrākṣadhāriṇaḥ | pañcākṣaraparasyaiva sadā liṅgārcakasya ca ca || 5 || bilvapatrairmahādevi pradoṣe pūjakasya mām | naktāśanārcanadhyānacaturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca || 6 || somavāravratācārayuktasya niyatasya ca | matkṣetravāsino devi hyavimuktaratasya ca || 7 || viśveśvarārcakasyāsya surasya ca narasya ca | tathā mahālaye puṇye rudrakoṭau maheśvari || 8 || kālañjare prabhāse'pi puṣkare'marakaṇṭake | piṇḍārake kurukṣetre mahākāle maheśvare || 9 || devadāruvane puṇye naimiṣe citrakūṭake | kedāre kāmade puṇye vaidyanāthe maheśvari || 10 || śrīśaile ca tathoṅkāre tathā veṇuvane śive | āvaṭaṅke somanāthe gokarṇe tryambake girau || śrīmaddakṣiṇakailāse tathaikāmravane mama | vṛddhādrāvaruṇādrau ca tathā goparvate śive || 12 || hṛtpuṇḍarīke gūḍhe ca japyeśe śvetakānane | gajāraṇye ratnagirau śrīkaṇṭhe mātṛparvate || 13 || koṭikāyāṃ maṃgale ca puṇye drutivane'pi ca | kumbhaghoṇe'rjune caiva śrīsundaragirau tathā || 14 || mādhavī tejinī devī kṣīriṇī kānane tathā | śamīvane bilvavane ghaṭeśe brahmakānane || 15 ||
pṛ0 231) chāyāvane ca śrīvāñchye tathā vedavane śive | valmīke vātapuryāñca setau vai gandhamādane || hālāsye śālikavane gajaśaile mahendrake | vasataḥ puṇyaśīlasya naktāśanaratasya ca || 17 ||
