saṃvasaddvādaśābdaṃ tu bhasmanoddhūlitasya ca | kasyacidbhāgyanivahairjñānantallabhyate mama || 18 || bahubhirjanmabhirdevi matprasādayutasya ca | vairāgyabhaktiyuktasya cātmaliṃgārcane matiḥ || jāyate puṇyapākena cittaśuddhyanusārataḥ | jāyate janmanāśāya nṛṇāmatyantadurlabham || nānācāravihārāṇāṃ viṣayāsaktacetasām | vāñchā na jāyate devi kasyacitkvacideva hi || bahujanmasahasreṣu tiryaksthāvarajaṃgamaiḥ | janmabhiḥ puṇyanicayairyuktasya puruṣasya ca || 22 || matprasādena vijñānaṃ jāyate nānyathā śive | madhyānadhārāmodādiyuktasya niratasya ca || adharvaśiraso'dhyāyaśikhājapayutasya ca | jābālaśrutiniṣṭhasya śāmbhavasya viśeṣataḥ || kaivalyakālarudrādijāpino brāhmaṇasya ca | rudrāvartanaśīlasya bhasmaniṣṭhasya me sadā || jñānaṃ vijāyate gauri kasyacicchivayoginaḥ | yatatāmapi śaivānāṃ kaścinmāṃ vetti tatvataḥ || majjñānasādhanaṃ devi nṛṇāmatyantadurlabham | māṃ dhyāyeddhṛdayāgārapadmasaṃsthaṃ caturbhujam || mṛgaṭaṅkadharaṃ saumyaṃ saccidānandavigraham | śuddhakarpūrasārācchakundendudhavalaprabham || 28 || mukuṭodbhāsicandrāṅkaṃ gaṃgāmalakapardakam | bhujaṃgarājavalayamahārhamaṇibhūṣaṇam || 29 || divyānekamaṇivrātacitasihmāsanasthitam | triṇetraṃ nīlakaṇṭhañcāpīndudhāmasamānanam || umayā sahitaṃ dhyāyetkṣaṇaṃ vātha kṣaṇārdhakam | so'hamīśaśśivassākṣādahaṃ rudro harirvidhiḥ || ahamindro'nalo vāyuryamo'haṃ varuṇo'ryamā | candraḥ kubero maruto hyaśvinau maruto'rkakāḥ || skando vighneśvaraścaiva nandikeśādayo gaṇāḥ | sarveṣāṃ janitā cāhaṃ matta evādya nirgatāḥ || mayaiva vidhaye dattā vedāssarve sanātanāḥ | mayaiva viṣṇave dattaṃ sahasrāraṃ sudarśanam || 34 || ahameveti vijñāya dhyāyenmadrūpamaiśvaram | evaṃ hi dhyāyatāṃ devi majjñānaṃ jāyate nṛṇām || athavā devamīśānaṃ māṃ dhyāyetsūryamaṇḍale | hiraṇyabāhumāśāsyaṃ hiraṇyaśmaśrumīśvaram || hiraṇyavarṇaṃ deveśi hyambikāpatimīśvaram | sarvagranthivimokṣāya tajjñānaṃ jāyate nṛṇām || yogena vāpi niyamayamāsanayutasya ca | recake pūrayedvāyuṃ pūrakeṇātha pūrayet || 38 || kumbhake kumbhavaddhīmāndhārayedghaṭikātrayam | yogāgnidagdhakāyotthamalasyāmalacetasaḥ || nīhāradhūmasaṃvidyutsphaṭikojvaladīpavat | jyotirvibhāsate devi hṛdi pūritavāyubhiḥ ||
pṛ0 232) prāṇāyāmena satataṃ tannīvāraśikhena hi | so'haṃ jyotirmahānātmā hyasaṃgaḥ puruṣaśśivaḥ || āpādamastakaṃ dehaṃ vyāpya sarveṣvasthitaḥ | yo māṃ yogena jānāti svātmārāmaṃ maheśvaram || tasya siddhyanti niyataṃ siddhayo'ṣṭau maheśvari | tasya mūrdhni mahānātmāsahasradalapaṅkaje || gostanākāravaddhārā hyamṛtaikarasasravā | vyapohya tatkapālantu ceḍāyāṃ santatasravā || 44 || piṅgalā kuṇḍalīmadhyātpatantī śikhimastake | vaiśvānaro'yaṃ sarveṣu madrūpo dehiṣu sthitaḥ || tatra candrāmṛtakaraiḥ piṅgalāyāṃ maheśvari | sa ātmajyotirānando nityamukto maheśvaraḥ || sadā krīḍannabhomadhyaṃ daharākāśagassadā | cetayāmīndriyagaṇaṃ vācā ca manasā saha || parāpaśyāvaikharīṣu praṇavādirasastvaham | so'hamāvasathātītaḥ puruṣo'haṃ purīśayaḥ || aliṅgo'smyahamātmā ca suratiryaṅnareṣu ca | nāmarūpātigassākṣādahaṅkāravivarjitaḥ || rasyastatkṛtakarmāṇiviṣayānvaiṣikaṃ sukham | ṣoḍaśākhyakalā devi hyekojānāmi sarvaśaḥ || tāssarvāpi kalā devi mayi dyotanti nityaśaḥ | mantāboddhārasayitā jñātā vijñāna īśvaraḥ || śruteśśrotā tathāghrātā dṛgdṛṣṭyādyahameva [dṛṣṭerdraṣṭā iti ca pāṭhaḥ |] hi | yathā kūrmamahāgrīvā hrasvadīrghā bhavecchive || yathā nadyassyandamānā nāmarūpaguṇātigāḥ | samudre'staṃ prayāntīśe yathā te bhānudīptayaḥ || punaryathodayaṃ prāpte sūryasyeva marīcayaḥ | prasaranti mahādevi tathā matsannidhau jagat || padmaṃ mitrakarairyadvadvikasatyabjinīkulam | yathā maṇijasānnidhyācceṣṭante lohasūcayaḥ || kālakarmavipākena tathā matsannidhau jagat | ceṣṭate nitarāṃ devi sthitisaṃhārajanmataḥ || so'haṃ sṛṣṭvā praviśyaiva tannāmaguṇarūpataḥ | brahmaviṣṇuharākhyābhiryathāpūrvaṃyugeyuge || 57 || sṛjāmyātmānamevāgre tato nānāvidhaṃ jagat | yathāgnervisphuliṃgā vaikṣudrāssambhavati priye || indro mitro'tha varuṇaḥ pūṣā somo'hamevahi | manavaḥ pitaroviprāstārājālaṃgrahāstathā || sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ caitadahameva sanātanaḥ | sarvassarvaśarīreṣu sarvendriyaguṇātigaḥ || 60 || sarvabhoktāhamevāsmi sarvakāryakṛtāspadaḥ | nāhaṃ tajjanmamaraṇaissthitisaṃgeṣvasajjakaḥ || asaṃgonaivalipto'smisarvabāhyāntarastvaham | ekastathāntarassarvaduḥkhahīno'smiśaṅkari || evaṃ māṃ yo vijānāti sohaṃso me hṛdantaraḥ | tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sacamena praṇaśyati || yogasāṅkhyau mahādevi [mayā devi tavoktau iti ca pāṭhaḥ |] tathoktau mama hṛttamau | sarvasādhāraṇaṃ devi kathayiṣye'pyupāsanam ||
pṛ0 233) aliṃgo'smyahamīśāno liṃge tiṣṭhāmi sarvadā | yathā gavi gataṃkṣīraṃ viṣāṇādau na dṛśyate || ūdhasyeva pradṛśyeta tathāhaṃ sarvavāsyapi | hṛdiddhyātumaśaktānāṃ jñānayogena vai śive || liṃge kṛtāṃ parāṃ pūjāṃ śāmbhavairbhasmadhāribhiḥ | matpuṇṭranirataireva rudrākṣavarakaṅkaṇaiḥ || rudrādhyāyādhyayanataḥ pañcākṣarajapena ca | ekaṃ vā bilvapatraṃ yairnikṣiptaṃ mama mastake || bhaktairgṛhṇāmi taddaivi tasmai jñānaṃ dadāmi ca | taṃ jñānabhājanaṃ kuryāṃ pratijñā mama śaṅkari || nānyavarṇāśramairdharmairvividhairapi me śive | naiva tuṣṭirmama parā jāyate karmakoṭibhiḥ || 70 || na ṣoḍaśamahādānairekāhāhīnasatrakaiḥ | prapāvāpīpradānairvā kanyānnādipradānataḥ || 71 || kathañcijjāyate devi madarcāyāmmatirbhavet | puṇṭrāntareṣu vipreṣu maskarīṇāṃ gaṇeṣu ca || naiva prītirmahādevi yathā matpuṇṭradhāriṣu | bhasmadhāryeva satataṃ madjñānasyaiva bhājanam || śivaliṃgārcanadhyānarudrādhyāyajapeṣu ca | pañcākṣarajapaiścaiva mama kṣetranivāsakaḥ || 74 || bhasmatripuṇṭradhāryeva svīkāryonānya ucyate | ūrdhvapuṇṭraṃ bhrameṇāpi na kuryānmohato dvijaḥ || pratyuto narakāyaiva tasya sarvamanuṣṭhitam | yadi kuryātpramādena pitṛbhissapatedadhaḥ || 76 || ūrdhvapuṇṭrāṅkitaṃ dṛṣṭvā mīlayāmyadya locane | matprasādālokanena tajjñānaṃ jāyate śive || yannetre [yannimīlanataḥ iti ca pāṭhaḥ |] mīlite devi kathaṃ jñānaṃ bhaviṣyati | liṃgaṃ kailāsamaulau me kailāseśvarasaṃjñitam || devatiryaṅmanuṣyādyairadṛśyamapi kāmadam | smaraṇādeva sānnidhyaṃ yatra kutrāpi siddhidam || etalliṃgasya mahimā vedairnajñāta eva hi | surāsuraiśca manubhirgaṇendrairapi śaṅkari || 80 || kailāseśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu liṃgaṃ muktipradāyakam | liṃgarājamidaṃ devi brahmaivedaṃ sanātanam || mamaiva hṛdayānandadāyakaṃ svargamokṣadam | saṃsārasāgarāpāratārakaṃ bhavabheṣajam || 82 || vedāntasārasarvasvametalliṃgavaraṃ śive | na kasyacinmayā khyātaṃ nākhyeyaṃ yasya kasyacit || etalliṃgaprabhāvena jagatsṛṣṭiṃ vitanvate | vidhātārassarveva kalpe kalpe svasūnubhiḥ || devatiryaṅnarākārasamurvīsarito vanam | lokā lokyāśca deveśi vidhātādyaṃ [vidhātādyantane'piceti pāṭhaḥ |] tanoti ca || viṣṇavaḥ pratikalpaṃ vai caitalliṃgaprabhāvataḥ | daityeśvarānnihantāro mahatāmalacakrataḥ || vaikuṇṭhavāsinassarve te lakṣyāḥ patayaśśive | pratikalpaṃ tathā rudrāste gauryāḥpatayo'mbike || etalliṃgaprabhāvena pralaye saṃharantyapi | jagajjālaṃ tathā śūlairvṛkṇaṃ sāsuramānuṣam || 88 ||
pṛ0 234) sendrāśca manavaścaiva ṛṣibhiḥ pitṛbhiśśive | etalliṃge layaṃ yānti pratikalpaṃ surāsurāḥ || jagadbrahmāṇḍajālaiśca sarvādhāramidaṃ śive | rūpaṃ saṅkocya me divyaṃ mahānte pralaye śive || tvayā gaṇavarairdevi skandaherambapūrvakaiḥ | nivasāmi sadā liṃge kailāseśvarasaṃjñite || aliṃgoliṃgasaṃstho'haṃ sṛjāmi visṛjāmi ca | jagajjālamidaṃ devi brahmaviṣṇvīśapūrvakam || saṃharāmi tathaivānte līleyaṃ mama śaṅkari | ātmakrīḍa ātmaratissṛṣṭisthityantakārakaḥ || kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāñca patīnāṃ patirīśvaraḥ | cetanaścetanānāṃ ca nityo'haṃ parameśvari || sakāraṇo'haṃ kāraṇādhipādhipo mamaiva kaścijjanako nahīśvari | kālātmayuktānyadhitiṣṭhatīśo [adhitapyāmi īśaḥ iti ca pāṭhaḥ |] guṇī sarvajñassarvabhūtādhivāsaḥ || 95 || etatte kathitaṃ devi rahasyārthaprakāśakam | na deyaṃ guhyamapyetadbhakteṣu pratipādaya || 96 || rahasyāṃśamidaṃ śaivamādimaṃ parameśvari | guhyajñānamidaṃ subhru rahasyajñānasaṅgraham || 97 || na prakāśyamidaṃ bhadre kasyaciddhelayāmbike | idaṃ rahasyaṃ vedānāmanantānāṃ sanātanam || devādīnāṃ munīnāṃ ca gaṇānāñca prakāśitam | tava hārdrena deveśi rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ mayā || hṛdi dhāryaṃ sadā devi gopyādgopyamanuttamam | prathamaśśivaratnābdhirahasyasyāṃśa uttamaḥ || karṇabhūṣāmaṇiste'dya kathitastu sugopyatām | satyaṃ satyaṃ punassatyamuddhṛtya bhujamucyate ||
skandaḥ– ityuktvā girijāṃ devassamāliṃgya maheśvaraḥ | kailāsamaulau śivayā vijahāra yathāsukham ||
devyuvāca– vastrādhautavidhau sahasrakaratā puṣpārpaṇe viṣṇutā gandhe gandhavatā [gandhavahāptatānnapacane iti ca pāṭhaḥ |] mahānnapacane barhirmukhādhyakṣatā | pātre kāñcanagartatāsti bhagavankāruṇyavārānnidhe śuśrūṣāṃ karavāṇi te paśupate svāmiṃstrilokīguro || 103 || gaṇḍūṣāmbunimajjanāya hṛdabhūdgaṅgāvataṃsasya [yadabhūditi pāṭhaḥ |] te cūḍālaṅkṛtikalpanāya vidhṛtaṃ jyotissudhādhāma te |
pṛ0 235) tṛptyai bhakṣitaśeṣamāmiṣamapi trailokyakukṣimbhare vidyādhīśamṛte tava stutiriyaṃ vāṇī laghiṣṭhāpi me || 104 ||
sūtaḥ– śrutvā cātha maheśasundaramahākailāsaliṃgālayā- pārāvāramahāghasaṃsṛtibharaṃ vahnyāptatūlādrivat | pāpādriḥ praśamaṃ prayāti sukṛtāṃ rāśiḥ paraṃ vardhate śaivasyaitadapāravarṇanakathāśśambhormudeśāṅkarāḥ || 105 || agaṇitaguṇagarbhapuṇyajālaissurajālairamṛtaissuradrusālaiḥ | kalahaṃsakulairvilāsaśīlairna viśeṣo'sti triviṣṭape'pi puṃsām || 106 || śrotṝṇāmidameva sundaramahāśaivaikasāraṃ madhu nānāsaṃsṛtidharmabhārakathayā samprāpnuyādvā phalam | kiṃ citraṃ kṣaṇamātramapyagasutākāntābjapādādaro nakrākāramahāghasaṃsṛtibharaṃ na prāpnuyājjātucit || 107 ||
skandaḥ– śrīmatkailāsamaulau tribhuvanajanakādviśrutāpāradhīrā- saṃsārāsārakārāgṛhagatajanatākāmapādārgalānām | devyā muktyai svayuktyā satataparicitāpādabaddhena premṇā vedānandaikasīmā [vidyānandaika iti pāṭhaḥ |] duritabhavanadītāraṇe [taskarāste varākāḥ iti ca pāṭhaḥ |] saiva naukā || 108 || puṃsāmāryaikadhuryāḥ kathitaśivakathāpānthakāssāmparāye jaigīṣavyakṛte maheśahṛdayānnissāritaṃ yanmadhu | devyā tatkaruṇādareṇa kathitaṃ mahyaṃ taduktaṃ mayā śaivaṃ divyarahasyamadbhutatamaṃ vedāntasāre sthitam || pītvā tundilamānasāśśivapadaṃ dhyāyantu muktyai sadā || 109 ||
pṛ0 236) jaigīṣavyaḥ– iṣṭāniṣṭasamastavastuviṣayavyāvṛttaceto'smyahaṃ niṣṭīvopamakaṣṭatuṣṭajanakaṃ manye paraṃ viṣṭapam | kiṃtviṣṭaṃ śipiviṣṭakaṣṭaharaṇīcitrāṣṭamūrteḥ kathā- śśrotuṃ meduradṛṣṭakoṭiharaṇaṃ tuṣṭaṃ prasannaṃ manaḥ || 110 || mattānaṃgakarīndradāraṇamahāsihmopamasyeśvara- syārcādhūtasamastapātakatateḥ prāptaṃ na kiñcinmama | svecchecchasya niraṅkuśasya jagatāṃ varṇāśramo'pyāśramaḥ kiṃ vā me tava vaktrapadmajamahāśambhoḥ kathāssundarāḥ || 111 || pāyaṃ pāyamapāyajanmarahito modāmi nṛtyāmi ca || 112 || pāpoddāmakrauñcabhaṃge tvameko jitvānaghaprastutaṃ śambhubhaktyā | tvaddarśanātsudinaṃ suprabhātamaiśīḥ kathāśśaktihasto'hi śūraḥ || 113 || viṣayā viṣasannibhā mama pratibhāntīśvarapādasevanāt | bhavatā bhavatāpasantateḥ parihīnā munayo'pyamī gṛhasthāḥ [kṛtārthāḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] || 114 || śivatatvaprabhavotthaharṣavarṣaiḥ pariṣiktā munayassurā gaṇāśca | gururasmākamaho'si bhāgyavargaistava deyaṃ kimataḥ praṇāmato'nyat || 115 ||
munayaḥ– ṣaḍvaktrāmalapadmasaṅghajanitāśśambhoḥ kathāḥ pāvanā- nasmāntsaṅkurute dayārasabharaissaṃsārabhārālasān | śāṃgasyāsya munessamāgamavaśātprāptā vimukteḥ phalaṃ kiñcitraṃ bhagavaṃstriṇetrajakathāsāraiḥ pavitrā vayam || 116 ||
gaṇāḥ– śramibhiḥ kila tendumaulicaraṇadhyānārcakaistvanmukhā- dāśrāvyotkaṭabhaktibhāṃvasurasāśśambhoḥ kathāḥ pāvanīḥ |
pṛ0 237) nau kailāsanivāsasaukhyadhurimā gaṇyo na kiñcitprabho tvadvaktrāmaladarśanena sutarāṃ tṛpyāmahe kevalam || 117 || skandaḥ tvadvaktrapadmāmalamadhujharīplāvitāssmo munīndrā- śśailendrāvaraṇottamatvacivihitāpāravṛtteḥ kathābhiḥ | śambhoḥ pumbhāvamuktyai kalitakalimalāsphāramādyajjanogha- dhvāntabhrāntyutthadāvapraśamanaśamanāgādhaduḥkhāpanutyai || 118 ||
viṣṇubrahmeśvarāḥ– sṛṣṭisthityantakāryaissatataparicitāpāraduḥkheṣu magnā lagnāḥkarmajapāpatāpamanaso janmādiduḥkhāspadāḥ | śāntāḥ prāpya bhavatpadāmbujotthasaraṇiṃ mukteḥ kimanyaddhi naḥ || 119 || santuṣṭuvuḥ kumāraṃ te gaṇāssuramunīśvarāḥ | praṇamya muditāssarve śṛṇudhvaṃ tatstutiṃ dvijāḥ ||
devādyāḥ– śaraṇātula mātulagādhipate karuṇākara kāmada kāmahantaḥ | śarakānanasambhavacāruruce paripālaya tārakamāraka naḥ || 121 || harasārasamudbhavahaimavatīkarapallavalālita kamratano | puravairimukundahṛdambunidhe paripālaya tārakamāraka naḥ || 122 || śaradindusamānaṣaḍānanāpārasarasīruhalocanayā vilocanayā | nirupādhikayā nijabālatayā paripālaya tārakamāraka naḥ || 123 || girijāsuta sāyakabhinnagire surasindhutanūja suvarṇaruce | śikhijāta śikhāvalavāhagate paripālaya tārakamāraka naḥ || 124 || jaya viprajanapriya vīramanojaya bhaktaparāyaṇa bhadranamo | jaya śākhaviśākhakumāra namo paripālaya tārakamāraka naḥ || 125 || purato bhava me parito bhava me pathi me bhagavanbharakṣatāntam [bhararakṣanamaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ |] | vitarāgiṣu me vijayin bhagavan paripālaya tārakamāraka naḥ || 126 ||
pṛ0 238) iti kukkuṭaketumanusmaratāṃ paṭhatāmapiṣaṇmukhaṣaṭkamidam | namatāmabhinandanamindubhṛto na kṣayaṃ kvacidasti śarīriṇām || 127 ||
sūtaḥ– aṇussthāṇurveṇupratinibhasumodyajjagadidaṃ mahābhānuścāyaṃ tuhinagirirāste hi hitakṛt | himāṃśuṃ svarbhānurbhagavatajanānāñca hi mude samīcīnenedaṃ divi vitatacitraikavasati || 128 || jāte pādābhighāte calati mahitale savyathe bhogināthe sākrande dantibṛnde viluṭhati kamaṭhe cañcale śailajāle | nādonnidre samudre nadaramaṇasutānāyake jāgarūke sāścaryatrāsadhurye tribhuvanamadhunā paśya me tāṇḍavaṃ tvam || 129 || pāyādāyāsakhedakṣubhita phaṇiphaṇāratnaniryatnanirya- cchāyāmāyāpataṅgadyutimuditaviyadvāhinīcakravākam | aśrāntaśrāntacūḍātuhinakarakarālīkanālīkanāla- cchedāmodānudhāvaddruhiṇarathakhagaṃ dhūrjaṭestāṇḍavaṃ me || 130 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśe skandastutirnāma ṣaṣṭhitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 60 ||
iti śrīśivarahasye prathamāṃśassamāptaḥ || 1 ||
śrīśivarahasyaprathamāṃśasya śuddhāśuddhapatrikā|
